title: Cardtographer
description:
Cardtographer is a stylized 3D-Graphics Roguelike Deckbuilder, in which you choose one or more Champions to fight the evil, which has overcome the lands.

During your adventure your chosen champions gain gold and experience during the fights and enhance their deck to overcome their opposing enemy finally.

You also can ally with your frineds in online coop.

title: Satisfaction Drone
description:
The party has ended.

Orion & Artemis, an odd pair consisting of a large cyborg and her still-human friend, go home together after a pleasant night out. Orion is wrapped around Artemis’s little finger once again. But what happens when she’s wound too tight?

SATISFACTION DRONE is a short & messy kinetic story with uncomfortable friends-with-benefits lesbianism and semiviolent robot sex. Adults only!

title: World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24 Gold Edition
description: iRacing presents the Official Game of The World of Outlaws, featuring the World of Outlaws Sprint Car, Late Models and Super DIRTcar Big Block Modifieds, as well as 8 additional series including the all-new Micro Sprints, and many others.

title: Bumble Brawlers
description: Bumble Brawlers is an exhilarating top-down shooter that lets you dive into chaotic battles with fully customizable characters, unique companions, and powerful upgrades. Enter a world where survival is your only goal as you navigate dungeons, face endless enemy waves, and conquer a series of challenging maps with wave-based combat.

title: Nak
description: Become a ghost to save your family from ghosts. Nak is a story driven platformer with arena combat. Enter the world of Nak. Here your reflexes and analysis will be tested as you traverse vast physical and spiritual realms and square off against traditional Thai ghosts. How long will it be until you can no longer distinguish yourself from the monsters you face?

title: Shawarma King
description:
Celebrating 20 Years of "Falafel King" with a Modern, Flavorful Twist!

Welcome to Shawarma King, where you’ll discover what it truly takes to become the undisputed ruler of the street food empire!

Transform your small shawarma stand into a culinary empire while navigating the challenges of rising taxes, demanding customers, and unpredictable suppliers. Inspired by the classic Israeli game, "Falafel King," this modern homage comes with a new twist, tons of humor, and plenty of challenges.

Will you succeed in turning your small shawarma stand into a culinary empire spanning cities? Or will you end up under investigation by the tax authorities?

title: Windah Horror Adventure
description: In this 3D top-down horror game, you play as Windah Basudara, a popular Indonesian YouTuber who gets trapped in a world of Indonesian urban legends. Your goal is to escape and survive the game's many obstacles, including traps and bosses in the form of Indonesian ghosts.

title: Project Afterfall
description: A dark, strategy-survival RPG blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore. Set in the wolrd of Thea, but thrust 1000 years into an urban future. Rebuild your colony, explore the post-apocalyptic wasteland, and engage in tactical card-based combat. Immerse yourself in a story-rich adventure with branching narratives.

title: Witch’s Gaze: The Vanishing Village
description: Embark on a mystical quest that blends Slavic folklore with arcane witchcraft, uncover hidden secrets, and rescue a village lost to the shadows in this magical detective visual novel. Oh, and never forget your cat - he might save you!

title: Black Raven
description: Black Raven is a dark 2.5D action-adventure rooted in Slavic Folklore set in 14th-century Eastern-Europe. Play as Ivan, a man consumed by vengeance after a brutal raid shatters his family. Journey through grim landscapes and fight brutal enemies in this dark tale of loss, rage, and resilience.

title: Angel's Lullaby
description:
Angel's Lullaby takes place during the game's opening introduction, back during the Human and Monster War. Expanding on the lore, meta narrative and core themes of the original games, Angel's aims to enrich the Undertale world by mixing both the old and new.

Combining both an open-world and linear story-line, Angel's is an ambitious fangame with a large story to tell. There's three main "Acts," each with it's own main area that follows a story.

title: Stop Slapping Tenshi!
description: In this game you should slap masochistic Tenshi Hinanawi from touhou to fill her "tenshi bar"

title: Unizone's Underswap: Distrust Sans
description: A take on the events of the Swap version of the famous "Disbelief Papyrus" Alternative Timeline

title: Fight
description: Fight is a fun, easy to play one on one fighting game with many different fighters and scenes to choose from. No Fight will be the same.

title: Two Men Go On A Date And Don't Fall In Love
description: but maybe they can find something else in common?

title: Crossovertale
description:
Play as Frisk all grown up after the ending of Undertale.

FIGHT or SPARE your way through a brand new world, where characters from all across the video game multiverse come together and wage battle

title: The Creature in my Dreams
description:
Dreams are so strange, almost like a movie that cannot be skipped.
No sense of direction or rationale.
It's a place where one must face true fear.
This house is where it all started.
With no way to look away from the movie,
I must face what is to come...

title: Bury Me With The Rain
description: Bury me with the rain is an interactive short story about the life, friendship and struggle of Jean and Avery. Follow their journey of hardship, joy and heartfelt conversation as they try to find meaning for their own lives.

title: Reactoryx
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of intrigue and investigation in “Reactoryx,” a unique detective game featuring hidden object searches, challenging puzzles, and uncovering mysteries that could change the course of history.

title: Shieven
description: Enter the enigmatic Luminora Hospital, where, as a researcher on the brink of ruin, you take on a case that will test your courage. Amidst dark rumors, you will uncover terrifying secrets that have caused those who dared to go too far to disappear.

title: MillMess
description:
It's a cold, cozy Christmas eve and everyone's asleep except for you! You're a good kid, but nobody will mind if you open a present earlier than you should...

MillMess is an original solitaire card game full of fun and bizarre creatures: THE RULES are simple yet chaotic, give it a look here (https://sites.google.com/view/mymadnessworks/home-page/millmess-rules) if you're confused (so that you can get even more confused). Or hey, you can always go in blind and join the mess!

title: Night Striker Gear
description: A brand new entry to the series, NIGHT STRIKER GEAR revitalizes the sprite scaling pseudo-3D style with polished graphics. The new GEAR System gives an added depth to the gameplay without sacrificing the intuitiveness. Feeling the rush of fast-paced music, strike through the night once more!

title: Desktop Cat Cafe
description: Build your dream cat cafe in this tiny cozy management sim that lives at the bottom of your screen! Unlock exciting new recipes, decorate your space with our wide variety of goodies, and hire cute staff to take care of the cafe while you're doing other things.

title: Piñata Puppy World
description: Piñata Puppy World is a 2000’s nostalgia driven explorative campaign game with a dramatic and surreal storyline disguised within the genre of “Mascot Horror”.

title: Chill Drive
description: Welcome to Chill Drive, this game can provide a comfortable atmosphere for studying, working, or resting. Plan those long, difficult, or delayed tasks, then complete your goal in an undisturbed environment!

title: The Sims 4: Cozy Kitsch Kit
description: Embrace vibrant colors and mid-century modern design with The Sims 4 Cozy Kitsch Kit. Inspired by the 60s and the 70s, this collection of living room items features bold color and pattern combinations, stylish surfaces, and cute décor with delightful character. Add subtle accents to your room, or make a statement with every piece. Created by myshunosun.

title: The Sims 4: Sweet Slumber Party Kit
description: Look cute even when the venue of your party is your own bedroom with The Sims 4 Sweet Slumber Party Kit. The pastel colors, fluffy fabrics, adorable designs, and patterns will make you feel like you’re in a dream. Complete your sleepwear attire with cute nail designs, fuzzy socks and slippers, and fun skincare items. Created by Trillyke.

title: The Sims 4: Comfy Gamer Kit
description: Settle in for a cozy time at the computer with The Sims 4 Comfy Gamer Kit*. With this collection you’ll craft warm, inviting spaces that feel personal with a large desk, playful clutter items, and of course a comfy gaming chair. This kit was created in collaboration with Lilsimsie to be fun and relaxing with subtle references to The Sims.

title: The Sims 4: Secret Sanctuary Kit
description: Indulge in iconic fashion and enchanting décor with The Sims 4 Secret Sanctuary Kit. Create a luxurious space full of opulent furniture concealed behind a secret passage in a bookcase. When you’re inside your hideaway, let the world melt away as you relax on your chaise lounge or try on polished Italian-inspired fashions in your floor-length mirror.

title: The Sims 4: Casanova Cave Kit
description: Impress guests with a modern entertainment space and suave fits from The Sims 4 Casanova Cave Kit. This laid-back masculine fashion will have Sims looking confident, and the contemporary style of your den’s décor — a stylish bar, sleek coffee table, and more — will guarantee the right atmosphere, whether it’s game night or date night.

title: The Sims 4: Business Chic Kit
description: Give your Sims a professional edge with chic and stylish outfits from The Sims 4 Business Chic Kit*. From tailored suits to elegant dresses, Sims will feel confident and fashionable. Complete the look with sleek shoes and fancy accessories for an extra touch of class. The Business Chic Kit ensures Sims always look up to the task. Created by Madlen.

title: The Sims 4: Refined Living Room Kit
description: Embrace elegance and sophistication with The Sims 4 Refined Living Room Kit*. With a clever mix of modern and retro furniture, you can create the perfect base. Add extra personality with unique and chic decor pieces. And voilà, you’ll have a living room worthy of a design magazine. Created by Pierisim.

title: Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
description: Includes Citizen Sleeper and Citizen Sleeper 2

title: Blast Damage Days
description: Blast Damage Days is a short story with visual and audio elements. Explore a story about lesbian love and healing from trauma in this queer-themed furry visual novel.

title: Carmen Sandiego: Deluxe Edition DLC
description:
Celebrate 40 years of Carmen Sandiego with the Deluxe Edition, crafted for devoted fans and new sleuths alike! Greet some familiar faces in the exclusive anniversary caper and become a master of disguise with some exclusive in-game outfits.

Carmen Sandiego Deluxe Edition includes:

- Anniversary Caper "Where in the World"
- Cosmetic Skin - Classic outfit
- Cosmetic Skin - Motorcycle outfit
- Digital Official Soundtrack
- Digital Official Art Book

title: Monster Jam Showdown: Off The Leash
description:
Keep the kibbles ready! The Monster Jam Showdown kennel has flung open its doors and these three doggos are ready to play in the dirt. The pack leader, Monster Mutt Retro, has competed in eighteen World Finals. His littermates are different versions of the truck inspired by two of the world's most appreciated dog breeds: Monster Mutt Dalmatian Retro and Monster Mutt Rottweiler. Unleash them on the tracks!

This DLC includes:

Monster Mutt Retro with 3 liveries
Monster Mutt Dalmatian Retro with 3 liveries
Monster Mutt Rottweiler with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam Showdown - Season Pass.

title: Shadow Prisoner
description:
"Shadow Prisoner" is a 2D fighting game with simple controls that allow you to perform exhilarating combos.

You can play with 25 characters (9 will be added for free, and one is a collaboration character that will be paid DLC).

Even if you have no experience with fighting games, you can use the simple mode to play like an experienced fighting gamer just by repeatedly pressing buttons.

There are story mode and survival mode for single player, and versus mode and network mode for competitive play.

Network mode has a zero-latency netcode that supports rollback.

If you are playing in Japan, you can play with the same input sensation as if you were playing next to someone in Japan.

In addition, Epsilon mode, a fighting action game where you shoot each other with a barrage of bullets, exclusive to the Steam version, will be added.

title: Aralez
description: This game is based on aralez from Armenian mythology, winged canines that lick the wounds of the dead in order to revive them. Explore each level and do minigames to revive the fallen.

title: CCSS07: 64 Squares of Purple
description: Crispy Chicken Chillzone discord server came together once more for a speedmap event. This time we have purple hue-shifted palette. All 256 lines had to be at 90 degrees to each other, and using 64 grid. The result is 36 maps, split into 4 episodes - castle, space, flesh, jungle.

title: Clash of Busts
description: Clash of Busts is a multiplayer shooter where players battle it out with quirky weapons like Rocket, Milk and Rail Guns across diverse arenas.

title: Classic Home Invasion
description: An alien is on Earth and has been under the radar for many years. Because of this, there have been many mysterious disappearances and sightings in the area. Unfortunately for Billy, hes about to find out the truth behind this mystery- and its not very pretty.

title: Falco Xolon
description: Collect plasma to fuel your weapons, as every shot counts.

title: Baker's Agony
description: Enter the dungeon to get the coveted sacred flour in this sword-focused action-roguelike. Make your way through bizarre and/or cute bread creatures thanks to the weapons and resources you'll find along the way, and if you don't succeed, try again, as the dungeon will have changed.

title: Maniac Land
description: "Maniac Land" Summon your mages to the court! Gather resources and transform them into powerful wands, mysterious books, or, well, stones. Develop new spells, defend your small land, or snatch up your friends' territories and zap them into another dimension.

title: Daddy Comes Home
description: You will play as a father who, in a nightmare, sees his wife and son smiling at him bizarrely. When you wake up, you find that reality is even more cruel.

title: Dungeon Online
description: A Dungeon Crawler that you can play alone or with your friends in online co-op. There's also Arena Mode where you can fight against other players in online pvp.

title: Lock. Stock. And Hungry Pumpkins.
description: A fun indie western-style shooter where you must protect the townspeople from hordes of living pumpkins, find a hidden stash of gold, and uncover a farmers' conspiracy. And, of course, there's a betrayal involved too.

title: Cannon Island
description: Cannon Island is a roguelike city builder, where you colonize procedurally generated islands and fight rivals. Wise building placement and resource management are the key to victory.

title: Wandervania
description: Wandervania is a short action adventure game similar to the Classic Castlevania games, a big one level with collectibles and lore to go through.

title: Mutant Legion
description: Mutant Legion is a charming but brutal top down shooter.

title: Demon Core
description: Abandon hope and delve into the core of an old nuclear power plant in this psychological survival horror experience. Trust your map and radiation detector to navigate the irradiated plant... And be forced to discover the monstrous cause of its sudden reawakening.

title: Aeonic
description: In Aeonic you experience the greatest events in different parts of the planet in the most important epochs of civilization throughout the whole history from the beginning to the future in one playthrough.

title: Bear Shooter
description: Simple vertical scrolling shooter with a bear as the main character, 5 stages in total

title: Rescue Girl Operation: Code X
description: Take up arms to drive away the mutated zombies and save the beautiful girls!

title: Cosmic Guardians
description: Become a Cosmic Guardian in this thrilling space shooter! Defend Earth from alien threats, battle colossal bosses, and save the universe. Play solo with A.I. or team up in co-op mode. Level up, unlock abilities, and collect power-ups for an epic adventure!

title: Back To Back
description: Back To Back is 2 player co-op adventure game, where the players are forced to act together to survive various challenges with limited shared resources.

title: Zombie Shooter TPS
description: It is more than just a shooter game; it's a test of skill, strategy, and reflexes. It challenges you to think ahead, move wisely, and build your character into a formidable force.

title: Animal Connect Fusion
description: Animal Connect Fusion is a delightful and engaging game with simple yet captivating gameplay. Players collect animals by connecting those located close together, forming the brightest straight line. The more animals connected, the higher the score.

title: Mazed Joseon
description: Welcome to the eerie nights of the Joseon Dynasty!Navigate the winding maze of stone walls and find the key to escape!But be careful... if you open what should not be opened while focusing on finding the key...?!

title: Ear Clicker
description: Ear clicker clicker game to expand your castle

title: Labyrinth of Shadows
description: Dive into the Labyrinth of Shadows, a game that challenges your wits and bravery. Navigate dungeons filled with traps, enemies, and hidden treasures. Use unique artifacts to overcome obstacles and uncover secrets. With procedurally generated levels, each playthrough offers a new adventure.

title: Being John Gogh
description: "Being John Gogh" is a life simulation game where you play as John, navigating through a world rendered in the style of Van Gogh's paintings, focusing on improving relationships, managing health, and enhancing charisma to find happiness on Bozca Island.

title: The Legend of the Heroes of the Water Margin
description: The Legend of the Heroes of the Water Margin is an ancient Chinese RPG game based on Shi Naian's novel Water Margin, in which players can have adventures with some of Shi Naian's characters from the protagonist's point of view. This only to understand the purpose of the protagonist is to find.

title: Ghost Shot
description: Photographer player goes for the best shot of a ghost at a haunted site. The camera's eye on the ghosts is a deadly risk! Please go to the scene with an open mind.

title: Art Spotting Co-op
description: Art Spotting Co-op is a casual game about spotting the difference between several art pieces together with a friend while listening to relaxing music. A controller is not required for local co-op play.

title: Hime Cut
description: "Hime Cut" is a one-on-one 2D shooting game. Aim for a high score as you clear the wave!

title: Dragon and Phoenix
description: This is an independent game with unique gameplay! I hope you can experience endless fun from it! This is definitely worth it! Hope everyone likes it!

title: The Late Arrival
description: Horror engine-based exploration game that takes place in an abandoned subway station that has experienced strange occurrences. The graffiti artist starts exploring an old subway station and finds more than he expected. His experiences include mysterious figures, strange sounds, and happenings.

title: Magic Jewelry Craft
description: Magic Jewelry Craft (MaJew) is a casual puzzle game where you merge gems to level up, unlock treasures, and achieve high scores. Merge three gems of the same tier to advance through 7 tiers. Complete sections to open treasures and earn rewards.

title: Dimensional Dilemma
description: A first-person physics-based puzzle game reminiscent of Portal. Manipulate the sizes of different objects to forge a path back to your ship.

title: Lost Lost Lost
description: An adventure puzzle game where you explore a colorless city to find hidden red, green, and blue color balls, solving challenges to restore vibrancy to Relax City.

title: Haunted Space Hotel: Vacancy
description: Build, manage, and thrive as an AI hotelier in a haunted sci-fi universe! Serve unique alien guests, research tech, customize your AI brain, and resolve spectral anomalies across 6 strategic shifts in this free demo. Your unique hotel management challenge starts now!

title: Brelok: Nezumi-tachi no Dasshutsu
description: “BRELOK - Escape of the mice -” is a cooperative escape game exclusively for two players. Play together with your family, friends, or your significant other.

title: Sonic & Shadow
description: Sonic & Shadow is a colorful 3D open world game.

title: Overtime Anomaly
description: You're working overtime again in your dead-end job, whilst your boss is on vacation. However, strange things are happening throughout the office. Complete your daily work tasks, explore your office, report any anomalies you may find, and you may just find yourself getting a promotion...

title: My Virtual Friend
description: My Virtual Friend is a desktop pet/idler game where a cute girl accompanies you whilst you navigate your computer. She's interested in what you're doing and will do her best to cheer you up! Play with her, unlock new backgrounds, and customize your outfits. Just don't make her mad...

title: HoverGrease 2
description:
Mixing the traditional elements of a team-based game with the arcade thrill of a twin-stick shooter. A super fast-paced game, where both your reflexes and your team’s positioning play a crucial role. Play the Singleplayer Story or join the 5v5 Online Multiplayer.

Dive into the vibrant, bio-cyberpunk world of Diamond Core Metropolis, where chaos reigns in every arena. Take control of a powerful mutant, master unique abilities, and fight for survival in an electrifying dystopian future.

title: Kataude no Zarigani: One-armed Crayfish
description: “Going against the grain is just another form of rebellion.” That's what high school student Yuta Nozaki believes, living by the principle of following the trend. Through his classmate Misaki Miyoshi, who constantly goes against the grain, Yuta begins to confront his true feelings.

title: Prop Haunt
description: Prop Haunt is a 4v1 multiplayer psychological horror game. Take on the role of spirits focused on expanding their influence on the physical world by haunting objects, or play as an investigator assigned to report on these hauntings to reduce the amount of paranormal activity in the world.

title: Terror Mod Ultraultimatum HD
description: Kill the mysteries that are scattered throughout San Andreas.

title: Kakyuusei 2
description:
Kakyūsei 2 is a dating sim and the sequel to 1996's Kakyūsei, itself a spin-off of the Dōkyūsei series.

The player is placed in the shoes of a student (default name: Oriya Rouma) during his last year of high school, as he is trying to find a girlfriend before graduation. Over the course of the story, he meets and bounds with nine eligible bachelorettes from his school, and can eventually chose to romance one of them.

Much like its predecessors, the gameplay centers around Oriya exploring his school, his local neighborhood, and the city, during which he can enter restaurants, shops, cafés, houses, etc. and potentially encounter the nine dateable girls and learn more about them through having conversations with them. The nature of these conversations usually depends on which location the girl is found at in and tends to feature multiple answers; in most cases these answers will either advance or hinder the progression of the relationship with the girl in question depending on the player's choices, leading to new story events. The game also features an internal clock and calendar, with some events, such as holiday celebrations or birthdays, only happening at certain times or on certain dates.

These two systems often times interact, with information given through conversations becoming relevant later down the line - most prominently, the girl in question can give a hint to their tastes in gifts, and if the player later gives them their desired item on their birthdays, it will greatly increase their approval of you.

Also like its predecessors, the game features scenes with nudity and explicit sexual situations.

[From MobyGames]

title: Deltarune Wandering Makers: Pantheon of the Discarded
description: Taking off from the original storyline, you explore a strange new "darker-than-dark" world, looking for "shadow bosses" to battle for their "Shadow Crystals"

title: Life And Death Are Predetermined by Heaven
description: Slapping Competition ": Two contestants stand face to face and alternate their attacks, using their maximum strength to slap each other's cheeks. The game will continue until one side is beaten and unable to get up

title: Hamster Hunter: Rodent Rampage
description: A fast, crazy boomer shooter where mutant hamster-men kidnap you.. and regret it. Bust out of their creepy underground lab with big guns, smash through their evil plans, and turn every furry freak into bloody chunks on your way to freedom.

title: Krashimals
description: Krashimals is a chaotic, physics-driven party game where you play as adorable animals and crash into friends for ultimate mayhem! Smash through stylized arenas, challenge modes, use power-ups, and enjoy the fun. Customize your Krashimals hats, karts and wheels and battle to be the last one standing!

title: 100 Hidden Cats: Playground
description: Hidden Cats Playground is a hidden objects/hidden creatures game. The player's task is to find all kitties hiden on the map.

title: Apico 4.0: Hive of Industry
description: A new free update now available for the bee-loved beekeeping sim APICO on PC and Nintendo Switch! Update 4.0: A Hive of industry, introduces new automation machines, new pets, a new craftable resource, new seasonal events, and much more!

title: Indoor Baseball
description:
The highly anticipated follow up to Indoor Kickball!

Indoor Baseball is BIGGER, better, and even more destructive!

Indoor Baseball is a 1v1 baseball game played in the rooms of your house! Play in a goofy story mode to work your way up to make the school baseball team. Play a 14 game randomly generated season mode, or quick play 1v1 in a local multiplayer match against a friend or CPU.

title: Gemporium
description: Mine, Refine and Sell Gemstones of various rarities to eagerly awaiting customers in Gemporium, a casual mining simulation management game. Keep your finances in check as you juggle a growing gem emporium while simultaneously paying off a generational debt. There's only so much time in the day!

title: Speed Demons 2
description: Speed Demons 2 is an arcade highway racing game featuring explosive action, breakneck speeds, and very intense TRAFFIC. With a pulse-pounding soundtrack, unique side-scrolling perspectives, and TONS of varied modes, vehicles, and races, Speed Demons 2 is a thrilling blend of speed and chaos.

title: ReCharge RC: High Voltage
description: Drift your way into ReCharge RC: High Voltage! Customize your vehicle, Create your very own race tracks, Share them online and race your friends best times with global online leaderboards. Created by an RC enthusiast, for RC enthusiasts!

title: Liminal Point
description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

title: Calico: Neat Things
description:
There's even more to explore in the world of Calico with the Neat Things DLC, including:
New Quest
New Area and NPC
New Animal Companions
Two New Mini-Games
New Café Decorations

title: Mushroom Island
description: Do you want to have a small island of your own? Come here, this is an idle building game. “Power over mushroom is power over all”，Mushrooms are the most precious food here. In order to produce more mushrooms, you need to gather resources, expand the island, upgrade buildings, and train workers.

title: The Invading Dark
description: A single player survival horror game where creatures are invading from the dark and hunting the inhabitants. You must survive and find different pages of notes to get an escape route to safety.

title: Project SXU
description: A project that aims to recreate the cancelled 1996 Sega Saturn title Sonic X-treme as close as possible, while adding original ideas and concepts from X-treme.

title: Tantalus
description: You are a patrol staff aboard the spaceship 'Tantalus'. Explore a spaceship filled with mystery, uncover anomalies, and report them to the control AI.

title: The Fallow City
description: Shoot Zombies with different Strength and Weakness, do Simple Crafts and Upgrades, Fight Monsters, Solve Puzzles, get Haunted by Creepy Creatures and Experience the Story in this Indie Horror, Action-Adventure, Story game.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Navi’s Quest
description:
Zelda Navi's Quest is an Open Source fan made 2D Zelda game that chronologically takes place after the ROTH trilogy, a series of fan made Zelda games made by Vincent Jouillat. The gameplay lies in the ability to play as both Link and Navi, the player being able to heal and survey the area with Navi’s powers.
The game is available to play on PC, the PSP and the PS Vita

title: The Demon's Room
description: The Demon's Room is a horror suspense interactive video game. Players need to establish a good feeling with the characters, and the plot triggers and selects to influence the story. The game contains many ways of playing. With the deepening of the plot, players can unlock 11 story endings.

title: Foss Park
description: Foss Park is a psychological horror VN that takes you deep into the fractured mind of a nameless patient in an unsettling mental hospital. You awaken with no memory of how you arrived, haunted by fleeting images of a life destroyed—a house fire, a lost family, and echoes of a forgotten tragedy.

title: Forest Runner
description: The game is a platform runner. The game is also suitable for offline play. The game is designed to just take a break from the action games and just walk around. You can just walk around the map, you can try to embed your files for yourself. The main task is to try to find way to get out from there.

title: Unfamiliar Lands
description: A story-driven, exploration-centric, fantasy adventure game with timed action boss fights filled with magic, mystery and puzzles.

title: AK-xolotl: Together
description: The cutest, deadliest top-down roguelike shooter featuring AK-wielding Axolotls. Blast your way through the animal kingdom with an arsenal of kick-ass guns, mighty power-ups and even raise an army of trigger-happy baby axolotls. Double the firepower! Local co-op update now live!

title: Unlucky Chicken
description: An unlucky chicken fell to the bottom of a ravine and was injured. It can no longer fly smoothly, but now it just wants to go home and hopes you can help it.

title: Project 1337: The Well
description: You awaken in a bunker, at the bottom of an unknown pit, where each floor brings waves of alien enemies and a single purpose: to test you. Who are you? Why are you here? Move forward, survive, and uncover the secrets buried deep within.

title: My Sweet! Housemate
description: My Sweet Housemate is an interactive visual novel style game that puts you into the shoes of a homeless adult struggling to find affordable housing in America. You're hit with a stroke of good - or maybe bad - luck when you finally find a totally not suspicious rental listing for a room in an apartment. The only catch is that your new landlord, Seung-min, seems to have something off about him.

title: The Sims 4: Businesses & Hobbies
description: Pursue new skills and live a life of accomplishment in The Sims 4 Businesses & Hobbies Expansion Pack*. Make your home in Nordhaven — a world of opportunity where you can chase your dreams among a passionate community. Create wearable art with the new Tattooing skill, and even earn Simoleons for it. Or, craft functional pieces with the new Pottery skill and charge for lessons as you improve. Savvy Sims can turn their wildest dreams into profitable businesses, so use your imagination to create something special. Run your business out of your home, hire employees, decide how to charge, and make the rules!

title: Sonic 4
description: A Sonic game which was being produced by VibrantDarkness and Cinossu, shown as a secret title at SAGE 9. Information about it is scarce, its SAGE booth didn't get properly archived. According to the page, Sonic, Tails and Knuckles would be in the game. No release date was given.

title: Skyline Bowling
description: Skyline Bowling is a fast-paced multiplayer bowling game where players compete in tournaments, unlock new alleys, and use special gear and skills to improve their performance. Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?

title: You Game+
description:
The popular "YOU Game" is upgraded!
Let’s combine "YOU" and "YOU" to create a BIG "YOU"!!

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Lunlun Super Hero Babies Plus NewGames
description:
Three games in one! Volume up!
A compilation of Super Baby LUNLUN's action
! A super bargain edition!

title: Big Helmet Heroes: Exalted Edition
description:
The Exalted Edition includes:
- Big Helmet Heroes
- Artbook & OST

title: Him, the Smile & Bloom: Additional scenario - Flower Halloween Night
description: A short story that depicts the situation after the main story of “Him, the Smile & bloom”.

title: Skyline Bowling: Bright Style
description:
With this DLC, You'll unlock:
3 powerful balls: Liquid, Swirl and Monster!
A Prismatic T-Shirt for better accuracy!
Polychrome Gloves for extra spin!
Refraction Shoes for more speed!
4K gems to buy new gear!

title: Skyline Bowling: Light Style
description:
With this DLC, You'll unlock:
3 powerful balls: Lightning, Electron and Dragon Egg!
A Neotech T-Shirt for better accuracy!
Energy Gloves for extra spin!
Bolt Shoes for more speed!
100K coins to upgrade your gear!

title: Aquarium at August 32nd
description:
Aquarium at August 32nd is a short walking simulator game inspired by the well-known horror simulator Exit 8. In this game, players explore a spooky aquarium filled with anomalies and must find a way to exit by identifying these differences.

The rule of Aquarium at August 32nd is simple: turn back if there is an anomaly, or go forward if there is none. The game is completed when the number of jellyfish in the tank reaches eight.

title: Hidden Nemesis
description: Survive six nights of terror in a deadly cat-and-mouse game. Immobilized in a chair, solve intricate puzzles, monitor cameras, and scour the dark web to uncover secrets—all while a relentless demon hunts you. Will you outsmart the darkness before time runs out?

title: Magic Trickery
description: Mrs. Jones has woken up in the fantastic world of magic... Magic Trickery is a shorter-but-sweeter casual RPG for all skill levels with a cozy pixelled overworld and traditional turn-based stylized cartoon battles, with a focus on exploration, collectibles and finding secrets at your own pace.

title: Cast n Chill
description: Cast n Chill is a cozy idle (and active) fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

title: Eve Online: 20th Anniversary Collector's Edition
description:
EVE 20th Anniversary Collector's Edition Includes:
- Deluxe 8" Megathron Ship Model
- 6" Fedo Plushie
- Megathron Art Print by Lloyd George
- Premium Blueprint Poster
- The New Eden Soundtrack CD
- 20th Anniversary Enamel Pin
- Empire Emblem Pin Set
- Signed Certificate of Authenticity

Digital Content:
- Exclusive Megathron SKIN designed by T'Amber
- Two new exclusive SKINS
- Set of Genolution Implants
- Five SOCT ships
- Metamorphosis BPC - run of 3

title: Mop Skater
description: Cleaning isn’t just a chore, it’s a sport. Pull off insane tricks, string together epic combos, and battle the clock in this ridiculous first-person skate mopping adventure.

title: Grindset T.V.
description: You have sinned, and Two-Day Delivery is the path to righteousness. Transport packages for the CEO of the Catholic Church, His Holiness the Cyberpope. Trick-based chaos meets corporate blasphemy in this unhinged speedrunning FPS. Your salvation isn’t free. But your suffering is priceless.

title: Songs of Silence: Lighteaters
description:
Dwellling deep in the Silence, these ancient beings have haunted Irdheim and Sonnan for countless cycles. Stuck between life and death, their insatiable craving for the Hymn forbids them to fade away...
Wield the arcane powers of the Lighteaters against your opponents in Skirmish single- or multiplayer, with Songs of Silence's first faction DLC!
The DLC focuses on providing fresh Skirmish content.
2 new hero archetypes
6 new hero vocations
8 new units
5 new strategy cards (including 1 new building upgrade)
8 new battles cards
1 new unit perk
1 new capital

title: Duck Duck Adventure
description: Duck Duck Adventure is a 2D top-down roguelike with deck-building mechanics. Play as a duck disguised as various characters to defend a village from invading monsters and bosses. Trade for equipment, craft unique card builds, grow stronger, and survive waves of enemies to claim victory.

title: Sorcerer's Servant
description: It is a roguelike spinning RPG where you turn slots to strengthen equipment and fight monsters. By chaining equipment with slots, you can strengthen your abilities and upgrade to new equipment. Use your skills to lead her to victory.

title: Mushroom Tower Defense
description: Magic Mushroom Defense is a creative tower defense game where players defend their castle against magical mushrooms in 200 unique maze-like levels. Strategically place and upgrade towers, adapt to evolving enemies, and overcome challenging obstacles to protect your kingdom.

title: Stray of Lostcat
description: Meet our eccentric little feline hero. Join her as she dodges the clutches of “Meowdysses”, gathers scattered Soul Shards, and finds her way back home!

title: Mini Kingdom War
description: English is a medieval strategy war game where you can freely choose your faction, acquire resources, purchase armies from crystals, strengthen yourself, defeat enemy armies, break down enemy walls, and destroy enemy crystals to win the game. You can compete with AI and invite friends to play online.

title: Misty Village
description: An adventure suspense, love simulation visual novel game. The player plays the role of a boy who runs away from home and enters a strange village in the fog. Then he meets the girl in the village and gradually uncovers the mystery of the village. Your final choice determines the ending of the two.

title: Zhuishu
description: Can you hear it? The faint sound coming from an abandoned radio, calling out for forgotten children. Trace back a chilling tale lost to time and unravel the mysteries hidden within the ruins. Who is silently watching you? And who lurks within the fog, waiting for answers?

title: The Reformatory
description: Your name is Dewey. You enjoy playing video games, much to the dismay of your parents. One day, they send you to a reformatory. There, a man electroshocks you. In convulsions, you fall into a world filled with enemies. This is a top-down 2D pixel-style shooter game with roguelite elements.

title: Escape from the nightmare
description: This is an action-adventure game similar to an escape room. During the game, players need to find a key and a door to escape, while also avoiding the pursuit of nightmares.

title: Can you finish it?
description: A game of great difficulty

title: Variable Puzzle
description: 《Variable Puzzle》is a strategy puzzle game.Challenge your intelligence and unleash your strategies! Come and try various challenges, enter the wonderful world of the game, explore the deep secrets of puzzles, and demonstrate your decision-making and thinking abilities.

title: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
description: Satoyama note Spring walk is a point-and-click visual novel in which you aim to reach your destination while identifying plants in a satoyama in spring. Listen to the animals, observe and identify the plants as you make your way through the forest, and have lunch under the cherry blossom trees!

title: Street Fighter 2
description: Classic mini game, Street Fighter, you will play as an extraordinary martial arts master, fighting against your enemies, upgrading skills, increasing levels, dragging, kicking, sweeping, and charging into the streets

title: Restart ShuHan Dynasty: Origin
description: Restart ShuHan Dynasty：Origin is an immersive interactive video game set in the history of The Three Kingdoms from the perspective of "Liu Bei", which incorporates modern anecdotes and suspense elements. Every choice you make will directly or indirectly affect the end of the game.

title: Armored Hongfeng
description: "Armored Hongfeng" is a TPS game with "tank vehicle" + "MOBA" gameplay. You will use famous active and retired tanks to compete on the battlefield. The game combines the strategic depth of traditional tank battles with the excitement of MOBA games, bringing an unprecedented gaming experience.

title: Kwun Tong
description: Made in Hong Kong. By Unreal Engine 5.4.4. Escape from Kwun Tong.

title: Wish Ready Go!
description: “Wish Ready GO!” is a game combines visual novel, simulation and role-playing. In the game, players will role as an goddess candidate, who need to pass the final exam to be a real goddess. Make your choices carefully, and help the heroine to finish her tasks!

title: Ogiri Adventure Game
description: "Ogiri Adventure Game" is a quest to gather and donate items to please the Goddess. Find theme-based items highlighted in red, donate within the budget, and raise the emotion meter. A high meter brings joy, while a low one may cause anger. Keep trying!

title: Oplero
description: Soar your way through 4 worlds and defeat fearsome bosses on the search for your lost friend. Discover the true nature of the world and reconnect.

title: Easy Delivery Co.
description: Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.

title: Only False
description: Only False is a party game that blends bluffing and strategy, spiced up with a dash of dark humor. In Only False, a game for those who can’t get enough lies, you’ll sometimes lie like a politician, and sometimes think as strategically as Sun Tzu.

title: Hero's Odyssey
description: Awaken on the mysterious island of Damatheia with a Godly mission in your backlog. Forge bonds with unlikely allies, make life-altering choices, and battle the undead in this Visual Novel filled with secrets, minigames and multiple endings. What truths will you uncover... and at what cost?

title: Wuthering Waves: Waves Sing, and the Cerulean Bird Calls
description:
Version 2.1 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Phoebe and Brant
• New areas: Riccioli Islands and Vault Underground
• New story quests
• New endgame content: Whimpering Wastes
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Grove Fisher
description: A relaxing idle game about fishing. Discover dozens of fishes and treasures! Spend your resources on growing your operation and unlocking new varieties of underground life! Achieve goals, buy skills, and mutate rare fish to improve your profits!

title: Nightmare Kart: The Old Karts
description: An upcoming free expansion to Nightmare Kart with a brand new mini-campaign, racers, karts, tracks, power-ups, and game modes.

title: Akabos
description: Do you hate squares? Then this game is for you! After all, the dog also hates squares. Help the dog to destroy all the squares!

title: 100 Hidden Cats in America
description: Can you find all 100 Hidden Cats in America?

title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Initiation
description: In Link's Initiation, brothers Sahasrahla & Aginah use their mystical abilities to project a dream into Link’s mind, in order to initiate him in the rites of the ancient Seven Sages. You must immerse yourself in Link's unconscious, where everything has a double meaning, and analyze the hidden keys to focus his spirit and acquire the wisdom that will guide him on the Sages path. In this prequel to A Link to the Past, you will have to solve the puzzles to initiate Link into the mystical wisdom of the Seven Sages! Available for Windows, Mac and Linux in English and Spanish.

title: Keys of a Gamespace
description:
An expressive game is all about experiencing someone else’s psychological, social, cultural problems and dealing with the moral and/or ethical dilemmas which result from them.

Keys of a Gamespace fits in that approach of video games, which is linked to Sébastien Genvo’s studies on game design and video games expressive potential. Just like cinema, or comic books, video games are not a minor way of expression. It can also, in its way, deal with serious or tough themes. The following works, for example, were references for our project : Mystic River, EraserHead and Twin Peaks, which happen to be some cinematographic references ; while A distant neighborhood, Black Hole, and American Splendor were some comic books references.

title: Keep It Running: Together
description:
Keep a 19th century factory running at all costs in this co-op survive-the-night game.
Fuel the boilers, repair any broken machinery and keep the production going at all costs. Keep the Boss happy and fend off the monsters that haunt the factory as you produce cursed children's toys. Do well and be rewarded with new outfits, new challenges and new Achievements as you unlock them! You may just make Employee of the Month~

The game can be played either alone or with up to 4 people over LAN or the internet.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: The Freedom Fighters
Somnifuge
description:
Compelled by a mysterious note, you step into the grand mansion. As you explore its dark corridors, you must solve cryptic puzzles, confront the residents, and uncover your purpose.

SOMNIFUGE is a first-person indie horror game that blends exploration, puzzle-solving and psychological horror. Drawing inspiration from the eerie atmospheres of Silent Hill and Alone in the Dark—as well as the many indie horror games they influenced—SOMNIFUGE calls back to PSX-era horror with its retro visuals.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Hands of Time
100 Ways to Kill the Crazy Frog
Mario for the Masses
description: A Mario fangame that didn't get past a demo presentation.

title: Nack the Weasel
description: The sniper gets a game all of his own, mixing many elements such as shooter, puzzler and platformer

title: Minion Masters: Mordar’s Malediction
description:
Mordar the Mad Necromancer’s cruelty knows no bounds. Mordar’s Malediction is a great +300% value bundle that gives you what you need to build your own Mordar deck, including the Mordar master himself and the infamous Ghost card (Legendary!). It also gives you a headstart in this month’s Season Pass.

Includes:
- Mordar (Master)
- Soul Collector Mordar (Legendary Skin)
- 3x Ghost (Legendary Card)
- 20x Spirit Vessel
- 20x Undying Skeleton
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

Mordar’s specialty is raising minions from the dead with his Tombstone ability. Use Ghost to take over your opponent’s minions, then raise them from the dead on your side! Use your trusted skeleton servants to bolster your ranks: Undying Skeleton won’t stay dead for long, and Spirit Vessel gives your other minions a bonus on death. Use all this death-y goodness and more to overwhelm your opponents!
With this Master Box, you have the perfect kit to become a supreme necromancer!

title: Bubble Dreams 3D
description:
Gogi the rabbit has misplaced his collection of precious rainbow gems... and they've all fallen into several different 3D dream worlds!

Using his magic bubble ball, help Gogi get his gems back by rolling, drifting, bouncing, and boosting your way through a handful of shiny platforming stages without falling off!

title: Minion Masters: Kaboom Kingdom
description:
The KaBOOM Kingdom DLC is a great +300% value bundle that gives you what you need to build your own Scrat deck, including the legendary Wreckinator 9000! It also gives you a headstart in this month’s Season Pass.

Includes:
- 3x Wreckinator 9000 (Legendary)
- 5x Boom Buggy (Supreme)
- 20x Scrat Tank
- 40x Zeppelin Bomber
- 40x Cannon Roller
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

Roll out the heavy machinery with this Scrat pack that lets you roll over your opponents. Let the Mighty Wreckinator and Scrat Tank plow down smaller enemies while protecting your Boom Buggy and Cannon Roller and let them deal out the damage from safety.
With this DLC, you have the perfect Scrat kit to become King of the Scrats!

title: Minion Masters: Best Plan No Plan!
description:
Scrat Infestation is the Faction Box for starting or expanding your Scrat faction collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Scrat cards, including the luckiest Scrat alive Jolo the Hero Scrat (Legendary!), and get a head-start in this month’s Season Pass!

Includes:
- 3x Jolo the Hero Scrat (Legendary)
- 5x Boom Buggy (Supreme)
- 20x Scratillery
- 40x Scrat Horde
- 40x Propeller Scrats
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

The industrious and ruthless Scrat uses sheer numbers to overwhelm their enemies. And if that wasn’t enough, they back up their formidable frontline with machines of death that can rain death (and more Scrats) from the skies. Use Scrat Horde and Propeller Scrats to protect and power up your Boom Buggy that can devastate the enemy defenses, and use Scratillery so wage some more carnage and bolster your forces at the same time. Jolo, being the lucky Scrat that he is, can dodge enemy fire to protect your army. Sometimes.
With this Faction Box, you have the perfect kit to become a Scrat commander!

title: Minion Masters: Zealous Inferno
description:
Zealous Inferno is the Faction Box for starting or expanding your Empyrean faction collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Empyrean cards, including the stalwart commander Caeleth Dawnhammer (Legendary!) and 2 exclusive Empyrean cosmetics.

Includes the new season card - Brother of the Burning Fist!

Includes:
- 3x Caeleth Dawnhammer (Legendary)
- 5x Sun Burn (Supreme)
- 20x Banner Man
- 40x Brother of the Burning Fist
- 40x Legionnaires
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 1x exclusive Legendary Empyrean Avatar - Animated!
- 1x exclusive Legendary Empyrean Emote - Animated!

The Empyrean Army keeps the enemy on the defensive with a strong blend of tough infantry and big minions to soak up damage. Take advantage of the Empyrean Army keyword that boosts your cards for playing multiple Empyrean cards. Use your Caeleth and Brother of the Burning Fist to lead your army and follow up with a group of Legionnaires, then put down a Bannerman to protect your Minions, and lastly, finish off with Sun Burn to send your army into a zealous rage!

title: Minion Masters: Charging Into Darkness
description:
With Ardera's true agenda revealed, High-Mage Leiliel races to the Whispering Woods to find an old friend. She’ll need all the help she can muster to brave her way through the raging battle between Crystal Elves and Accursed…

The Charging Into Darkness Faction Box will provide you with all the Crystal Elf support you need to wage your own war against the undead! Containing +300% value of Crystal Elf cards, including the studious High-Mage Leiliel and 2 exclusive Crystal Elf cosmetics.

Includes:
- 3x High-mage Leiliel
- 5x Leiliel's Vortex
- 20x Border Patrol
- 50x Crystal Construct
- 50x Lone Scout
- 5x Power Tokens
- 1x Legendary Emote
- 1x Supreme Avatar

Crystal Elves make use of their Mana Surge to output huge amounts of damage. Keeping your Mana at 6+ is key to effectively utilising them, as well as keeping them protected. Use your Crystal Construct to protect the frail Crystal Elf cards, while using Leiliel’s Vortex to pull your enemy’s minions away and render them helpless! High-Mage Leiliel herself is a great counter to long range minions that will try and dispatch your elves, as her Mana Surge enables her to reflect incoming damage!

title: The Little Uni
description: The game is a point-and-click adventure game in the form of a story with hand-drawn illustrations. Go on an adventure to the planets with various characters and listen to their stories, and find a new planet for Uni to stay on.

title: Minion Masters: Furry Fury
description:
The Furry Fury DLC is a great +300% value bundle to unleash the fury of the Cold North on your enemies! including the legendary Fergus Flagon Fighter! It also gives you a headstart in the Season Pass.

Includes:
- Snow Wall Arena
- Ravager (Master)
- Gray Wolf Ravager Master Skin
- 3x Fergus Flagon Fighter (Legendary card)
- 5x Mountain Gale (Supreme card)
- 20x Adventure Party
- 40x Wild Stonebjorn
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

Embrace your inner beast with Ravager. Use Ravager and his friends BRUTUS and TERROR BRUTUS to make crushing attacks. Support Ravager’s attacks with sturdy Stoutheart to make unstoppable pushes. The pack also includes the custom arena Snow Wall which is the perfect setting to unleash the fury of the north!

title: Minion Masters: Vanguard
description:
The Vanguard DLC is a great +300% value bundle to roll out the heavy machinery! You also get a headstart in the Season Pass!

Includes:
- 5x Siege Imperator Ruby (Legendary card)
- 5x Magnetic Bombs (Supreme card)
- 20x A.I.M Bot
- 40x S1ege Br3aker
- 40x M0nitor Gn4ts
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

Assume control of the Outland invasion force. Use the heavy Siege Imperator Ruby and its smaller S1ege Br3eaker cousin to pave the way for your M0nitor Gn4ts and Magnetic bombs to wreak havoc! In the meantime, save up Outlander Tech by playing Outlander cards to empower your A.I.M Bot to be a force to be reckoned with.

With this DLC, you have the perfect kit to start your galactic conquest!

title: Five Nights at Roner's: Remastered
description: You are an ambitious paranormal investigator searching for his big break. When you're presented the opportunity of a lifetime--$25.99, to be exact, you jump at the offer. But everything comes with a catch, and Roner and his friends are keen to teach you that...

title: Minion Masters: Outlandish Operations
description:
Outlandish Operations is the Faction Box for starting or expanding your Outlander faction collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Outlander cards and Master, including the outlaw Settsu (Master), and get a headstart in this month’s Season Pass!

Includes:
- Settsu (Master)
- Infested Settsu Skin (Legendary Master Skin)
- 5x Infiltration (Supreme)
- 20x A.I.M Bot
- 40x Beam Of Doom
- 40x S.T.INT
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

The high-tech Outlanders employ ranged minions and a formidable air force to outmaneuver their enemies. Build up your Outlander Tech by playing Outlander cards, which empowers certain Outlander machines to make a strong push, then finish off your opponent by dropping off marines behind enemy lines with Infiltration, and combine it with Settsu’s Blast Entry for an extra devastating finish.
With this Faction Box, you have the perfect kit to become an Outlander Prime!

title: Minion Masters: Voidborne Onslaught
description:
Voidborne Onslaught is the Faction Box for starting your Voidborne Army – or adding some reinforcements to your existing Voidborne collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Voidborne Minions, including the massive Legendary Colossus as well as 2 exclusive Voidborne cosmetics.

Includes:
- 3x Colossus (Legendary)
- 5x Succubus (Supreme)
- 20x Rammer
- 40x Nether Bat
- 40x Morgrul's Ragers
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 1x Legendary Faction Box exclusive Voidborne Avatar - Animated Colossus!
- 1x Legendary Faction Box exclusive Voidborne Emote - Animated Doompuffer!

The Voidborne faction is aggressive with high speed and dark magic. With this Faction Box, you can immediately experiment with the "Voidborne Wound" mechanic using "Morgrul’s Ragers" which makes your minions stronger if any of your Voidborne Minions wounded the opponent.

title: Minion Masters: Uprising
description:
Uprising is the Faction Box for starting or expanding your Zen-Chi faction collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Zen-Chi cards, including the wise and electrifying Shi-hou Zensei Shen Stormstrike (Legendary!) and a head-start in this month’s Season Pass!

Includes:
- 3x Shen Stormstrike (Legendary)
- 5x Lightning Bolt (Supreme)
- 20x Zap Shrine
- 40x Jade Flingers
- 40x Blue Golem
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

The mysterious and secretive Zen-Chi harness the destructive and nurturing aspects of nature. Jade Flingers plant Growthburst Shrooms that makes your strong Blue Golem even stronger. Use Zap Shrine to stun enemies from a distance, then blast away even the biggest threats with Lightning Bolt, or let Shen Stormstrike deal with them with his lightning attack that damages stunned enemies.

With this Faction Box, you have the perfect kit to become a Zen-Chi Master!

title: Minion Masters: Crystal Conquest
description:
Crystal Conquest is the Faction Box for starting or expanding your Crystal Elf faction collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Crystal Elf cards, including the powerful commander Lord-Sentinel Thelec (Legendary!) and 2 exclusive Crystal Elf cosmetics.

Includes:
- 3x Lord-Sentinel Thelec (Legendary)
- 5x Guardian (Supreme)
- 20x Crystal Arcanist
- 40x Arcane Ring
- 40x Crystal Archers
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 1x exclusive Legendary Crystal Elf Avatar - Animated!
- 1x exclusive Legendary Crystal Elf Emote - Animated!

The Crystal Elves use overwhelming force from a distance, and hidden safely behind huge golems. Lord-Sentinel Thelec fields a whole battalion of his own if you bring enough spells. The bulky Guardian takes all the damage from your Border Patrol and Crystal Archers so they can bring the pain. Use Arcane Ring to punish anyone who tries to get too close.
With this Faction Box, you have the perfect kit to begin your watch as a Crystal Elf Conqueror.

title: Minion Masters: Might of the Slither Lords
description:
Might of the Slither Lords is the Faction Box for starting or expanding your Slither faction collection. This is a great +300% value bundle of Slither cards, including the cunning Legendary Musketeer and 2 exclusive Slither cosmetics.

Includes:
- 3x Musketeer (Legendary)
- 5x Harbinger (Supreme)
- 20x Rabid Prowler
- 40x Daggerfall
- 40x Slitherbound
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 1x exclusive Legendary Slither Avatar - Animated!
- 1x exclusive Legendary Slither Emote - Animated!

The Slither Lords use trickery, poison and control to keep their enemies at bay. Keep the strongest minions at arm’s reach with Musketeer’s Dodge ability while Harbinger controls the battlefield with his extremely long range. Slitherbound’s poison keeps enemies’ health low while your Rabid Prowler moves in for the kill with it’s deadly Pounce ability!

With this Faction Box, you have the perfect kit to start your reign as a Slither Lord.

title: Samurise
description: A runner/platformer where play as a samurai trying to save your cat from demons. Your character runs automatically while you control your jumps and attacks.

title: The Seven Realms: Realm 1 - Terran
description: The Seven Realms is a fantasy, story-driven, adult visual novel where your choices will shape the fate of the Realms and the people around you. Will you be a Fair or a Strong Ruler? Will fate be enough for you, or will you want more? The choices are yours to make.

title: Apex Legends: From the Rift
description: Go original and experience the beginning of Apex Legends again. Relive the rush of that first drop in Launch Royale then get reacquainted with Lifeline, revived with new abilities to take the frontlines, glide to reposition, and more. Tear through the Outlands with Rift Relics, offering cosmic abilities and weapons that dial up your power. Wield the Raptor’s Claw, a new Universal Mythic Melee Cosmetic and harness the madness of science in the new Battle Pass Split 1.

title: Larentia
description: Julius is an aspiring adventurer visiting port city of Genoa in Larentia region. The city is prospering and thus there is a constant shortage of manpower. Julius answers the call to make a name for himself over three years.

title: Smile, you're being filmed together
description: Dive into an intense psychological horror experience with Smile, You’re Being Filmed: Together, the multiplayer version where observation and cooperation are your greatest assets.

title: Croak Crusader: The Champion of Canada
description: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

title: Gelluloid Domination
description: Gelluloid Domination is a fast-paced strategy game of fantasy biology. Start with a single fragile cell and expand across the network, assimilating rivals to grow your gel-powered army. Evolve mutations, unlock new abilities, and outmaneuver deadly pathogens. Adapt and conquer, expand or be consumed. Every decision shapes the network — will you achieve total domination?

title: Bober Constructions
description: Bober k***w. Patrz jakie bydle! And even more than just one. 4 beaver-builders, and you can control one of them. Create structures, manage time and resources, watch out for obstacles, and remember, fast action is the key to success!

title: Space Duck: Escape
description: Collect equipment and climb upwards to assist Puddles the Duck escape from an erupting volcanic planet in this fast paced rogue-lite vertical platformer. Move quickly to avoid the rising lava flows to help this Space Duck Escape!
As in life, in 6.543.499.712 you have to figure out what you are supposed to do. You can even learn the controls in-game.

title: Operation Get Bike Back 2: Pedal Recall
description: A sequel to the 22 year old map Operation Get Bike Back except this time it takes place on Mars. Find all the disassembled bike parts scattered across the map across the Martian city (which houses apartments, stores and the usual hi-tech facilities) is open-ended just like the city in the original OGBB was.

title: Perfected Doom 3
description:
A gameplay-altering mod that changes the slow pacing of the base game, to a more fast-paced action-horror shooter. The mod attempts to completely overhaul the entire game with new monsters, rebalanced weapons, rebalanced monster stats, better graphics, new gameplay features, and much more.

There are 2 versions of the mod:
Vanilla Doom 3 & Doom 3: RoE.

title: Graymerca
description: A full-length simulation RPG (strategy SLG) that chronicles the civil wars of an empire and the offensives and defenses of continental countries for three generations.

title: Welcome to Maison Chichigami
description: Deep in the mountains, there is said to be a legendary hot spring: called the Spirit Spring. Becoming lost on the way to the spring, you are rescued by a mysterious, reclusive family. But what secrets does this family hide away in their manor?

title: Hidden Tomatoes 3
description: Explore serene forests, sparkling river, and rustic rural houses in *Hidden Tomatoes 3*! Find 100 cleverly hidden tomatoes in a peaceful yet challenging hidden object adventure. With stunning visuals and relaxing gameplay, it's fun for all ages. Can you uncover them all?

title: Mahoroba Cat
description: Travel across Japan with "MAHOROBA CAT"! The protagonist, tasked with taking photos for a travel magazine, visits famous landmarks nationwide to gather the desired shots. Now, set off on an adventure to capture your very own "best shot"!

title: Drop 'n' Fill!
description: A simple puzzle game? Well, this is a groovy puzzle game. Fill a board with blocks to make a complete line, remove them, and rinse and repeat. Great plays will be rewarded with increasingly evolving music, and you'll soon start to groove with the very blocks you're placing down!?

title: Class 3, Third Grade
description: Through a strange coincidence, the protagonist 'I' stumbles into the childhood bedroom they once inhabited. It is a world where hazy memories of childhood vividly regain their original form. Will 'I' be able to return to the real world from this labyrinth of memories?

title: Puppet Saurus
description: Two-player cooperation, kaiju pulling action!

title: Rescue Q
description: The objective of this “Top-Down puzzle action game” is to assist rescue workers in their movements until they can rush to a person in distress and rescue him or her. Various terrains and gimmicks will block your and the rescue team's way.

title: When Tails Gets Bored: Special Edition
Superhuman
description: superhuman is a visual novel full of battles and romance developed at Ren'py.

title: Bluesky Map Jam
description: This project started as a way for Doom mappers and modders to find each other on the new social media site and to show off their skills. The result was 44 maps from mappers of all disciplines with all kinds of aesthetics and gameplay styles.

title: Double Dangerous
description: Shooting freedom—aim anywhere and unleash chaos with dual guns!

title: Love Take Back
description: Tsuna Hanamushi has a big collaboration coming up with another YouTuber, but there's a problem: someone's stolen all the furniture in her apartment! With her roommate Sango Happou's help, the two of them head to the thief's house to regain what they'd lost.

title: Static Dread: The Lighthouse
description: Lovecraft meets Papers, Please. Play as a lighthouse keeper and guide ships safely into the harbor using your radio. Survive the presence of something impossible, and don’t let the shadows consume you!

title: Noelle: Lost Soul
description: Noelle: Lost Soul is a DELTARUNE fangame set during an alternative ending of the Chapter 2's Weird Route.

title: BrasFoot 2004
description: BrasFoot 2004 is the second iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: BrasFoot 2005
description: BrasFoot 2005 is the third iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: BrasFoot 2006
description: BrasFoot 2006 is the fourth iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: Foliage vs. Undead
description: A game created with the proposal of being a 3D version of Plants vs. Zombies.

title: Moon Rat
description: A charming platformer game about a Rat who embarks on an adventure where you collect cheese with properties that are out of this world.

title: Living_City
description: Watch Dogs mod that improves and expands the gameplay of the base game with custom missions, random events, new gadgets and several new features.

title: Frozen Ship
description: Frozen Ship is a first-person narrative adventure in the unique blending of survival, build&craft, and economic strategy genres.

title: 5D Diplomacy with Multiverse Time Travel
description: A new standard in measuring how galaxy-brained you are, 5D Diplomacy With Multiverse Time Travel combines the classic game of pure negotiation with the modern classic game of pure disorientation. Can you convince your opponent to support an attack in the present while simultaneously backstabbing them five years ago and seven timelines over?

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 2
description: Grab your Glider and jump off the Battle Bus as Fortnite OG enters Chapter 1 Season 2, bringing back beloved POIs like Tilted Towers and Shifty Shafts! The days of the Fort Knights are upon us again, so rise to the challenge and fight valiantly with upcoming loot like the Boogie Bomb and Minigun.

title: Itoshi Kokoro
description: Itoshi Kokoro is the second game in a series by Miyuki Taito. The main focus is on young Javoo. As he strives for adventure he finds himself being a part of something much larger than himself.​

title: Memento in Marrow
description:
A girl has a strange wish, a will she wishes to carry on even after her present is over. How far will Yori go to have it carried out? Can Thelma even help with something so bizarre? Can something so wrong possibly feel so right?

A kinetic visual novel about two girls who try to make the best of things, and certainly, things could be much better.

title: American Cooking Simulator
description: What's more American than Fast Food? How about cooking it with guns! Switch between individual weapons to move ingredients, cook and deliver them to your customers before they lose their patience.

title: BrasFoot 2007
description: BrasFoot 2007 is the fifth iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: BrasFoot 2008
description: BrasFoot 2008 is the sixth iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: BrasFoot 2009
description: BrasFoot 2009 is the seventh iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: Lekano World Online
description: is a social MMO on Unreal Engine 5, inspired by 90s and 2000s pop culture. Explore an open world, interact with fantastic creatures called Lekamons, and enjoy various fun and competitive mechanics. Meet new friends and immerse yourself in an exciting adventure!

title: Alquiem
description: Alquiem is a new Medieval RPG in which you will be able to gain strength through numerous classes and talent trees, professions and equipment to face the creatures that inhabit the lands of Odenzur. Its old-school style will remind all browser game fans of a familiar memory of Fighting, Loots and Relaxing.

title: Iron Convoy
description: Iron Convoy is a turn-based tactical survival game set in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. Manage your convoy, battle enemies, gather resources, and make tough decisions to survive. In this unforgiving world, only the strongest endure!

title: Maumau and the Labyrinth
description: Maumau, an adventurer, found a huge treasure chest in an ancient ruin. However, she was taken into the other dimension by the girl who appeared from the treasure chest. Maumau's unique adventure to survive begins.

title: Astragali
description: astragali is a short 3d computer program in which you throw objects called "dice", each with their own unique upgrades. The numbers on these dice are combined with a revolutionary new gameplay mechanic called "addition" which is used to determine the winner each match.

title: Magic Chess: Go Go
description: Welcome to Magic Chess: Go Go, the ultimate strategy game combining MLBB heroes with fresh and casual gameplay. It's not about fast mechanics, but about wisdom and a touch of luck! Play anywhere, anytime, and have fun with friends!

title: With The Fire And Sword
description: Turn-based strategy game with role-playing elements. WTFAS is a round PvP battle between several opponents until one winner remains. Play in pairs with a friend, improve your hero, army, artifacts, economy, etc. The main goal of the game is to stay alive longer than your opponent...

title: Welcome Googoo
description: A game where you write party invitations using a selection of words and stickers.

title: Legends of Elumia
description:
Legends of Elumia (Elumia) is a next generation web 3.0 Massively Multiplayer Online RPG (MMORPG). Players can immerse themselves in various gameplay zones, engaging in multiplayer adventures, quests and fierce battles to gain epic loot items.

In the Elumia game world, players have full ownership of their characters and equipment. The governance token Elumia Crowns ($ELU) gives users a voice in the future direction of the game’s development.

title: Timemoon
description: This cab is a time machine. Become a cab driver on the moon and solve the mystery of the president's assassination in this sci-fi time travel visual novel.

title: Mythical Whalers
description: Set sail in a fantasy roguelike, exploring ever-shifting seas. Face monstrous leviathans, trade with cunning factions, and shape a diverse, evolving crew of mythical races. Each decision leaves its mark — forge your legend or be lost to the depths!

title: Gretel's Honesty
description: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

title: Flowers for You
description: Simulation game where you create bouquets based on customers’ requests. While listening to the worries of people living in modern Japan, you’ll provide bouquets that brighten their lives a little.

title: Melt Away
description: People end up forgetting about the dead.

title: Dukkido
description: Recruit an army of minions and overwhelm the enemy! Dukkido is a physics-based Action-RTS, featuring large handcrafted levels and dungeons. You've been Zorped in from your edge of reality, and command your Dogs of War to riches, glory, and a good meal. Supports up to 5-player online co-op.

title: The Ultimate Banana Game
description: The ULTIMATE Banana Game is an idler game about... making an idler game.

title: There's No Dragons
description: There's No Dragons is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random dragons to find for each of them.

title: Manners Be Damned!
description: Push your friends and steal their hats in this party game for up to 8 players! You’ll play as posh pixel gentlemen with fancy beards and canes, but don’t be fooled! Good manners give no points…

title: Cipheur
description: Cipheur is a free cryptogram game allowing you to test your logic and language skills against 100 quotes by famous people.

title: My Joyful Aquarium
description:
My Joyful Aquarium is a cozy game about creating your own fish aquarium and breeding fish.
Create your own aquarium and breed fish - from the most basic species to the very elaborate and demanding ones.

title: Leadlight
description:
Do you like pixel mosaics? Try a new approach at it with Leadlight!
Assemble stained glass mosaic from small shattered pieces - move, rotate and blend colors! Leadlight is a unique puzzle experience with 100 images for you to assemble.

title: Day Zero
description: Can you survive a zombie apocalypse? Day Zero is a text-based survival game where choices determine fate and ethical and moral decisions matter. Every choice shapes the story. Are you ready to test your limits in a zombie apocalypse?

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion
description:
Plants Vs. Zombies: Fusion is a Plants Vs. Zombies fangame developed mainly by Blue Fly using the Unity engine.

The main concept of the game involves fusing your plants to make them stronger.

title: Dreamy Syrup
description: "Sato Ama," whom you met by chance at university, is an ardent fan of the virtual idol "Amaha Shiroppu" just like you! The two hit it off and go out together, talk about their favorite idols, and gradually become closer. However... "I almost got found out." A certain comment made by Amaha Shiroppu during a stream raises a question: "Could it be that Amaha Shiroppu is... Sato Ama?" Will you witness the virtual idol "Amaha Shiroppu" being found out? A thrilling love comedy where "dreams" and "reality" intersect!

title: Akai Majo
description: Dark fairy tale...

title: Kiloton
description: Invade your neighbors, conduct bombing campaigns, research and develop nuclear arsenals, and grapple for diplomatic power in Kiloton, a dark and abstract new RTS that puts you in the room where potentially world-ending decisions are made.

title: Of the Devil: Episode 1
description: Unlock the first of five episodic murder mysteries with the Episode 1 DLC for "of the Devil" and dive headfirst into the dark and thrilling corporate conspiracy that unfolds when the father of modern android programming is found dead of apparent suicide.

title: Occultus Vitae: Hidden Life
description: A psychological horror adventure where you explore abandoned locations and unravel dark legends. Set in a remote castle hiding a Nazi black magic experiment gone wrong, you'll face haunting environments, challenging puzzles, and a fight to survive the horrors lurking within.

title: Dead Daylight
description: "DEADDAYLIGHT" is a side-scrolling platform action-adventure game.Developed independently by a single person. It tells the dark story of a protagonist who wakes up from a nightmare about the plague during a plague after the gods abandoned the earth, and then return to the Cathedral of Holy Light.

title: Caught by a Spider
description:
You've fallen into the spider's web.

Caught by a Spider is a short yandere Visual Novel where you talk to a Spider!

title: Beta Hospital
description:
Beta Hospital is a horror game with a lot of Internet memes, with some funny content, but the main tone is horror.
You will play Zeng Zhaofeng, to Beluta hospital to find his missing wife Zhai Yina, on the way will meet a strange woman Hu Yilian, she is an enemy or a friend?

title: Gravity's Apple
description: An action adventure game in which you guide a rolling apple. As you roll through various stages accompanied by soothing music, your goal is to reach the top of Newton's head.

title: Unblinking
description: Trapped on death row, unravel the dark mystery of an ancient horror to escape alive. Outsmart the abyss, cheat death - if you dare.

title: The Silent Suite
