description: Last Drop is a story you need to experience. Welcome to Nykylä Finland 1994. Seppo Sahtivaara and friends are waiting for you. This is an openworld action game with a story that has an impact. We bring back old good games and action from the best movies from that era. We want you to enjoy!

title: Delivery Guy Simulator
description: Welcome to Delivery Guy Simulator, where you take on the streets of a vibrant city as a determined delivery guy! Navigate bustling city blocks, deliver all kinds of packages and rise to the top of the delivery business.

title: Scrapworks Simulator
description: You start as a scrap collector in Scrapworks Simulator and work your way toward building a large production workshop. There’s an active trading system among players; you can sell your products to others, establish business partnerships, or take on custom orders.

title: On Roads Between
description: Take photos of horrifying monsters and sell them to the news. Just don't get too greedy or you might have taken your last...

title: Harbor
description: In Harbor, your sole purpose is to survive. You need to access limited resources and protect everything you have. You will not only face hunger and thirst! You can form alliances with others, build shelters, and trade. There are no rules; the only safe zone is Harbor.

title: Echoing Silence
description: ECHOING SILENCE is more than survival. Alone in an unexplored cave, surviving means more than just staying alive — it means facing what you cannot see. Will you escape the silence, or will it consume you?

title: Fuel Harvest Together
description: Play solo or co-op with up to 5 players to find oil, store crude, refine fuels, and sell them at gas stations and shop. Dig for gems and fossils, upgrade your gear, lease new land, and dominate the city as the biggest oil supplier!

title: Scaravan 66
description: Put the pedal to the metal and outgun the Devil in this high-octane car combat roguelike. Get that extra bit of horsepower from allies you meet on the road to take on the fiends of the underworld as you defy fate and anyone who stands in your way.

title: Unidentified Feline Obliterators
description: Unidentified Feline Obliterators is a multiplayer arcade space shooter where you play as cats shooting deadly balls of matter in space! Their natural predators are the jetpack dogs, treadmill porcupines, and rocket rats. But what else is out there in space out to get these cats?

title: Kitten Food Alley
description: Kitten Food Alley is a casual management sim with the theme of petting cat. You can open various food shops and adjust food recipes, produce food by petting cat employees. Unlock various tools to automate petting. Enjoy the stress relief of cyber cat petting!

title: Infinity Cats Project
description: This is a typing-themed placement game. In the game, you can hire three cute kittens to type for you. At the same time, purchase various props to improve typing speed. Watch the cute cats typing and enjoy your relaxing and leisure moments here!

title: Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood
description: Enter the brutal battlefields of World War II in this grim, blood-soaked top-down shooter. Fight your way through relentless enemies with brutal gunplay, gritty visuals, and intense, unforgiving combat. Every bullet counts as you move through the trenches, leaving a trail of destruction and gore.

title: In Purr-Suit
description: A hidden object game where you need to find over 500 mischievous cats. Prepare for the great purr-suit!

title: Fire Hero: Pixel Rescue
description: Fire Hero - Pixel Rescue is a 2D pixel art platformer where you play as a firefighter rescuing civilians and animals from burning buildings. You'll travel through different worlds and biomes, following a story with short dialogues that reveal the dramatic events your character is experiencing.

title: CatTris
description: You’ve been ambushed by five adorable kittens! Take them home, solve fun 3D puzzles to help them settle in, and enjoy their playful tricks. Share both the joyful moments and the challenges with your new furry friends.

title: Farmyard Survivors
description: Survive hordes of cute (but evil) animals attacking your farm in this fast-paced, lane-based roguelite. Recruit adorable heroes and unlock powerful support animals to protect your farm from relentless attackers!

title: Cats Contrast
description: Dive into the fascinating world of a feline family, where every frame is filled with amusing details and unexpected nuances. Find 10 differences between the two images to uncover all the secrets of these fluffy heroes! ???

title: Mewseum: Masterpieces
description: Mewseum: Masterpieces is a shikaku-style puzzle game where each solved grid reveals part of a great masterpiece. Solve hundreds of puzzles and discover unique paintings in the latest art exhibition of the feline world!

title: Lab Cats
description: Lab Cats is a puzzle platformer game that emphasizes cooperation and coordination, requiring players to work together seamlessly.

title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty
description: BE A CAT! SAVE YOUR HUMAN! You're a fluffy feline who must save their owner from the hordes of flesh eating greebles which dwell within the bathroom. Will she make it through her morning business alive? Only you can save her!

title: What Comes Next
description: Stealth past enemies, solve puzzles and explore a unique narrative in this two-perspective cozy adventure game! You play as the orphaned girl Sophie and her pet rat Ami as you go on an adventure to find Sophies missing parents.

title: Maya: Cats of Istanbul
description: A captivating hidden object game set in the cat capital of the world: Istanbul! Explore detailed 3D dioramas of Istanbul's historic and iconic landmarks, and find the adorable cats hidden within them. But the real question is: Can you find them all?

title: A Short Death
description: A short 3D Platformer and Collectathon situated in Hell. Play as a humble cat (with wings!) and get to the top of the mysterious tower!

title: Nyassembled!
description: Nyassembled! is a simultaneous turn-based tactical RPG with a plan-action system. Build your modular mechs, command electronic cats, and explore a procedurally generated world.

title: Cats in Cozy Rooms
description: A charming room-decorating game with a feline twist! Hand-drawn art, unique cat clients, and endless creativity—decorate rooms based on each cat’s likes and dislikes to make their dream home! A relaxing, artistic game full of charm and creativity!

title: Puppet Team
description: Try to control one person with 2 people! Take the reins with your friends as you try to complete challenging and hilarious missions in this fun cooperative game of teamwork, chaos and comedy!

title: StreetSync
description: Dive into a rhythm-action FPS rogue-like where every shot must sync with the beat. Slide, wall-run, and harness the rhythm using your own custom music. One missed note leads to your demise. Collect powerful cards to remix the gameplay and keep the beat alive!

title: Sugar Overdrive
description: Slash and combo your way through hordes of sugar monsters in this first person melee game set in a candy city! Inspired by fast-paced FPS and Character Action games, swap weapons on the fly to extend your combos and heal from those combos. in Sugar OVERDRIVE, you combo or you DIE.

title: Escape the Quack
description: Get ready to race in this exciting platformer against the clock, complete your tasks, and outsmart the duck in this captivating low-poly world! Compete against friends and the world with an online leaderboard.

title: Crop Crusaders
description: Play as a sentient Vegetable who can transform into 6 different veggies with unique abilities. Escape the tormenting lab where you were created and are now being held captive.

title: Smack Monkey
description: Monkey climb. Monkey fall. Monkey climb.

title: Spider Canyon
description: Set in an unforgiving desert world, SPIDER CANYON is a first person physics-based puzzle platformer where you play as a spider. Use your trusty spiderweb to scale the dangerous desert terrain and reach the finish line. Good luck!

title: Disguised Blessing
description: Disguised Blessing is a dynamic first-person hack-and-slash game focused on fluid movement and ability-centered combat. Use power-ups and special abilities as you slice through enemies, unlock weapon skins, and progress through countless combinations of attributes.

title: Wacky West
description: Wacky West brings the action you've always wanted from those endless runner fake mobile ads, but this time it's the real thing! Dive into a fast-paced, post-apocalyptic world, fight off mutants, create sick combo builds, craft weapons, and survive the wasteland.

title: Dragon Expedition
description: This is a fantasy adventure action game that blends Eastern and Western elements. Players will become dragon slaying warriors and embark on a long journey, freely wandering between multiple main storylines. Acquire various skills, and challenge the ultimate boss.

title: Rustic Defense
description: Rustic Defense is a hexagonal fantasy tower defense game with roguelike elements, generated enviroment with option explore your own way. Research skills and cards, choose path, build towers and uprade them.

title: Braise
description: Dive into the fantasy world of Braise, a narrative adventure game. Explore the Dragon’s Valley and complete quests and puzzles to uncover the mysteries it holds.

title: Dragon Puncher
description: Dragon Puncher is a single-player arcade-style action game designed to be a training tool for Street Fighter and 2D fighting game enthusiasts, and a well-rounded short game. About 15-20 minutes in length, players typically perform 50-75 dragon punch moves per play-through.

title: Skulker
description: Skulker is a casual fishing game for work slackers. Swing your pole and enjoy your leisure fishing time.

title: Social Hook
description: Catch powerful monster cards with your fishing rod and battle against other players in exciting duels.

title: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic
description: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic is an RPG with a deep turn-based combat system and a story filled with multiple choices and endings. Let yourself be carried away by this epic adventure: plan your moves, choose your destiny and be prepared to face the consequences!

title: Open Fishing 2
description: Open Fishing 2 is a chill open world fishing game. Fill out a book with 115 fish species, meet friendly fish gods, sail the oceans with your boat, cook, draw your own map, and enjoy fishing without worries.

title: Big Burger Store
description: Big Burger Store is a 2D top down cooking game where you push around giant food items and serve burger orders to customers. Explore the busy world outside of work and participate in activities such as going fishing, fighting monsters, gambling, and so much more!

title: Sunshine Farm
description: In Sunshine Farm, grow crops, expand your farm, sell at the market, and build your dream shop while exploring caves, fighting monsters, and turning your house into a perfect home.

title: Leafing Home
description: Leafing Home is a cozy adventure game where you play as a small squirrel on a quest to retrieve the World Tree’s stolen fruit and find your way back home. Explore a vibrant world filled with quirky characters, and help restore nature to its former glory. Master unique flight mechanics, tackle aerial challenges, solve puzzles, and dive into a variety of fun mini-games. This heartwarming tale of belonging and environmentalism is perfect for players of all ages.

title: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
description: Manage your Graveyard by day as you bury and cremate bodies, maintain graves, fulfill visitor requests, grow crops, run a shop and unlock upgrades. When night falls, face relentless zombie hordes as you build defenses to protect your work and fight to survive in Zombie Graveyard Simulator!

title: Dream Life in the Country Side
description: A laid-back farming simulator where you play as Lisa, a dedicated farmer by day and a passionate partner of Honoka at night. Work the land, raise animals, and cultivate your relationship. Unlock special scenes as your bond and farm flourish.

title: Medieval Legacy
description: Start as a humble commoner and guide your family through generations in this family sim meets city builder. Climb the ranks of society to become the most influential family in the land. With wit, strategy, and a bit of luck, build your legacy - just try not to trip over your ambition!

title: Ranch Store Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in Ranch Store Simulator, where you care for adorable animals, grow fresh vegetables, and manage your own store! Feed, water, and harvest to keep your farm thriving. Sell your goods, attract customers, and expand your business in this cozy, fun-filled farming adventure.

title: Fungi Fantastico
description: Fungi Fantastico is a first person platforming adventure set in a vibrant mushroom filled world. Play as a druidic nature-magic staff wielder who is dealing with a toxic fungal infestation in your home. Set off on an adventure to purge the corruption and learn some new tricks along the way.

title: Operation Zero
description: Grab your biggest gun and jump into this story-driven top-down run-and-gun sci-fi arcade shooter starring the ultimate bio-engineered hero-manchild TASKILLER!

title: Dice with the Devil: Rerolled
description: Out-luck your opponents in Dice with the Devil, a horror themed autobattler where you unlock and collect special dice, customise them, and strategise to make the best hand of 3 to win your opponents' souls.

title: Gomiboru
description: Gomiboru is an arcade-puzzle game set in Stampland, a decaying amusement park. Guide a strange sticky ball as it collects the trash scattered throughout the environments, solving physics puzzles and facing absurd obstacles. Unravel the mystery behind the chaos in a dark and surreal world.

title: It Was You
description: A multiplayer murder mystery party for up to 12 players. Assume the role of Detective or Killer and use tools to uncover—or manipulate—evidence. Murder, investigate, discuss and deceive. Put your true-crime-solving skills to the test, or see if you are capable of cold-blooded murder.

title: Into the Mine
description: Old-school-inspired SHOOTER. Steal a treasure map from a gang of murderous bandits before heading into the darkness of an ancient mine. Avoid dangerous environmental hazards while battling deadly cursed enemies as you search for gold in this atmospheric single-player adventure!

title: Terminal Bore
description: Explore the depths of a desolate planet as you search for rare ores. Upgrade your mining pod, build outposts, and max out your skill tree as you navigate the dangers that lurk below!

title: Coal LLC
description: Fill your quota or die. Mine increasingly absurd amounts of coal using some dubious, but effective, mining techniques. Or relax and mine at your own pace in peaceful mode.

title: Casemate
description:
A custom mission for Halo: Combat Evovled, set in the Resistance universe.

Your squad will infiltrate a British military base that is home to valuable Gray Tech, a powerful and experimental piece of technology that could change the course of the war.

The objective is simple: get in, grab the tech, and get out. However, with heavy Chimeran forces, this is no easy feat.

Get ready to lead your team, infiltrate the British base, and secure the Gray Tech.

Good luck Specter.

title: Cave Path
description: Mine for valuable ores in a dangerous cave. Gather resources, fight monsters, and invest your earnings in skill upgrades as you push deeper for bigger rewards

title: Hexcavator
description: ⛏️ A fresh take on Minesweeper with hexagonal grids and treasure hunting! Clear tiles, collect resources, and unlock a huge collection of themes and flags. Soothing sounds and atmospheric visuals make every session a delight. Of course, featuring a classic mode available for purists!

title: TankOre Mining
description: Descend into the depths of a perilous underground world with your mining tank! Mine rare ores, evade deadly traps, and upgrade your tank to withstand the dangers below in this action-packed mining adventure.

title: Collapsed Horizon
description: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

title: Rock Crusher
description: Crush, upgrade, explore! This incremental clicker puts you in control of a little rock crusher on a mysterious planet. Uncover its secrets and your destiny as you complete the skill tree.

title: Stellar Shapers
description: Survive in space in this action roguelike with RPG elements where you use your strategy to combine design, weapons and passive skills, shaping your ship in your style, facing increasingly powerful enemies.

title: Mars: The Last Exodus
description: Build and manage your colony on Mars in this sci-fi colony sim meets RTS. Harvest and optimize resources to survive dangerous natural threats. But your ambition to conquer Mars has awakened an ancient threat. Raise troops, defend your colony and turn Mars into humanity’s promised haven.

title: Braveboy
description: Pick your breed, and build your clan. An open-world adventure about a pup from the Scottish highlands destined to the lead a rebellion against the evil Cat King Of England.

title: Water Maid
description: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

title: MolaMola Adventure
description: "Molamola Adventure" is a danmaku shooting game. Players will control a molamola and embark on an underwater adventure alongside a girl.

title: Flesh Psychosis
description: Flesh Psychosis is a little casual puzzle game, in which you have to score as much as possible. You have to collect various spooky ingredients and make deathly meals, using gravity and mad scientist tools.

title: The Lonesome Guild
description: In a world consumed by loneliness, only friendship can save the day. Lead a quirky cast in this colorful single-player ARPG full of heart, battles, and bonds that change everything.

title: Crunda
description: Leap, dive and slam your way across the asteroid belt in this unique physics speedrunning platformer. Explore the mysteries of Crunda's wobbly whimsical world or challenge your friends to tackle the world record table!

title: The Shadow of Swallow
description: "the Shadow of Swallow" is a stylish Chinese side-scrolling action game. Featuring beautiful 3D environments and fluid, acrobatic combat, players take on the role of a deadly female assassin. Experience thrilling stealth action through episodic missions.

title: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo 4
description: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo 4 enables players to customise their decks with new cosmetic card skins featuring characters such as Vault Boy, Ezio Auditore da Firenze, Percival Fredrickstein von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III and more.

title: RockBeasts
description:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

title: Spamware
description: You are sentenced to 3000 hours in prison. Earn your freedom by identifying and reporting spam.

title: Word to Angel
description: Play as five heroes in this musical pacifist RPG taking place in a 2D alternative version of the world where some friendly angels and a very shy god conduct balance and harmony together.

title: A Hole in my Room
description: Explore a mysterious place and an atmospheric world filled with horrifying and unusual environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, hide from darkness, and enjoy a unique experience in the horror genre.

title: Bubble Battle Blast 3D
description: Bubble Battle Blast 3D is a retro arcade third-person shooter in which a spaceship battles its way through 8 arenas in which a guard drone protects bubbles. Earn ship-enhancing items and temporary power-ups by blasting bubbles with lasers, Earn bonus points after each arena to upgrade faster.

title: Of Roots and Gears
description: Of Roots and Gears is a dialogue-based RPG in an aetherpunk setting. Explore the world where nature and technology are charged with magic. Make choices, find friends and enemies. Make your own path!

title: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo 2
description: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo 2 enables players to customise their decks with new cosmetic card skins featuring characters from Cyberpunk 2077, The Binding of Isaac, Slay the Spire and Stardew Valley.

title: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo 3
description: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo 3 enables players to customise their decks with new cosmetic card skins featuring characters from Divinity Original Sin 2, Shovel Knight, Potion Craft, Enter The Gungeon, Cult of the Lamb, Don't Starve, 1000xRESIST, and Warframe.

title: Wild Willy West
description: Wild Willy West is a western top-down shoot 'em up, featuring action packed levels and instant death combat. Use an arsenal of magical bullets to blast your way through the old west, and take revenge on those who wronged you.

title: Ahapika: Heroic Agency
description: Gather brave heroes and open the most heroic agency in Ancient Greece! Help people, argue with the gods, but remember: a mistake can be fatal.

title: Ladies I'm Ready
description: The player becomes Samuel, uses the first-person perspective to immerse himself in meeting two beauties, and embarks on a joyful and sweet love journey with them. Two girls with different personalities, and it is up to you to decide who will go to the end with you.

title: Blessing in the Darkness
description: Blessing In The Darkness has an unique turn-based combat system, into a dungeon scroller perspective, with survival horror elements! There is no map, go ahead and try to survive till the end!

title: Parasited Will
description: Enter this story of survival against the new alien domain with the help of the warriors of the Anti-Chaos Brigade in intense, fast-paced Arcade-style combat.

title: The Adventures of Badgersaw: Chapter 1
description: The Adventures of Badgersaw is the only RPG where you can restore your party's MP with a slap. The adventurer Badgersaw and his two companions are lost in a cave full of schizo-tech and nightmarish creatures. They must find their way out, but end up unwittingly unravelling a web of ancient secrets.

title: Pokettohiro
description: An epic, old-school adventure full of challenges and secrets! The biggest adventures come in small packages!

title: 3D Escape Room: Detective Story
description: 3D Escape Room: Detective Story is an immersive 3D puzzle game that takes you to 1930s London. In the game, you play as an insightful private detective, searching for clues in realistic 3D environments, solving intricate puzzles and mini-games, and cracking bizarre cases.

title: Axe Slasher
description: Axe Slasher is a fast-paced 3D dungeon crawler where you slash through endless dungeons with your axe. Battle hordes of enemies and gather loot. Can you survive the depths and emerge victorious?

title: Veilfall: True Strength
description: A story-driven fantasy turn-based strategy rpg where players mix-and-match skills, carefully balance their equipment, and manage character deployment to minimize Fatigue.

title: Otaku Miracles
description: A story about you, an anti-social Otaku who is a student at Ashikaga Academy, a very traditional private high school in Japan. Suddenly, you awaken in a place called the Spirit Realm and are tasked with saving the world! How? Well, with the help of your friends of course!

title: Level up Everything!
description: Bite sized solo dungeon delve. Use cards to activate gear or special effects as you delve through dungeons. Attack, block, move, heal, and interact with the environment using the unique card & gear activation system. After each delve upgrade your gear and cards to exploit powerful combos.

title: Ways of Alchemy
description: Become a medieval alchemist in this card game. Grow, craft, and brew your way to power. Hire adventurers, discover ancient recipes, and master the art of alchemy. No wands are required — just wit and wisdom.

title: The Suspense
description: How might life inside Artificial Intelligence be like? Is it possible to stop this painful routine? This life even real or not? Try your luck...

title: The Last Nordic Tribe
description: The Last Nordic Tribe is a RPG with survival elements set at the end of Little Ragnarök(536-539 AD), where 95% of Scandinavia's population perished. Survive the frost, battle hunger, foes, and adversity, exploring a brutal world inspired by the early Middle Ages. Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Sovereign Brain Empire
description: “Who isn’t a baby anyway?”~You travelled to a parallel world governed by the Sovereign Brain AI. In SB Empire, you’re an adopted “one-year-old”, recognized as a "Monarch-level" prodigy! There will be beauties giving you a sheltered babyhood. Your brilliance and privileges will change their fates!

title: Haydee 3
description: Haydee III is a hardcore metroidvania with third-person shooter mechanics, platforming, puzzles, a sexy heroine and cake!

title: Trackastrophe!
description: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

title: The Wind's Path
description: The Wind's Path is a fast-paced top down singleplayer game. If you want to stay alive, keep moving. A mysterious force is wreaking havoc in other worlds and only you can stop it. You'll unlock powerful wind abilities that not only make you a force of nature but help you fly through difficult levels.

title: Tincan HD
description: Released March 6th, 2013, to celebrate five full years of game development, Tincan HD is a remake of the original game in C++ using the Allegro library, as well as a custom engine I built myself for the language.

title: Yanchat
description:
Yanchat is a question and answer forum board for completely normal people.

Users can ask from a variety of topics but the most common topics here are relationship advice. Our members strive to give helpful and rational advice and always abide by our rules and guidelines.

title: The Brothers Hotel
description: Welcome to The Brothers Hotel, where shadows whisper secrets, and every corner hides untold horrors. This spine-chilling indie horror game takes you deep into a mysterious hotel filled with eerie atmospheres, enigmatic puzzles, and a story that unveils the dark bond of two brothers.

title: Train Metropolis
description: Idle Clicker City Builder. Build and manage your railway company, helping the city expand and thrive as you grow together.

title: Parking Master
description: Parking Master is the ultimate parking simulation! Park with precision using real mirrors and advanced car systems. Navigate tight spots, manage your own parking empire across Europe and Japan. Build, expand, and conquer diverse environments!

title: Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids
description: An action-strategy game where you gather Brainium, build a base, and command your army of bots to defeat the freaky Brains-in-Jars aliens. Lead from the front with your hero, Chip or Clawz, or both in co-op. Look out for ejected alien brains, you can squish ‘em!

title: Fishing the Abyss
description: This is a relaxing atmospheric game where you simply watch a robot catch creatures. Place it at the edge of your screen like a vertical desktop accessory and observe the ecosystem. It’s neither an idle game with mountains of stats nor an exciting fishing game.

title: Hang up Street
description: Build your vocational academy to turn adventurers into your idle heroes, liven up the deserted streets, and advance the levels together!

title: Sunset Town
description: Explore a post-apocalyptic city destroyed by a solar flare. Fight mutated creatures, hostile factions, and harsh environments while scavenging for resources. Manage survival needs, upgrade gear, and uncover the truth behind the disaster in this challenging, randomly generated adventure.

title: OpenFront
description: A massively multiplayer real-time strategy game pitting hundreds of players against one another. Over one million nuke each other every month.

title: Muse
description: The story begins in a mysterious house. Strange items scattered about are key to uncovering the truth. You must ingest them and “vomit blood,” gaining powers at the cost of your health. But beware: the scent of your blood draws a lurking threat that ends the game if it catches you.

title: ProtoBound
description: ProtoBound is an obstacle-avoidance game in which you navigate your character through various obstacles. It's inspired by bound-type custom maps for StarCraft.

title: Omelet You Cook
description: The cozy chaotic cooking roguelike. Assemble omelets for quirky students using ingredients from a conveyor belt. Discover wacky combinations to satisfy the ever-demanding Principal Clucker.

title: Warborne: Above Ashes
description: Fierce flames of war are now raging. We roam, fight, and defeat all who stand in the way of our ambitions. Join a faction in the sci-fi post apocalyptic-style multiplayer PvP war game Warborne Above Ashes, and fight for honor!

title: Smiling Misery
description: Smiling Misery is an interactive tale that introduces us to the story of Margo, a jester who, weary of a comfortable life, embarks on a journey to seek misery. Join Margo on a brief adventure through a Mediterranean medieval kingdom and bring the story to its conclusion.

title: Doki Doki: The Dark Rainclouds
description: Doki Doki: The Dark Rainclouds is a fan mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that delves into a darker and more emotionally profound approach to the original story. In this mod, players explore Sayori's journey from a new perspective, highlighting her inner struggles, hidden thoughts and the challenges she faces in her everyday life.

title: Drapline
description: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

title: Poem Ex Machina
description: Anime style, Ride X Fight, fast paced game.

title: The Second Circle
description: The Second Circle is a skill-based fast paced movement game. With a unique mix of fast movement mechanics, deadly weapons and powerful abilities all blending together in lethal dance, it is your skill that will prove whether you are worthy to pass the trial or be stuck in the circle of desire!

title: Divine Orders
description: Bullet-hell shooter with RPG-like elements such as exploration, growth and reinforcement. In each area, the situation changes, and you have to earn experience scores, acquire materials, level up and strengthen your weapons, and challenge the bosses

title: Cafe Dreamland
description: This is Cafe "DReAMLAND". Grant your "customers'" wishes by serving them drinks mixed with a hint of blasphemy! Cafe simulation x Exploration x Multiple endings Let your choices decide the final outcome.

title: Solo Defender
description: Solo Defender is a vertical space shooter game where the player clears waves of multiple enemy types and mini bosses to ultimately face off the the final Mothership and free the Janera system.

title: Gemmy's Adventure
description: Simple but not easy! Gemmy's Adventure is a casual action game. All you need to do is move a mouse to reach the finish line without touching any traps, objects and walls. Levels get harder, requiring strategy to pass.

title: Tessera
description: Explore multiple worlds in first-person, composing views and transforming them into living jigsaw puzzles.

title: Cryptage
description: A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters and buying new staffs and skins to improve yourself! The game has endless mode.

title: Stratogun
description: Stratogun is an ultra-fast orbital arcade space shooter where a fraction of a second will decide whether you live or die. Do you have what it takes to survive on the orbit? Play the demo and find out.

title: Assetflip Attorney
description: Assetflip attorney is a murder mystery satire visual novel, Solve crimes in a world where everyone has gone insane and everything feels like a fever dream, interrogate witnesses, hunt for clues and take down the criminal organization that threatens to destroy reality.

title: Vespia: Shield of Aberration
description: Vespia: Shield of Aberration is a strategic tower-defense game where you combine spells to create the most powerful wizards. Blending rogue-like and deck-building mechanics, you’ll upgrade your wizards, unlock new spells, and recruit allies to defend the city from impending doom!

title: Perfect World: Ascend
description:
Join players worldwide on the same server. Switch between landscape and portrait modes at will. The latest masterpiece from the 20-year classic IP “Perfect World” is now officially released globally!

[ Perfect World: Ascend ] offers a truly open 3D world with high freedom and diverse gameplay.
Choose from a variety of cool professions and engage in exciting cross-server battles.
The innovative rotatable screen design allows you to switch between landscape and portrait modes at will.

title: Spring in Her Step
description: Change is scary, but she'll choose to bloom anyway.

title: Goo Hunter
description: Play as a brave Slime treasure hunter who uses her unique abilities to overcome dangerous obstacles and solve intriguing puzzles. With her sticky hands, she skillfully launches herself, uncovering the best path to progress in her adventure.

title: Alliance Peacefighter
description: A linear, story-driven space sim in the style of 90s classics like X-Wing and Wing Commander. As a newly qualified Alliance pilot, you find yourself caught up in a plot to break the fragile peace between two galactic super powers.

title: Mortal Quest
description: A survival-adventure game about a mortal who's been transferred to a demon-infested island.

title: Rebel Tank Solo-Raid
description: Top-down extraction shooter, where you play as a tank tasked with raiding a military outpost filled with landmines to loot Nuclear Nukes and deliver it at the extraction point.

title: Arthur Loves Watermelon
description: Arthur Loves Watermelon is a unique 2D Platformer where you help a little squirrel named Arthur to recover the sacred watermelon tree from an evil witch.

title: Quodan: Treachery on the Arheid
description: When the Arheid III is sabotaged by a spy aboard the spaceship, Captain John Will Smith must get to the bottom of it or risk another attack.

title: Shadow Breakers
description: Play as Ultra, Apola, and Mozez as they battle shadow demons unleashed by the Cursed, a group seeking to restore balance through chaos. With their robot companions, they must split up to stop the demons and thwart the Cursed’s sinister plans.

title: Super Meat Boy: Collector's Edition
description:
This is a Collector's Edition of Super Meat Boy distributed by a subscription box service Indiebox in April 2017 under the name of "Dr. Fetus Edition".

The edition includes:
- DRM-Free Installation Disc
- 2 Disc Soundtrack
- Instruction Manual
- Steam Key
- Plastic Bag of 48 Meat Cubes
- Dr. Fetus' Level Skipper
- Indiebox Sticker
- Exclusive Slime-San Demo

title: Harold Rabbit: Finder of Lost Things
description: Harold Rabbit : Finder of Lost Things is a fully hand-drawn point & click game for all ages. Join Harold and his sidekick Maud on a quest to recover Harold's stolen trumpet!

title: Esteem
description: Esteem is a game that takes you to discover the saga of a little girl called Lais and her internal conflicts as she fights to save her village and her friends. How far would you go for your friends? What fears are you able to face to defend what is most important?

title: EndSeeker
description: Infiltration game with roguelite mechanics, the room's placement is different each time you launch the game. Can you find your way past the Guardians which monitor hallways ?

title: Nitronauts
description: Nitronauts is a 2-6 player couch/online multiplayer party game fusing classic Bomberman-like mechanics with explosive new twists. Battle across nine unique stages with an arsenal of wacky items & power-ups. Gather your friends and let the bombs do the talking!

title: Bamboo Bushido
description: When a mysterious force snatches his Grandpa into the depths of the Bamboo Forest, young Sam must master the ancient art of Bushido to bring him home. Battle a wacky cast of enemies and an even wackier cast of bamboo in this action packed 2D Adventure.

title: The World Ends in Ohio
description: Explore the depths of Ohio and uncover a mystery in the Midwest!

title: Kite Hunter
description: Aim for the skies and shoot down the kites. Witness the vivid skyline in rugged weather and lighting that challenge your aiming skills. Discover relics and upgrade munition in a race against time.

title: The Corruption
description: Explore a decaying digital world and lure its corrupted inhabitants into traps, cascading explosions and the barrel of your grenade launcher.

title: Fortitude Tower Defense
description: A classic Tower Defense game with minor offensive tactics.

title: Sorcery Slam
description: Sorcery Slam is a competitive/party puzzle game inspired by retro era classics. Play with up to 6 Sorcerers locally or online to collect powerful elemental Gems and be the first to power up your ultimate final blast for the win!

title: Bloodmoon Rush
description: Brave through Dracula's castle to retrieve Davids true love; his car! In this 2D platformer with stunning visuals, you'll face goons and ghouls, fight off Dracula's loyal staff and explore the castle on your way to the final boss, the big man himself.

title: Snowman Mo
description: Snowman Mo has been separated from the little girl who built him! Now, he'll have to scamper, slide, and snowball fight his way across the mountains of Powderville to get back to her.

title: Office Outbreak Savior
description: The office is under zombie attack! Recruit coworkers and survive the outbreak.

title: Fungi Crossing
description: Traverse terrain and solve puzzles as odd sticky mushrooms!

title: Quail Crossing
description: Cross hectic roads, dodge vehicles, and hatch eggs! Quail Crossing is a challenging, emotional rollercoaster where you step into the daring life of a quail and guide your bevy of hatchlings to safety. Earn high scores and unlock the latest in quail fashion!

title: Cardinal Sequence
description: Cardinal Sequence is a relaxing sci-fi deckbuilder where you play cards by matching patterns, assemble game-changing synergies and watch your score reach into the stratosphere and beyond.

title: HalfMoon Adventures
description: You own a store for weekend adventurers and mainly sell maps of dungeons. You sell maps during the day and crawl through dungeons at night. However - the market for map sellers is in high demand.Try to offer the best maps and push your competitor out of the market!

title: Super Block Boy and Friends
description: Super Block Boy and Friends is an exhilarating 2D precision platformer that puts your skills and sanity to the ultimate test. Dive into our world of challenging levels that reward grit and persistence.

title: The Void Below
description: An underwater horror game where you take photos of wreckages in the deep sea. Pilot a submersible vehicle. Locate the shipwrecks with sonar. Get out of the vehicle and take photos while managing your oxygen.

title: Endless Salvation
description: Endless Salvation is a cooperative puzzle game (with a single-player prelude) .You and your partner will respectively play the roles of Savior, who's rescuing the Wanderer, and Wanderer, who seeks a way to come back to mundane world. Communicate effectively and complete the adventure together.

title: Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade
description: Fast-paced slalom 'em up fantasy roguelite. Play as a radical goblin and his friends with a ton of different powers. Swerve past obstacles, do sick tricks, slam into enemies and collect boons as you make your way to the underworld to catch air off the The Ancient One's Halfpipe.

title: Tiny Duck Hunt 3D
description: Next generation arcade game in a cute cartoon 3D world. Sweet graphics, nice gameplay, unique control system focused on handheld and joypad gaming.

title: Suqare: Hired Gun
description: Take on mission after mission as you attempt to become the best Mercenary ever. Shoot, stab, protect, steal, lie, betray, and much more as you complete jobs from corporations and special interests. Will you assist or destroy them? The choice is yours... And watch out for that pesky Cricle.

title: Redneck Brawl Turbo
description: Redneck Brawl Turbo is a casual auto shooter that unfolds in a quirky world, drawing inspiration from 1980s martial arts comedy movies. Play as a guy who must save his village. Fight waves of wacky enemies. Earn coins and spend them on lessons from the Kung Fu Master, Drunken Master, and Ninja.

title: BitRick's Venture
description: BitRick's Venture is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps. Take control of BitRick and face off against terrifying monsters armed with your pistol! Select your gun, find items and upgrades to make your character even stronger.

title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3
description: MATCH DNA BUBBLES IN AN UNDERGROUND LAB TO KEEP YOUR PSYCHIC CLONE FROM INVADING YOUR MIND AND TURNING YOU INTO A CANNIBAL. This is the match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania you didn't know you needed.

title: Potion Pleasing
description: How far are you willing to go to be accepted?

title: Nelumbra
description: Trapped in a timeloop with no memories, you are the Light Bearer, fighting to uncover the truth - but at what cost? Harness rhytmic auto-attacks and dashes as light fades around you, raising tension with every move. Shape your power, rewrite your path, and embrace eternity or break free.

title: Azure Flame
description:
Vance and Carmelo, 2 friends who have lived in the city of Calida—capital city of the region of Dracaena, where dragons come from—since their birth have recently started dating.

Unfortunately, Carmelo’s family doesn’t approve of Vance due to old family traditions as well as the unspoken "rules" of Dracaena. To make matters worse, Vance is discriminated against for being a hybrid and not a “pure” dragon.

Will these lovers be able to escape? Or are they doomed to be separated?

title: Mirrored Phantoms
description: Trapped in a nightmarish mannequin factory where reality itself is shattered, unravel the secrets of Mirrored Phantoms. Explore a deeply atmospheric world, solve the mystery of the mirror shards, and survive the terrors that await in this slow-burning, first-person horror experience.

title: Crystal: Automaton
description: A short automation challenge aimed at everyone from beginner to veteran. Take your time to uncover the lore of an ancient civilization without any dangers. Can you find a clever way to use logistics to overcome the scarce space available?

title: Escape Observation
description: ‘Escape Observation’ is a short walking simulator inspired by the game ‘The Exit 8’, where you can only move your character and control your vision. It is important to note that the game is not about finding out if a room has changed, but rather that each room is different and you must be aware of the signals that these changes give you.

title: Tumble Egg
description: A colorful physics-based 3D ball platformer where you play as an egg. Traverse levels across the four seasons. Collect challenging coins and speedrun levels to test your skills.

title: Clean Stack
description: A little puzzle game that involves stacking odd-sized objects with fun physics without making anything touch the ground. There are lots of different objects. You'll also need to use potions on the objects to get through the levels, which makes the game even more challenging!

title: RoboSamurai
description: RoboSamurai is a 3rd-person fast-paced sword-fighting action/slasher game about Nix: a robot mechanic turned katana-wielding fighter. Set in a cyberpunk dystopian city filled with corruption and tyrannical corporations waiting for him to let his guard down.

title: RLChess
description: Dive into the ultimate chess showdown with RLChess! It's not just a board game; it's an epic battlefield where classic chess meets wild party antics. Get ready for a chess revolution that's packed with thrilling twists and lively interaction. Charge into RLChess and turn the chess world on its head!

title: Killer Trait
description: Would you ally with a serial killer to get revenge on your worst enemy?

title: Only for Gamers
description: The game was designed for only Pro gamers. There are many hard obstacles in the game. You have to find a correct solution to overcome all the obstacles. However, It will not be as easy as you imagine.

title: Momoka
description: MOMOKA is a RPG Maker Pixel Horror Adventure game made in RPG Maker 2003. It was made for IGMC 2018.

title: Mad Room No.3
description:
LET'S TURN THE MILK OVER.

In this game, you play as a Japanese high school girl in the Judo club.

A short game where you interact with your surroundings, and chat with your classmate who is a bit of a weirdo.

title: Cribbish
description: The roguelike deck builder for Cribbage.

title: Electigirl: High Tension Beauty
description: A retro and free-scrolling shoot 'em up. The plot follows a city being drained of electric supply by otherworldly invaders.

title: Hole Dweller
description: Hole dweller is a sandbox incremental furry porn game! You are the captain of a caravan, with spare rooms, not to worry there are plenty of cute and hot characters to fill them with.

title: Edge of Memories
description: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

title: This is Kiko
description: A long time ago, my younger sister and I lived together in a house by the sea.And then, one day—I remember meeting her.Was she a good person? I should have asked myself that question sooner."THIS IS KIKO" is an adventure game set in the modern era.

title: Elmo Through the Looking-Glass
description: In this game, Elmo goes through the looking-glass in his room to find the little red monster he sees there. Skills emphasized include object identification, visual discrimination, vocabulary, matching, and reading. The game is inspired by Alice Through The Looking-Glass (Alice in Wonderland).

title: Grover's Travels
description: Grover's Travels is a 1998 CD-ROM game developed by Encore Software and Children's Television Workshop. In this parody of Gulliver's Travels, users join Grover as he meets Big Bird, Elmo, Mr. Snuffleupagus and more. There are six activities designed to teach numbers, shapes, sound recognition, story comprehension and emotions.

title: Golly Soda Pop
description: A Brazilian soda brand that existed from the 40s until the 60s, closed its doors after a macabre incident... Nowadays, an urban legend circulates that says a creature roams the abandoned bottling factory's corridors. May God help the poor soul who dares to enter this place...

title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Deluxe Edition
description:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a ground-breaking turn-based RPG with unique real-time mechanics, making battles more immersive and addictive than ever. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France in which you battle devastating enemies.

Get the ultimate Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 experience with the Deluxe Edition!
The Deluxe Edition includes:

·Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Base Game
·The “Flowers” Collection - Six outfits and hairstyles inspired by the Flowers of Lumière, along with six additional “Gommage” outfit variations. One for each playable character.
·“Clair” - A custom outfit for Maelle
·“Obscur” - A custom outfit for Gustave

title: The Thing from Space
description: A meteorite crater intrigues George, an geologist, due to reports of strange events. He manages to camp there and study the soil, but something outer-worldly happens that night...

title: Need for Kill
description: Quake 3 but in 2D dimension, Launched in 2001 for Computers by the "NFK team"

title: Skull Skull Skull
description: Skull Skull Skull is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you fight off hordes of skulls. Customize your gun and choose power ups to survive as long as possible.

title: Bunny Love Expert
description:
Reisen has been having troubles with love lately... but she's far from the only one. Basically every bunny in all of Eientei is asking for her help to get with the rabbit of their dreams, leaving with little time to handle her own issues.

Solve everyone's problems (somehow) by solving 28 bunny-based puzzles, picking stuff up or using items and devices to direct the bunnies to where they want to go!

title: Cralon
description: Cralon is an authentic 3D dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

title: Loop: New Reality
description: Play as Maya, a beta tester trapped inside a broken VR simulation. Manifest items to navigate hidden digital layers, purge anomalies, and escape the terrifying Warden. Manage battery life and corruption, search your virtual desktop for clues, uncover the secret truth, and shatter the endless L00P!

title: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe
description: “A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe” is a point-and-click stealth game where the goal is to make sure nobody talks to you so that your head does not explode. You'll get to experience an average week of Giraffe's life as he does exciting things on his to-do list, such as going to the laundromat, peruses antique stores, purchasing groceries, and working out at the gym, all while making sure the incredibly sociable citizens of Friendly City never have a chance to speak with him for fear of losing your head.

title: Company of Heroes 3: Fire & Steel
description:
Company of Heroes 3: Fire and Steel is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ skirmish vs AI.

US Forces – Heavy Weapons Battlegroup
Superior team weapons and halftracks control the battlefield before heavy armor arrives to finish the fight.

Requisition .50 cal heavy machine guns or off-map batteries of the devastating Black Dragon howitzer as part of Weapons Team support, or call in the Cavalry, with Assault half-track variants, 3-inch towed Anti-tank guns, and the implacable M26 Pershing heavy tank.

Wehrmacht – Terror Battlegroup
Shatter the enemy’s willpower with airstrikes, suppression and superior infantry tactics. Devastating heavy weapons will destroy anything that remains standing.

Use unorthodox Terror Tactics such as field interrogations, the Stuka’s iconic Jericho Trumpet, or V1 Rocket Strikes to force the enemy from the field, or show the enemy no quarter with Weapon Superiority and the King Tiger heavy tank.

British Forces – Canadian Shock Battlegroup
Seize territory to gain unparalleled momentum on the battlefield, and deploy powerful incendiary weapons to displace any who dare deny your movement.

Call upon Canadian Shock Sections and aggressive battlefield tactics to secure ground in a Shock Assault, or deny the enemy what they stubbornly refuse to cede with Incendiary Weapons, including the indefatigable Churchill Crocodile.

Afrikakorps – Panzerjäger Kommand Battlegroup
Cripple the enemy’s advance with defensive obstacles, enabling powerful anti-armor weapons to make the killing blow.

Use Stalling tactics, including Roadblocks, Minefields and Defensive Positions to buy the time you need to deploy your forces; elite Tank Busters and Tank Hunting tactics including the Elefant Tank Destroyer will crush even the strongest enemy armor.

title: Save The Village: Tower Defense
description: Save The Village is a medieval tower defense game where you strategically protect villages from waves of skeletons, goblins, and fearsome bosses. Build powerful towers and use magical abilities to fend off the invading forces!

title: Home Again
description: Home Again is an interactive story game about Jason, a man stuck in an endless loop of work who adopts a stray cat. Discover Jason's journey through the eyes of his little cat friend as they meet Melissa, a caring florist who will change the way Jason sees the life.

title: Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows
description: Konnichiwa Shop-owner-kun! Become a hero of the weeb/otaku community in a cute Japanese suburb with your very own waifu pillow shop! Stock your shelves with exciting dakimakura designs, expand your store, and make a fortune in Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows!

title: El Hero
description: El Hero is a 100% Brazilian Battle Royale, developed by Moonite! Bringing Brazilianness in every aspect, El Hero provides a unique gameplay, mechanics & environment experience for your Hero.

title: Lily & Sury: Adventures On Cristya
description:
Classic retro-style platform game. Help Lily or Sury save your friends from the evil Wuning through 8 worlds and 32 levels.

In this game you will find 32 challenging levels, find secret treasures, jump, crush your enemies and go through multiple obstacles, stairs, cliffs, spikes, various enemies and most importantly, save your companions from the hands of Wuning to prevent them from destroying the planet Cristya.

title: Chess Bomb
description: Chess Bomb is a unique puzzle game where bombs take the shape of chess pieces. Strategically use these explosive chess bombs to fend off waves of invading monsters threatening the chess kingdom.

title: Siberian Way
description: Siberian Way is a historical detective thriller. Follow the dark non-linear story and decide how it can end! For all fans of snowy Siberia, Murder on the Orient Express and twisted plots, seasoned with mysticism.

title: Museum of All Things
description: Visit the Museum of All Things, a nearly-infinite virtual museum generated from Wikipedia! You can find exhibits on millions of topics, from the Architecture of Liverpool to Zoroastrianism. Search for the topic you want to learn about, or just wander from topic to topic as your curiosity dictates!

title: Signal: Uncharted Lands
description: Embark on a journey with four adorable explorers! Uncover all the secrets of a post-apocalyptic world, meet the future inhabitants of Earth and enjoy plenty of Easter eggs. Your choices will shape the game's ending, so choose wisely! Or try a second playthrough to catch all the fun moments!

title: What's On The Menu?
description: In What's on the Menu?, step into the shoes of a restaurant manager. From selecting ingredients and crafting menus to hiring staff and customizing your restaurant, every decision counts. Face random events, unlock new recipes, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate restaurateur!

title: Flood of Zombies
description: Flood of Zombies is a third-person roguelike shooting game in which the player takes on the role of a soldier, defending against numerous zombie attacks!

title: Surf Dance
description: Next to the cartoonish cute style island, with your favorite cute animals, experience the excitement of high-speed sprint in the rhythm of platform jumps.

title: Refence
description: Refence is a roguelike based idle defense game, where you can choose heroes and their traits, upgrade your castle, and manage resources to fend off enemies trying to attack your castle.

title: Bakken: Ski Jumping 2025
description: Bakken 25 is a winter sports simulation game. Become a ski jumper and master every aspect of the discipline from the inrun to the outrun: the jumping, the flying and the landing! Are you ready for a new season?

title: Hazmat Hijinx
description: In Hazmat Hijinks, you’ll need multicolored hazmat suits for protection as you traverse chemical spills, walk through radiation, and battle the Cleaners in your quest to rescue Hanford’s furry friend.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Tales of Agrabah
description: The 15th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings the new Aladdin Realm, the new characters Aladdin and Jasmine, four new Floating Islands, improvements for cooking and UI, custom size rooms and the Oasis Retreat Star Path.

title: Firefly Village
description: The Firefly Village awaits! A bite-sized, streamlined farming sim that focuses on moments that matter, without wasting a single second of your time. Build a homestead, raise crops, tend to livestock, make friends, and enjoy a pocket of paradise where farming is a delight and friends plentiful.

title: Knights of the Crusades
description: Travel to the Holy Land with the First Crusades. Rise from a humble knight to the founding father of a world-spanning holy order. Lead through war, faith, diplomacy, and cunning schemes. Experience a unique blend of RTS, city-building, and sandbox gameplay, and shape history!

title: Dragon Attack Mythologies: A Night Wolf Revenge
description: Jump, dodge, and fight against anyone who crosses your path in search of revenge. Explore 8 challenging worlds filled with danger and classic arcade action.

title: Void Echo
description: A psychological horror game where players explore eerie liminal spaces through the lens of an old camera. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive lurking threats in a surreal, non-linear world that blurs the line between reality and dreams.

title: Food Park Manager
description: Build and manage your own Food Park! Customize food stalls, hire staff, and cater to hungry customers as you find the perfect recipes. Decorate your park to attract and satisfy more customers.

title: Overtime Pay
description: As the clock strikes midnight, you find yourself trapped within the oppressive confines of a desolate office. Your task seems straightforward: Keep putting the correct paper in the correct place and you might find yourself entitled to overtime pay. And will you?

title: Shovel & Swindle
description: Shovel & Swindle is a fun co-op game, where players will make a living by graverobbing as Scotland's infamous Burke and Hare! Explore multiple locations and uncover the graveyard's secrets by solving puzzles, and avoiding getting caught by patrolling bobbies!

title: Gyroban
description: Spin and shake entire Sokoban-like levels to solve puzzles, avoid obstacles, and interact with unique objects that transform gameplay and add new layers of challenge.

title: Brutalistika
description: BRUTALISTIKA is an immersive and contemplative experience. In this walking simulator, explore mysterious and intriguing liminal spaces with neo-brutalist architecture at your own pace, filled with serene pools and interactive works that invite you to be aware of your emotions.

title: Faun Town
description: Faun Town is a relaxing automation-building puzzle game. After crash-landing on a mysterious island and losing your memory, you must use the island's resources to build automated production lines and repair your ship.

title: Deep Sea Heroes
description: Dive into a fast-paced underwater roguelike! Battle swarms of sea creatures, cursed pirates, and colossal bosses as you explore unique aquatic biomes. Collect a variety of weapons, uncover treasures, and survive the unknown in an epic journey through the ocean depths!

title: Horde Together
description: Strategize, scavenge, and survive as you battle through relentless hordes, upgrade your arsenal, and gear up for the ultimate fight for survival. How long can you last before the apocalypse claims you?

title: Blade & Soul Neo
description:
Blade & Soul NEO is a modern reinterpretation of Blade & Soul's iconic Wuxia-themed, fantasy world, offering unparalleled action-based combat and character customization. Players can reconnect with the original spirit of the free-to-play, open-world MMORPG in a richer, visually enhanced experience set in a world of Asian mythology where fast-paced combat collides with the stunning visual beauty.

Gamers will re-live the original storyline as a hero determined to restore honor to their clan that’s been wiped out by enemy forces. Players can pick one of four playable races based on animal lore, including the Dragon, Qilin, Phoenix and Turtle, and amongst seven classes, including Assassin, Blade Dancer, Blade Master, Destroyer, Force Master, Kung Fu Master, and Summoner.

title: Hollowforge
description: Hollowforge is a fast-paced stealth/action FPS where you explore a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous experiments. Sneak, shoot, and survive using an array of weapons while conserving resources. Uncover the dark secrets of a megacorporation in this atmospheric, immersive world.

title: Mutant Slime: Survivor Team
description: Is an arena shooting light rogue-like game, players will use slimes to destroy invading unknown creatures in the game.

title: Contra Spem Spero
description: Contra Spem Spero is a non-linear horror visual novel. You are lost deep in a twisted place — a forest one can only hope to escape.

title: With Dream
description: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

title: Farland Saga I Saturn Tribute
description: A War Orchestrated from the Shadows – A Tale of Escape in Pursuit of Coexistence Between Humans and Demons

title: Last Report
description: Last Report is a dark horror game where you play as a night shift park ranger. While monitoring the camera footage, you start noticing strange events. Uncover the terrifying secret of the National Park. Something moved in the window, but don’t worry it’s probably just another deer, right?

title: Bermuda Survivor
description: Bermuda Survivor is a unique blend of bullet heaven and world exploration. Your goal is to survive the hordes of enemies and discover the secrets of the Bermuda Triangle. Each run will provide you with new unlockables, story bits, NPC-related quests, and optimal paths to achieve victory!

title: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
description: 「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」 is a Touhou fangame.This is a "reverse-construction" action rogue-lite.Koishi vs. Kokoro! But as the playable character, Koishi uses various enhancement cards to continuously strengthen Kokoro. Can she ultimately defeat the Kokoro she has built up herself?

title: Farland Saga II Saturn Tribute
description: An Adventure Across Time Begins Now! Eight years later... A young girl sets off on a new journey!

title: Fumehead
description: FUMEHEAD is a hero-focused turn-based RPG set in a post-abandonment underground world. Play as Jack & Ami as you try to eradicate the new alien disease that calls itself Slither.

title: Digital Revolution
description: This is a casual game that combines math and basic elimination gameplay. If you're confident in your math skills, give it a try! In the game, you'll decide the direction of all the "blocks" and gradually strengthen the "Blue Legion" to defeat the evil "Red Legion."

title: Cybersim: Noetic City
description: A half cozy, casual room builder where players can create their own cyberpunk theme space and also play as a secret cyber-warfare agent. Decorate your own apartment, upgrade your equipment, build a deck of powerful hacks and clean up the city, one job at a time.

title: Crypt Robbery
description: Explore, achieve, hide, and fight in this chilling, one-of-a-kind adventure—a first-person shooter survival-horror game. Do you dare to enter a creepy cemetery at night? Can you escape the horrors lurking in an underground crypt where evil reigns? Prove how brave you are now in Crypt Robbery!

title: Paws and Whiskers
description: A Clever Blend of Rucksack Management & Auto-Chess Battles! Dive into a light roguelite where tactical pack organisation meets addictive auto-battling!

title: Dice Legends
description: Dice Legends is a roguelike deckbuilder with dice-driven combat. Roll, flip, and split dice to manipulate your deck, stack powerful effects, and unleash devastating card combos. Make your own luck!

title: Knockoff
description: KNOCKOFF is an upcoming Iso-fighter RPG, set in a Lovecraftian mall taken over by various gangs. Featuring a blend of RPG decision making and fighting game combat, KNOCKOFF is like nothing you've ever seen.

title: Nox Aeterna: Veil of Darkness
description: On your journey in this sometimes philosophical text adventure, discover unforgettable characters and secrets that must remain hidden from the human world forever..

title: O.W.L Projekt 2
description: Guide a young being’s daring adventure as you puzzle your way through diorama-style landscapes!

title: Painted Legend: Knights of Ink & Paper
description: An action-adventure platformer in the metroidvania subgenre. The graphics are made in the style of a checkered notebook and blue ink. Defeat crowds of monsters, overcome traps, explore the game world, unlock new characters and find secrets! And all this to the accompaniment of driving music!

title: Dana Cipher: Dead Man's Hand
description: Dive into a high-stakes investigation in Vincent Marconi Mystery, a hidden object game where you uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and track a cunning killer in a glitzy casino.

title: Wrap House Simulator
description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

title: Folk Tales: Alageyik
description: Folk Tales: Ala Geyik is an action-horror game. It follows a hunter who, after experiencing a nightmare, is chased by a deer he has repeatedly killed. As supernatural events unfold, he must face the Ala Geyik in a night filled with haunting nightmares and his struggle for survival.

title: Detective: Rainy Night
description: Detective Rainy Night is a psychological horror narrative adventure with elements of deduction. Violent crimes, mature stories, and a touch of horror await you at the Motel Holiday. Grab a pencil and paper because solving this case won’t be easy.

title: Blessed with Death
description: Blessed with Death is a FNAF-Like playing in its own universe with its own story and characters. It brings a twist on the original formula by cleverly removing the electricity system and instead having uniqiue door and item mechanics that were never seen before.

title: Odyssey to the Frozen Legion
description: A survival horror game, in which you search for your last living family member. What begins as an exploration of a mysterious island, becomes a hellish abomination. Descending into this terror is the only way to find what you seek.

title: Death and Ladders
description:
Death and Ladders: Roll the dice, climb the ladders, avoid scythes, take risky shortcuts, use Tarot Ability Cards to improve your odds or trap your opponent. Reach the end first to win.

You are supposed to die, but Death is bored to death doing the same job for an eternity. So he gave you a chance to win back your life, if you entertain him by playing his board game.

Gamble your soul in a relaxing atmosphere amongst a Skeleton crew, or if you want more of a challenge, try your luck against other unfortunate souls in Online or Local PVP.

title: Territors
description: Dive into the world of particles in this fast-paced card game, where the Proton and Neutron factions clash in intense matchups! Enhance your factions with new powerful particles, set and upgrade your deck, and prepare to face the ultimate challenge.

title: Spectrum Siege
description: Master the art of strategy in Spectrum Siege, a vibrant turn-based game of grid domination. Jump, capture, and outmaneuver your opponents on a dynamic board.

title: Somniora: Chapter 1
description: Somniora is a horror-puzzle game. Get ready to delve into the adventure of our character, who is trapped amidst strange dreams, while searching for answers to the questions lurking in their subconscious.

title: Healer Simulator RPG
description: You can heal any wounds and give a second chance at life, but your gift does not work on yourself. In a world full of mysteries and secrets, you must piece together fragments of your past to understand who you are and what role you play in this tangled world.

title: Knock on the Window
description: Martin has been given an urgent assignment at work. However, for this he had to go to the house of his Boss. And so Martin found himself alone at home, in the middle of a vast field of sunflowers. Everything was going well until there was a knock on the window.

title: Jack Street
description: Jack Street is a dark 2D platformer. The short adventure with horror elements is inspired by cartoons of the 90s and 2000s

title: Monday Syndrome
description: Monday Syndrome is a singleplayer action roguelike where you play as an intern that's trapped in a hellish office. Descend into a satirical corporate hell, battling demonic coworkers with absurd office supply weapons in an endless, procedurally generated tower. Can you survive the eternal 9-to-5?

title: Night Club Simulator
description: Purchase an abandoned, run-down venue and transform it into the best nightclub in the country. Renovate, upgrade, and expand the space while dealing with troublesome customers. Work together with your friends to reach the pinnacle of nightlife!

title: OrbHand
description: Stack your cards to cast spells, get resources and recruit allies in OrbHand, a beautiful hand drawn card management game.

title: Freezia
description: A cold-sleep management puzzle action game. You are the artificial intelligence called Freezia. Bring peace and order to humankind by putting them into cold sleep.

title: Menes: The Chainbreaker
description: Embark on a perilous journey as Menes, an angel with no memory, sent to free a mysterious prisoner from a forgotten realm. Uncover dark secrets, face relentless enemies, and shape the fate of a universe on the brink of collapse. A platformer adventure awaits, with very similar vibes to Soul Reaver .

title: True Vikings
description: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

title: Mutational Loading
description: In this experimental singleplayer 3D horror game, a man struggles with adopting a familiar child off the street while outrunning the consequences of an agreement he made with his nightmarish stalker.

title: Cordels & Spells
description: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

title: Negative Energy
description: Negative Energy is a tower defense game with basic RTS mechanics, where your goal is to defend the construction of a Dyson sphere, while fighting against waves of hundreds of enemies ships.

title: Break Siege
description: Break Siege is a train-themed deck-building rougelike game in which you constantly construct your own deck and breakthrough forces of the Empire in intense, real-time battles.

title: Home Cleaning
description: Home Cleaning is a cozy, family-friendly game where you tidy up a baby’s messes in a playful environment. Use various cleaning utensils to clean rooms, and enjoy the satisfaction of a sparkling home!

title: Consumables
description: A humorous and bizarre puzzle game! Absurd plots, strange puzzles, and unexpected endings await you. Find the only survival ending and help the protagonist trapped in a strange world return home.

title: MeMic
description: MeMic is an atmospheric stealth game with horror elements, where you take on the role of a mimic, able to disguise yourself as everyday objects.

title: Banker Simulator
description: Banker Simulator is a single-player game where you revive a bankrupt bank. With active and passive (idle) gameplay, make strategic decisions to grow your bank, satisfy customers, and tackle financial crises.

title: Pochemeow
description: Economic strategy about trade war

title: Autonomous Odyssey
description: Autonomous Odyssey is a story-driven, hand-drawn 2D metroidvania. Use agile platforming on your apocalyptic sci-fi journey to explore the labs once filled with exceptional researchers. Fight through vengeful robots on Pim’s quest to find his missing father and restore everyone's humanity.

title: ChessFinity
description: ChessFinity redefines chess in 3D! Play with 3+ players on custom boards across multiple layers. Dive into modes like Classic Chess, Mods, and Mana Chess, with features like obstacles and a-synchronous play. The future of chess starts here—endless possibilities await!

title: Forsaken Island
description: Awaken as Captain Elias Blackbone, a cursed pirate turned undead skeleton, stranded on a haunted island. Scavenge, craft, and fight to survive as you rebuild your body, uncover dark secrets, and decide your ultimate fate.

title: Cardalaxy
description: Cardalaxy is a card upgrading game with 4X inspiration and 5+ different victories.

title: The Two Thinkers
description: A challenging puzzle and platformer game for 2 players. Play with a friend, combine your skills, think logically, and overcome obstacles together to reach the exit and complete each level. Only by working as a team will you be able to overcome every challenge and progress!

title: Fomon
description: A very minimalistic TCG card battler featuring creatures called Fomons. Grow your collection and discover a new unique Fomon every hour NOT DURING DEMO PLAY! Each Fomon comes with a tier and has its own attributes. Compete with others climbing the leaderboard.

title: The Little World
description: The Little World is a strategy-based tactical game featuring random campaigns, story maps, custom game maps, and custom character creation, with support for multiplayer battles and cooperation.

title: Expedition Chronicles
description: Embark on an adventurous quest through jungles, deserts, and oceans to uncover the lost city of Atlantis. Solve puzzles and unlock ancient secrets!

title: Eternal Glory
description: Romance of cruel fate, fantasy otome game ‘Eternal Glory’

title: Card Linker
description: Card Linker is a card-based simulation/strategy game that lets you build a factory using cards. The main goal of the game is to make combinations with different cards so that each player can build different factories and feel the sandbox experience to the fullest.

title: Poly TD
description: Poly TD is a new type of tower defense game with roguelike elements. Combine heroes in a circular stage and use your own strategy to fend off endless waves of enemies!

title: KeyLess
description: Keyless is a jump and run platformer, with very unique logic puzzles.By starting the game you get into a dispute between logicians and poets.As a result you lose access to the keys on your keyboard!You will have to think differently than usual to regain control!

title: Scarecrow Tactics
description: A strategy card game where players use scarecrow cards to deceive each other about the number of their soldiers. With unique yet simple rules, strategic scarecrows, and quirky, hideous mercenaries, players must survive a dreadful battle where losing means being devoured by Water Deers!

title: Bloxpath
description: A minimalist roll playing puzzle game. About 10 unique puzzle mechanics, around 150 puzzles, and satisfying smooth procedural animations.

title: QuantumPulse 2A
description: Solve programming puzzles on a fictional computer with radio-based communication and unique limitations. Competitively optimize to compete on leaderboards against friends and the global community.

title: Hotel Tales
description: Hotel Tales is a mystery hotel manager set in the crossroads between worlds. Dive into the amazing, frightening and funny stories of guests and colleagues, discover the hotel's secrets and try to survive at least to the end of your probationary period!

title: Rogue Hands!
description: A rogue game aimed at delivering a thrilling experience, crafting a powerful genre, and pushing forward to the end!

title: Chosen War
description: " Chosen War" is a roguelike strategy game full of randomness. You'll take on the role of the Chosen One, build and lead your army to explore various islands. Through tactical deployment, you'll engage in battles with enemies, skillfully utilize abilities, and achieve victory with minimal losses.

title: Operation Remode
description: Welcome to WI Corp, Moddie Operator! Proceed through various levels inside WI Corp's headquarters while defending it from a perilous threat to its secrets using M.O.D.D.I.E, an high tech modular rifle, in this new single player, low-poly style, Twin-Stick Shooter.

title: Axom: Conquest
description: A base building roguelite tower defence game set on the dangerous planet named Axom. Gather resources to build defences, unlock research between games to get stronger and ultimately unlock the secrets of the mysterious planet.

title: Prisoners of Ulag'Bol
