title: Quest for a Punchline: The Collection
Apartment Filled With Cats
description: Uncover the purr-fect challenge in Apartment Filled With Cats! Explore charming, hand-drawn apartment filled with whimsical details as you search for cleverly hidden cats. Can you find them all? A relaxing, delightful journey awaits!

title: Ispitatel 4: Classic
description:
It's a comical adventure about a Russian scientist - Ravil Unisovich, who unwittingly unleashes a plague of monsters after an unsuccessful experiment.
The story takes place between 1986 - 2007 with lots of new locations to visit and new characters to meet.

title: Suri: The Seventh Note
description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

title: Tetradome
description: A non-linear puzzle adventure game with 3D pixel art visuals, containing mechanical, logical, and environmental puzzles themed in a fantasy scene. Unravel the enigmas of the four elements of nature so you can free yourself from the dome!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Seekers of Eternity
description: The Patch 7.2 series update includes: New Main Scenario Quests, a new Dungeon, a new Raid, a new Trial, Cosmic Exploration, a new Large-scale Battle-oriented Duty – Occult Crescent, New Allied Society Quests – Mamool Ja, new Hildibrand Quests, Duty Support Additions, and PvP Updates

title: Tales of the Forgotten
description: Tales of the Forgotten features 3 short ghost stories that haunt everyday locations. Explore PSX-style environments in first person, endure jump scares, and experience surreal moments. Unlock multiple endings to uncover the secrets of the forgotten ghosts.

title: Bone n' Gone
description: A challenging and fun game that will push the player to the peak of their gameplay. Get ready to win, lose, die, and play again! Perfect for those looking for a challenge in the FPS style!

title: Heart: Future Whispers
description: Heart: Future Whispers is a top-down shooter set in a dystopian future. Face hordes of enemies, manage resources to acquire powerful weapons, and uncover the dark secrets behind the chaos. Test your skills in infinite mode and fight for the highest score!

title: Switched Destiny
description: A space mystery in 1-bit pixel art, where every choice unveils dark secrets.

title: The Final Fragment
description: A coming-of-age visual novel with GxG romance elements set in a Ukrainian arts academy. Nina tries to keep the trouble at bay. But when a mysterious incident occurs at the academy, will she muster the courage to confront the things she's been running away from?

title: Canvas Infernum
description: Canvas Infernum is a strategic tile-placement landscape builder where you craft a surreal Renaissance-inspired hell using real historical art. Seal pacts that shift gameplay dynamics, blending classic board game mechanics with roguelike elements and story-driven progression

title: Midnight Garden
description: During the day, explore the dark surroundings in search of vital resources to fortify your garden and protect your home. Each tool you possess is a key to collecting specific resources, essential to building your defenses. Prepare for the crucial moment: when night falls!

title: Kaizen: A Factory Story
description: Kaizen is an open-ended puzzle automation game from the original Zachtronics team, set in 1980s Japan. Design, build, and optimize production lines to create iconic products, like calculators, camcorders, and arcade machines.

title: Sonic Flow 2: Next Dimension
description: Sonic Flow 2: Next Dimension is a Sonic game that takes place 5 years after the events of Sonic Forces in the Classic Dimension. Following the story of the very very badly made first game, the gathering of the 7 Chaos Emeralds in Modern Sonic's frozen dimension causes his dimension and all connected ones worlds to shatter into floating pieces.

title: Metal Garden
description: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

title: Tails Adventure: Armada
description:
Tails Adventure: Armada is an action platformer with a focus on story, exploration, and collection.

You play as the incredibly intelligent, twin-tailed prodigal kit fox, Miles "Tails" Prower caught in the midst of yet another Battle Bird invasion of Coco Island.

Run, jump, hover, and fly your way across the land. Explore, uncover secrets, solve puzzles, collect gadgets, upgrades, and candy in your efforts to dislodge the Battle Bird Armada and foil their mysterious plans.

title: Quantum Soteriology
description: 18+ Only Non Fiction Visual Novel. LGBT+ Affirming Christianity. Touhou. True story of decade of abuse faced by autistic plural trans lesbians. Survive suicide attempts, OCD scrupulosity. Keep breathing through deviated nasal septum. Fight fawn freeze and fly fly away Escape this eternal Hell

title: Battlefront Expanded
description: A mod for Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) that adds a whopping 71 custom Heroes and Reinforcements, pulling from both Canon and Legends material.

title: Mochi's Cosy Quest
description: A 3D puzzle game where you lead a little capybara to its goal of eating fruit. Make use of the environment to get to the fruit as you are completely unable to jump.

title: Meow Garden
description: Welcome to Cat Island, a cozy farming sim where cats sprout from the soil! Plant seeds, care for your cats, and discover over 40 breeds. Decorate your home, train your cats, fulfill orders, and grow your own cat estate.

title: Mauri Mursu's Odyssey
description: Mauri Mursu’s Odyssey is not just a game — it’s a legacy. A journey through time, space, and the elements themselves. Dive into a world where philosophy meets action, where every battle is a lesson, and where every victory brings you closer to mastering the mysteries of the universe.

title: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine
description: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine is a short adventure puzzle game. Use your wits, creativity and puzzle solving ability to help Flibbius take to the skies!

title: Birdigo
description: A word game about migrating birds - inspired by Wordle and Balatro. Play cards, build your deck, trigger combos and guide your flock. From John August (Corpse Bride) and Corey Martin (Bonfire Peaks).

title: Critter Caboodle
description: Watch and play with quirky critters as they generate loads of money for you in a unique idler/creature collector hybrid.

title: Cloudy & Stormy: Pawtastic Adventure
description: A side scrolling adventure. Fly high as Cloudy and lightning dash as Stormy! Jump through colorful regions, help new friends, find treasures, and overcome challenges on your quest for a lost blanket.

title: Himawari Catastrophe!
description:
Slice your way through the Garden of the Sun as Tenshi Hinanawi in this fast and arcadey top-down hack and slash game!

This game was made in a little over a week for Touhou Fan Game Jam 15!

title: Sonic Surge: Rhythm Showdown
description: Sonic Surge: Rhythm Showdown is a fast-paced rhythm game based on classical games of our childhood where players battle to the beat and hitting notes to unleash powerful combos and grind for the highest score. Master the music, dominate opponents, and conquer electrifying tracks!

title: Questboard
description: A text-based RPG where your choices and dice rolls determine the outcome of every quest. Embark on adventures, help townsfolk, battle enemies, and engage in immersive minigames like fishing, dice rolling, and gauntlet challenges.

title: Bookey Manor
description: Click on haunted key to collect points and survive the sudden visits by the Residents as you advance through the manor.

title: Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them!
description: In this game, you must blast 100 toy ducks! Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly! With light-hearted gameplay and cute ducks to hunt, it's a casual first-person experience full of wholesome, family-friendly fun!

title: Seek
description: A survival horror game where you play as Alice, trapped in a shifting, nightmarish orphanage. Explore eerie environments, manage limited resources, shoot at lurking enemies, and solve puzzles to uncover dark secrets. Classical music underscores the psychological tension as you navigate the mystery of your imprisonment and confront the cruel truth behind it.

title: Doki Doki Despair
description: Doki Doki Despair is a dark and intense mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that takes the game to a new level of psychological horror. Inspired by elements of horror and mystery, the mod transforms the literature club experience into a journey of despair, where the player is thrown into a distorted and oppressive reality.

title: Doki Doki Indian Man Time
description: DDLC Indian Man Time is a unique and comical mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that adds a new and unexpected twist to the original story. Inspired by memes and Indian culture, this mod features a charismatic protagonist full of personality who interacts with the girls in the literature club in hilarious and unpredictable ways.

title: Unleashed Recompiled
description: Unleashed Recompiled is an unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 version of Sonic Unleashed created through the process of static recompilation. The port offers Windows and Linux support with numerous built-in enhancements such as high resolutions, ultrawide support, high frame rates, improved performance and modding.

title: Doki Doki Malignancy
description: Doki Doki Malignancy is a dark and exciting mod for Doki Doki Literature Club that delves into the themes of illness, loss and fighting the inevitable. When one of the club members receives a devastating diagnosis, the light and romantic atmosphere gives way to a deeply emotional storyline, exploring how each character deals with the fragility of life and the challenges of mortality.

title: Slowly Fighter
description: You are a master of martial arts. Your sharpened senses make everything seem like it's in slow motion. A master's attacks hit vital spots so accurately that a single hit can result in an instant KO. Dodge your enemy's attacks and deliver a fatal blow.

title: Doki Doki Nightmare
description:
What seemed like just another normal day at the Literature Club soon turns into an endless nightmare. In Doki Doki Nightmare, you'll be forced to face terrifying distortions of reality, where nothing is as it seems and every choice can lead you even deeper into an abyss of madness.

This mod delves into the psychology of psychological horror, featuring new artwork, unsettling soundtracks and a suspense-filled storyline. The club you know and love is falling apart, and it's up to you to uncover the dark secrets before it's too late.

title: Doki Doki A Slice Of Life
description: Doki Doki A Slice of Life is a mod for the game Doki Doki Literature Club that proposes a softer, more peaceful approach, focusing on everyday life and the interpersonal relationships between the characters in the original game. Unlike the main game, which contains elements of psychological horror and mystery, this mod aims to create a lighter and more optimistic experience, exploring simple moments such as walks, conversations and personal development, without the tensions of the original storyline.

title: Danganronpa: Antebellum
description: This Fanganronpa is cancelled, and now has a reboot called Danganronpa Antebellum: Lockdown

title: Toontown: The Grindworks
description: Toontown: The Grindworks is a single-player Toontown roguelike! Play as some of Toontown's top Toons to take down Cogs Inc. from within!

title: Danganronpa: Antebellum - Lockdown
description:
Danganronpa Antebellum: LOCKDOWN is an interactive remake/reimagining of the original Antebellum that attempts to create a more cohesive, thematic and better written experience. It will take the form of a playable Danganronpa Fangame developed in RPGMAKER with the prologue currently in development, if Lockdown is received well then more parts to it will be created- if not, development of the original game will resume!

Alongside completely refreshing the characters and story, the game improves previous daily life and deadly life mechanics to create more enriching experience. Additionally a major part of Danganronpa Antebellum: LOCKDOWN is its Audience Interaction!

Throughout the various releases of the game individual character's crimes will be revealed, post these releases the community will be able to vote on if they believe the character is worthy of Redemption or if they're completely Corrupt! What the majority votes will impact the characters and story going forward so vote wisely!

title: Ninpuchi! Cryptoninja Petit
description: Ninpuchi! is an exhilarating roguelike action game where you control a group of ninjas with unique personalities to defeat the oncoming monsters. 3-person party strategy and free character builds allow you to create your own unique adventure!

title: Sonic Remade
description: A fan remake of some zones from Sonic the Hedgehog (8-bit).

title: Mroi
description: A game about being stuck in your room in a cycle of waking up, just to go back to sleep. The solitude of your dreams has been disturbed. An unknown guest. What is the life you were living beyond your dreams? What life did this mysterious figure live? Explore the dreamlands and figure it out.

title: Commander of Battlefront
description: A new game created by Yashiromori Yuki, a japanese indie game developer. Commander of Battlefront is an anime world war two game that uses anime characters and tanks. Its a third person, single player strategy game. The game is currently in alpha mode as the developer is still making adjustments to his game.

title: The Charity Shop
description: An adventure game where you must use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived. To this end, you have been delivered before The Charity Shop, the place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.

title: Demon Corporation: Onboarding
description: This game is a strategy RPG with the theme of anti-work from 9 am to 9 pm, six days a week. The gameplay inherits from the classic "Magic Tower" series, combining elements such as pigeons and BD combinations. Please play with caution under the age of 35 to avoid dissing and hurting the boss!

title: Beachcomber
description: Take a quiet walk along the shore, collecting unique shells with each new wave. Find ones that speak to you, or seek out ones with hidden surprises. How you play is up to you. Discover the world inside every shell.

title: Wednesdays
description: "The hardest part is not to speak up. It’s being heard." Part video game, part graphic novel, Wednesdays seeks to raise awareness about child sexual abuse through a surprisingly uplifting story.

title: Little Library
description: Build a brand-new library in a quaint village! Meet quirky villagers, recommend books, unlock rare titles, organize displays, host events, uncover the village's history, and revitalize the community in this cozy library-management game!

title: Stellar Poetry
description: Stellar Poetry is a 2D action adventure game similar to the galaxy Castlevania. The sorceress, who awakens after sensing the call of a mysterious voice, goes on a series of adventures in order to find memories lost due to the curse.

title: Gothic 1 Remake: Nyras Prologue
description: Welcome to the Colony – an exclusive stand-alone prologue to the Gothic 1 Remake. Take your first step into the world of this genre-defining classic RPG by experiencing an entirely new story: the first day of a fresh inmate in the prison colony.

title: Gothic: Playable Teaser
description: The Kingdom of Myrtana has been invaded by an implacable horde of orcs. King Rhobar II, in need of a large quantity of magical ore in order to forge powerful weapons, operates the Khorinis mines with all available prisoners.

title: Islanders: New Shores
description: Welcome to ISLANDERS: New Shores. Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

title: Fallen Devotion
description:
Fallen devotion is more than just a story- it's a reflection of existential dread, guilt, and human desire for redemption.

In which, your supposedly deceased childhood best friend has somehow come back, but something about him is different now.

title: Card Town
description: A life simulation card game with multiple endings. In the game, players can obtain higher level cards to enhance their character attributes by stacking cards. You can get into the ideal university and realize your ideal, or rewrite the fate of the whole world in the other world.

title: Winter Clothing
description: This is a horror plot puzzle game with Chinese folk themes. There is an unwritten rule in Tianhe Town: on the day of the Winter Clothing Festival, no villager is allowed to approach the back mountain. Is there really a ghost on the mountain? Perhaps there is something more terrifying than ghosts.

title: PhantomZone Labyrinthos
description: ”The nightmare that never allows waking lasts forever.” You wake up from bed and a girl appears before you. She calls herself “Entourfe,” a management support android. The stage is a strange facility, and you will explore the inside of the strange facility with her.

title: Missi
description: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Find hidden objects and solve puzzles using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for the sick little mouse.

title: Leena
description:
Experience a unique game mechanic where when lining up jumps time slows down to help navigate tricky sections and dodge dangerous obstacles.

Enjoy a beautiful immersive world brought alive through high-quality unique 2D art. Enjoy the dynamic day night cycle, unique lighting effects, and varied environmental & weather systems that help make the world as engaging, stunning, and immersive as possible.

Buy today and start Leena's adventure!

There are currently 10 levels, I plan to increase this over time. Please bear with me.

title: Light Engine
description: The light socket has suffered a leak!

title: La costurera
description: You are a seamstress in a world where society is falling and you only try to help other people.

title: Funi Raccoon Game
description: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

title: Plylbl
description: PLYLBL is a collection of games of various genres and styles. Adventures, puzzles, racing and many other genres are gathered in one place. Discover new games and play them alone or together with friends online or on the same screen!

title: Incarceration
description:
It's inCARceration -- a one of a kind warioware-style minigame collection!!!!!!

You have been trapped in your car by an oppressive legal system (american) and your only hope of escape is to gain parole -- by completing a series of strange and surreal jobs!!!!

Do you have what it takes to earn parole, or will you be executed for your failures?

title: Beyond One's Past
description:
Beyond One's Past is a psychological horror game which takes you on the journey of a police officer, who has gone through, is going through, and will continue to go through the mysteries of events that unfolded in a small town in the outskirts of Pennsylvania.

Can you break the cycle and bring the investigation to an end?

title: Divide By Sheep 2
description: In this colorful cartoon world, you will never think that math can be boring! Solve ever-changing puzzles with our fluffy sheep, divide like never before and get the most of an adventure full of riddles! Can you conquer the evil grim reaper from flooding the sheep and become the ultimate math hero?

title: Sonic RPG: Episode 10
description: An official continuation and conclusion to the classic fangame series Sonic RPG.

title: Corrigendum
description: An eerie puzzle game that is designed to test a players memory and hand-eye coordination while they have to try and escape a madman's gauntlet in order to test human's "worthiness" of his new world.

title: Feverdream: Rainbow Chaser
description: Free your mind with Feverdream: Rainbow Chaser, a free cross-platform multiplayer shooter. Team up with friends to create and surf rainbows in any direction, as you track and eliminate assigned player targets in a surreal desert environment.

title: The Bat
description:
Master Bryce is throwing a party. As his most faithful servant, that means it's your job to make the party run smoothly. But you only have two hands—and far too many duties. You'll have to manage requests from the guests, the master's eccentric demands, and your own composure. All the other staff have quit, unwilling to entertain the master's "moods," but you've served Wyatt Manor for decades; what's one more evening?

A comedy of errors, mild frustrations, and major workplace-safety violations. With limited actions and a limited inventory, juggle hors d'oeuvres, flaming curtains, and radioactive elements—and keep the drinks coming!

title: Mow Meow
description: The best multiplayer catnip mowing simulator on Steam. Up to 20 players, ragdoll kitty physics, unlockables, treasure, a chill 33-song soundtrack, and controls that definitely work as intended... most of the time.

title: Friends & Foes
description: Friends&Foes adds outvoted and forgotten mobs from the mob vote. One of the main goals is to further expand upon original concepts and add new vanilla-like features related to all the mobs.

title: Game of Crafts
description: In your hands - a palette with dozens of patterns of Russian folk crafts! Discover their secrets with the magical bird Kika. Paint the world around under Gzhel or Khokhloma according to traditions or drop all the rules and form your own folk style to bring colors back to Kiki's house!

title: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.

title: Waxweaver
description: This is a sandbox / rpg game similar to games like Terraria. Create your world, delve deep into the earth, gather resources and become stronger.

title: Vestaria Saga Gaiden: Heroes of Lucca
description: Vestaria Saga Gaiden: Heroes of Lucca is a 4 chapter side game in the Vestaria Saga series that was released alongside Vestaria Saga Gaiden: the Sacred Sword of Silvanister (later localized as Vestaria Saga II).

title: Pokémon Soulstones 2: Time Wardens
description: A sequel that stays true to the spirit of the first game, by building on what made it great: Quality of life, mega Pokemon, and lots and lots of regional variants.

title: Quirky Forest
description: Place the correct item at the right place, plan ahead, think carefully, you could say this game is easy to play, but hard to master, be prepared to be challenged!

title: Temple of the Gods
description: In 1920s Mexico, married archaeologists Jon and Jess embark on a daring expedition to uncover a lost temple deep in the jungle, built for gods to live and worship in. At the base of a towering volcano, where they rendezvous with a second team—unaware of the dangers lurking ahead.

title: Edd Skeleton Game
description: Survive Edd Skeleton's "amazing" game, Mock his efforts, and watch him up the ante with scarier creatures, trickier puzzles, and surprises that will keep you on edge. Can you endure his trials and become friends... or will you just keep mocking his incompetence?

title: Stop and Breathe
description: A 3D puzzle platformer that teaches you a breathing technique to help with your anxiety! Calm your mind by performing the breathing technique, Belly Breathing! Traverse a school environment, solve puzzles, move platforms, all while being accompanied by your companion, Zen!

title: Supermarket Mania: Match 3
description:
Dive into Supermarket Mania - Match 3 – an exciting puzzle adventure!

Roll up your sleeves! It’s time to switch and match treats on hundreds of unique levels to open new supermarkets and expand your grocery chain. If you have ever wanted to run your own business, then seize this opportunity and see how easy and fun it could be!

Together with Nikki, head to her native Tinsel Town to make a contribution to the city’s development. To keep your supermarket business growing, you will need to beat hundreds of puzzling levels by matching three or more identical treats. It’s easy to play but challenging to master, so better plan your steps to meet all targets before you run out of moves! Knock down annoying obstacles by driving over them with a turbo cart, and use and combine other special boosters and power-ups. Challenge yourself to become a supermarket expert in this exciting match-3 puzzle adventure and open a record number of grocery stores across the city!

title: Dokis & Dragons
description: Dokis & Dragons is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that mixes the elements of the popular visual novel with a tabletop RPG experience inspired by Dungeons & Dragons. In this mod, players follow the literature club as the characters embark on an RPG campaign full of fantasy, battles and strategic decisions.

title: Doki Doki Our Time
description: Doki Doki: Our Time is a popular mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! (DDLC) that focuses on expanding Monika's story, allowing the player to finally have a happy ending with her. Unlike the original DDLC experience, where Monika is aware of her existence as a game character and manipulates the events of the story, this mod seeks to give her a second chance - a world where she can live out a true romance with the protagonist.

title: Pine Point: Insomniac
description:
Fishing at Lost Lake, trashing the popular kids' cars, and playing in your shitty garage band are all things you'd rather be doing than working a dead-end job that will probably keep you trapped in Pine Point for the rest of your life.

Fortunately, you get to work alongside your best friend, Dimitri. Unfortunately, Dimitri is leaving town at the end of the summer... and you're not.

title: Doki Doki A Brand New Day
description: Doki Doki: A Brand New Day is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that revamps the original game experience, offering a new perspective on the story and allowing the player to change the fate of the characters. In this mod, the protagonist is aware of the traumatic events of the base game and seeks to prevent the tragedies from occurring. This leads to a storyline full of new interactions, choices and exciting moments, giving players the chance to create a different future for Sayori, Yuri, Natsuki and Monika.

title: Doki Doki 2nd Anniversary
description: Doki Doki: 2nd Anniversary is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that celebrates the second anniversary of the original game with a new approach to the story and new interactions with the characters.

title: Where Noble Plans Lie
description: Build-up your territory, your team of advisors, and your reputation as you bring every other noble to ruin at the behest of the Vampire Queen. Make the kingdom yours in the city-builder and turn-based RPG: Where Noble Plans Lie!

title: The Test: Reality Check
description: The Test: Reality Check is one of multiple installments in an ongoing social experiment that can be classified as an atmospheric, psychological-simulation with horror elements. Dive deep into your own psyche to find answers to questions you've kept locked away, hidden from yourself for far too long.

title: Remonstrator
description: Remonstrator is a game from Rev Team, developed for the PC platform. The project combines genres and elements such as action. Additionally, players highlight such game features as action, beat em up, 3d fighting game and spectacular battles. The game is designed for single player play, no multiplayer modes are provided.

title: Broken Sun
description: What do you do when your heart is replaced with a shard of the Sun, giving you great power? Free yourself from the shackles of death, defy the gods, and change the fate of the Lotus World! Enter into an epic battle of the gods! Explore your newfound abilities and fight in PvE and PvP modes in the most up-to-date MMORPG for browsers and smartphones (Android and iOS).

title: Alex's Mobs
description: Alex's Mobs is a Forge mod that adds 89 new mobs to Minecraft. All of these mobs fall into either two categories: most of them are real world creatures, like Grizzly Bears, Roadrunners, Orcas, etc; but some of them are purely fictional, like the Endergade and Bone Serpent. All of these creatures fulfill a necessary purpose, and either have unique drops, mechanics or functions, as there are no purely aesthetic creatures. That said, they also help make some environments in the game feel more alive. The models, textures, animations and AI are all stylistically compatible with the vanilla game's latest additions.

title: Memes At War
description: Memes At War is a high quality first-person shooter that brings meme characters to life on the battlefield. Through multiple maps and game-modes you will be able to gain ranks on the leaderboards.

title: Mutant Monsters
description: The mutants are back! The original returns, be ready to fight mutated variants of a lot of the old Minecraft monsters. No longer will battles be quick and easy, now you'll be seriously challenged by those new foes.

title: Kara Fantasy
description: Embark on an epic journey through five mystical forest worlds to save Princess Kara and show the world that the true hero lives in each of us.

title: Enhanced Celestials
description: Enhanced Celestials is a mod that aims to improve the overall environment of the night by adding lunar events such as Blood moons & Harvest moons! Expect fresh lunar content with each coming update!

title: Naturalist
description: Have you ever wanted a truly immersive animal mod, where animals interact with each other realistically? Naturalist adds more animals to the game that behave as they do in real life. There is a working food chain, sleep cycle, and tons of other fun behaviors, giving each animal a personality of its own. So, are you ready to venture out into the wild?

title: Serene Seasons
description: Serene Seasons is a Minecraft mod that adds seasons. Grass and foliage colors will change throughout the year, and in the winter, temperatures will shift and allow for snow to fall in some biomes that don't normally receive any. Seasons also affect various other features, like crop growth, weather, and more!

title: Better Letter
description: In this word roguelite, collect and manage letters and items to solve puzzles and tackle challenging "final exams." Each run offers new puzzles, rewards, and opportunities for bonus "extra credit." With randomized levels and endless replayability, master the art of word manipulation to succeed!

title: Hidden Skulls
description: Immerse yourself in a short but mysterious adventure in a black and white world full of monsters and evil! Explore the map and find 100 cleverly hidden skulls of different creatures and recreate the picture in color. Play and relax if you are not afraid!

title: Monsterest
description: Manage a monster-friendly inn. Every day, a new monster guest visits. Chop down trees to make furniture and decorate the rooms. You'll need to catch fish, hunt, and prepare meals. Satisfied guests will return to your inn next time.

title: Emily
description: Chat with a mysterious AI, uncover secret codes and find hidden files. Your choices may lead you to uncover different things, the only way to find the truth is through Emily and whatever was left inside the old computer. You need her help

title: TypInc.
description: Typinc. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game. Type the paragraphs presented to you and maintain your streak to survive and win the game.

title: Hidden Cats: Japan
description: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of Japan! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats, Nya! are waiting for you, Nya! Play and relax, Nya!

title: Watch Restoration
description: Enter the world of watch restoration in your well-equipped workshop. Attracting global clients, you restore antique and modern watches, handling worn parts and precise calibration. Each unique project demands meticulous care, combining technical skill and creativity for flawless, impressive results.

title: Orbi Universo II
description: Orbi Universo II is a strategy simulation game developed and published by Orbi Universo Team, slated for release in July 2025. In this abstract strategy management simulation, players guide their civilization from the Neolithic era to the Atomic Age through an innovative node-based system where decisions create cascading effects across society. The game features interconnected elements including agriculture, commerce, religion, and warfare that players must balance while adapting to local resources and regional characteristics. Players can shape unique cultural and religious traits, engage with rival civilizations through diplomacy or warfare, and pursue multiple victory conditions. Building upon its predecessor, Orbi Universo II offers enhanced visuals, rebuilt systems, and deeper gameplay mechanics while maintaining an abstract visual style focused on clarity and readability.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Conqueror's Carapace: Beelzebub
description: Contents: Unlocks the Conqueror's Carapace costume for Beelzebub for use in battle and the Figure Studio.

title: Manacaster
description:
An old-school tabletop card-battle game for players who like bashing each other with monsters. Precision-balanced gameplay, no collectables or pay-to-win.

Chase Victory, Not Cards!

title: Trickster Cards: Euchre
description: Get social in this online PVP Euchre card game! Play online against the computer, other live players, or friends! Or create your own private games complete with live audio and video functions! Go to trickstercards.com to get started!

title: Flat 9
description: A psychological horror set in a deserted apartment, where you're trapped in a relentless cycle. Armed with a strange device, you must find and report every anomaly to escape.

title: D.O.T. Defence
description: Welcome to the frontlines of D.O.T. Defence! Build towers, muster armies, and conquer the map. Fight local matches in 1v1, 2v2, or free-for-all battles against friends and AI-controlled bots. Victory comes with the last HQ standing!

title: Kakoi
description:
A man wakes up in a strange room with no memories.

Who is he? Who is this nameless stranger who takes care of him? And why is he always locked in?

title: Dungeon of the Devourer
description: Dungeon of the Devourer is a turn-based RPG where you play an orc on a quest to save her village from The Ravenous Hunger. Explore the dungeon while using expansion based abilities and statuses to fight baddies and solve puzzles.

title: Bad Summer
description: Bad Summer is a visual novel developed by S&J Games. An ordinary job takes a dark turn when camp counselor Jenny stumbles into a chilling mystery, while Detective Oliver Smith races against time to uncover the truth. Strange phone calls, eerie disappearances, and something watching from the trees. Camp Bear Ridge isn't what it seems.

title: Monstrix TCG Card Shop
description: Manage your own collectable card shop! Stock cards, figurines, customise the interior, and expand your store. Let people compete in your shop and build a personal card collection of rare finds!

title: 8 Yous+
description:
You are trapped on a train that runs forever.
Find the one different 'YOU' and escape!

title: Grab it! Crane Game
description:
Gear up for an arcade classic: the crane game!
Win as many prizes as you can and become a crane game master!

title: Suikoden: Star Leap
description:
A new story of 108 stars about the runes begins.
Suikoden STAR LEAP is an entirely new addition to the series and is the first title to be tailored for mobile.

title: Exploring Phonics 1 for Beginners
description: Exploring Phonics 1 for Beginners is an educational PC game by Eureka Multimedia designed to teach kids ages 4-7 about phonics.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes Monster Hunter Wilds (main game) and the Monster Hunter Wilds Deluxe Pack!

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Premium Deluxe Edition
description: The Premium Deluxe Edition includes Monster Hunter Wilds (main game), and the Monster Hunter Wilds Cosmetic DLC Pass, which consists of 3 DLC packs including the Deluxe Pack at a great value!

title: 100 Africa Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Africa, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️

title: 100 Berlin Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Berlin ️️, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍

title: 100 Caliber Dash
description: A high-speed run-and-gun shooter with roguelite deckbuilding upgrades.

title: 100 Dubai Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Dubai, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Cyprus Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the ️Cyprus , full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Greece Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Greece , full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Hidden Cats: Ninja
description: 100 hidden Cats Ninja is a hidden objects/hidden creatures game. The player's task is to find all hundred cats on the map.

title: 100 India Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the India, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Los Angeles Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Los Angeles, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Miami Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Miami, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: Ella Stars
description: Bop and bash to the rhythm with Ella & Bird! Help them beat bosses with an explosive Fever Time! Experience a new world of rhythmic action, where dynamic moves and diverse music come together!

title: Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator
description: Run your own conveyor belt sushi restaurant. Make sushi, serve customers, process payments, clean tables, hire staff, and design your restaurant’s conveyor belt. Set your own prices, manage troublesome customers, and expand your sushi restaurant.

title: Rogue Rampage
description: A high-speed FPS where you harness powerful skills, combined with roguelike elements in a survival shooter. Level up, acquire powerful items, and fight against stronger enemies to stay alive! Build a different loadout in every run and discover the best strategy to dominate the battlefield.

title: Its Time To Meet God
description: Its Time To Meet God is an interdimensional Ray Tracing shooter built from the ground up in Game maker studio. Fight and loot your way through interdimensional realms created by demi Gods, eldritch horrors, and Holy creatures to get to your loved ones who reside in the 3rd Heaven.

title: Cute, Broke, and Dungeon Bound
description: An RPG about the protagonist "Memelis," who is deep in debt. Because she spent everything she has on card lottery in mobile games, Embarks on an adventure with her best friend "Tina" to find the treasure hidden in the depth of dungeons.

title: Bless You Again
description: Lily is a magician and a homunculus who braves a perilous dungeon in search of the Philosopher's Stone. Control a character faithfully reproduced from cel animation and defeat countless monsters in pursuit of powerful blessings. Use blessings, skills, and gimmicks to forge a strength of your own!

title: Monstabox
description: Monstabox: A turn-based 1v1 battle game mixing strategy & action. Choose monsters, cast spells, roll to attack, and unleash ultimates. Win by securing the Star after KOing your opponent. Play cross-platform & compete worldwide!

title: Auto Rogue
description: A roguelike where you automate combat. Combine skills and conditions to find your own optimal solution! No complicated controls at all!! Sit back with a coffee and watch the beautiful battles you've crafted unfold! Utilize a variety of skills, conditions, and relics to craft the ultimate build!

title: Scrap Dealer Simulator
description: Run your grandfather’s old scrapyard, collect and dismantle scrap, craft materials, and sell them at the second-hand shop. Manage hunger and thirst while upgrading your business with new machines, storage, and vehicles. Pay off your debts, expand your scrapyard, and turn junk into fortune!

title: Kalia
description: Jump, climb, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of Kalia. An engaging story awaits you, filled with mysteries and challenges. Discover the secrets of this lost world... if you dare!

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Crimson Bomber: Zeta
description: Contents: Unlocks the Crimson Bomber costume for Zeta for use in battle and the Figure Studio.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - The Black Butterfly: Narmaya
description: Contents: Unlocks The Black Butterfly costume for Narmaya for use in battle and the Figure Studio.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Color Set 5
description: Set Contents: • Unlocks color variant no. 20 for the following characters. Sandalphon Galleon Wilnas Meg Ilsa

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Color Set 6
description: Set Contents: • Unlocks color variant no. 21 for the following characters. Sandalphon Galleon Wilnas Meg Ilsa

title: FPS Infinite
description:
FPS Infinite is a "Metroidvania" (similar to Metroid Prime) where the enemies, weapons, levels and item placements are procedurally generated. You'll need to explore each unique world for new abilities, which will unlock new areas.

Your goal is to find the Forbidden Phr00t in each world, which will trigger the world to blow up. You must escape safely in the dynamically calculated time to win.

title: Millivolt
description: You play as an electrical appliance repair robot named 'Robert Wattson'. You fix a microwave by entering them and solving various puzzles to put the wiring back together, replace components and avoiding obstacles. These puzzles often involve moving screws to join circuits together and activating buttons within the appliance to both traverse through the appliance and eventually fix it. Robert also faces gravity shifting in this microwave that you must traverse around whilst solving certain puzzles.

title: Chlorofell
description:
Chlorofell focused on mastering quick thinking and manual reloading. You play as a soldier of nature’s wrath, and fight through a factory of environments where plants and technology collide, and squads of enemies coordinate to stop you.

With a limited shield covering your fragile amount of health, you can be easily overwhelmed, but through mastering the speed of movement, manual reloading, and the specialized ammo you’ll find along the way, you just may make it all the way to the source of this scourge and have the chance to finish this fight.

title: Starboard
description: Become Cillian Cade, a pirate thief who’s in over his head after a heist gone wrong. After stealing a magical gauntlet possessed by the spirit of a pirate lord, the duo set out to find an ancient vault. Outwit and outplay the crew of a malicious pirate captain who wants the treasure all for himself.

title: Stellarion
description:
Returning home from your interstellar travels, you stumble upon a mining station that presents the perfect opportunity to upgrade your outdated spaceship. Take on the role of a miner, harvest precious resources, and trade them for powerful upgrades.

Navigate asteroid fields, face increasingly challenging enemies, and master your spaceship’s controls in a vast, procedurally generated space environment. Customize your ship with four types of upgrades—cargo capacity, firepower, durability, and speed—each with multiple tiers to suit your playstyle.

title: Off-Score: A Game of Songs
description: A surreal game that tells the stories of 3 songs. Play the music until the end by solving the puzzles and secrets along the way.

title: WeightWare
description: A game that contains multiple different weird minigames to complete.

title: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
description: Witness the resurrection of the forspoken nemesis of Jurnal Risa crew that was never told before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game. This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.

title: Spidle Tridle
description: Minimalist sci-fi base building about resource extraction and refinement in a 100% indie, lo-fi aesthetic, relaxed atmosphere, humble and honest little idle builder game made to be played in a window on the side.

title: WallSmashers
description: an action physics-destruction-based infinite runner where you smash into walls at high speeds in order to accumulated multipliers and points. THIS IS NOT A RACING GAME! See how you stack against other players with our leaderboards (on mobile only for now)

title: Snap Flex
description: Snap Flex is a fast-paced card game based on classic Snap. Match ranks or suits, play with points or winner-takes-all. Enjoy offline or online multiplayer with up to 4 players.

title: Lost Lands X
description: The sudden madness of an old friend from the Lost Lands forces Susan, who has long since retired, to return to her old adventures. “Lost Lands X” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

title: Sumigami
description: Sumigami is a walking simulator set in a world of enigmatic creatures. Ranging from wholesome to horrific, each encounter pulls you deeper into a haunting journey with a unique visual style.

title: Worshippers of the Gain
description: Assume the role of a visitor to a small town in the middle of nowhere. For reasons unknown, no visitors seem to stay small for long, and it's up to you to discover why... or just eat some burgers instead.

title: 100 Cats Istanbul
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Istanbul! Can you find them all?

title: The Way of the Tray: Japanese Restaurant Simulator
description: The Way of the Tray is a waiter simulator with action puzzle elements in a Japanese spirit world setting inspired by Ghibli studio films. Your task is to master the skill of serving dishes and earn the trust of yokai patrons. Will you be able to prove yourself and find your way home?

title: Apothecurse
description: A mysterious letter compels Leon, an alchemist, to brave the seas and travel across the world to Port Gelour, a cast in shadow. Craft potent potions, befriend quirky locals, and uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the waves in a quest for alchemy and discovery!

title: Hauntrick
description: Hauntrick is a chaotic, goofy horror game where you hunt cursed objects, perform rituals, and survive bizarre hauntings—solo or with friends. The ghosts? Unpredictable, absurd, and hilariously annoying. Every match is a mix of strategy, panic, and laughter as reality itself starts to unravel.

title: The Last Camp
description: This is a top-down survival-building game blending farming, tower defense, and micromanagement, requiring you to fend off zombie hordes, grow crops, and strategically deploy traps to defend your homestead.

title: The Artifactory
description: The Artifactory is a chaotic couch co-op party game set in a whimsical fantasy lootbox factory! Craft potions, forge weapons, and experiment with recipes to fulfill unpredictable orders. Fix broken machines, survive moving platforms, lava, and more! Play solo or with up to 4 players!

title: Isekai Harem Quest: Love, Blades, and Power
description: Reincarnated as the strongest man in another world, you share a mansion with three women: knight Alize, maid Giselle, and mysterious Mio. Despite your power, they're cold to you. Through dialogue choices, win their hearts in this romance adventure. Can you turn their icy attitudes into a warm harem?

title: Tint The Saver
description: A survival game where players capture and protect endangered species, facing hostile environments while maintaining rare wildlife. Cutting down trees and trash lowers the environment index, while cleaning up raises it. If the index hits zero, players’ health rapidly declines.

title: Cross The Boundaries
description: This is a Touhou Fangame. Maribel Hearn is a girl with unusual experience with ghosts and supernatural beings. In Cross The Boundaries, you will solve riddles while trying to stay alive, and looking for a way out of the nightmare.

title: Revive
description: A mysterious plague known as the Sleeping Sickness has taken your beloved. But it is too soon for despair. There is still a chance to bring them back. Gather the tears of the Hero’s bloodline and reclaim your love.

title: Scavenger Zero
description: Restore hope in a hopeless world. Fight hordes of enemies, make choices, and decide the fate of the universe.

title: Where Are You, Diamond
description: Where Are You, Diamond?

title: Never Fall
description: "Relax, listen to music, and guide the ball to reach the highest position in this physics-based adventure. Can you master the climb?"

title: Card Fable Quest
description: Create a character, fight monsters, level up, go on quests, and explore dungeons in this card based fantasy RPG. Play by drawing a card, choosing how to respond, and then drawing another. Use our editor tools to create your own cards, monsters, quest lines, dungeons, and more!

title: Melbourne: Route 96
description: Part travel journal, part visual novel with a hint of psychological horror, Melbourne: Route 96 is an experimental game about catching a tram in the wrong direction - and a polaroid camera.

title: Astro Fighters
description: Astro Fighters is a tough old school vertical scrolling bullet hell shooter designed to test your skills with non-stop arcade style action. Fight against large bosses at the end of every level and compete for the high score across 4 difficulty modes to be the best fighter pilot in the game.

title: In Search of Something
description: You are in an unfamiliar place, completely unaware of what is happening. Creatures made of shadows or something else and strange puzzles are everywhere. Maybe you only know one thing: you are In Search of Something.

title: Kaiju Evolution Survivor
description: Kaiju Evolution is a top-down action roguelike game where you choose a Kaiju to evolve through four different size stages, from a microscopic creature into a gigantic world-ending threat. Survive for 20 minutes against increasingly larger waves of enemies as you learn new weapons and abilities.

title: Hermes' Runner
description: Hermes Runner is a 3D movement-based open level parkour punk game. Freerun using Hermes’ boots, deface billboards, and make deliveries in a reimagined 2000s Greek city where the Gods are real, and they own everything.

title: Spank The Idle Monkey
description: This is a classic spin on Idle Clicker games, inspired by a classic Flash game with a twist on it, hidden horror story built into a simple game will take your clicking excitment and make you question all that hard work. Was it worth it? how many did you hurt? Will you stop?

title: Tomb of the Bloodletter
description: Tomb of the Bloodletter is a strategic word roguelike where your keyboard becomes your arsenal. Use your wit to unleash deadly words through tactical combinations of your letters to defeat the denizens of this dingy tomb and claim the Bloodletter for yourself...

title: Escape From Timokha 2: Army
description: Pay your debt to the Pie Federation or RUN AWAY!

title: Fun School
description: You play as an electrical technician tasked with shutting down the power to an abandoned school—except, somehow, it mysteriously turned back on. What seems like a routine job quickly spirals into a nightmarish experience as you uncover the dark secrets hidden within the school's halls.

title: Pudding Frog
description: Dive into Pudding Frog, a high-stakes, physics-based platformer where every leap and grapple could be your last. Master the art of the swing as you painstakingly ascend through a treacherous world to reclaim your precious pudding from the cunning Harry the Heron. Do you have what it takes?

title: Quest of Legend
description: Single player adventure game in third person mode. Mild puzzle solving elements shroud a world in imminent danger! Explore the world, collect ingredients, and weapons to arm yourself against many odd foes. Find one of many ways to save the world!

title: Clawsome
description: Control a claw in a chaotic world where grabbing prizes is harder than it looks! Avoid moving platforms, disappearing objects, and unexpected twists while building your own diorama with the trophies you collect.

title: Mari's Magical Deliveries
description: An otome game about a witch reigniting old flames.

title: Robbery Day
description: This is a first-person shooter where the player controls one of three characters. Each has two types of weapons, allowing them to adapt to different tactical situations. The gameplay combines dynamic shootings and robberies.

title: CursorLublub
description: "Pet the little monsters to make them feel comfortable! " A cute game where you can touch the little monsters with your hands, upgrade your hands to be stronger, and have fun with the cuteness!

title: Gunlocked 2
description: Movement is your weapon. A sci-fi action roguelike and shmup combined, in Gunlocked 2 you'll pilot and upgrade a state-of-the-art warship against endless waves of deadly aliens. Deep customization, branching paths, and tons of unlockables offer endless replayability!

title: Survive the Hunt
description: Survive The Hunt is a Multiplayer Horror game (2 vs 16). Two players are the beasts and the remaining 14 will be scientists, prisoners or cops who will have to decide whether to cooperate or not to escape from the facility.

title: Beach Bass
description: Beach Bass is a 3D vehicle platform game. It's a game for drivers who rely only on their skills.

title: Fatrifice 3
description: The third addition to the Fatrifice series. This time around, it's Delilah's turn. She will need some help from Shar's minions, each with their own unique abilities. Summon food from the demoness' realm, and watch Delilah expand over and over again as she reaches new sizes.

title: Basil and the Isles of Spice
description: Join Basil the Basilisk as she runs, jumps, and glides through the Isles of Spice on her journey to become the new Shaman of her village. Along the way to collect the mystical crystals, she'll meet a colorful cast of characters who will grow alongside her and help her uncover the secret of the caldera.

title: Hats and Guns
description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

title: Decadent Heir
description: Rewrite history in this narrative RPG set in the last days of Imperial Russia. Born into nobility, you will shape both your destiny and the fate of a nation. Will you preserve the old order, ignite the flames of revolution, or carve out your own path? Every decision will echo through time.

title: Pizza Rogue: P.P.M.P.D.E.S.
description: Complete the Driving Course: All new employees must pass our challenging delivery test to earn their official Pizza Pups Multidimensional Pizzeria Drivers License. License Required: Be sure to present a valid multiversal driver's license at the start. Don't have one? That's fine The MDSC can cover you.

title: Whispering Memories
description: Immerse yourself in a psychological thriller where your choices shape the story. Unravel the mysteries of a town plagued by supernatural phenomena, as you navigate the environments and interact with complex characters. Can you uncover the truth before it consumes you?

title: The Pharody
description: ARPG about the medieval inquisition. With a view from the 3rd person. Ridicules (parodies) the RPG genre. 18+ as it contains references to alcohol, erotica and rude conversations

title: Wake Up The Box
description: Mr. Box sleeps too much. Wake him up in this physic based puzzle game.

title: CatCatMan
description: This is a Exam to test you that you can be superhero CatCatMan or not.

title: Melee Light
description: A web based version of Super Smash Bros. Melee with a minimalist aesthetic. Play as three characters, Fox, Marth, or Jigglypuff across a handful of different stages.

title: Beachfront
description: Beachfront is a sandbox game where you take care of mischievous alien critters as they soak up the sun, dig for buried treasure, and asexually reproduce.

title: Rainbow Festival 3
description:
Rainbow Festival and Rainbow Festival 2 are games that I made on Scratch in 2013 and 2016. Earlier this month (June 2021) marked the ten year anniversary of my Scratch account, so I decided to continue this series outside of Scratch.

The appeal of the first two Rainbow Festival games (to me) is the absurd amount of frustratingly bad design. The games are fun because they aren't fun. When you get hit by an obstacle, instead of dying, you experience a fate worse than death: knock-back. Many levels rely on getting lucky with random spawns and behavior.

I decided to take these terrible ideas and expand upon them in the third game. On top of including intentionally annoying mechanics, I filled the entire game with inside jokes and references that only a couple people will actually understand.

Oh, there are also a few major secrets.

title: Qwerty Warriors 2
description: Put your trigger fingers on the home row and get ready for even more typing warfare!

title: Save The Sailboat Race
description: Save the Sailboat Race. Falling Letters are ruining the sailboat race. Help by typing the letters before they land on the boats. Lots of fun!

title: Dimension Warrior
description: Dimension Warrior is an intense soulslike action adventure game in which you traverse various dimensions, facing powerful enemies in your quest to complete your dangerous mission and return to your own world. The core of the gameplay revolves around defeating powerful bosses.

title: Boeboeks: De Tocht Naar Opa Kakadoris
description:
Piepel, one of the children of the Boeboeks, very small creatures, becomes ill. Help his sister Soeza to get the miracle cure from Grandpa Kakadoris, a piece of the cotton candy web.

Based on the story 'The Cotton Candy Web' by Marc De Bel.

title: Kaseki no Uta
description:
Kaseki no Uta is an adult romance adventure game released by âge on January 28, 2000.
God created man. And man created "dolls". But what is the difference between these "dolls" and us humans?

This is a rare and monstrous work that mixes several motifs often used as popular elements in recent years, and then weaves them into a science fiction story!

However, what is this inexpressible sadness that lingers deeply in the heart at the end...

title: Absolum
description: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

title: Pushika
description: Merge kitties & feed them fishes. Dress them in adorable outfits!

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 is a remake of the two skateboarding games originally released in the early 2000s. Players perform tricks, complete objectives, and explore varied skate parks across global locations. The gameplay emphasizes fluid controls, combo chaining, and arcade-style challenges. Each title features a roster of professional skaters, along with customizable characters and gear. The collection preserves the core mechanics of the originals while offering updated visuals and performance on modern platforms.

title: Lawnmower Game: Survival
description: Drive a lawnmower across 15 different levels. The player has 60 seconds to find a coin and finish each level.

title: Deep Dark Block
description: Roguelike Tetris, Super Challenge Mode

title: Sans Spielen's Epic Megalovania
description: You play as CHARAWSKI, a Polish commando whose goal is to end the war by eliminating the evil dictator SANS SPIELEN.

title: Dungeon Keeper Premium
description:
Dungeon Keeper Premium (ダンジョンキーパープレミアム) is a Japanese release and repackaging of Dungeon Keeper. It features both Japanese and English voice and text, and includes The Deeper Dungeons, the Desktop Theme, and the Direct3D version. It does not, however, include the Dungeon Keeper Level Editor. There is also no MS-DOS version; it is Windows-only, unlike western releases.

The package also includes the story booklet The Dreadful Demise of Derek the Dauntless. At least some versions also feature an Electronic Arts loading cinematic, which does not exist on the western versions of Dungeon Keeper. There is also a creature 'investigative report' booklet, which shows each creature's stats and is not in western releases of Dungeon Keeper, although the information is in the English official guide book. Later releases also include trailers for other Electronic Arts games, including Dungeon Keeper 2; this is the later trailer.

While at first glance, Dungeon Keeper Premium may seem to simply be the Japanese name for Dungeon Keeper Gold, the numerous differences are strongly suggestive of it being a separate release.

title: Sheep Lass: Quest Zero
description: Sheep Lass is a minimalist adventure game that forces you to pay attention by abstaining from leaning on modern quality of life features players expect from the genre. Explore a wide, non-linear playspace to find and explore dungeons to fight monsters and claim treasure.

title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
description:
Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

Current PC players can transfer both GTAV Story Mode progress and GTA Online characters and progression with a one-time migration from the legacy version of GTAV to GTAV Enhanced.

title: Stalked in Solitude
description: A teenager's quiet night home alone turns into a fight for survival in this psychological survival horror. Scavenge for tools, outsmart a relentless stalker, and make life-or-death choices in a chilling race to escape. Every decision matters—can you survive the night?

title: Soko Spectacle
description: Push crates of fireworks and find a way to light the sky in this relaxing puzzle game.

title: Never Second in Rome
description:
Never Second in Rome is a turn-based historical game with RPG and management elements. You take the role of a Roman centurion in the army of Julius Caesar.

Starting right before the beginning of the Gallic War, you will assume command of a century in a newly raised legion.

title: Submansion
description: Journey into a whimsical mansion in search of the invaluable thing, where Keykeeper will be your guide. Keykeeper has lost all her keys. You must find them to take your invaluable item.

title: Polycar Blitz
description: Shift into high gear and defend the moon! A top-down vehicle shooter with rouge-lite elements, gun down monsters and upgrade your Polycar to fend off against increasingly difficult waves of alien invaders! Do you have what it takes to win?

title: Doki Doki Another Round
description: Doki Doki: Another Round is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that delves even deeper into the characters' psyches, exploring themes of memory, reality and the continuous cycle of events. The game challenges the player's perceptions, introducing a darker and more intriguing atmosphere.

title: Doki Doki Space
description: Doki Doki: Space is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that offers a narrative experience focused on the character Sayori, exploring themes of hope, distance and the search for comfort in the midst of adversity.

title: Doki Doki Grappling Hook Yuri: The Origin Arc
description: Grappling Hook Yuri: The Origin Arc is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that takes players on a comical and action-packed adventure through the multiverse, centered on the character Yuri equipped with a climbing hook.

title: Crumps
description: Crumps is a small, social, multiplayer, platforming game where you are a Crump :3

title: Doki Doki Loser MC
description: Doki Doki: Loser MC is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that transforms the original experience by focusing on an extremely passive, insecure and socially awkward protagonist (MC). Unlike the standard version of the game, where the MC is a relatively neutral character, in this mod he is portrayed as a complete “loser”, resulting in hilarious, embarrassing and even frustrating interactions with the girls in the club.

title: Doki Doki Zero Bitches Plan
description: Doki Doki: Zero Bitches Plan is a hilarious and satirical mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that puts the player in the role of a protagonist (MC) desperate to finally get a girlfriend. Inspired by the famous “Zero Bitches?” meme, the mod plays on the MC's lack of charm and social skills, turning his romantic journey into a sequence of comical failures and disastrous attempts to win over the girls in the club.

title: Magical Literary Heroine Natsuki Saves The Literature Club!
description:
Magical Literary Heroine Natsuki Saves The Literature Club! is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that transforms the original experience into a magical, action-packed adventure, with Natsuki as the main protagonist.

In this mod, the literature club is on the verge of collapse due to mysterious forces that threaten the reality of the game. However, Natsuki awakens magical powers and takes on the role of a heroine determined to save her friends and restore order. The storyline combines magical girl elements with visual novel style, bringing exciting battles, new sprites and dialogues that mix humor, drama and action.

title: Be Our Guest
description:
Have you ever found yourself exhausted and confused by the hustle and bustle of corporate life in the big city?

Wouldn’t it be wonderful if there were a place you could just relax and unwind, maybe have a nice cup of coffee or a snack, in the company of a variety of attentive pink-feathered waterfowl (and also Kenneth)?

Need an opportunity to just hang out and be unafraid to be yourself?

If the answer to any of this is no, then it should be yes, and if the answer to any of this is yes, then you’re welcome to Be Our Guest at the Matinee Cabaret, a fun and inviting café, just a little off the beaten path, and with live entertainment too! Pop in for the grand opening in this charming visual mini-novel featuring original, dynamic sprite-work and colorful backgrounds for the various locations in the café, where you can meet and chat up the employees through their voice-acted branching dialogue trees. Order a drink, make a friend, solve a dilemma, and preview what the Matinee Cabaret has in store!

title: Myulk
description: Myulk is a combined adventure and farming management game.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club The Mod In Which Natsuki Has A Nice Day And Nothing Horrible Happens To Her, Thank You Very Much
description: Natsuki Has a Nice Day is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! created with a simple but very necessary purpose: to ensure that Natsuki has a peaceful and happy day, without any tragic or frightening events.

title: Doki Doki But an Old Dog Tries To Learn New Tricks and The Literature Club Tries to Help It: A Dog Story
description: Doki Doki Dog Mod is a fun and light mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that brings a big and adorable change: dogs!

title: I Drink Sorrel Coffee to Reboot Reality, but I’m Being Hunted by Monster Girls and Armed Agents
description: "I drink Sorrel Coffee to reboot reality, but I'm being hunted by Monster Girls and armed agents" is a branching visual novel where your choices truly matter...

title: National Park Girls: Love Our Parks Edition
description: The complete edition of National Park Girls! After five years of being a ranger in Yosemite National Park, Eve is just about ready to throw in the towel. However, things start to change when she meets three spritely girls who claim to be manifestations of the National Parks.

title: Cozy Island
description: Take a relaxing walk around a surprise-filled island and build your own secret base! Explore the island, meet cute animals, play fun mini-games, and collect cool toys and furniture. Enjoy carefree and happy moments on the island! Play with your friends and share the fun together!

title: Marshmallow Marvin: Greenwood
description: Marshmallow Marvin on a sweet new adventure in Greenwood! Explore a magical forest full of vibrant mysteries, quirky creatures, and hidden secrets, where every corner holds a new challenge for our squishy hero!

title: Sugarbound
description: The human kingdom is facing a food shortage crisis and the only option to survive is defeating the monsters from a mythical land called Sugarbound, but only a master patisserie is able to transform the defeated monsters into edible food! Chloé Fondant is the only hope humanity have to survive (and eat delicious cakes).

title: Witch Pachi
description: "Witch Pachi" is a physics-based roguelike game featuring elemental and skill deck-building. It introduces new mechanics that offer fresh strategies and fun.

title: Veins of Darkness
description: Veins of Darkness is a first-person horror game. The hero is an ordinary shift worker. During a business trip, his company rented him a house on the outskirts. But no one knew what evil was hiding in this godforsaken place.

title: Loopmayor
description: This is a casual simulation building game where a mayor will collect taxes in a city with only one road, and build a prosperous city through the connections between different buildings. It is my first independent game and will continue to be updated. If you have any questions, please contact me

title: The Unrested
description: The Unrested is a story-driven first-person horror game. A spirit from your past traps you in an abandoned boarding school. A shadow watching your every step will test you with puzzles while forcing you to confront your fears.

title: Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders
description: Famous detective Kosuke Kindaichi's first case, the Honjin Murder Mystery. Honjin descendant Kenzo Ichiyanagi and his new wife Katsuko Kubo lay dead in a bed of blood on the night of their wedding. Kosuke Kindaichi searches for the truth about this locked room murder mystery. However...

title: Deep Blue: Devour and Evolve
description: Play as different fish, devour opponents in the ruthless underwater world of survival of the fittest, and evolve your abilities.

title: Critter Isle
description: Jump right in and hatch your first Egglin, let creativity flow as you learn how to manage your Egglin's wants and needs through food and play. Zen out to the blissful comforts of decorating your island how you see fit, and bask in the rewards your Egglins provide as you grow your Egglin empire.

title: Fruit Mountain Party
description: A brand new game in the hit 3D puzzle game "Fruit Mountain" where you combine fruits to make them bigger is finally here! This time, it's fruit battles!? There are plenty of versus modes that everyone can enjoy! Get together for online or local multiplayer! Keep stacking those fruits!

title: Goal3
description: GOAL3 is a 3D arcade soccer game with a side view.

title: Horde Arena
description: Horde Arena is a third-person shooter roguelite where you survive endless enemy waves. Pick a character, upgrade your stats and weapons, and evolve to dominate the battlefield. Play solo or team up with up to four players in co-op mode.

title: Trump Simulator 2025
description: 'Trump Simulator 2025' is a silly little game. Run the country while flying in Air Force One, thousands of feet in the air. Immerse yourself into the role of the President Elect!

title: Watermelon (with a Broken Head) Game
description: Watermelon (with a broken head) Game is a thrilling, physics-based puzzle game inspired by polyomino puzzles and the Suika Game. Shake, mix, and merge blocks of various shapes to find the lost emotions one by one!

title: Nezha Legend
description: This is an action shooting game. There will be 50 people on the game battlefield, including the player, but only one person can win in the end. The last remaining person can receive generous rewards. All in all, this game allows players to experience the thrilling atmosphere of the battlefield.

title: Fate's Masquerade
description: In this animated manhwa-inspired romance fantasy, toy with princes behind their perfect masks. Fall in love? Maybe. Make them fall for you? Absolutely. You are unpredictable, audacious, and just unhinged enough to make history. Heroine or villainess? Why not both?

title: Tahitian Driftin'
description: A tropical anti-gravity racing game from the depths of a long-lost arcade cabinet that will have you cruising through lush, remote Polynesian islands with a draft-based boost system that fosters tight-knit competition between players

title: Detective Araka
description: In this gripping visual novel, step into the shoes of Yuuki, a boy with amnesia, and team up with top-tier exorcist Ihayase Araka. Together, you must uncover the dark secrets of Inusai Village and piece together your forgotten past.

title: Assemble Ensemble
description: Assemble Ensemble is a music-themed factory-building game, that offers a variety of fun melodies, for you to recreate by cleverly placing machines and conveyors!

title: Forsworn
description: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this rogue lite, turn-based tactics adventure where no hero fights alone. Build powerful synergies to overcome unforgiving battles and defy fate in a world controlled by the gods.

title: Rock Island
description: Explore the mystery of the mysterious cube at the center of Boulder Island, dig out endless treasures, wake up the sleeping little boulder people, and lead them to create prosperity!

title: Trapventure
description: A tough, rage-inducing platformer where you solve puzzles, dodge traps, and navigate through deadly obstacles to escape a cursed fortress. Good for players who love a challenge and don’t mind a little frustration along the way.

title: DX Legends
description: Fast-paced online battle arena with thrilling modes, deep customization, and chaotic battles. Will you rise as a legend?

title: Stela Boss
description: Face challenging bosses and hordes of enemies in an action roguelike, using elemental weapons and unique combinations to master each cycle.

title: Escape From Biochemical
description: Escape From Biochemical is a 3D single-player puzzle horror game. The protagonist needs to complete various tasks while being chased by the experimental subjects and then escape from there.

title: Rename the History
description: Lead your country in one of the most difficult periods of post-war history. At this time, you will have to choose between the strong, or become a great power. To go west or east? It's up to you to decide.

title: Vastophobia
description: Explore varied environments and chilling soundscapes. avoid threats that stalk the in-between. try to uncover why you are here and what happened to you. listen out for strange out of this world creatures.

title: Liar Game
description: Can you find out who the Liar is? Will you outsmart everyone in this intense battle of wits?

title: Nighthawk
description:
ABOUT GAME
Set in a ghost town of the same name, Nighthawk is an upcoming horror adventure game. Explore the remnants of a once prosperous community and uncover the mystery of its abandoned mine. Find Jesse, or die trying.

EMPHASIS ON EXPLORATION

To survive in Nighthawk you need to use your resources wisely... Make sure to scout every area you pass through along your journey to collect resources and other useful items!

STORYTELLING

Drop yourself into this games immersive story created by BainMeetsWorld and find out what really happened to the people of Nighthawk and how it all links to the company responsible for the mine in the first place, GEL&PC. While also uncovering the dark and malicious secrets surrounding the people themselves.

GAMEPLAY MECHANICS

With gameplay heavily inspired by recent first-person horror titles, we decided to mix that gameplay style with the nostalgic gameplay of a point and click adventure game!

ADVANCED ENEMY AI + FEAR SYSTEM

The Enemies in this game will respond to how scared the player is by becoming more aggressive and erratic the more scared of them you are! You have to find a way to stay calm and try not to alert the enemies of your presence...
The fear system will limit your ability when you are too scared, blurring your vision and destabilizing your character, be careful!

title: Prophecy of Ashen
description: "Prophecy of Ashen" is a medieval fantasy role-playing game. The game revolves around the conflict between the Ashen descendants and the Hall of Divine Edict, and players must make difficult choices throughout the game to determine their fate.

title: Yagazem Elements
description: In Yagazem Elements, a medieval fantasy RPG, you play as Kubke. A curious young golemancer / wizard, in search of knowledge. Experience a story about discovery and sacrifice as you guide your golems in a hexagonal world, clearing dungeons and helping gods solve their problems.

title: DigSite
description: DigSite is archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archaeologist.

title: Dream Place
