Back inside once more, you can choose any number of Christmas craft activities and then join Dudley and the other Little People for a sing along of five perennial favorite Christmas carols such as "Deck the Halls," "Up on the Housetop," and "Jingle Bells."

title: Sonic Essence
description: Sonic Essence is an original 2D Modern Sonic adventure built with the Retro Engine V4 Decompilation. It features completely original sprites, levels, badniks, and an all-new soundtrack featuring remixes and original compositions! This project aims to push the potential of Retro Engine (V4) modding to show the fresh and new experiences the decompilation can offer!

title: Spark the Electric Jester: Recharged
description: Spark The Electric Jester: Recharged is a mod that adds bug fixes and new content to the original game.

title: The Third Pig
description: After your brothers are killed by Mr. Wolf and a mysterious associate you wake up to find yourself trapped in your own home and must use your wits and determination to escape. Do you have what it takes to escape?

title: PC Install Girl
description: A girl because her father owes a huge debt is unable to pay, imprisoned in a private prison to work, every day forced to wear sexy clothes live sell computer debt.

title: Foul Repercussion
description: Challenged by his friends, this young boy stayed overnight at school and successfully overcame evil entities... or so he said. Little did he know, everything he told his friends was coming to reality. Will he manage to survive just like what he said in his lies?

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - The Lion’s Crest
description:
Experience a unique questline that, once completed, will reward you with the legendary armour and weapon set of the famous Knight Brunswick: The Lion's Crest.

Stand out from the crowd with a polearm for long distance combat, a dagger when you want to get up close and personal, a full set of plate armour for your good self and a full caparison (a protective and decorative cloth covering) for your noble steed. This set comes replete with a Bohemian coat of arms, with burgundy and gold trim in abundance. Because no one said you can’t look classy on the battlefield.

title: Dark City: Amsterdam Collector's Edition
description: Amsterdam is in trouble and only you can help! Get ready to tackle one of the biggest cases of Agatha’s investigative career, when the legendary ghost ship The Flying Dutchman returns to Amsterdam, bringing a crew of ghost sailors that stalk the streets, sowing terror and seeking revenge! However, there are some that don’t believe the tall tales, so Agatha is enlisted to start an independent investigation into these so-called ghosts. Do these salty spirits really hold water, or will the legend prove to be all dried up? There’s only one way to find out! Dive into another haunting mystery in this Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: Pawfish Bay
description: Fish, grill and serve your feline bosses!

title: Goos Hunt
description: Infinite rounds, every 10 GOOS they get faster. Each round you get to let 2 GOOS escape, and you get 13 bullets, miss 3 or run out of ammo and the game ends... Each GOOS = 10 points.

title: Här Kommer Pippi Långstrump
description: Här kommer Pippi Långstrump is the second game of Pippi Långstrump games. It contains ten different mini-games which can be played with Pippi, Tommy and Annika.

title: Motocross The Game
description:
MTG - Motocross The Game is the materialization of nearly 30 years' experience in both motocross and video games. The entire core project team is or has been a motocross racer, and is an active member of existing motocross video game communities.

MTG is the game that gamers have been dreaming of for decades: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator based on online competition, available on both PC and next-gen consoles, with cross-play capabilities.

title: Starmaker Story
description: Starmaker Story is an immersive Adult Visual Novel where your dialogue choices shape the journey. Encounter and romance a variety of intriguing characters, grow your Starmaker Page, and unlock one of 11 unique endings.

title: Last Laugh
description: Last Laugh is a horror game that tells the story of the fate of 3 teenagers who often bully their classmates.

title: Asylum: Patient Zero
description: Plunge into the frightening depths of horror in this thrilling horror game, where every step conceals new nightmares and darkness hides the creepiest secrets....

title: Twilight Tales: Hollow's Store
description: While trying to avoid the dangers of working the night shift at a store deep in the forest, you'll also make decisions that shape the fate of the story.

title: Death Worm
description: If you've ever secretly harboured a desire to snap up entire elephants in a single bite, Death Worm, more Shai-Hulud than Nibbles, just might be the game for you. Loosely inspired by cryptozoological accounts of the Mongolian Olgoi-Khorkhoi, this game allows the player to be to the Gobi Desert what Jaws was to Amity Island -- a menacing avatar of hunger incarnate, lurking somewhere unseen beneath the surface... waiting to strike!

title: MinecraftEdu
description: MinecraftEdu focuses on allowing the player to explore, interact with, and modify a dynamically-generated map made of one-cubic-meter-sized blocks. In doing so, the student, with the help of the teacher, is intended to learn a variety of subjects. The teacher can change settings to define where students can place and destroy blocks and the world used on the server.

title: Harmony of Fear
description: In Harmony of Fear, you will take on the role of Dian, a music instructor who brings her students to a secluded villa for a music rehearsal. Uncover dark secrets and face supernatural threats in this gripping psychological horror inspired by Indonesian folklore.

title: A Regular Store
description: As a new staff member of "A Regular Store", you're job is to complete tasks such as locking the doors, filling sections of the store, grabbing cash out of the register, etc. But as you do so, horrific events occur, and you learn the horrors of the store's past.

title: Goosthetic
description: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Escape captivity and evade slime mutations in this fast-paced action-platformer FPS.

title: Argonauts Agency: Gorgon Medusa - Collector's Edition
description:
Jason and Medea are on a mission again: the famous relic collector Pelias asked them to retrieve the artifact that protects against Medusa's gaze. Without hesitation, the Argonauts set off on a journey to recover the artifact, save the cursed people, and find new friends. Explore the world, gather resources, and help the heroes lift the curse, using your time management skills and strategy to stop the curse and defeat the evil!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
Complete the exclusive bonus campaign!
View concept art and replay your favorite tracks on the music player!

title: Cursed House 14
description: Banish evil spirits by combining tiles 3 in a row!

title: Cursed House 7
description: Use your Match 3 skills against the demons!

title: Dragon Tale 4: The Raven Plot - Collector's Edition
Avalon Jewels 2: Collector's Edition
description: Avalon Jewels is a story-driven Match-3 adventure in a magical fantasy world. Restore the fading Avalon Jewels, defeat Morgana's minions, and explore enchanted lands. Play 300 total handcrafted levels, including Collector's Edition content, in Relaxed or Puzzle Mode.

title: Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick - Collector's Edition
description: Join the most famous pair of detective twins as they delve into the mysterious deaths of two prominent magicians. Were these tragic accidents, or is there a sinister force at play?

title: Enchancement
description: Enchancement is a mod that aims to completely overhaul vanilla Minecraft's enchanting system, along with some other adjacent mechanics.

title: Wilde Investigations: The Zoo Kerfuffle - Collector's Edition
Incredible Dracula: Academy of Shadows - Collector's Edition
Criminal Archives: Blade of Deceit - Collector's Edition
description: A judge's body is discovered with a clean cut across his jugular, setting the stage for an intense puzzle of motives and clues.

title: Ms. Holmes: The Milverton Plot - Collector's Edition
description: Can you uncover the truth behind your uncle’s dangerous past?

title: Relaxing Time: Enchanting France - Collector's Edition
description: Let the magic of Paris, the city of romance and history, sweep you off your feet as you embark on an architectural journey like no other!

title: Relaxing Time: Italy Tour - Collector's Edition
description: Experience the trip of your dreams as you explore the beauty of Italian cities, uncover the secrets of the Colosseum and find hidden objects!

title: It Happened Here: A Storm is Brewing - Collector's Edition
Wilde Investigations: Animal Sanctuary Shuffle - Collector's Edition
Greek Kitchen Frenzy: Dionysus - Collector's Edition
Fables of the Kingdom V: Collector's Edition
Fables of the Kingdom III: Collector's Edition
Ruins of Tearyn
description: Ruins of Tearyn is the smallest fantasy Indie MMO inspired by classic MMORPGs (but modernized!). There will be formidable warriors, epic healers, try-hard DPS and mesmerizing enchanters.

title: New Yankee: The Way of the Knight - Collector's Edition
Mystery of Myths: Heart of Athens - Collector's Edition
description: Step into a world where ancient legends come alive and danger lurks in every shadow. Uncover the truth behind a deadly cult and save Athens from ancient horrors!

title: Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits - Collector's Edition
description: Can you solve the riddle of the disappearing visitors before you lose yourself in the gallery’s macabre beauty?

title: Grim Tales: All Shades of Black - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a haunting hidden-object trip through time!

title: Love Letters: First Bloom
description: Solve word challenges, clear locked tiles, and enjoy relaxing minigames while growing a beautiful garden with each discovery.

title: Alice's Wonderland 7: Sugar Rush - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 2: Stolen Souls - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 5: A Ray of Hope - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 6: Fire and Ice - Collector's Edition
Christmas Fables: The Wishing Store - Collector's Edition
description: Save Christmas from Mr. Greedy! Win over the Christmas-hating mayor, and bring the festive spirit back to Christmasshire.

title: Jewel Match: Dracula - Collector's Edition
description: Sink your teeth into a gothic Match-3 adventure in this ghoulish new installment of the Jewel Match series. As a powerful vampire lord, tackle eerie match-3 puzzles to resurrect and refurbish the legendary Castle Dracula.

title: Knight Cats: Whisper of the Universe
Knight Cats: Waves on the Water - Collector's Edition
Myth or Reality: Snowbound Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: Unlock the secrets of Blue Roche! Are the legends of monsters real, or just figments of the local's imagination? It's time to find the truth!

title: Animal Kingdom 3
description: Animal Kingdom 3 is a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints and cameras while searching animals in fantastic locations! With 3 game modes and jigsaw and swap puzzles between the chapters, Animal Kingdom 3 will provide hours of fun for Hidden Object fans in soothing natural settings!

title: Ramek: Total Machine Death
description: In a future Earth of machine overlords, warrior chieftain Ramek enacts a terrible revenge upon his mechanical enemy. Fly Ramek's genetically-engineered war-budgie through five levels of non-stop carnage, from the irradiated sands of the Dead Zone, to the iron towers of Machine City.

title: ChessBlaze
description: ChessBlaze is a strategy game based on Chess but with a major twist: TURNS DO NOT EXIST! Who needs turns if you can have energy instead. Every move costs energy, no need to wait for opponents response. Some game-modes feature "PowerTiles". They offer unique abilities for pieces entering them!

title: Jixo: The Season of Joy - Collector's Edition
description: Explore a variety of holiday-themed games, from hidden object challenges in enchanting Christmas scenes to captivating jigsaw puzzles that piece together the wonders of winter. And if you're looking to flex those brain muscles, our clever puzzles will keep you happily engaged all season long.

title: Umbra Lumen
description: Roguelike Deckbuilder meets puzzle gameplay. Collect tarot cards and mystic items as you face unpredictable events, meet memorable characters, and explore the beyond life. Each run is different, and every decision matters. Will you ascend or fall in this unique turn-based RPG?

title: Metaneurosis
description: A turn-based RPG blending strategy, surreal worlds, and dark humor. Customize your character, shape the story with your choices, and explore worlds where absurdity meets heart.

title: Ramen Shop Simulator
description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique restaurant. The aroma of success is just a bowl away!

title: Fillet Fury
description: Set in the Original Wild West, Fillet Fury is a high stakes game of strategy, skill, and survival. Engage in intense showdowns where every decision counts. Will you walk away a legend or lose it all? Literally!

title: Catale
description: Catale is a new type of card game with a mix of CCG and RogueLike. Use units strategically in the field, and attack enemies with spells to win. After opening the loot pack to get the card, make your own deck to face a more powerful enemy...!

title: Staroot
description: 1-person Topdown strategy game. Plant seeds to defend enemy and grow roots. Terraforming the planets!

title: Hailborn: UFO Stole My Egg!
description: A souls-like action game where you fight monsters, explore hail, and build bridges to reclaim your stolen egg. Created by a solo developer.

title: Kingdom Fortress
description: Command powerful heroes in this turn-based, deck-building village defense game. Build strategic fortifications, deploy loyal troops, and protect settlements across the realm of Valora. Manage resources, unlock powerful cards, and lead your forces against the encroaching darkness.

title: Uhilant
description: Cozy, turn-based puzzle game set in a dystopian land overshadowed by a long war. You've made the bold choice to survive instead of becoming cannon fodder. Now You are - "The Uhilant", war dodger. Immerse yourself in this charming adventure, where every move brings you closer to freedom

title: Box King
description: BOXKING - Bounce the box to the target point! Bounce the box by clicking the mouse, avoid obstacles, and reach the target to advance to the next level! 🚀 Collect coins and rubies to upgrade, and enjoy stylish play with unique box skins! ✨ Try BOXKING right now!

title: Any Castle
description: This is a very relaxing and minimalist idle game. However, if you want to defeat the ultimate dragon or obtain the final treasure, you will still need to invest a lot of time and have great luck! Start your journey now!

title: Spell Candle
description: Spell Candle is your grief coping mechanism in a 2D romance visual novel. Take on the role of a foreign correspondent turned investigator of magical crimes to uncover the culprit behind the mysterious disappearance of a sleeping God.

title: WyshBound
description: A great knight is all that stands between his kingdom and demise. Wes…is his squire. When the villainous Fangor defeats the great knight, Wes is the only one who can avenge his mentor. Gather a party of friends, solve unique puzzles, and collect the realm's gifted flowers in this hand-drawn RPG!

title: Paws & Potions
description: You are the pet and kitchen assistant of a young alchemist witch. Run through the garden of the shop she and her girlfriend manage and deliver the correct ingredients to help with sales!

title: The Mnemograph
description: A strategy game that combines deck-building, card-based combat, deduction, and management, all set in a steampunk world of press and crime. Build a unique deck and manage your printing factory to create the city's most influential newspaper.

title: Ventilate
description: A bullet hell top-down/isometric steampunk game where you must fight rogue constructs to get home and flee the city.

title: Phantom of the Grove
description: A fungal fairycore colony sim where you are the vengeful spirit of an ancient forest. Possess and gaslight invaders into fighting each other, reclaim their bodies as fuel for the Grove, and guide your Seely mushroom children to build and expand. The Grove is done being nice.

title: Wizards and Knights
description: Wizards and Knights is turn-based fantasy strategy game featuring randomly generated maps for an infinite variety of games. The goal of the game is to battle five other AI controlled teams to conquer the world.

title: Lonefield Evacutation Survivor
description: Lonefield Evacuation Survivor is a... survivor in which you play as a ship facing an alien incursion. Destroy your enemies, collect bolts and upgrade your ship to survive long enough and escape. Play alone or with up to 3 friends in local multiplayer or with Remote Play Together for online gaming.

title: Drop Dimensions
description: Drop is an endless runner with short enough sessions for quick casual plays and enough features and unlockables to fill more hardcore sessions. Smash your way through walls and dodge traps to survive! RPG-Lite features (leveling), quests, collectibles, achievements, leaderboards and more!

title: Echoes of the Night
description: Two rival phantom theives collide in a high-stakes heist. Will they fall for each other or betray one another? Race, dodge, and fight to the beat of Barney & Company's debut Album "No Refusal"

title: Aster Symphona
description: Aster Symphona allows you to mine, construct, and automate your way through 2D levels each acting as their own puzzle. Fly around space and listen to the sounds of your factory fade in and out as you pass overhead.

title: LuminaRun
description: LuminaRun, a retro-inspired endless runner with two modes: race the clock or test your endurance in Endless Mode. Featuring synthwave visuals, 7 darkwave soundtracks, and fast-paced gameplay, this heartfelt homage to ‘80s and '90s classics is my first Steam release!

title: Blind_Site
description: Explore dark corridors, snap photos, and survive hostile entities hunting you. Use your camera's flash to reveal the way, but beware - each flash draws unwanted attention.

title: Cityventory
description: CITYVENTORY is a minimalist city builder/inventory management game where you build colorful cities just like you are organizing your inventory. Place and move your tiles freely, synergize them to earn points and build the best city possible!

title: Lex Talionis A
description: Lex Talionis A is a team-based, 4 player, couch co-op where aliens fight astronauts, drones, and bosses for revenge against humanity. Choose from four aliens with unique abilities and survive together in this 2D Run n' Gun Adventure.

title: Super Muscle Knight
description: Aim for the top wearing a mysterious mask that generates magnetic force when you strike a macho pose. High difficulty platform game with pixel art. One mistake can lead to despair.

title: Secrets for Taking
description: Take the others' deepest secrets--including your own. Find out where you belong in this decaying world.

title: The Meowfficer
description: You play as a cat in the police force, talking with your allies, fighting in intense gun fights, unraveling the lore, and making moral decisions.

title: Mutant Kingdom
description: Mutant Kingdom thrusts you into a haunting, ever-changing world where survival hinges on clever deckbuilding and tactical exploration. Harness the power of dynamic weather and elemental synergies, discover game-changing items, and unleash adrenaline-pumping combos.

title: Anchor: Quest for Atlantis
description: Dive in and solve the mystery of Atlantis! Explore the depths in this Isometric Action-Game, fight against the Guardians and awaken the powers in your Anchor to uncover the truth behind the fall of the Civilization.

title: BoomerPunk
description: The game takes place in the Far North of Russia in 1997. You play as an investigator who finds themselves in the mysterious settlement of Metallurg-63. Every choice you make affects the course of events and the ending.

title: Strange Jigsaws
description: A game of strange jigsaws.

title: Lunar Elixer
description: You've been tasked with drilling and collecting the valuable resource of elixer that originates from your planet's moon. The native snails are the only thing in your way from collecting this valuable resource. Mine gems and axe down trees to build up your defenses to protect your elixer storage.

title: Necromancy for Homies
description: Necromancy for Homies is a non-linear, black comedy surrealist visual novel, inspired by the legacy of punk band Sektor Gaza.

title: Baseball Legacy Manager 25
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional baseball team!

title: Orbit Economica
description: Trade, Build, Spy, Negotiate, and Battle for total control of the galaxy's riches. Become the backbone of galactic commerce in a grand strategy universe ripe with opportunity for exploitation and conquest.

title: Braving Chronicles
description: Experience a variety of stories that chronicle the tales of a boundlessly creative universe through a tactical, team-building no microtransactions gacha system featuring a wide variety of characters to utilize amidst the many tales of the Braving Universe.

title: Row Divers
description: Row Divers is a short, experimental incremental game about diving into dungeons in the form of rows, shooting enemies, collecting resources, and upgrading your bow to conquer the depths!

title: Haru and Wonder Land
description: Haru and Wonder Land is a game where Haru, a young cellist, embarks on an adventure in a mysterious world.

title: Crystal Keepers
description: Face hordes in intense battles, unlock abilities, and combine items to create unique builds. Play solo or with up to 3 friends, discover powerful synergies, and survive the insane waves. Evolve your strategy, defeat bosses, and become a true Guardian of the Crystals!

title: Matrix Bro
description: Matrix Bro is an arcade-style rougelite battle game where you control a team made up of multiple brothers to defeat all enemies that block their continuous evolution. Of course, this is only possible if your team can survive the relentless onslaught of enemies that keep appearing...

title: Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes
description: Have you ever heard of the damn Green Record? Or maybe the Black Sheet is trying to kill you at night? Have you ever seen a Blue Nail in a pie? The visual novel "Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes" is the first of five planned games in the entourage of Soviet children's horror stories, where everything happens for real. The story tells about a girl named Dasha from 4th grade, who disobeyed her mother and listened to a green record. Together with her, you will face a mysterious and terrible evil, and only you can decide what awaits her in the end ^___^

title: Luxury Supermarket Simulator
description: Step into the world of high-end retail with Luxury Supermarket Simulator! Manage your very own luxurious supermarket. Customize your store with furniture.

title: Don’t Lose Your Ship
description: Step aboard your starship and prepare for an intergalactic showdown in Don't Lose Your Ship, a fast-paced, team-based 2D multiplayer game that combines strategy, coordination, and chaos. This game pits two teams against each other in a battle for supremacy on a grid-based map.

title: Odra Online
description: Meet Odra Online - a completely new multiplayer turn-based strategy game created in the Gothic fantasy style, which carries the spirit of the best games of its genre. Immerse yourself in a fantasy world with atmospheric graphics and exclusive game mechanics.

title: The Mindvasion
description: What's more frustrating than watching an army of monsters fail to wipe out humanity? Take control of a minion and turn the tide in a roguelite survival game. Just died? No problem—another creature is ready to be possessed. Keep the carnage going and make sure humanity meets its end!

title: Sea Scraps
description: After a catastrophic event flooded the Earth, the remnants of humanity are left adrift on an endless ocean. With nothing but scraps of the old world floating across the waves, survivors must scavenge, build, and fight to stay alive in this vast water-covered wasteland.

title: MosGhost
description: Having moved to Moscow, Andrei rents a cheap apartment in an old Soviet house. After a while, he notices strange things happening in the dark. It seems that the landlady has left unsaid something....

title: Next Player
description: Next Player is a first-person psychological horror experience that starts as an ordinary platformer and drags you into a tension-filled nightmare.

title: The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood
description: He is back. Once again take control of mass serial killer John Wade. Six years later, the infamous Pale Grin resurrects from the grave to terrorize the broken town of Happyhills. This time he has more on his mind than simple killing.

title: Before the Ash
description: A strategy city-builder with cards and hexagonal tiles, about developing a city next to Vesuvius - the volcano that ended ancient Pompeii.

title: Just the Boss Fights
description: A classic 2D platformer RPG with a twist: the game skips all the story, dialogue, exploration, and grind, leaving only the bosses themselves! Unfortunately, our hero wasn't quite prepared for this shift into a boss rush, and finds himself confused at every turn.

title: Huntsman
description: Trapped inside a spider-infested research facility, Huntsman immerses you in a survival horror experience fueled by arachnophobia. Combining realistic spider behavior with intense tension, Huntsman will test your nerve like never before.

title: Magic Soldier
description:
Embark on an epic journey in Magic Soldier, a 2D open-world MMORPG.
Explore vast landscapes, fight powerful foes, craft unique items, and team up with players worldwide. Adventure awaits, shape your destiny today !

title: Haunted Hues
description: Travel to the world of Amille as Larue, an eager art curator looking to make a name for themselves. Build your reputation by talking with collectors and locals, and explore the ever-expanding gallery as you buy more artwork. But beware, as every choice matters when day turns to night...

title: Tunguska 2: Whitefall
description: Venture deeper into the vast Tunguska Exclusion Zone. Challenge deadlier mutants and heavily-armed Predators. Survive the perils of extreme cold and other-worldly beings. Get ready to embark on a journey searching for dark secrets and a life beyond.

title: Magicbook AutoBattler: Contract
description: This is a brand - new strategic auto - chess game that integrates RPG and roguelike elements. In the world of the Grimoire, players can freely create combinations and indulge in endless battles.

title: Maiden and Lord
description: "Maiden And Lord" is a relatively casual strategy war game that emphasizes player cooperation and the development of civilizations. It introduces innovative mechanisms such as "Private Territory" and "Safe Gathering," creating a prosperous and harmonious otherworldly realm.

title: Puttler
description: Puttler is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 13 courses and over 200 unique holes to solve.

title: Yume 5
description: n the game, you will play the heroine Chen Xi, and control her actions through the WASD keys, while her past life memories act in the opposite direction.cleverly avoid various obstacles, solve the puzzles of the complex maze, and finally find the way to the exit!

title: Ratio (Rat Patio)
description: You're just a humble rat. Use your trusty ratling gun turret to dispatch the onslaught of aliens and defend your ratio (rat patio)!

title: Cartagra
description: An all-ages port of Cartagra: Tsuki Kurui no Yamai - Rebirth FHD Size Edition, with English and Simplified Chinese support. It will also have new CGs made specially for this version.

title: Rig Riot
description: A fast-paced third-person mech-action roguelike

title: Immortal Boy
description: A 2.5D turn-based RPG where you dodge through enemy turns - and emotional abuse.

title: Ukrainian Shield: Iraq
description: Take command in a realistic RTS strategy highlighting Ukraine's peacekeeping mission in Iraq. Lead your forces, call in powerful support, and complete a series of unique missions.

title: Three Sisters
description: Three Sisters is a goofy RPG featuring some cute little (not nightmare inducing) enemies and a story where nothing bad ever happens! Wait, what's that? You played the other games? crap.

title: River of Time Yarn
description: Fixed-value RPG games, also similar to Evil spirit tower. Release different skills to restrain enemies. Observe the distribution of enemies, doors, and items on the map to find the appropriate route. The game has a rich story and four different difficulty levels.

title: Etherburn
description: Etherburn is a Souls-like action-adventure. Play as a hero resurrected in a mysterious and interconnected dungeon. Explore and face intense duels as you fight your way to freedom.

title: Stars of the Valkyrie
description: Endless runner action has never been more dynamic with a unique 3D movement system. Fly through the stars in this Neo-Arcade game as you dodge asteroids shoot down enemies ships and protect transport ships. When you have finished upload and compare your score against the best from around the world.

title: Mordar Warrior
description: third person action rpg game where player mission is to kill enemy waves and survive enough long.

title: Star Dream Journey
description: Star Dream Trajectory - Chinese Style Agent "is a celebrity development interactive game. As a new agent in a celebrity artist agency, you will encounter four artists with different personalities that you will be responsible for in your career, and cultivate them into legends in the industry

title: Simple Clicker
description: Simple Clicker is a satisfying idle clicker where every tap earns you valuable resources! Gather materials, sell them for coins, and upgrade your production to maximize profits

title: CrimSaw
description: A small, fast-paced, and deadly arena FPS with a ‘spin’. You can’t jump and are only armed with a badass weapon. Charge, launch and recall your sawblade to slice up endless hordes of demons into pieces. Survive as long as you can and climb up the global leaderboard.

title: Banan'em Up!
description: A tiny challenging arcade shoot’em up where you shoot down quirky aliens to save your planet. Evade bullets, shoot enemies, get upgrades, survive through challenging waves to defeat the final boss, "The Monke".

title: Skyrift: Aratirí
description:
Skyrift: Aratirí is a racing game from Paraguay where players can enjoy the first digital rally championship, although it will also feature other competitive modes.

The game also features a social network called SKYLINK where users can share their profiles, their customized cars, posts, make friends, and share news and memes.

title: Battle AirForce
description: Three years after Battle Marine a new battle is about to begin! Battle AirForce is the first orthodox style vertical scrolling bullet hell STG since NOKOGI Rider by SUZUKI PLAN. It was created in Z80 full assembly language, aiming at a level close to the limit of VGS-Zero.

title: The Sixth Sorrow
description: Things haven't felt right since the accident. Your mother's passive aggression, your father's refusal to speak, and strange things around the house... Are they unable to move on, or is something even more sinister lurking beneath the surface?

title: Forest Smasher
description: "Forest Smasher" is an exploration and looter-based TPS Rougelike game that focuses on "shooting & explosion". In randomly generated maze, you can destroy all obstacles and enemies you can see, with fast-paced battles, easy-to-use operations, and a amazing system of weapons and items.

title: Orbital Nexus
description: Start on a barren planet, expand your empire through resource management, fleet building, and planetary conquest. Discover cosmic relics, trade or fight with neutral factions, and build galactic wonders like particle colliders. Balance strategy, exploration, and combat to dominate the galaxy!

title: Legendary Heroes Survivors
description: Slay thousands of monsters and survive until you defeat the ultimate boss. Legendary Heroes Survivors is a rogue-lite game where your character development choices will help you quickly overcome hundreds of monsters that attack you, reach the boss, and defeat it.

title: Aerial Lockdown
description: Aerial Lockdown, an Arcade game where you'll navigate your airplane over a factory-filled city. Destroy them! Blow them to pieces! But avoid the mines in the sky. Now fly my friend, and make Davie Bones proud!

title: Dorsaka
description: A strange exploration game with an ever decreasing health bar. Take control of your weird alien space bunny and traverse a set of inter-linked mazes in a quest to escape a desert that may or may not exist in multiple dimensions within your own mind. Manage your health, find secrets, escape the maze

title: Shut the Windows and Don't Look Outside
description: Recent disturbances and abnormal phenomena have been detected in your area. For your safety and well-being, all individuals must remain inside their homes. Under no circumstances should you look outside. Keep all doors locked and windows shut. It is required by all citizens to be afraid. The Angel will come.

title: Tri Bogatyrya i Shamakhanskaya Tsaritsa
description: How Not to Rescue a Princess is a quest and Point-and-click game based on the cartoon of the same name. Unlike previous games, this game has its own storyline that has nothing to do with the cartoon. In addition, this is the latest game in the franchise in the quest genre.

title: Powerstation 17
description: Pick up the crowbar of research scientist Gordon Freeman, who finds himself on an alien-infested Earth being picked to the bone, its resources depleted, its populace dwindling. Freeman is thrust into the unenviable role of rescuing the world from the wrong he unleashed back at Black Mesa. And a lot of people, people he cares about, are counting on him.

title: Clickoin
description: Welcome to Clickoin, an addictive clicker game where every coin click unlocks unique skins that alter gameplay. Enjoy free drops and additional activities as you progress using clever in-game mechanics.

title: Rules & Rodents
description: A puzzling adventure where you abuse the rules set by your rat captors. Manipulate enemies and environments with the commanding power of rules to escape.

title: Deadly Rails
description: Fight your way through the horde of undead and reach your goal. The only limits are your wits and determination.

title: Lord of the Wilds
description: A strategy game where you build and defend your territory in a wild land. Gather resources, train armies, and face threats from rival lords, orcs, and undead.

title: BackRooms X
description:
BackRooms X is a game that combines all quality backrooms games into one.
The game features many levels where you will have to avoid strange creatures and solve puzzles. The gameplay is full of exploration and survival elements, where every detail matters.

title: Absinthe
description: A game where you just walk around the room.

title: Jurard Run
description: A short side-scroller shooter game featuring Jurard T Rexford of holostars! Fight against corruption beasts and 4 other holostars members in this simple boss-rush game!

title: Ultranatural
description: Ultranatural is a fast-paced PvP arena shooter where skill and speed rule. Battle friends on one finely crafted map with a single versatile weapon. Easy server hosting makes it simple to jump into intense duels or team skirmishes. Pure, straightforward competition awaits!

title: Moss: Becoming Human
description: MOSS Becoming Human is an AI science game where players develop and deploy AI agents to build a Martian civilization. Customize, evolve, and test AI in various modes, shaping diverse outcomes. Agents can also interact with the real world, including social platforms like X.

title: Dreamscape Highschool: After Stories
description: This story takes place where "Dreamscape Highschool" left off.

title: Unwelcome Guest
description: You find yourself in a house that the owners have long since abandoned. But something lurks in the shadows, watching your every move. Explore the rooms, solve the mysteries, and find a way to banish the evil... Before it gets to you.

title: All Aboard! The Train Defense Express
description: Protect the Infinite Power Generator by looping around the train tracks! Battle endless waves of enemies in this unique hybrid of auto-battler, survivor, tower defense, idle/clicker gameplay. How long can you survive?

title: Kipidon: We Will Always Love You
description: A colorful shooter that uses a flower as a cupid's arrow. Shoot as many people as you can before time runs out!

title: Boeckham's Football Manager
description: An old-school football manager in the style of the management games of the 90s. Lead your team through the seasons, shaped by dynamic story events. Develop your club and yourself to gain reputation and conquer your league and the world.

title: Chill Fishing
description: Chill Fishing is the ultimate laid-back desktop fishing experience!

title: Warbot Engineer
description: This is an exhilarating bullet-hell shooting game.

title: Bibi Bunny
description: ​Bibi wakes up in an unknown place with messages from an unknown individual. This place seems unsafe, and Bibi must keep herself safe as she explores this seemingly abandoned place to find her brother.

title: Mini Drift Car: All Cars Key
description: All Cars Key

title: Baki Hanma: Blood Arena
description: Enter the brutal world of Baki Hanma: Blood Arena, a thrilling 2D action game inspired by the Netflix anime phenomenon Baki. With gameplay reminiscent of the classic Super Punch-Out!!, this game blends precision, timing, and shonen-style flair to deliver a high-energy combat experience.

title: Coffinman
description: Transported to a nightmarish world, your only goal is to survive until dawn while avoiding terrifying creatures, including the terrifying, Coffinman. Conserve your energy by turning off lights on each floor, but beware—running out of power could mean your end.

title: Mysteries of the Forbidden Forest
description: Mysteries of the Forbidden Forest is a pixel art game inspired by the greatest platformer classics of the '90s. Join our protagonist on a perilous journey with a single goal: to uncover the secrets hidden within the mysterious castle.

title: Call From the Darkness
description: Enter this first-person shooter with dark and realistic scenarios, use your shooting skills to kill all the enemies and survive. Explore the scenario and collect all the resources you can because you will need them to get out alive.

title: Letters of Bernard Thorne
description: 『Letters of Bernard Thorne』 is a story-driven psychological horror game about trauma. Take a seat in Bernard's motorized wheelchair. Roam around the old man's house. Discover his scarred past. Flee from his sins. Climb up the attic.

title: Hydra Hide Land
description: Hydra Hyde Land is a deck-building rogue-lite game. The player must defeat a “certain demon” in order to break the curse placed on the girl who saved his life.

title: Help! I've Been Cursed With A Bubble Butt
description:
A game about self-acceptance and big butts.

Take control of a bountifully cursed enby protagonist as they navigate a world filled with peril and problems as they search for purpose and self-love.

Make impactful choices and guide our cheeked up hero to save the world... and themselves. Three endings, 2,400 words.

*This game contains at least 80% butt puns.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Steampunk Stories
description: This DLC includes two steampunk themed tables: "Silent Streets", "Steampunk City" and some accessories.

title: Welcome to Primrose Lake 4
description: Welcome to Primrose Lake, the charming Rocky Mountain town that's captivated folks around the world! If you're a fan of the previous games in the series, you're in for a real treat with the fourth installment of the fan-favorite Time Management game created by SQRT3.

title: Welcome to Primrose Lake 3
description: Enjoy Primrose Lake 3 in its classic Time Management game takes you down the twisty lane of mysteries, murders, and romances.

title: Welcome to Primrose Lake 5
description: Are you ready to unravel the mysteries of Primrose Lake and embark on the final journey of the Welcome to Primrose Lake series by SQRT? Brace yourself for a nail-biting and action-packed conclusion that will leave you spellbound!

title: I Love Math
description: Mastering math becomes fun-and-games as you travel back to the ancient worlds of Atlantis, Greece, Egypt and the Aztecs. The intelligent tracking system automatically responds to your child's progress by topic so kids move ahead when they excel and get extra practice when they need it. All the lessons and problems in I Love Math are based on core curriculum topics which means it matches what kids are learning in school. With over 250 topics I Love Math! covers 4 grade levels to target your child's individual problem areas. Plus, over 6,000 help pop-ups provide extra reinforcement!

title: Last Hit Titan
description: Strategically place turrets and build defenses to maximize your firepower against colossal Titans! Experiment with different setups, optimize your battlefield, and take down legendary creatures with the most efficient tactics. Every decision counts in this unique tower defense experience!

title: Operation Eventide
description: Adelle, a former magical girl, wakes up in a robotic body. Still picking up the pieces after her untimely demise, she seeks the truth of her new life. Experience as this 'love song' resounds in the rift of magic and logic in this nostalgic, thrilling yuri sci-fi visual novel.

title: Frontier Force Vanguard
description: A strategy game focused on combat, with elements of tower defense and RPG infused into it. Lead a small team to conquer new lands, gather resources, and use them in the next campaign.

title: Frogstool
description: An 8-bit action platformer where you play as a frog. Use your tongue to fight monsters, defeat challenging bosses, and explore dangerous medieval landscapes.

title: Jinchou
description: A block-pushing puzzler set to atmospheric, eerily beautiful lo-fi tunes. Make your way through hundreds of challenging levels through different terrains. Each terrain granting special abilities, improving on the basic idea of block-pushing.

title: Prismatic: Nox's Gate
description: Hunt for Prismatic Gems and improve your team while getting embroiled in the complex situation of the Galactic Animal Kingdom. Prismatic is a retro turn-based tactical RPG with full voice acting, open world elements, and team battles.

title: I'm Truely a Good Guy!
description: Welcome to Cattlehorse Corp, where deadlines are tight, and backstabbing is tighter! Complete tasks, expose traitors, and suck up to management—just make sure you survive. Use wacky gadgets, bluff, and betray to climb the corporate ladder. In this office, only survivors get promotions!

title: No Time to Build
description: No Time to Build is a cooperative casual game with parkour and action elements! Collect logs, avoid cars, trains, and walking bombs, overcome challenges, and build structures within the time limit. Teleports, speed-boosting bushes, and player interactions make every game chaotic and fun!

title: Mansion of the Dead
description: Step into the shoes of Agent Kim, drawn into a chilling mystery deep in the wilderness. Find hidden clues, solve intricate puzzles, and outsmart the relentless zombies that roam the estate. Will you make it out alive, or will you too vanish without a trace?

title: Spellloom
description: spellloom is a roguelike bullet-hell dungeon crawler with deep spell-building. Play as a Spellweaver—an intrepid QA tester employed by a cynical Dungeon Architect—and brave his chaotic creation. Prepare for fierce Combat, creative Spell Crafting, and perilous Exploration in the ever-shifting Void.

title: The Forgotten Village
description: The Forgotten Village is a Fantasy Simulation RPG. Arrive in a rundown Village with nothing but the shirt on your back. Clear the land, Gather Resources, Help the Villagers and Earn new Tools to aid you in restoring the Forgotten Village back to its former Glory!

title: Renai Bakudan
description:
Having just dealt with the roughest time in her life, Juri Kido's luck is finally turning around. At the invitation of her best friend, Juri moves to the small, coastal town of Akiyama; leaving behind the big city of Tokyo for good. But what Juri doesn’t know is just what kind of place this cozy locale really is...

Because Akiyama is not only home to a massive red-light district, but also houses the biggest, hottest, and weirdest love hotel in the world; HOTEL BAKUDAN!

After meeting seven beautiful ladies and scoring a job at the hotel, Juri knows that this is the golden opportunity she's been searching for. With so much sex, drama and romance at every turn, Juri has no doubt that living in Akiyama is going to change her life. Just what awaits her on these sunny shores?

Welcome to HOTEL BAKUDAN. We hope you enjoy your stay!

title: Jeff the Janitor
description: Jeff the Janitor is a co-op survival horror game for up to 1-5 players. Sneak into the mall at night for a heist, but beware - Jeff, the night-shift janitor, is on watch! Complete your shopping list, and make your escape.

title: Plenty of Fish in the Sea
description: Plenty of Fish in the Sea is a cozy narrative-driven dating sim where you engage in heartfelt conversations with charming salmon and take them on delightful underwater dates.

title: Hacking The Moon to Find My Goddess
description: Kaito Shiromae is a young man with a gift for hacking, but when he hacks into Central-AI—a system that supervises countless AIs around the world—and asks it to find him his soulmate, he ends up with an unexpected surprise.

title: Devil's Derby
description: Devil's Derby is a fast-paced first person shooter on skates, where you fight endless hordes of demons as you use advance movement techniques to shoot, skate, and slide your way around a singular arena to compete for high score.

title: Galacticare: The Voice Beyond
description: The galaxy burns. The wounded are piling up. The CABAL wants to exterminate all life, and Galacticare finds itself on the front lines. Galacticare: The Voice Beyond is an expansion for cult sci-fi hospital sim Galacticare, bringing new threats, and a galaxy-shaking conspiracy.

title: The Black Ice
description: In a remote and mysterious research facility in Antarctica, an intense atmosphere of fear and death hangs in the air. In horror "The Black Ice", players find themselves exploring this haunting place alone, solving puzzles and fighting to stay alive as they face the chilling unknown.

title: Spalg
description: SPALG is a runner in 3-dimensional space, where you jump and turn around the tube, and your goal is to reach the finish without touching any spikes. Dodge obstacles. jumps on platforms. customize your character and create user-made levels

title: The Bright Path
description: "The bright path" is a 30 minutes long educational interactive computer game for Windows which you can use to familiarize yourselves or your students with the topics of dangers of drug abuse and active citizenships in your communities.

title: Find All: Bunker
description: Explore the underground bunker and the surface of the earth in anticipation of a nuclear explosion, finding various items and painting the black and white picture with colored inks.

title: Time Enforcers
description: Save history before it’s erased! Join the Galactic Space-Time Continuum and battle Chronolith’s minions in this action-packed RPG and interactive digital comic. Travel through time, solve puzzles, and restore history in an educational adventure for kids and the young at heart.

title: Pocket Thief
description: Slide your way to becoming a master thief, as you steal from the rich, and keep a little something for yourself; in this criminally fun 2D puzzle game. Navigate barriers and drag other obstructions thoughtfully away until you can successfully guide the loot out of each maze-like level.

title: Sheeple
description: The Sheeple are moving, and they won't stop for anything. Not walls, not traps, and definitely not common sense. In this chaotic puzzle-platformer, you don't control the player, you control the world.

title: Retro GameShop Simulator
description: Build and manage your dream retro video game store! Buy, sell, and stock games, consoles, and collectibles. Set your own prices, hire staff, and expand your shop to become the ultimate gaming destination.

title: Touhou Chouhatsuyou: Burgeoning Tresses of Longevity
description: A mysterious scent has caused everyone's hair to grow haywire...

title: Scarlet Enigma
description: Investigate a chilling birthday murder in a branching mystery filled with secrets, suspects, and puzzles. Uncover the truth, bend time, and stop the killer before reality begins to unravel.

title: Adventurous Slime
description: Adventurous Slime is a mini metroidvania about a small but very courageous slime going on an adventure. Featuring a magical world full of dangerous creatures and powerful ancient items to find, colorful pixelated visuals and chiptune songs.

title: Manicos Haunted Hotel
description: Manicos Haunted Hotel is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a haunted hotel which was built on an old burial ground during the 1950s.

title: The Junkyard
description: Explore a network of tunnels that lead to several different rooms. There are various creatures to frighten and hinder you, which grow stronger and more numerous. Defeat bosses. Experience the dramatic and mysterious plot of the life of Joseph, the main character, but be careful not to go mad...

title: Hello User!
description: Recruiting players to save the crisis in the internet world! Those who are good at hacking and puzzles, those who enjoy Indie games in the abyss. Preferential treatment for those interested in darknet AIs that have never been there.

title: Kutha Stroom Rush
description: An electric-grid simulator game. Plan, build, and maintain your growing city's electric needs. Keep all of your electric grid users satisfied, watch your existing grid infrastructure, and build out to serve new users.

title: Impossible Moto Sim
description:
Impossible Moto Sim – Conquer the Sky on Two Wheels!

Welcome to the ultimate challenge for those who live and breathe motorcycles! This is not just a race—it’s a battle against gravity, speed, and fear itself. Imagine tearing through high-altitude tracks suspended 3,000 meters above sea level, with no barriers to save you. Every turn is a test of precision, every jump is a leap of faith, and every second pushes your adrenaline to the max.

title: 101 Cats in Shenzhen
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Shenzhen landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Cancun
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Cancun landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Zombie Town Breakout
description: Zombie Town Breakout is a top-down survival action game set in a zombie-infested ruined town. Scavenge for weapons, recruit survivors with unique abilities, assemble your team, explore the ruins, defend your stronghold, and fight for survival!

title: Bill Wants to Retire
description: By day a cozy farming sim, by night a doom like boomer shooter. Farm, gather resources, and craft powerful weapons because when night comes so do the wolves. Can you protect your chickens and make it to retirement?

title: Find Kittens 3: Steampunk
description: Explore this amazing steampunk world finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: 33 kvadratnykh metra: Voyna s sosedyami
description:
An arcade computer game developed by the Ukrainian studio Jam-Games and published by Novy Disk in 2007. It is based on the TV series of the same name.

The player takes on the role of each of four family members as they visit retribution upon the very inhospitable locals in their new town. Each character infiltrates the home or workplace of a target, using a point-and-click interface to stage elaborate pranks using improvised materials found in the battle zone. Well-executed pranks can be replayed at dramatic camera angles, optimizing the humiliation of the target. Timing and stealth are crucial to set up your opponents downfall, as the player must remain out of the enemies' field of vision to avoid getting caught. All stages can be replayed at the players' leisure to achieve better times.

title: Murder in Crayontopia
description: Grab your crayons and delve into the world of Crayontopia in this murder mystery visual novel. Become an adept or inept detective as you gather evidence, get to know your fellow crayon-lovers, and seek to uncover the colorful secrets behind the murders that plague this seemingly perfect world.

title: Witch Hazel
description: An enticingly cozy, witch themed gardening simulator. immerse yourself in the joy and whimsy of tending to your magical garden. Develop your powers, grow magical plants, and maybe even find your own witchy animal companion!

title: Button Prison
description: You find yourself trapped in a mysterious room upon awakening. Surrounding you are sparse pieces of furniture, mannequins, and countless buttons. Can you safely escape this room?

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Steam Ships
description: Step aboard three legendary steamships that have survived wars, luxury cruises and technological experiments. Each one has a unique story to tell - from a relief ship, through an ambitious aircraft carrier project, to the most iconic passenger ship!

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Floating Cities
description: Set sail for new horizons with the Floating Cities DLC - this time, the challenge takes place on luxurious passenger ships that offer more than just scrap - they hold hidden treasures waiting to be uncovered!

title: Rinny Platformer Rage Game
description: Rinny Platformer Rage Game is an indie shitpost game developed by santu1423 about Rinny, a character from Pretty Blood, gaining brain damage.

title: Let's Build Wonders: Galaxy — Star Trade Chamber Pass
description: Join the Star Trade Organization, get the "Star Trade Chamber Pass" to become a member of the organization, enhance interstellar navigation and resource exchange with the Chamber.

title: Miner Hoversurf 2 Multiplayer Madness
description: Have fun with your friends in this epic adventure, a 3D crazy hoversurf race to be the best in the world.

title: Cafe on the moon
description: “Cafe on the Moon” is a simulation management game and a visual novel. In this game, you step into the role of a new Cafe owner on the desolate Moon, where your mission is to create a variety of desserts. As you progress, you'll uncover the mysterious secrets hidden beneath the tranquil moonlight.

title: Minecraft: A Minecraft Movie DLC
description: Adventure deeper into A MINECRAFT MOVIE! Compete in elytra races, survive the night, and sneak into a woodland mansion in this free DLC.

title: Parkour Challenger
description: In Parkour Challenger, there is no storyline. The goal is simply to complete each parkour. Note that the word 'simply' is to be ignored. Good luck!

title: Cooking with Magic
description: Cooking with Magic is a chaotic and fun cooperative game where players take on the role of witches and wizards working together in a magical kitchen.

title: Skvears
description: Skvears is a short, casual single-player adventure RPG.

title: Personal Murder Theater: Strangled Roots
description: Immerse yourself in this grotesque visual novel. Unspeakable secrets, sinister crimes, and a macabre obsession weave this tale, where sanity crumbles beneath the tide of perversion and human cruelty. The first chapter in a new independent anthology of visual novels.

title: Couple Maker
description: This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female.

title: This is the last time
description: This is the Last Time is a minimalist first-person narrative game with a dark and heavy atmosphere.

title: Phantom Relics
description: Phantom Relics is an isometric action slasher with roguelike elements. Explore ancient catacombs, battle hordes of darkness, and find powerful relics. Face the challenges solo or team up with a friend in local co-op to stop the awakening of evil.

title: Get a Midnight Snack without Mom Knowing
description: Find delicious food in the dark kitchen. But you have to move as carefully as possible. My mom may wake up.

title: 3 Bullets
description: features: explore massive areas from a expansive city to an abandoned train yard. save your ammo, bullets are more precious than gold in this world. use unique weapons, from an emp that disables enemies to a full on rocket launcher. sneak past randomly generated enemy camps.

title: Doomer Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in the bleak world of a doomer, lost within the gray walls of a post-Soviet Khrushchyovka. Work, bad habits, and endless self-reflection define his reality

title: Distant Worlds 2: Factions - Atuuk and Wekkarus
description: The Galaxy Expands. The fourth Distant Worlds 2 expansion brings two new playable factions – the naive and energetic Atuuk and the mysterious Wekkarus.

title: Meowland: Island Farm
description: MeowLand: Island Farm – a cozy farming simulator! Build a farm on a cat island, grow crops, water fields, and sell goods and complete orders. Earn coins to buy the island! ️

title: Bolsheviktion 3D
description: Russia, 1918. Bolsheviks are in power. Imprisoned on suspicion of being a spy, you plan to bust out and save the Tsar and his family from certain death. BOLSHEVIKTION 3D is an old-school FPS: an alternate reality Wolf3D. Upgrade weapons, collect royal treasure and blast your way to Ipatiev House.

title: Slowly Sliding Ducks
description: Stay afloat and navigate challenging waterpark rides against up to 16 online players. Spray water, slide, score, and aim to become the pool's most distinguished duck!

title: Jumpscare Simulator
description: Welcome to your childhood trauma! Inspired by Scary Woman Jumpscare, this experience features retro graphics and sudden horror elements across three game modes. Pass through doors carefully and battle the simulation while trying not to fall from your seat too much.

title: MultiMino 2: Polyform
description: Multimino 2 is a block falling game that tries to extend the Tetris Guideline to multiple piece sets made out of different polygons, with multiple quality of life additions to provide a smooth gameplay experience. Along the usual Polyominoes , there's the option to play with Polyhexes and Polyiamonds.

title: BubbleByte
description:
BubbleByte is a whimsical incremental clicker/idle hybrid with tower defense elements. Players start as a lone bubble-popper and gradually build a cat army to automate their bubble-popping empire.

The core gameplay loop involves popping bubbles to earn cash, recruiting quirky cats with unique abilities, investing in upgrades, exploring to discover rare cats, and ascending to gain permanent upgrades.

Players can choose between a relaxed idle playstyle where their cat army handles everything or an active clicker approach chasing high combos. The game features various cat types (Unicats, Devilcats, etc.) with distinct abilities and synergies, an expandable map, over 400 achievements, and multiple prestige mechanics that provide meaningful progression.

title: DanganRonpa: It's Showtime!
description: Danganronpa: IT'S SHOWTIME! is an in-progress English fan game created by American developer AquariusBat. The game currently contains a prologue and three completed chapters.

title: GravShift
description: An arcade style precision platformer where you Invert gravity and jump to work your way through a gauntlet of hazards, collecting coins and big bonuses.

title: Thrae
description: Thrae is a cozy crafting adventure game, where you play as a bunny on their path to become the Legendary Easter Bunny! Build relationships, Craft, Decorate & Deliver Enchanted eggs to heal your friends of the forest!

title: Danganronpa Z: Patient Madness Cropper
description: A Danganronpa fangame that is set in a hospital. 15 students are trapped in a hospital with a psychotic bear named Monokuma, the only way to get out is by getting away with murder. This fangame was completed up to chapter 4 daily life, and has since been cancelled.

title: Dere Quartet
description: A funny story about four cute girls. Join their class and have a good time with this relaxing game!

title: Song of Feathers
description: 《Song of Feathers》 is a deeply immersive post apocalyptic survival adventure game. In this world shrouded in the shadow of the apocalypse, Players will play as the last human in this desperate land, searching for the meaning of survival and the opportunity to rebuild civilization.

title: Boutique Builder Simulator
description: Build your dream clothing store in Boutique Builder Simulator! Design layouts, stock trendy clothing, manage inventory, and satisfy quirky customers. Unlock upgrades, expand your shop, and create the ultimate shopping experience. Can you become the top boutique boss? Play now!

title: Just Anomalies
description: A slow-burning psychological horror where the fear comes not from monsters, but from the unknown. Each step leads you back to the same room—familiar, yet subtly wrong. The silence weighs heavy, the air feels off, and the deeper you stare, the stronger the sense that something is staring back.

title: Bite-Sized Scares
description: Bite-Sized Scares is a small collection of short, retro, indie horror games; created by Aaron Wise & D. Zenith. Strap in, grab some snacks and get ready for some spooks!

title: Travel to Brazil
description: The Hudson family is ready for their next adventure! Join them as discover the wonders of amazing Brazil! On this journey, you’ll explore beautiful locations in Latin America as you solve a variety of challenging puzzles.

title: Royal Defense: Ancient Menace
description: The dwarven kingdom struggles against the Ancient Menace, who only wants to crush the dwarves and claim their territory. To defeat the monstrous hordes, you must construct defensive towers and units and learn to wield powerful spells.

title: Demon Knives
description: Survive waves of demons and collect their gems to level up. Compete against your friends for the #1 spot on the leaderboard. Or conquer the worldwide charts.

title: Travel to India
description: The Hudson family is ready for their next adventure and you’re invited. This time, explore beautiful India, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve challenging mini-games while visiting iconic locations.

title: Makai Agito
description: First-Person RPG Dungeon Crawler set in the modern day. A group of adults must use the powers of supernatural beings from various folklore and mythologies to save a town from an ancient curse.

title: Malice Within
description: An atmospheric horror quest in the style of Resident Evil, in which the player will have to escape from the mansion, exploring locations, finding keys, notes and weapons, and fighting monsters.

title: Downward Spear
description: Downward Spear is a single player isometric tactical action game with stealth and horror elements. The ice caps have melted causing flooding of most coastal land, and released ancient viruses that consume their hosts.

title: Travel to Germany
description: Get ready to celebrate Christmas in Germany with the Hudson family. Experience the most wonderful time of the year in one of the most incredible places in Europe.

title: SCP: November 2010
description: It's November 2010. You find yourself lost in a forest rumored to be home to SCP-173, a deadly and unrelenting entity. With only a flashlight, you must search for hidden plushies while staying one step ahead of your stalker. Can you keep it in your sights long enough to escape the nightmare?

title: Travel to England
description: The Hudson family vacation turns into a much more expansive tour of Europe when their flight departure is changed from France to London. Why not take this opportunity to enjoy the historic sights of England? No planes necessary - just a quick ride through the Chunnel and all the sights and sounds of England will be at your fingertips.

title: Travel to USA
description: After an exciting visit to Europe, the Hudson family is back home. But Jennifer met a new friend on the plane, and Mark invited the family to join him on a trip around the United States. Join Mark and the Hudson's on their new adventure; find hidden objects and solve challenging puzzles.

title: Travel to Italy
description: Experience the beauties of Italy, with its magnificent architecture and works of the great masters in this uplifting hidden object adventure! Join a happy family on this exciting trip as they celebrate a wedding anniversary in one of the most beautiful places in the world.

title: Travel to Japan
description: After their US tour, the Hudson family is headed for faraway Japan. Join them on their latest adventure and help find over 1000 hidden objects while visiting incredible locations.

title: Fire Emblem Fates: V.O.W Edition
description: A mod for Fire Emblem Fates. This mod alters the base story of Fates while also adding a wealth of new characters from other media each with their own classes to change up the game.

title: The Far Kingdoms: Spooky Mosiacs
description: You need to prepare your Kingdom for a spooky celebration. Solve puzzles to find gold coins and buy decorations. Solve all the puzzles and find the missing Dracula costume for the Elven Prince.

title: 101 Cats in London
description: 101 Cats Hidden in London challenges you to find hidden kitties in a beautiful hand-crafted landscape.

title: 101 Cats in Milan
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Milan landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in New York
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted New York landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Paris
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Paris landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Vienna
description: 101 Cats Hidden in Vienna challenges you to find hidden kitties in a beautiful hand-crafted landscape.

title: 3D Puzzle: Apocalyptic Wasteland
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.
Three dimensional grid turn-based strategy game. Combat the computer or your friends to prove your brain is less smooth than theirs.

title: Fireplace Simulator
description: Simulate your cozy fire, add logs and feed the fire to customize it to your preferred experience.

title: The Far Kingdoms: Magic Mosaics II
description: The dark magician has returned to threaten all the kingdoms. He has created an evil army that no one can resist. You must solve all the mosaic puzzles to locate the dark crystal. Only by destroying it can the dark magician be finally defeated.

title: Artifacts of Eternity
description: Return to the past in Artifacts of Eternity. Something terrible has happened - most of the artifacts collected during your last time travel journey are missing. Your grandfather needs your help again in this match 3 game.

title: 3D Puzzle: Colonial Graveyard
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Pirate Tavern
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: Kill Your Heart
description: Love becomes a curse—and you’re its reluctant matchmaker. A survival thriller RPG where you scavenge resources, solve cryptic puzzles, and battle grotesque monsters in a stylish pursuit to unite human hearts.

title: Rescue Team: Attack of the Atom - Collector's Edition
Shark Coin Party
description: Shark Party is a unique multiplayer party game focus on collecting Shark Coins and donate it to Shark King to gain its reputation.

title: Star Conqueror
description: Engage in real-time battles with customizable space warships. Explore the galaxy, forge alliances, develop powerful ships, and defeat alien invaders.

title: Garden Warfare: Crab Invasion
description: In 'Garden Warfare: Crab Invasion,' nurture your garden's central tree by collecting sunlight and water. Command Pixies to fetch water and Sun Buds to gather sunlight while defending against cunning Crabs. Can you outsmart the invaders and lead your garden to victory?

title: Color Splash: Horses
description: Color Splash: Horses is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable horses and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful horses paintings.

title: Technoblade The Quest Of L'Manburg
description: 10% of the profit of this game will be donated to Cancer Research.

title: Hexalert
description: Scifi strategy game combining turnbased strategy and tower defence Upgrade and customize your own mechs to adapt in an ever changing world!

title: Kill The Lights!
description: How many clicks does it take to Kill The Lights?!?!

title: Pseudoku
description: Sudokuesque puzzle game with variety of rules and chill ambient soundtrack.

title: Prime Mosaic
description: Can you complete the Prime Mosaic gallery? Play more than 140 beautifully hand crafted levels and unveil the gallery!

title: Library Game
description: Enter a world where books spring to life. A beautiful Journey about forgiveness and books awaits you.

title: Space Variance Authority
description: Simple rules, extreme challenge! Just move your character and loop around bubbles to clear them. Sounds easy? Don’t be fooled—no one’s conquered this game yet. Are you up to the task?

title: The Ransom of Atawallpa
description: An Adventure in Edutainment

title: Fur and Void
description: A turn-based strategy game where anthropomorphic animals engage in epic battles set in a medieval fantasy setting. In this unique tactical game, players take on the role of commanders of two competing armies, each composed of various characters with unique skills and professions.

title: Order of Renewal
description: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

title: Astro Combat
description: This is an "Arcade-style Beat 'em Up" with "Real-time Tactics" and "Action RPG" elements. Choose to engage in a rampage or opt for stealth. After the main story, explore regions, collect items, battle foes, and develop your team.

title: Infinite Blue
description: Discover an immersive ocean Eco-Sim where you can be almost any animal under the sea! From a tiny seahorse to a massive blue whale, experience the endless circle of life in a massive world of reefs, shipwrecks, and hidden wonders.

title: Pineapple Panic!
description: Have your games become bland and fruitless? Help Pina, the terrified pineapple, to dodge and leap over obstacles so that he can outwit the dastardly Chef Joe Colada in this rear-facing endless runner. Can you outpace his culinary madness, or will you end up in a fruity predicament?

title: Block Trucks Multiplayer Racing
description: SuperTrucks is a competitive, real time, ranked multiplayer racing game. Race against real opponents on challenging track surfaces, upgrade your truck and rank up as you win races.

title: The Infernal Abyss
description: Face the nightmares of the main characters and find a way out of this hell.

title: Scyla
description: Dive into the waters of Scyla, a third-person 3D exploration adventure inspired by Lovecraft's universe. Discover the mysteries hidden into the depths as you pilot a submarine through a strange cave system. Run away from a criature that stalks you.

title: Escape the Testing Facility
description: The Facility is a single player, first person escape game with physics and horror elements. Solve a variety of physics based puzzles as you try to escape the facility, while relentless being chased by the experiment gone wrong. All while the timer ticks.

title: Inhabitants
description: Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend. Uncover the mysteries of their apartment. Solve puzzles in an escape room-esque environment. All while avoiding those that have now inhabited in their absence.

title: Aracore Astromining Ventures
description:
Hailing from one of the many slum communes of Mars, a young pilot is given a chance as a mining pilot for an upcoming corporation. The chaos of unregulated mining in the outer asteroid belt has our pilot flying dangerous missions to collect precious metals, salvage debris, and explore space in order to earn enough to help their community back home. With fellow pilots, CEOs, rival corporations, and freedom fighters, everyone has their own agenda, but what path will our pilot choose?

Explore over 20 mission locations, discovering their riches and secrets. You'll find, mine, break down, and haul precious resources from asteroids into your cargo, earning commission, but will you use your pay to help your community, yourself, or something more? As you converse with your bosses, colleagues, and rival factions, you'll discover more about the world, but be wary: actions have consequences: what you do, or fail to do, in a mission will dictate future missions and the direction of the story

title: Gavin Tyler's Game Collection
description: A collection of classic games made by Gavin Tyler, now for the first time on Steam!

title: Epic Space Trader
description: Commanding a starship, you’ll trade goods across the galaxy, evade cosmic threats, and grow your trading empire. Do you have what it takes to outmaneuver rivals and become a trading legend? Take command of your destiny in Epic Space Trader, your journey to the stars begins now!

title: The Bean Trials
description: In The Bean Trials, join your friends in competing to see who is the best! Play in over 20 different minigames all while trying to top the Leaderboards! Talk in text or voice chat with other beans while you complete challenges, win to earn coins, and unlock over 100 unique items for your bean!

title: Desolate Echoes
description: Survive alone or with friends in a city where humans have vanished but zombies roam freely! Explore houses, gather resources, craft tools, and eliminate zombies. This city once belonged to humans, now it belongs to zombies, but in the future, it might belong to you and your new companions.

title: Seeds
description: Plant seeds, and reap valuable plants in this relaxing idle game. Collect rare varieties and build your virtual garden empire, then sell your bountiful harvest on the Steam Marketplace!

title: Cat Calculations
description: This game provides the fun and variety of arithmetic. Besides addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, it also helps him to increase his mental calculation speed to pass the levels. Many times, my son calculates faster than I do because he wants to pass the levels quicker.

title: Haunting Memories
description: Haunting Memories is a psychological horror, walking simulator, platforming and puzzle game. You play as a middle aged man that has made a deal with the devil and must now face the consequences. The game takes place in an old mansion with occult themes and a rich story ready to be uncovered.

title: Infinite Rebirth
description: Play games by clicking on blocks

title: Sanguinaria
description: Embark on a dark odyssey in 18th century colonial America. Control Aura, a vampire, and rescue her sister Lyra from a religious cult. Use blood-consuming skills and choose your attacks carefully in this 3D third-person top-down action game.

title: The Case of the Dark Strangler
description:
The Dark Strangler has been killing the victims of the bizarre "black lightning incident," and the cops refuse to do anything about it...

It's up to private investigator Magnum Johnson to save the day, aided by his trusty companion Gizmo!

Fly your hat around! Shoot homing missiles! Replace most of the oxygen in a room with lead! All that matters is that justice is served!

title: Dark Confrontation Chapter 1
description:
Step into a world torn apart by a generations-long war between two powerful clans: the fiery Crimson Wolves and the strategic Azure Falcons. Commanding their forces are Kael, a fearsome warrior driven by loyalty and vengeance, and Lyra, a brilliant strategist determined to protect her people at all costs.

As their armies’ clash on the battlefield, Kael and Lyra are drawn into a fateful encounter that will challenge their perceptions of loyalty, honor, and even hatred itself. Their stories intertwine in ways that could shape the fate of the war—and their own lives—in ways they never anticipated.

title: Meet Cute: Finding Love
description: Meet Cute: Finding Love is a heartfelt romance about Zak, a socially isolated man in his mid-30s who, on the advice of his therapist, begins exploring in-person activities to combat his loneliness. Despite some awkward starts, he eventually bonds with a group of fellow comic and anime fans, including Jessica, a woman who shares his love for Demon Slayer. What follows is a journey of self-discovery, as Zak learns that before he can fully open his heart to others, he must first confront his fears and embrace his own worth.

title: Meet Cute: A Sweet New Chapter
