description: Put on some of your favorite tunes and wander the twisting alleys of Kowloon. Discover bizarre and impossible alleys, teleport across great distances, and get lost in an endlessly looping maze.

title: Yandere: Love & Madness
description:
Yandere: Love & Madness is a psychological thriller and action game developed by Gemora Studios. Set in a world of intrigue and obsession, the player will take on the role of a young woman with a dangerous devotion to her beloved. With mechanics inspired by the life simulation genre, the game will offer a deep narrative experience, where the player's moral choices and actions can lead to unpredictable consequences.

Through a carefully designehttps://, Yandere: Love & Madness will combine exploration, stealth, and psychological horror elements. Players must navigate the school and its surroundings, managing social relationships while struggling with the dark side of obsession. The game will offer immersive gameplay, with intense interactions, events triggered by the protagonist's behavior, and a focus on manipulation and control.

With a unique visual style and a deep narrative that explores themes of toxic love and madness, Yandere: Love & Madness will challenge players to question how far they're willing to go for love and what the line between passion and obsession truly means.

title: Ranfren: Not Lucid
description: Fan-made visual novel for the webcomic RANFREN produced by captainhowdie

title: Spectre VR
description:
Spectre VR is a frag-fest that pays homage to the arcade classic Battlezone.

This is the second sequel to Spectre, following Spectre Supreme. New features include texture-mapped graphics and the (limited) ability to fly.

title: How a Body Sounds
description:
The stones of the town resonate at the sound of a hollow hand. The Unmake is near, the fissures dilate. Quick, new chants are needed.

How a Body Sounds is a lore-rich exploration game made with GBStudio. It can be played on GameBoy Color hardware, Analogue Pocket, GB emulators or browser.

title: Soccer Field Pro 3D
description:
Soccer Field Pro 3D is a Multiplayer Football/Soccer game that offers a dynamic and realistic football experience, allowing you to customize your own training, perform incredible dribbles, enjoy advanced physics and fully edit your player.

Play the game how you'll like. Cooperate with friends to create the perfect plays or go solo to demonstrate the beauty of your skills. Use your body to defend the goal or use your ability to attack the opponent's. Be the piece that your team needs or the X factor that changes everything.

Become a great player and start your legacy on the fields!

title: Being a DIK: Season 3
description: Continue your story, deepen your relationships, and experience more songs, mini-games, achievements, and girls in this highly anticipated DLC.

title: The Voyage Sinister
description: The Voyage Sinister it's a Gothic story with an investigative and mystery element, set in a Victorian-inspired world. While a JRPG at its core, the game is also a mixture of Visual Novel and Adventure Game.

title: Wizard Hand
description: A magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. Uncover dazzling combos and accumulate points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

title: The Spike Cross
description:
A volleyball game made by an actual volleyball club player!

"The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?"

The volleyball game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

title: The Harmony Chronicles: Cat Out of the Bag - Collector’s Edition
description: Help Mona save the kingdom old kingdom!

title: Argonauts Agency: Ares Games - Collector's Edition
Bohemian Cupid
description: A cute yaoi romcom featuring two couples!

title: Combolite
description: In this satisfying roguelike deckbuilder, every weapon you buy matters! Strategically order them to trigger powerful combos, send the enemy flying with physics-based hits, and watch your damage reach MILLIONS and above!

title: Dimwood
description: A roguelike deck builder where you venture into the Dimwood, armed with unique modal cards. Rendered in dense 1-Bit pixel art, carefully build your deck and modify your cards to balance offense and utility. Battle your way past increasingly fearsome enemies and defeat the Beast at its heart.

title: Lenin Street Geek Shop
description: Become a shopkeeper in the first geek store in a snowy 2000s town: sell CDs, snacks, and fan merch, influence your customers' lives, get involved in shady business, and grow your small store.

title: Decrypto Project
description: Our algorithm has chosen you for inclusion in the Decrypto Project. Your job is simple: we send encrypted texts, you decipher them. Loyalty and diligence will be rewarded with upgrades and customization options for your system. Disobedience and sabotage will be punished.

title: Cardness
description: Cardness is a card-based management and automation game. Build ingenious systems, optimize your resources, and command troops to face threats. Create autonomous machines and dominate a minimalist, strategic world.

title: Ferulorum
description: Strategy/simulation game/Auto-Battler - Higher mercenaries, equip them, organize them into a team and watch as they fight through the dungeon collecting loot and gold. Clear your way through 5 locations in the Kingdome so you can enter the deepest reaches of the castle and reclaim the lost relic.

title: Run Salmon Run
description: During Alaskan summers, salmon can be found swimming upstream rivers during spawning season. You are one such salmon. Can you make it to the top of the river in one piece?

title: Wicked Seed
description:
Wicked Seed is a modern-day horror RPG with tactical combat and survival horror roots.

Hybrid Combat System: Combine real-time actions like dodging and parrying with strategic turn-based attacks.

Rewarding Exploration: Discover hidden paths, solve optional puzzles, and find unique items that enhance your abilities.

Customization: 50 unlockable costumes and a variety of weapons and accessories to tailor your play style.

title: Figments of the Night
description: You wake up on a deserted island with no memory of who you are or what you're doing there. You'll have to explore its surroundings, meet its other visitors, and find clues to uncover the truth behind this mysterious place... Or you can simply relax in this paradise in the middle of the ocean and accept ignorance. Whatever you do, do it before you have to go to sleep...

title: I’ll Fuck Your Grandpa!
description: A frank visual novel for adults, where you will find yourself in the role of a young woman who finds special pleasure in sex with old men.

title: Mind Echoes: The Lost Mysteries - Collector's Edition
description: Join investigator and medium Emily Rivers as she explores the abandoned Starlight Dreams Hotel to find hidden objects and confront a malevolent force known as the Lurker!

title: Whispered Secrets: Cruise of Misfortune - Collector's Edition
description: How deep do the dark waters go?

title: Mamizou's Mimic Check
description: Touhou Project's secondary Speedy Mistake-finding game!Check for errors in the content of the changes! The speed increases when you get consecutive correct answers! Let's check if the various Touhou characters are correct!

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 10 - Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of European adventures with "Trip to Europe 10" and discover the continent from the comfort of your home!

title: Tank Trouble 3D
description: 3D sequel to classic Tank Fighting game of 2007.

title: Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi
description: Decorate your own cozy workspace! Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi combines relaxing Lo-Fi music and room decoration into one productivity game. Cute avatars and pets will keep you company, while desktop Pomodoro timers, notes, and to-do lists boost your efficiency.

title: InterImperium
description: A tower defence game with realistic graphics. Romans vs barbarians

title: MoteMancer
description: Automate across six Elemental planes, each with unique logistical tools. Infuse ingredients, craft alchemical structures, and uncover elegant solutions through experimentation - cultivating a garden of possibility, one discovery at a time.

title: Miracle Heroes: Temporal Bounty Hunter
description: Miracle Heroes is a multiplayer light rogue-like game where players must select suitable combinations from a rich arsenal of weapons and items to enhance their gear and survive in a world fraught with danger.

title: Spirit Legends: Solar Eclipse - Collector's Edition
Spirit Legends: Finding Balance - Collector's Edition
A Moderately Uncomfortable Night with Tux
description:
You have woke up in a mysterious office -- and Tux from Linux is after you.

Armed with malfunctioning doors and a laptop with a barely functional battery, you must survive to 6 AM while Tux's gang tries to taint your PC. If they fully taint it.. well, something bad will happen.

Beware Tux...

title: Cursed Covenant: The Demonic Pursuit
description:
As a rookie adventurer aiding a powerful Magi on their quest, you'll gradually uncover your own hidden past and fragmented memories. Amidst a backdrop of seduction and intrigue, you'll forge intimate connections with Magis, Demons, and Spirits.

Will you successfully aid the Magi, reclaim your lost memories, or will you be forever condemned to roam the labyrinthine corridors imbued with secrets?

title: Cellitaire
description: Solitaire meets Cellular automaton in this addictive game that requires both observation and strategy.

title: Blightborn
description:
In a dystopian future ravaged by an unstoppable blight, you play as a young scientist on the verge of discovering a cure. But just as you near a breakthrough, a series of deadly “accidents” begin to threaten your life.

Before uncovering the truth, you black out only to awaken in an underground facility. As you struggle to escape, you met... him.

title: End the Endless
description: End the Endless is a dark fantasy turn based RPG set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness unique directional based weapon systems in an oppressive environment. Utilize unique abilities, items and even your party members as a resource. Explore the Afterlife and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

title: Cartomantic
description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

title: A Tower
description: A Tower is an atmospheric adventure of exploration and self-discovery. Solve puzzles and collect artifacts in a desolate world, unraveling the mysteries of the colossal structure and your true identity.

title: BearPit
description: Experience a 'painfully human', 'psychological' narrative through dreams and allegory. Live in a flat. Buy things. Use things. Tire yourself out. Sleep. Dream. Wake up. Repeat. And maybe, just maybe, find a Bear in a Pit. What could be scarier than the Bear? Find out.

title: Blanksword
description: You’re a fallen Angel, your brain is missing and half of God’s country wants you dead (again!). Battle legions of weird monsters with your smiling sword. Find and customize a large number of skills. Rebuild your brain from scratch and rise against a tyrannical God in this turn-based roguelike RPG!

title: Murder Is Game Over: Murder Otaku
description: Play as a detective with a clue-sniffing dog partner. Solve the murder of a J-pop singer at an anime convention in a historic high-rise hotel.

title: The Revanchist
description: The Revanchist is a first person survival horror game featuring punishing combat and inventory management. Investigate a mysterious numbers station and its connection to the disappearance of a loved one. Explore depths forgotten by time, and uncover why some things should stay buried.

title: Azoth
description: Build game-breaking combos as you ascend through challenging rituals in this strategic deck builder. Master the unique card linking resource system and discover infinite procedural possibilities.

title: Hellmate
description: "HELLMATE" is a deck-building chess game where king pieces must fight through the seven floors of Hell, playing Hell Chess against the Seven Sins to purify themselves before they can ascend to the world.Prepare your deck in the most suitable way for you and escape from that damned hell.

title: Hear Tell of Hauntings
description: Deep in the mountains of wild west-era Montana, former outlaw Adelaide Clancy ventures to the desolate remains of the Wraith estate in this third-person survival horror game.

title: Fried Rice Apocalypse
description: A cooking simulation game where you serve food in an apocalyptic world while trying to survive yourself! Cook a meal for the survivors, Discover new recipe, Meet strange customers and even finding a unique zombies trying to attack you!

title: Kingdomino
description: Kingdomino is a cosy 1-4 player tile-laying strategy game of kingdom building. Place colorful dominoes, match terrains, and crown your lands to create the most prosperous realm. Simple to learn yet deeply strategic game perfect for quick sessions, solo challenges, or competitive multiplayer.

title: Nomia
description:
Nomia is a story-rich tactics roguelike where two heroes coordinate to execute brilliant skill combos.

Guide a warrior and a wizard through a mystifying tale. Harness grid-based strategy and deep deckbuilding mechanics to battle gorgeously illustrated foes. Blast monsters off cliffs, steal their cards, and sling spear and spell to reach the horizon.

title: Oreblaze
description: Dig up the Adamant Core from a procedurally generated mine, extract ores, sell them for profit, upgrade your equipment, and keep the King happy by sending him tributes before he loses his temper!

title: Keyrin Loves You
description: A section of an upcoming game, THREE VERSES³

title: Journey to Whale Fall
description: Guide a young giant isopod through the perilous deep sea chasm in his quest to reunite with his mother at the whale fall event. Defend yourself against dangerous enemies, meet new friends, and uncover the secrets of the deep sea!

title: Happy Rabbit Farm
description: A little bunny girl named Alice lost her best friend Sebastian. You need to find Sebastian and help Alice to defeat monsters.

title: Paper Mario: Great Star Offensive
description: Paper Mario: Great Star Offensive is a Paper Mario styled fangame by SEVA, it is a full-length game based on the Nintendo 64 game. Great Star Offensive plays like any traditional Paper Mario game, fight Action Command-based battles, equip Badges, buy items, and so forth. The game features new locations along with old ones.

title: Spot Zero
description: Spot Zero is a mission-driven anime action RPG where you lead a squad of Human and Yokai investigators through monster-controlled zones, securing outposts and pushing the frontline, with each character fighting in a distinct style from blade clashes to TPS mode and elemental bursts.

title: Stop the Blight
description: Stop the Blight is a tower defense roguelite with powerful spells and destructible voxel terrain. Build your defenses, reshape the land, and wield elemental power to uncover the truth behind the Blight.

title: Fantasy Trader
description: Guide your trading post in a dynamic fantasy world to riches and fame. Build relationships with visiting heroes, confront their problems and needs. Defend what's yours from the monsters, thieves and tax collectors.

title: Peacebringer
description: Peacebringer takes the addictive auto-attacking gameplay of Vampire Survivors to the next level by introducing a party system. Build and control a team of heroes, each with their own unique abilities and attack patterns, as they battle against endless waves of corrupted beings.

title: Sword Road
description: Make your best sword! Fight monsters in dungeon, collect items and craft a various sword.

title: No Food No Drink
description: Enjoy delicious snacks, earn rewards, and navigate whilst avoiding the librarian. Equip yourself with many tools to distract others creatively. Assist your classmates and prepare to face challenges in this stealth-strategy game at different time or weather.

title: Korokoro
description: This game is a gyro-only game. Please make sure that your controller is equipped with a gyro function before purchasing. Roll around with the gyro control. Overcome numerous gimmicks and aim for the goal! A total of 50 stages. Tilt and roll 5 balls of different shapes to reach the goal.

title: Paranormal Files: The Tall Man - Collector's Edition
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Keep on the Borderlands
description: Help the commonfolk trapped within the Keep on the Borderlands in their struggle against the Cult of Evil Chaos. A collection of 8 quest dungeons adapted from the classic D&D module for new characters & early epic levels. The Borderlands is also a large adventure area where players can hunt monsters and obtain horses.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Seal of Shan-to-Kor
description: A premium three-part dungeon for low level characters. Search the sewers for a large hobgoblin town and take back the Seal of Shan-To-Kor before its power is turned against Stormreach.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Sharn Syndicate
description: A small series of very short premium dungeons for low level characters. Protect the marketplace from a gang that extorts innocent business owners.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Archetype - Wild Mage
description: An add-on that has to be purchased in the store. You can make a new character that plays as a variant of the sorcerer class. Wild Mages tap into chaos and luck when they cast their spells.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Warforged
description: An add-on that has to be purchased in the store. Warforged are a race of sentient constructs built to battle in the Last War. The Warforged body is covered by plating, but prevents wearing any other armor. They can be healed with repair magic, which makes them ideal for playing as or partying with arcane spellcasters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Tabaxi
description: Tabaxi are cat-like humanoid creatures with supernatural powers. Light on their feet, the fearsome Tabaxi favor dexterity and agility as they hunt, leap, and claw their way through many dangers.

title: The Tower of Mimi
description: Explore the Tower of Mimi floor by floor and try to reach the top! Endure games forced on you by Mimi, resident strange funny animal. See if you can survive... ohoho~

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Delera's Tomb
description: A premium collection of short dungeons about ghostly skeletons and other undead. The main quests are narrated by Gary Gygax.

title: Golden Rails: The Heart of the State - Collector's Edition
Farkle with Friends
description: Roll the dice, push your luck, and strategize your way to victory! Compete with friends in this fast-paced multiplayer dice game where every roll counts. With real physics-based rolling, every outcome is truly random—no tricks, just skill and luck! Unlock unique dice skins to show off your style!

title: Adventure Trip: London
description: If you are a virtual bird but love adventure too, this game is just for you.

title: Rescue Team: Ancient Guardian - Collector's Edition
Detectives United: Mission Possible - Collector's Edition
description: Can the Detectives United team unravel the secrets of Myst Hill in time?

title: Cursed Fables: A Gilded Rose - Collector's Edition
description: Can you use your magical gifts to save the prince from a deadly fate?

title: Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel
description:
In "Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel", your stomach is rumbling, and there's only one solution – find the ingredients and cook the world-famous schnitzel! But even in Schländ, the schnitzel-loving country, it won't be easy!

Embark on a quirky adventure filled with unexpected encounters, platforming challenges and a fun merging mechanic. Explore a world brimmed with secrets, strange characters, and even stranger problems. Dig, swing, and sprint your way through a lovingly designed environment, where surprises await around every corner.

title: Memory Recoil
description: Memory Recoil is a short surreal horror visual novel following the story of Von, a boy who lives secluded in his house until one day he receives an unexpected visit from a boy named Liam who invites him to play outside. Nothing bad could happen, right?

title: Double Shoulders
description: Double Shoulders is a two player action-adventure game. You take control of Lois and Sam, two kids trying to escape from a strange place filled with dangers and challenges. You'll have to work together to get out of this place alive.

title: Rack and Run
description: The story is from the perspective of a hunter who finally gets her first kill. However, it turns out to be way more than she bargained for! Will the hunter now become the hunted?

title: Pimbolas
description: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

title: Skools Out
description: Skools Out is an educational adventure game for younger players. The main character, a boy named Derek, must try within twenty days to make sure that the sheet of paper with the latest results of his scientific achievements does not reach home. The notes there are not among the highest, so it would be better not to get them in the hands of parents.

title: Demian
description: Emil Sinclair is torn between a monochromatic understanding of the world of childhood and the ambiguity of adulthood. As Emil dives deeper, he's caught in a swirling journey where dreams and desire are indistinguishable from reality. His path is lined with bizarre encounters. Maybe a strange boy with a mouth full of biblical riddles can help him find his way. Demian is a reinterpretation of the novel "Demian" written by Hermann Hesse and published in 1919.

title: Ark: Extinction Ascended
description: An Element-infested, ravaged planet Earth filled with fantastical creatures both organic & technological holds both the secrets of the past and the keys to its salvation. Can you defeat the gigantic roaming Titans which dominate the planet, and complete the ARK cycle to save Earth's future?

title: Epimutation
description: 399 days ago, the world ended. Epimutation is a horror visual novel that follows seven survivors as they attempt to navigate life in the apocalypse. Make life or death decisions, form bonds with your fellow survivors, and attempt to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak.

title: Midas
description:
Train. Customize. FIGHT!

MIDAS is a 3D Platform/Arena Fighter with a heavy focus on movement and positioning that seeks to bring something new to the already vast array of fighting games.

Ready your shield, aim your flail, and launch into the fray against friend and foe alike!

title: Danganronpa: Salvation's Fears
description: Danganronpa: Salvation's Fears is a developing RPG Maker MV fangan with a playable prolouge and fully completed chapter 1. DR: SF has no affiliation with SpikeChunsoft or the official Danganronpa series.

title: Paranormal Survey
description: Paranormal Survey is a "Spot The Difference" style game, look out for moving objects, objects growing in size, paintings may change, and certain other spooky events may occur.

title: Welcome! Uninvited Guest
description:
A short and mildly difficult one shot type horror game I made in two weeks to try and get my game dev groove going after a month long hiatus. Was a bit experimental with this one. While the game may be a bit difficult to play due to it's heavy emphasis on hiding and not getting caught, I do hope people will enjoy the learning curve and have some fun with it!

You must scour the forest in search of gears to unlock the ritual doors. Activate powerful statues, hide wherever you can and most importantly, do NOT let them see you... Once all four of the Formless Statues have been activated, the ritual will be complete. This won't be a simple task. You must use your wit and resourcefulness to hide and evade the Uninvited whilst you explore the forest.

The map randomly generates every time you play, making each run feel a little different from the last. But your objective remains the same, complete the ritual.

title: Nightlings
description: Nightlings is a First Person survival horror game, set in the mind of a child's worst nightmares come true. Prevent the Nightlings from breaking in, and survive until morning. You have 3 nights to survive...could these be your last?

title: Dance To Heck
description: Play as a funny little demon guy as you look out for funny little lava guys don't touch those they'll burn you silly.

title: Blitzr Ball
description: An arcade style game where you control a bumper to bounce the blitzr ball! Destroy all blocks to beat levels. Discover power ups and unlock perks to help you along the way!

title: RNG Quest
description: Zero player randomly generated idle-game by Viktor.

title: Hand of Hexes
description: Play cards to cast spells that control enemy hordes and use your deck to build deadly mazes of towers with funky attack patterns.

title: Clutter 17: Flower Power - Collector's Edition
description: It's Clutter - but with added Flower Power! Flowers used as Stackers and unmissable new Petal Puzzles are among over 1800 puzzles to keep you playing for days and days. Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability!

title: Code Trainer
description: Code Trainer is a programming practice tool. Solve coding problems and improve your understanding of computer science. Prior programming experience is required.

title: Coffee, Snow, and You
description: A short visual novel about a lonely soul spending December 31st at work. A funny and heartwarming story about searching for joy and meaning on the eve of the most magical night of the year.

title: CoinForge
description: CoinForge is a clicker game where you generate S-coins! Click to earn S-coins and exchange them. Try to get your S-Coins every day with every 100 Clicks you press. 3 is max per day. It's time to forge fortune with Coin Forge. Join our community on Discord and help shape the game!

title: Coldblooded
description: After crash landing in the midst of a catastrophic orbital battle, take on the role of a reptilian alien in this non-linear 2D puzzle adventure game.

title: College Gay Sex: Episode 5
description: An erotic VISUAL NOVEL featuring HD graphics, steamy ANIMATIONS, and realistic-looking characters. Cody's gay adventure continues with a steamy ménage at the spa when he and Jax challenge the handsome receptionist to join them in the sauna.

title: Color Breakers 2
description: A casual co-op game about coloring with friends! Form a party of up to 8 players in local and online multiplayer and try to beat crazy levels by coloring procedurally-generated paintings. Expect fast-paced, chaotic fun with plenty of twists and turns to keep you entertained!

title: Colors of the Past
description: Soo-ji is pulled back into her past through haunting melodies and unsaid words. As she uncovers hidden truths, she must face her trauma and decide whether to find redemption or let go forever.

title: Colossal Crisis
description: Colossal Crisis is a fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer where you play as a brave swordsman fighting to reclaim an island overrun by ruthless enemies and towering giants. Will you rise against the "Colossal Counsel" or fall beneath their might?

title: Coming From Above!
description: In an arcade game somewhere. Aim for a high score while stacking blocks falling from the sky and avoid falling off the stage!

title: Concentration Required
description: Concentration Required is a tough bullet hell made to challenge your focus and reaction time. The game has 6 unique retro-themed music tracks with 5 levels plus a tutorial and endless mode.

title: Conduits
description: Nostalgic Screensaver Simulator - With Teapots! Conduits allows you to create nostalgic and original scenes full of colorful pipes using a custom GUI.

title: Confluence: An Of Sense and Soul Soliloquy
description: A poet ponders queer life and love after his happily ever after.

title: Containers
description: Containers – a clicker game where unexpected discoveries await you! Your main task is to click the button to earn balance and open various containers with rare and valuable items. Test your luck!

title: Corporate Chaos
description: Corporate Chaos is a 2D Action game where an office worker must battle the forces of automation to get his job back! Explore the labyrinth like office building with only furniture and broken bits of bots to defend yourself.

title: Corporate Cut: The Hair-Raising Adventure of an Office Employee
description: “Corporate Cut” is a satirical adventure set in a bizarre hair-obsessed magazine company. As the new intern, you'll experience the struggle to fit in while exploring the boundaries between conformity and innovation. Expect intricate lore, experimental game design, and of course… many hair puns!

title: Corporate Suck Up
description: Oliver’s future at Reeve's Capital depends on winning over three strange colleagues while working as a secretary. Nothing ominous is happening if he doesn't think too hard about it.

title: Cosmic Decode
description: Cosmic Decode is a space game where you explore an unknown universe, solving puzzles and discovering the reason for your situation. Immerse yourself in an adventure full of mystery and challenges at every step.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Lost Gatekeepers
description: A small series of short premium dungeons for low level characters. The Gatekeepers have established a new grove outside Stormreach and some of the recently recruited initiates have gone missing. Follow the clues to help rescue these would-be guardians of Eberron.

title: Spinera
description: Spinera is a chaotic yet euphoric civilization management game… decided by a slot machine. Pick a leader, build Wonders, and see if luck favors your empire. Light, surprising, and perfect for short, fun runs.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Devil Assault
description: The Chronoscope premium raid and a dungeon that supports multiple character levels. Travel back in time to find out what happened when a vortex of invading devils destroyed the Stormreach Marketplace.

title: Bullet Yeeters
description: Bullet Yeeters is a third-person shooter where miniature agents navigate oversized household environments using jetpacks. Players engage in combat across domestic settings like kitchens and living rooms, face boss encounters, and can modify their characters' appearances and loadouts. The game emphasizes aerial mobility and firefights within familiar spaces transformed into battlegrounds.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules IV: Mother Nature - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules V: Kids of Hellas - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules VI: Race for Olympus - Collectors Edition
12 Labours of Hercules VII: Fleecing the Fleece - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules VIII: How I Met Megara - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules IX: A Hero's Moonwalk - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules X: Greed for Speed - Collector's Edition
Cloverpit
description:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules XII: Timeless Adventure - Collectors Edition
description:
One sunny day brave Hercules was resting in his hammock and cooking delicious donuts. He dozed off just for a few minutes but it was enough for the hero's brunch to burn to a crisp. All the dreams of a starving Hercules were ruined. What should he do? There was a way. Hercules decided to turn back time, and move the clock's hand back with all his might. What could possibly go wrong? Obviously, everything!

The collector's edition contains additional bonus levels, a guide, and wallpapers.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XIII: Wonder-ful Builder - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules XIV: Message in a Bottle - Collector's Edition
The Terror At Freddy's
description: The Terror At Freddy's Is A FNaF Fan Game Where You Need To Survive All Nights And Complete Challenges And Full Game.

title: Dr. Plague
description: In a world ravaged by plague, a lone plague doctor embarks on a journey to stop both the disease and a sinister order of knights controlling it. Dr. Plague is a stealth-adventure game that combines puzzle-solving, platforming, and ambient soundtracks.

title: Coil's Containment
description: Coil's Containment is a horror roguelike where you start a new job at a local ice cream parlor. To secure your employment and satisfy your boss, Mr. Coil, you must generate enough revenue in 11 days.

title: Chess Force
description: Chess Force! The wicked MAGNUS and his evil minions have taken taken over the moon with their dark chess powers. You, the KING, will earn PAWNS from each boss battle. Spend your hard-earned ELO to PROMOTE your pawns and add to your firepower. Can you become a GRANDMASTER and save the moon?

title: Trivia Murder Party 3
description: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

title: Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC
description: Get ready for adrenaline-fueled racing fun as you climb your way through the motorsports ranks in pure arcade style! Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC is all about speed and pushing your driving skills to the limit.

title: Okko the Exiled
description: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure, where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the demon lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

title: Exo-Calibre
description: Meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! The Exo-Tech corporation is dedicated to developing advanced weapons and defenses to aid humanity, but when AI drones go haywire and start attacking the populous, it’s up to you to take control of the Ex-Calibre Knights and restore order by any means necessary!

title: Tiny Pixels Vol. 2: Stormy Knights
description: Step into the armored boots of an overzealous knight as you fight across the continent rescuing princesses from monstrous captors in Stormy Knights! Strategic real-time combat ensues as you storm the halls of each castle in side-scrolling pixel art style, from medieval Europe and mystical Persia to feudal Japan and more, all accompanied by an original retro soundtrack!

title: Metahorror Therapy Session
description: Take control of a therapist in a mysterious, never-ending therapy session. Can you unravel the truth behind your patient's lies, and live to tell the tale? A psychological mystery developed by a psychologist.

title: Humanelfo: Um Segredo Vai Te Libertar
description: Lohan, prince of the Kingdom of Candara, has always lived “imprisoned” in his own castle. Until his father, King Carlus IX, discovers that he is not his son and decides to arrest him and then kill him. Lohan becomes desperate when he learns that his father is planning to kill him. So he decides to flee the castle to get answers about his origin. On his way, he receives a mission to find the Sealed Mana in order to discover who his real parents are, but not everything goes according to plan. The life he knew will change forever.

title: O Horror Amarelo
description: Angela is a young woman who suffered various traumas in her childhood and adolescence, her life plunged into nightmares and anxiety attacks. After being referred to a hypnologist and psychotherapist by her psychologist, the young woman begins a journey through her memories in search of a cure for her problems. What she didn't know was that this internal journey would awaken and bring to light terrible secrets, hidden fears that flirt with the darkness and insanity of the human mind? before the watchful eyes of unnameable mysteries that roam in the shadows of the cosmos.

title: This is Interesting
description: This is Interesting is a psychological horror narrative based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.

title: Animatronic Memories
description: Animatronic Memories is a fnaf fan-game based on the events of the first FNaF game, but set in an alternate universe.

title: RPG Maker Coloring Book
description: A simple coloring book program made within RPG Maker 2003!

title: Super Stream-Bara
description: CAPPA, a hero from capybara legend, needs your help! Your mission: free every capybara in the world from the evil clutches of Capy Land. But wait... who is that mysterious Stream-Bara lurking in the corner of the screen?

title: Transregnum
description: Step into a dystopian visual novel where secrets, betrayal, and self-discovery collide. Follow Garrett Marek's text-driven journey through a world ruled by Deus Magnus Rotamea. Unravel family mysteries, confront fate, and explore a linear story where every revelation brings you closer to the truth!

title: Trainer Eyes
description: Let's workout with a girl! Are you ready for the first-ever workout/rhythm game? This game does not require VR HMD and can be played on a PC.

title: Track Masters Pro
description: Track Masters Pro is a competitive racing game focused on precision driving and adaptive AI opponents. Players race through a variety of tracks with customizable vehicles, aiming to master each circuit and climb the leaderboard. The game emphasizes realistic handling, time trial challenges, and progression through skill-based performance.

title: Tower Of Penguinaria
description: Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica. Through turn based combats where your gear effects what abilities you will learn to aid in battle!

title: Totomi Trainer
description: Totomi trainer is a trainer simulator in which You will become a trainer of runners. But there is one small detail, you will train monsters :) But don't worry, they are cute and don't bite at all ! i guess...

title: Totem Clash
description: Collect blocks to summon units and defeat ghosts! Totem Clash is a roguelike tower fence game where you summon units through blocks to defeat ghosts. Combine and strengthen various units to reclaim areas occupied by ghosts. Use each unit's unique characteristics to strategically defeat ghosts.

title: Toriki: The Castaway Island
description: A companion app necessary for playing the Toriki: The Castaway Island board game from Lucky Duck Games. Toriki: The Castaway Island is a cooperative family game of adventure, exploration and survival mixing an app with physical components.

title: Tomorrow's Land
description: Tomorrow’s Land is a free land Where Adventures Begin. It may not be the best game ever created, but it is surely the most fun. The game is not yet finished and is still in active development.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke One
description: An funny early 3D retro inspired FPS. Become Mr. Weedz himself and fight on the power of Evil. Pass through 6 unique level and upgrade a Toey with gunz and skillz to put an end to the madness once and for all!

title: Toast Astronauts
description: Complete all tasks or exile the assasin!

title: Tiny Shooters
description: Engage in fast-paced 2D deathmatch action! Choose from 9 unique characters, collect weapons, grenades, and health packs as you battle for supremacy in a 5-minute showdown. Play against friends or bots in this thrilling shooter game where every kill counts!

title: Time to Star II
description: A female-led star training game where players aim to win the TTS Starlight King Award. Features include open-world exploration, unique romance systems, and diverse career choices.

title: Tide: 1932
description: A new story of a young girl who escapes from a murder charge and weaves with her chosen lover.

title: Ticker
description: This game is a colorful platformer where players control a nimble character navigating through a vibrant world full of color

title: Pelican Post
description:
Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about delivering mail to a town of unique characters and helping to regain a lost sense of community.

You play as Pepper, a young pelican who recently moved to Port Pleasant to take a job as the town's mailman. Through your job, you'll get to interact with and get to know the townsfolk and help them out.

"Small acts of kindness" is pretty much in the job description.

title: Throw Home
description: (This game was created as both a proof of concept and game design showcase) A 2D action showcase for players new to video games.

title: Throweat Area
description: A arena FPS multiplayer game, were you can collect lot of items around you and throw EVERYTHING on other players or eat EVERYTHING to regenerate your health.

title: Will She?
description: You want her to be your date for the dance but it is in 5 days. Will you be able to build up the courage to ask her in time, or will you have to go to the dance alone this year?

title: ThrillKings
description: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a set of weapons and movement inspired by games from the early 2000s. Compete in classic and new game modes, dominate your enemies through a variety of maps with unique traversal mechanics, and become the ultimate King.

title: Three Sheets
description: Arcade sailboat racing for all! Take the helm of an offshore racing sailboat in beautiful and challenging waters. Race through the checkpoints and reach the goal before time runs out!

title: Three Kingdoms: Strategy MOBA
description: Fast-paced war strategy mobile game, 7 days per season, North vs South

title: Three Doors: Labyrinth of Fear
description: Trapped in darkness, you've lived in fear for as long as you can remember. Now, thirty rooms stand between you and freedom. Each one holds a deadly challenge, but only one path leads forward. One wrong step, and you're lost forever. Open the door!

title: Three Against the Odds
description: Three Against the Odds is a base defense fantasy roguelike. Build your amphibian hero(es) and settlement as wave after wave of enemies descends from bordering terrain that you can terraform. Play through three campaigns, conquering the shadowy powers that have corrupted the world of Primeva.

title: Thief Office Simulator
description: Simulation game where player mission is to steal as much money, jewelry etc in different places and avoid guardians and cameras

title: The Yapori Clicker
description: Yapori Clicker is a Clicker game where you need to keep clicking Yapori to level up and unlock skins, get coins, armor and more

title: Emoji Puzzle Action: Codename: ManKun
description: In a future transformed by tech, social media and emojis dominate communication. But a disaster strikes when the "Emoji Virus" turns emojis into aggressive beings, overrunning the world. You, "ManKun", the sole survivor and ex-security expert, must now save humanity.

title: Threat: Scream and Escape
description: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE- is a unique horror game where you must scream into your microphone to stun approaching creatures and make your escape. Use the power of your voice to clear the path and guide the protagonist, who wakes up in a mysterious research facility, to freedom.

title: Breaking the Grip
description: Breaking the Grip is a multiplayer horror and strategy game. As a survivor, complete a ritual to eliminate the spirit before it drives you insane. As the spirit, spread terror and break their will. Who will prevail between life and the beyond?

title: Range
description: Range is a game that helps you stay on-task and focused when you want to be. Set a timer for your focus session, the tasks you want to complete, and enjoy a relaxing, distraction-free drive through a hand-drawn world.

title: Jump to Space
description: Aim for space from the ground. Climb up while jumping on objects. The jump distance changes depending on the degree of accumulation, so delicate control is required. Don't cry no matter how many times you fall! I am sure you can do it!

title: Next Week at Freddy's
description: Welcome to “Next Week at Freddy's”, a realism-based, fan-made reimagining of “Five Nights at Freddy's”. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game features enhanced graphics and spatial audio to immerse you in its atmosphere.

title: Lootbound
description: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

title: The Wungo Dungo Surprise
description: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game, with no combos or roster, just 1 simple enemy to beat repeatedly. The main moves are punching, kicking and dodging, and some extra tools, a few weapons and powers.

title: The Wild Outback
description: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game in a Wild Western setting. It's a single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots!

title: The Void Chronicles Chronis
description: Every decision matters. It’s a race against the clock in a story where paranoia, creativity, and courage are your only allies. Will you break the loop, or will time break you?

title: The Viewer's Game
description: Defeat HUGE waves of enemies as Bob, The Viewer's Game is a very satisfying but hectic game where you can Shoot, Burn, and smash into hundreds of enemies and bosses! Each run you get to choose a Class for Bob and discover what each subclass and unlockable weapon does!

title: The Very Brief and Meaningless Adventure of Hero Man
description: Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from a terrible evil ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please in this small, satirical RPG!

title: The Valley: XuGu
description: The Valley: XuGu is a casual deck-building roguelike game that blends Taoist alchemy with cyber technology. Players can combine herbs based on their grades and elemental attributes to create unique alchemy recipes and refine distinct elixirs. These pills can help those who enter Xugu.

title: The Trio
description: The Trio invites you into a world shrouded in mystery and danger. By day, gather resources and reinforce your shelter, but as night falls, sinister creatures rise from the shadows, driven by a dark curse. Survival becomes a desperate fight against cursed creatures that stalk the land.

title: The Tower of Aether
description: Welcome to the Tower of Aether—a labyrinth filled with countless doors, At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether, an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize.

title: The Time Traveling Toxicologist
description: Travel back in time, investigate a murder, and prevent it from ever happening!

title: The Tale of: Bubble Boy
description: Help Bubble Boy reach the highest mountaintop in the Alps by moving him upwards inside his giant soap bubble, but don't let the bubble pop, or you will fall, all the way, back down...

title: Meathook
description: PSX-styled survival horror FPS meets point-and-click adventure game. You are bound to a sinister conveyor mechanism. Reach for weapons and items, navigate labyrinthine tunnels, and blast your path to worthiness!

title: The Story Is You: Look Within
description: A freely navigable and open first-person real-time 3D reflective experience. Come see what you see in you. Explore a beautiful and immersive environment that touches on lots of areas of life. See what resonates.

title: The Rose of Cravenmor
description: A gothic short story set in the most Blighted city of the North Kingdom.

title: Dark Witch Fighting Buster
description: Introducing the Majin Shoujo Fukitou Buster Prototype for the first time in a while. It's basically a 1 vs 1 game, but this is a "Battle Royale" that can be played by up to 4 people.

title: The Pancake Paradox
description: The story of two women, who make pancakes in the middle of a sandstorm, even though the planet is dying. is a bit short, right? ...then a story that has a little more than that.

title: The Nutcracker of Riepass: A Nymph's Tale - Episode 2
description: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with jrpg battles

title: Speak, Lord
description:
Matthew 10:28 - “Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul.”

Is God truly there? Is God even real?

These are some of the questions that face practicing Christians each day.

Those who claim to hear the voice of God elate in worship. They spread the gospel

title: Hermit Night
description: A hermit living in the forest has his usual day. He is watching TV, and suddenly the program he was watching is interrupted due to an emergency. Due to an emergency in the country, which the authorities do not disclose, the hermit decides to act in order to survive the night.

title: Yellow Eyes
description:
Dive into the depths of a nightmare in this 3D horror game crafted specifically for the Gdevelop 3D Game Jam. Immerse yourself in an eerie and claustrophobic maze as you gather pieces of mysterious relics of unknown origin.

Be prepared, for there's something hidden within the dark depths and it is coming for you.

title: Bumptz Science Carnival
description: An educational science game from Theatrix

title: Fantasy World Manager
description: Build a massive-scale MMO-themed fantasy world where you design all creatures, objects, quests, events and dungeons. Watch the inhabitants of your world embark on their adventures.

title: Miracle! Panzou Uchu Daisakusen
description: A children’s PC action/educational game featuring the character Panzou. Players embark on a space-themed adventure where gameplay includes simple action challenges and mini-games. Designed for accessibility, it encourages younger players to download and play with parental help.

title: Deer Hunting Camp
description: Deer Hunting Camp allows you to create your own private deer habitat which can be traded with friends! Once done creating, managing, and scouting your property you will be challenged with early fall bow hunting, late fall black powder hunting, and winter rifle hunting.

title: Alien Cat Story
description: Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies in the game Alien Cat Story. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

title: World War Z: Sin City Apocalypse Episode
description: A new story episode set in Las Vegas, featuring new survivors battling the zeke on the strip and in a casino! In the shadow of the outbreak, swarms of infected wander the empty streets of Las Vegas, while the living search for a way out.

title: Depths Debris
description: A walking simulator about a journey in search of the mother ocean. Control "Hoi-chan," a girl with a yellow hat, and collect hearts hidden throughout various locations.

title: RuinsStory
description: A high-speed action shooter that allows you to move at high speed and aim at the floor, wall, and ceiling. Combine various items to create your own build.

title: Fishing Master Kitty
description: You will play as a little cat whose dream is to eat every fish in the world! Pick up your fishing rod and grow from a rookie angler into a legendary Fishing Master!

title: Team Fortress 2 Legacy
description: Team Fortress 2 Legacy is a project that provides some post-2008 Team Fortress 2 features like items and cosmetics on pre-2008 Team Fortress 2 gameplay basis.

Immerse yourself in a grim post-apocalyptic world where survival depends on your skills, ingenuity, and determination. Explore abandoned streets, battle hordes of zombies, solve puzzles, and forge a path to the Central Hospital — your ultimate goal.

title: PomoFish
description: Are you ready to level up your productivity? PomoFish is a game that merges fishing and the Pomodoro studying technique! Work hard while Joe catches fish for you! Sell your fish to level up your skills and buy items.

title: The Count of Monte Clicker
description: The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.

title: Fruitgeddon
description: Blast through hordes of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits in this intense space shooter with bullet hell action. Shoot, dodge, and survive unique boss battles that push your skills to the limit. Only the strongest will uncover the truth behind the chaos. Are you ready to save the universe?

title: NiuMa
description: This is a third-person controlled combat game where figurines fight on the battlefield until the highest level figurine is born. The last surviving figurine will dominate the battlefield.

title: Cube Lab
description: Portal & Lock: A 2D Puzzle Platformer with Spatial Mastery

title: Free Dunk
description: "Free Dunk" immerses you in street basketball, celebrating individuality and competition. Build your legend, craft a dream team, and join global streetball leagues. Experience the raw joy of the game with controller support—hit the streets for epic battles!

title: Pay Your Crimes
description: Pay Your Crimes is a Tactical Management game with elements of real time strategy, you play as a mafia boss where you need to upgrade your drug dealers, buy dealers, and play with them to sell drug to the people, earn as much money as you can and bribe the cops maintain your freedom

title: Impartial
description: Impartial is an intriguing short 2D narrative game where you take on the role as a conflict resolver - tasked with resolving moral dilemmas between the Police Force and Superheroes to fight crime in Neo-Victorian London.

title: TableSoccer
description: A two-player game on a single computer, where both players control rods to kick the ball into the opponent's goal and score points. This game also features an impostor control mechanic.

title: Videoclub Simulator
description: Manage your own video store in this management simulator. Sell movies, organize shelves, and attract customers in a nostalgic experience inspired by classic video rental stores.

title: Allegro Molto wo Hakobu Game
description: A casual action game starring the Vtuber Allegro Molto and Lead the cat. Balance speed and care as you carry her safely to the live streaming room!

title: Cartoon Bash
description: Cartoon Bash is a horde survivor game where our dear protagonists who just died must fight to get another chance to get back to life. You equip multiple weapons and items, fighting off waves of enemies and bosses.

title: Three Kingdoms Front
description: This is an idle text game based on the Three Kingdoms. As the game progresses, the system will randomly trigger various events, and automatically trigger various military commands and various internal affairs facilities according to different development situations.

title: The Game of Bionic Goat
description: The Game Of Bionic Goat is a suspenseful story-oriented adventure game in which you manipulate the main character to interact with the scene and game characters, advancing the story through communication and choices with other characters.

title: Euplectella
description: A short Visual Novel. Player will play as a reclusive writer who explores in her own dreams by moving and clicking, listening to and recording the story of a dream-prisoner. As the story progresses, she can no longer remain detached ...

title: Cold War: Frontline
description: Join this multiplayer cooperative PVE tank shooting game, drive famous vehicles from the Cold War, and have the opportunity to fight side by side with players around the world. Now, start the engine, the order will come later!

title: Guild Receptionist: Good Luck
description: Become a guild receptionist and save the world! Or pay back your debts! This is a simulation game of a receptionist. Serve the King or turn to the Demon King, the future depends on your choice!

title: Taipei Midsummer Night's Dream
description: You will play as a young tourist from mainland China, and meet five female characters with different styles in a city that is both prosperous and quiet. Every choice is the key to a different ending - is it a sweet romance, or an emotional test full of twists and turns?

title: My Journey
description: This is a Interactive Live-Action Game. You will travel back in time to become a noble Highness and experience the local customs and practices of ancient times. A series of your choices will influence the development trajectory of this world.

title: Trapped Beast
description: Detective Iver investigates the case of a missing girl. As the investigation deepens, Iver is unable to escape and the secrets behind it are slowly being revealed. Can they escape from that crazy world

title: Hell's Cooking Joy
description: "Hell Cooking" is a cute mini-game of business simulation, in which players will play the manager of a Hell restaurant and prepare dishes that meet the needs of customers. In the game, you'll have to take care of the time to chop vegetables, cook them, and appease your guests.

title: Dumpling Together
description: Dumpling Together is a very easy click casual game.You can complete the level all the way with just a few clicks of the mouse.

title: Chronicles of the Great Wilderness
description: It is a multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) that combines multiple gameplay, allowing you to experience the fun of hanging up easily in the cultivation world.

title: Miracle Squirrel Club
description: In Miracle Squirrel Club , you can experience the unique stacked tower defense gameplay, building your tower of heaven, weighing the height and turret performance, and applying unexpected turret Build combinations to easily destroy all enemies!

title: Queen Ant Perfume Episode 0: The Mad Love of Jack the Ripper
description: A visual novel game set in “London at the end of the 19th century” and “modern Tokyo”. The game depicts a love episode between you and a male suspect that “Watson-kun,” the assistant of a famous detective (you), witnesses while investigating a threatening letter sent by Jack the Ripper.

title: Into The Corner
description: A geometric-style tower defense game where your defenses persist beyond victories, becoming permanent strategic assets. Build defenses, repel attacks, expand territory, and snowball economically to gain tech and military advantages.

title: Galaxy Express Chaldea
description: It appears every time I find "true happiness" on the night of the Galaxy Express... This is a visual novel game that helps you discover the brilliance of life.

title: Battle of Emperor Tian
description: "Battle of Emperor Tian" is a casual tower defense game. In the game, players can skillfully place these turrets. According to the characteristics and attack rhythms of different monsters, they can reasonably match the lineup to ensure the stability of the defensive line.

title: Fantasy Illness
description: Pseudo realistic visual novels,I'm Social livestock,Life is full of pressure and fatigue, feeling dissatisfied and confused about the current situation,can only escape reality through fantasy,The spiritual world is hovering on the edge of distortion and collapse.

title: Eternal Tree
description: "Eternal Tree" is a turn-based combat role-playing game that tells the story of a journey spanning the Divine Era and the modern age. A grand epic, unknown challenges, and the continent of Titalyera await your exploration. Your adventure will shape the future of this world.

title: Survive Till 100 Years Old
description: How hard is it to "survive" to 100? This match-3 strategy game brings the answer with fun and challenges! In the game, players must use match-3 mechanics to gain nutrition, maintain health, and acquire skills to survive. Wisdom and strategy might help you achieve the goal, but luck is indispensable!

title: Huanu Poems
description: Huanu Poems is a multi-ending love adventure game. As a photographer, carrying the secret of being a bloodline inheritor of HuaNu Town, you will take lovely Peach to run a B&B, encounter gentle Cloudia. Your choices will affect the direction of the story.

title: Button Cat
description: [Button Cat] is a comprehensive game that consists of several mini-games [horizontal board jumping, snake eating, jerking off, big fish eating small fish] connected into a plot

title: Midori Budou-den
description: Friendship! Effort! And victory! This is the ultimate battle formula! Even NORMAL is difficult, but there are difficulties VERY HRAD! Climb up! There are two peaks of boobs, but there is only one peak of grapes! ...Oh, if you find it too difficult, you can take your time and clear it on VERY EASY.

title: The War Zone Crisis
description: The War Zone Crisis is a third person shooting game for online online combat on the Internet. The game supports remote online games through the steam platform. In the game, players play the roles of red and blue teams of anti-terrorism special forces。

title: Memory of Time
description: This is a science fiction detective themed visual novel game, where players need to play the role of a "detective", connecting seemingly unrelated events and discovering mysterious truths hidden behind them, Please survive, and walk with your head held high towards the 'perfect ending' you expect.

title: Kare Kano Trial: Toki wo Kakeru Toki-meki Daisakusen
Touhou Danmaku Shunsatsu Gekijou: Shoken Koroshi ni Inochi wo Kakete
Dream Management Company
description: Guard every trapped soul. Step into the realm of dreams, and clear away the nightmares. DreamControl Inc—wishing you pleasant dreams!

title: Adventure Book in Dimension
description: Adventure Book in Dimension is a turn-based RPG based on the novel Wonderful Dimensional Journey. In the game, you as a new member of the human wizard team "Tribal Clan", experience the main adventure story of the "Tribal Clan" in a magic book given by your predecessors.

title: Abyss Pact
description: Abyss Pact is an adventure fighting RPG,where you become a talented heroic warrior to protect the last remaining pure land, and embark on your own legendary path!

title: Paintbrush Warrior
description: Once upon a time, there was a kingdom of drawing paper. There, the prince and princess lived happily together. One day, the devil appeared, and the devil took the prince. So, at the request of the princess, the paintbrush brave set out to fight the demon king and save the prince.

title: Wandering Dreams of Yuri
description: She becomes Alice of the fairy tale world and joins forces with the mysterious Zixuan to explore the twisted world of fantasy: name-grabbing factions, invisible witches ...... In their light-hearted adventures, they gradually uncover the truth and endeavour to return to reality.

title: Your Majesty's Arrival
description: A high-simulation emperor simulation game with a real game timeline. From the first perspective of the simulated emperor's accession to the throne, he governs the government, manages officials and concubines, raises children, conquers the world, and experiences the life of an emperor.

title: I Love Spelling!
description: Building spelling skills becomes fun-and-games as you bop from planet to planet with your hilarious game-show host. An intelligent tracking system automatically adds misspelled words to your own personalized list, to give you extra practice where you need it most. With over 5,000 key words and 50 spelling-pattern word groups I Love Spelling! is based on core curriculum lessons, to match what kids learn in school. Words are divided into spelling lists that teach you the basics so you can apply it to almost any word in the English language.

title: Rammy's Great Adventure 1&2 Remake
description: The full remake of the randomly generated dungeon RPG "Rammy's Great Adventure 1 & 2" is here! Join tomboy treasure hunter Rammy for hidden treasures. Revamped controls and UI, nostalgic pixel art. Challenge Mode, new foes, encyclopedia, color options, and online rankings.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Shadow Under Thunderholme
description: Explore the dwarven city of Thunderholme and defeat powerful dragons and their allies. This is a premium quest collection with two raids, a large adventure area for hunting monsters and the ability to craft thunder-forged weapons. Part of D&D's 40th anniversary "Tyranny of Dragons" event across multiple products.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Vault of Night
description: A premium six-part quest series, culminating in an epic raid battle against a red dragon. The story revolves around recruiting the lost Laughing Knives companions to help infiltrate a heavily fortified vault. This was the first raid added to Dungeons & Dragons Online.

title: GrimKeep
description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

title: Remanence
description: Explore several Large slaughter maps that have seen better days. Ancient ruins lost to time, rediscovered for better or worse.

title: Dragon Nest Classic
description:
Dragon Nest imposes FPS game control that uses WASD and Mouse so it brings fast view change and character movement more than other action games.
Also Dragon Nest arranges a character at left side of screen that make players can see character's movement and opponents attack action more easily.

title: You Are The Code
description: A programming puzzle game where bugs are eating away your code! One problem: YOU CAN'T TYPE. Navigate and run pre-existing lines of code to make your output match the goal!

title: Samly's Merge
description: Easy to learn, hard to master. No time limits. No rush. Just relax and merge in pixel-art goodness.

title: Hole Digging Master
description:
The rules are as simple as possible - dig the hole. Dig deep. Deeper than you can even imagine.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, because there's real treasure waiting for you in the ground. Start digging and miracles will happen. You have no idea what could be under your lawn.

Everything you find can be sold and used to upgrade your tools or buy new equipment to help you dig faster and find more.

Can you reach the true depths?

title: SkyFighters 1945
description:
SkyFighters 1945 puts you in the cockpit of a World War II-era fighter plane and sends you off to do battle in the skies over Europe or the South Pacific. You can embark on any of 30 missions, each with unique objectives, diverse topographies, and distinct enemy planes. The game supports network play by as many as eight players on a LAN or the Internet. You can also compete head-to-head in a dogfight against a computer-controlled aircraft.

SkyFighters lacks the intricate flight-control systems that high-end flight simulators offer, and its garish graphics sometimes give the game a cartoonish feel. But the mechanics of flying aren’t difficult to master, and the animation is fast and fluid, even on low-end systems.

title: Gost! Buster
description: Gost! Buster is a horror game in the genre of psychological thriller, inspired by Russian mythology. You will have to become a ghost hunter, explore the places where the evil dwells, collect clues, determine the type of ghost and conduct exorcism rituals. Use special equipment, fix anomalies and uncover the secrets of the otherworld to rid the world of evil entities forever.

title: Little Big Adventure: Purple Empire

You have been hired to manage a graveyard in the mountains for 10 days.
The company that hired you says you're supposed to take care of one task each day, working during the day for three days and then at night for the next three days.
And if you notice anything out of the ordinary, you are to return to your quarters immediately and report it to the company by phone.

After reporting the anomaly, you're told you can go to sleep without doing any work.
But be careful, you shouldn't call the company if nothing unusual happened.
Beware, if you fall asleep without finishing your work or reporting anomalies, you'll be stuck with a day that never ends.

title: Princess Ursula

Princess Ursula is a short and funny hand drawn adventure game with a folk tale theme. Through the game, the player will impersonate three different characters that each have an important role in the story's progression.

The Princess is looking for a husband but suitors do not abound. It is even said that many fear her. Who is this mysterious princess and will she be able to get married?

title: Band of Crusaders

Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

title: Riven Crown
description:
Riven Crown is a dark, atmospheric Souls-like Action RPG where death is not the end but the beginning of a mythic descent through layered realms beyond life. Set in a decaying dimension ruled by a corrupt monarchy and haunted by the remnants of lost civilizations, the world is steeped in mystery, ritual, and the echoes of a forgotten society.

Blending classic Souls-like combat with a deep, combo-driven fighting system, Riven Crown introduces a fresh, high-skill twist to the genre. Each weapon comes with its own unique combo routes designed to be memorized, mastered, and chained together with precision. It's an approach that rewards muscle memory and strategic timing, especially during tense encounters with relentless, unforgiving enemies. We call it a “Souls-Fighter” a brutal fusion of methodical combat and stylish execution, built for players who crave both challenge and mastery.

title: A Way Home Uzy's Journey
description: Uzy's navigation system got damaged in a storm, now he and his friends are separated from each other and their home. Join Uzy solving puzzles and help out others along the way.

title: Text Your Life

title: Text Wall

title: TetriMatch

title: Tescaris
description: Create blocks and fill the board to clear each level. As new mechanics and power cards are added, the gameplay keeps evolving. Enjoy 120 levels, plus a new puzzle every day! Aim for the highest score and challenge players worldwide!

title: Orbital Descent
description:
Dive into Orbital Descent, a fast-paced maze challenge where every tilt of the maze can lead you to victory or send you spiraling off track. You're in charge of guiding a rolling ball through twists, turns, and obstacles as the maze rotates beneath you.

You can discover hidden shortcuts and speedrun tech to cut your time or find all the coins to go for 100% completion. With simple controls, you can try to master the maze. Use checkpoints to reset to a safe point, but remove the timer, to practice the hardest parts of the level and master the maze.

So jump in, pick your path, and see if you have what it takes to conquer Orbital Descent.

description: Events is an anomaly-style horror game designed to challenge your cognitive abilities and test your memory. You must closely observe the monitored area, recall its original state, and report anything unusual. This includes anything that is misplaced, missing, or altered objects (e.g., furniture).

title: La storia della Arcana Famiglia: Rinato
description:
The heroine spent her childhood days in a lonely, remote place with her mother, Sumire, and her servant/subordinate, Luca. The Christmas she turned 16, she was invited to go and live together with her father, Mondo.

The dream she had ever since she was young was to live a happy life with her family together. Thus, with her long-yearned-for dream coming true, she took her first steps as a member of "Arcana Famiglia", a vigilante organization the frank Mondo is in control of.

The story takes place 3 months after that, on April 1st.

title: On Any Journey
description:
On Any Journey is an immersive adventure built for two players, demanding tight cooperation and teamwork. With a striking blend of visual styles and inventive co-op puzzle-solving, this game isn’t just about exploring a world—it’s about experiencing a heartfelt story of friendship and self-discovery.

On Any Journey is all about the thrill of shared adventure. As Kai, Mateo, and Summer, you’ll embark on an unforgettable quest, encountering the enigmatic magician Bruno, the mysterious, mask-wearing Puka clan, and even a giant rockstar who rules the ocean depths. But no great story is complete without a formidable villain—enter "Big Man" and his relentless guards, standing in your way.

Throughout your journey, you’ll face tough choices and thrilling challenges. Confidence will battle self-doubt. Destiny will test your resolve. And when the day comes to an end, will you hold onto who you truly are, or surrender to the fate that seeks to define you?

Early Access will evolve with new cards, mechanics, and layers of mystery—shaped by feedback from those brave enough to enter the ALTR.

Your mission is to collect precious pearls and rare artifacts scattered across the ocean floor. But beware, a relentless octopus is on your trail, watching your every move!

As you navigate through stunning underwater landscapes, you'll need to dodge dangerous obstacles and outsmart the cunning octopus. The deeper you go, the more valuable the treasures you’ll find—but the challenges will also increase. The octopus grows faster and more cunning with each passing moment, making escape a true test of skill and strategy.

Featuring rich underwater environments, captivating graphics, and heart-pounding chases, "Deep Sea Pursuit" offers an unforgettable journey beneath the waves. How far can you go? title: Monster Energy Supercross 25 x Monster Jam Showdown: Dirt Master Edition

title: Danganronpa: Hope Recration+

title: Dots Survivors
description: DOTS Survivors is a casual action game where you play as an astronaut exploring the cosmos fending off hostile aliens along the way! As you progress through each run you can choose from a selection of futuristic weapons that can be leveled up to increase power!

title: Down Abyss
description: Down Abyss is a two-phase adventure survival game where you play as a transforming robot who protects a little girl by collecting, climbing, and fighting.

title: Dragon's Dog Mother
description: A hilarious medieval fantasy adventure with an epic world that will immerse you. Strange and diverse monsters let you build a unique team, while the funny yet profound storyline will make you laugh and ponder.

title: Drag Racing 3D: Streets 2
description: The racing simulator created on game engine with a realistic physics and wide customization options. Create a unique car, installing new parts and tuning up car characteristics. Compete with other players in various tournaments on colorful race tracks. Prove that you are worthy to be a champion!

title: Dragrave Marauders
description: A classic JRPG style semi-open world game that let's you explore how you want. Choose from many classes, collect loot, complete quests, defeat foes and meet new allies along the way! "Frequent" updates to so you can come back once in a while to experience new content!

title: Drama Queens
description: JAE-WOO JEON, a naive freshman, happened to step into the p&m theatre club. Little did he know it was a club full of flirting campus queens. Will Jae-Woo be able to safely go through his bumpy campus life?

title: Dreamline 404
description: Thank you for calling the Dreamline Service Center. We are dedicated to providing you with the highest quality dream services. How may I assist you today?

title: Dream Rhythm
description: "Dream Rhythm" is an addictive rhythm game. Simple operation, beautiful songs, bring you a dreamy flow experience.

title: Dream & Sugar
description: Welcome to Dream & Sugar, a wholesome visual novel exploring relationships, love, and the transition to adulthood. Navigate relationships with unique dialogue and branching endings in this cozy LGBTQ+ friendly otome game!

title: Drift Desert Race
description: Drift Desert Race - A wild and chaotic game where you will embark on an 8-hour non-stop journey across an endless desert, all to discover the answer to the ultimate question: "What is the meaning of life?"

title: Drift On Snow
description: Who doesn't look forward to winter as much as we do?

title: Driving Around
description: Drive through serene landscapes to the sound of relaxing lo-fi. Choose to explore a vast open world or follow an endless road, with no rush, no limits. With stunning graphics, simple controls, and a calm atmosphere, this is the perfect game to relax and enjoy the journey.
