title: Equality
description: This game features a unique design where players use the mouse to control a red ball, rotating its position to safely drop it from platforms surrounding a cylinder.

title: Erogoddess: Mirage
description: This is a dating simulator with feminized Egyptian gods. Ra, Anubis, Seth, Osiris, Horus and other gods are waiting for you. Discover new gods by spinning the wheel of fortune and go on dates with them, liberating them and undressing them. Add new goddesses to the gallery until you undress them all!

title: EroHPuzzle
description: EroHPuzzle is an anime picture puzzle game with unique photos. Connect the right pieces to move to the next level. Connect the pieces correctly and you will be relieved

title: Erotic Rhythm
description: Erotic Rhythm is a music game that will leave you wanting more, just hit the notes accurately and the girl will swing her body to the music.

title: Esca
description: Esca is a gripping survival RPG where you play as a repair robot maintaining an underwater research station, facing tough decisions and uncovering secrets of your past.

title: Escape 51
description: In Escape 51 you play as a small alien that has been mistreated by humans as he works to escape the research facility that has kept him and other aliens like him captive for so long.

title: Escape From Clive
description: Escape From Clive is a simulated real war evacuation computer game. Successfully evacuating to safety zone is your ultimate goal. Players would go into the Clive and come back with fruitful supplies. Remember that if you are ambushed, you will lose everything.

title: Escape from Haon Island
description: "Escape from HAON ISLAND" is a first-person 3D platformer with unique controls - where you find yourself on an island with happy inhabitants and try to escape.

title: Escape of Pinball
description: Act so that the enemy does not find you, shoot, run away and aim for the goal!

title: Escape Team
description: Turn your living room into an escape room!

title: Espresso Economics
description: Coffee shop management game that teaches economics. Manage your own coffee shop and make money. During the day you serve orders at your coffee shop, during the night you manage it using economics principles like demand and supply curves, labour market, externalities etc.

title: Eto
description: Balance between tactics and luck as you lead your troops across various skirmishes! This tabletop turn-based strategy game will peak your interest as you try to clear all levels in this WW2 inspired setting.

title: Eva's Hook
description: A 2.5D Platformer with a Grappling Hook, Collectibles, and a Timer for an extra Challenge while different Events are trying to make you fail, 3 different Difficulties, but even the Easiest one could be a hard time for you !

title: Everyone Fights
description: Everyone Fights is a turn based city building and conquering strategy game. Complete with a map creator, character creator, campaign, multiplayer, and loads of characters with their own unique ways to play.

title: EvolRun
description: Can you survive for years since the beginning of evolution, where you will face creatures that you must devour or flee if they are more evolved? It's a score game.

title: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
description: A run-and-gun metroidvania set in Voivod’s dystopian universe. Battle biomechanical mutants, explore a twisted post-apocalyptic world, and recover fragments of your lost mind. Featuring pixel-art visuals, tight action-platforming, and Voivod soundtrack.

title: Paranormal Files: Sacrifice to Shadows - Collector's Edition
Decomposition
description: Decomposition is a psychological horror and survival game in which you will face a deadly cult, solve challenging puzzles and explore claustrophobic environments as you fight to save your life and stop the Decomposition of the world.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 1.7 - Bury Your Tears With the Past
description:
Version 1.7 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:

• New Characters: Vivian and Hugo
• New Main Story Quest: Bury Your Tears With the Past - Part 2
• New Events
• ...and more!

title: Trilogy of the Moon
description: Immerse yourself in a romantic fantasy where past meets present! Experience a unique interactive game featuring Korea's stunning photoshoot models in this cinematic adventure.

title: Flooded Burials
description: Flooded Burials is a top-down action adventure game about exploring a tower buried in the sea. Play trough stages where you have to face combat and platforming challenges, as well as meet and talk to strange creatures.

title: Pub Toilet Simulator 25
description: In Pub Toilet Simulator 25, you're trapped in Spetherwoons pub, racing to find a toilet. Navigate endless hallways, tricky stairs, and bizarre tunnels while keeping your beer meter full. Grab pub food for points, but don’t waste time! Every wrong turn brings you closer to disaster. Will you make it?

title: The Nightmare of Pandemic: Kyle's Story
description: Kyle wakes with a headache unaware he has survived a helicopter crash in Nannestak Norway. Alone on a farm he suddenly finds himself in a space suit. A flash of light transports him back to a mission he must complete. As he progresses he experiences flashbacks uncovering pieces of his lost memory,

title: Eternal Night Town
description: Eternal Night Town is a horror game. Protagonist Xu Fan unexpectedly got a lawyer's letter about his great - aunt's inheritance. Curious, he went to her hometown. In the village, the people seemed oddly strange. Then, he entered a journey he couldn't escape.

title: After Friday
description: After Friday is a psychological horror game. Every late Friday night on your way home, you sense that someone—or something—is following you. At the same time, your memories begin to fade—perhaps they were never important to begin with.

title: Yni^
description: A sandbox game where you can explore the magical and mystical world of elementals. Create, discover and study ElfenAlien fairyy Realms of Ynithia^ and much more: yayfully emotinal fantasy, colorful amazing miracle challenges and achievements of Subculturarial living in Ypony^

title: Rain98
description: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

title: Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club
description: You wake up with amnesia in Kamitsubaki City, a city with a giant tower in its center. There, you meet a girl named Kafu Morisaki, and begin participating at the Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club at her invitation.

title: Hollow Hometown
description:
When your father calls you frightened, telling you that strange things are happening in your hometown, you decide to return to investigate.

People are no longer themselves. They fade away. They behave strangely: blank stares, icy smiles, emotionless voices.

And when your father also disappears, you realize you have no choice. You have to act.

Something is happening.

And you may be the only one really ready to deal with it.

Or die in the attempt.

The alien invasion on Italian soil is something no one expected. But you can still do something about it!

This game was made for the "SPAGHETTI INVASION GAME JAM 2025"

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 2 - Hellfire Gala
description:
It’s the most glamorous night of the year, darling - Emma Frost herself invites you to the Hellfire Gala on Krakoa! Once a year, this sovereign Mutant island opens its gates, welcoming both friend and rival alike to shape a brighter future. Now stranded in the year 2099 by a raging temporal storm, the fate of Krakoa hangs in the balance, its ecosystem suffering from dangerous chronal energy.

Can a night of glittering festivities bring unity over fine dining and dazzling conversation? Who among the attendees possesses ulterior motives or solely seeks to party? And who is the uninvited guest?

Dress your best, step through the gates, and join us for an unforgettable evening of elegance, intrigue, and power.

title: Blossoms of Eternity
description: The story of three high school students who must overcome the boundaries of time and dimensions in a death spiral to save their world from higher beings who threaten their world.

title: Insectile
description: Insectile is a creature collector RPG where you piece bugs together to form your attacks! Assemble your party of cute bugs and synergize their puzzling shapes with their unique effects!

title: Causal Loop
description: Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler that blends mind-bending mechanics with a rich sci-fi story about time, consequence, and survival. Solve intricate puzzles by using the unique “echo” mechanic to record, replay, and interact with up to three versions of your past self. Can you break the loop?

title: Skibidi Mahr Simulator 64
description:
An Indie horror platformer that takes inspiration from movie tie-in games from the early 2000s.
You play as a silent protagonist looking for a cure for a mysterious disease they are suffering from.
Travel through several eerie locations, but beware of the evil mahrnster...

title: Guess Me If You Can
description: Welcome to a museum where every picture is a real product from the internet! Explore the exhibits, guess their prices, and test your intuition - how much does that vintage toaster or rare figurine cost?

title: Darkheart: Flight of the Harpies - Collector's Edition
Angel Hua Yin
description: "Angel Hua Yin" by Xiong Da is a role-playing game (RPG) made using RPG Maker, and the game is in Simplified Chinese. The story follows an angel whose mission is to save humanity.

title: Comet Moon: The Journey Begins
description: "Comet Moon: The Journey Begins" by Xiong Da tells the story of a New Year's Eve in the late 1990s, in a port city in northern China. Ulan, a first-year student at Hongxing High School, arrives at Jiawu Square in the Fen Dan district to begin her routine duty — sweeping away the resentment in people's hearts...

title: Hotel Security
description: A first-person 3D game in which a night guard working in a hotel where an anomaly occurs finds the anomaly and reports it to the government and survives the enemy

title: The Undergrounders
description: Play as Jack in this first-person thriller where your choices determine his fate. Uncover dark secrets, solve puzzles, and navigate a world of mystery and emotional drama to save yourself and your daughter.

title: Touhou Kinjoukyou: Fossilized Wonders
description: Touhou Kinjoukyou: Fossilized Wonders is the 20th official installment of the Touhou Project. It was announced by ZUN on April 12, 2025.

title: Ultra Bravo RPG
description: Ultra Bravo RPG is a pixelated comedy RPG in which you explore a three-dimensional map while battling enemies by pressing buttons. The story takes place in the Kingdom of Shizukani, a country inhabited by only idiots. Nabeo and his no-good friends cause mayhem!

title: Vive le Roi 3
description:
«Vive le Roi 3» is a puzzle and anticipation game, without chance or timing, based on mini puzzles to be solved by choosing the right ladder on each floor to reach the king and save him from his executioner.

Inspired by the concept of labyrinths, the originality of «Vive le Roi 3» is to be able to modify the state of the active elements of the levels according to your choices.

The levels are made up of numerous obstacles, such as doors, monsters, moving guards, tunnels… They are also made up of multicolored switches allowing to invert the states of the obstacles in order to clear a path.

Crowns are placed at the end of the level and the player will have to collect them in order to collect all the cards of the kings of France.

This brain game features 1000 levels to resolve, 5296 crowns to collect and 66 French kings to discover.

The third opus has a richer narrative thanks to the history of France told through the 66 cards to collect.

Unlike previous «Vive le Roi» or even Limbo-like, the gameplay is mostly based on logic and anticipation concepts.

title: Please Help Me! I'm Stuck In Esoteric Prime Number Hell!
description: Randomly Generated Levels set to a 21edo Microtonal Soundtrack!

title: Legend Sang 5
description: Why are humans, though unable to wield magic, so obsessed with it? What is the essence of magic? Why do countless legends of magical creatures persist in a world devoid of them? What defines a "monster"? What is the nature of gods? What was wrong with the world of the past? What feels off about our world today? All these questions, reflections, and answers will gradually unfold in Legend Sang 5.

title: Unique Ladies
description: Love, fine food, and romance await! Join Laura Renaldi, a charming sales manager, on a whirlwind trip to an exclusive hospitality conference in Stockholm. Amidst galas and business deals, she’ll meet stunning women—will one be her true love? A heartwarming Yuri VN with humour, jazz, and romance!

title: Jaro TCG
description: Jaro TCG is a digital trading card game simulator where players can build decks, and engage in strategic battles using a fully customizable card system. Set in a rich original universe, Jaro TCG offers immersive mechanics, full card collection, and multiplayer duels designed to recreate the feel of a physical card game—digitally. Whether you're testing new strategies, or playing with friends, Jaro TCG is the perfect sandbox for card game enthusiasts.

title: CrazyCattle3D
description: A battle royale rage game about sheep.

title: Will Jump
description:
Discover "Will Jump," a captivating platformer that immerses you in a retro universe filled with challenges.
Play as Will, a fearless locksmith, a hero who races with his keys.
Get ready to conquer 23 thrilling levels spread across 6 unique biomes.
With its "die & retry" gameplay, each attempt will bring you closer to victory or a nervous breakdown.
Dive into this pixelated adventure and take on the challenge of conquering each platform!

title: Armored Suit Solgante: Expansion DLC
description: The war may be won, but work continues for Solgante's pilot! Joint training exercises are being held with Tomzon Base, and only Captain Will can show them how it's done by demonstrating the techniques that brought Radulta victory. Through a sequence of training battles, help the other base's soldiers learn how to fight like champions! Alternatively, you can train using your neighbor Naji's home-built simulator, and prove yourself worthy of his admiration.

title: Renegade Rush
description: Renegade Rush is a survivor-style roguelike featuring deep upgrade systems, strategic exploration, and dynamic weapon builds. Stay aware of your position in the universe—venture out to hunt and discover, but don’t stray too far from home unless you're prepared for the dangers ahead.

title: The Horde Wants You Dead
description: The Horde Wants You Dead is a casual, top-down shooter with 4-player online co-op. Ambushed by an angry horde, you and your friends face a fight for survival against thousands of relentless enemies!

title: Comfy Cosmos
description: New age chill out music. Cassette fetch quest. That's the stuff (for now)

title: Shark's Treasures Adventure
description: Plunge into danger! Dodge sharks, claim treasures, and survive the deep seas!

title: The Last Oath
description: The Last Oath is a short story based game about a knight that fell in in battle fighting for their king. You find yourself with a final task to keep your oath to the king. Complete this task as you find out more about the world by interacting with the environment through text based dialogue.

title: Ninja: ShadowBlade
description: In this survival, hack and slash 2D action-platformer game, you are a ninja wielding the ancient but powerful ShadowBlade. You must hunt two powerful sorcerers who control a shifting maze & kill them to escape. But beware—every vanished wall may spawn deadly foes like fire spirits & zombie ninjas.

title: Late Ming Fly Guy
description: A platformer where players use arrow keys and spacebar to jump/fly. The game randomly generates floating platforms and obstacles, and players can choose to collide with monsters to eliminate them or dodge them, challenging themselves to continuously ascend upward.

title: Trawler’s Empire
description: Build your fishing empire in this relaxing idle tycoon game. Upgrade your boat, explore new waters, catch rare fish, and earn profits—even while offline. Master the seas and grow your Trawler's Empire!

title: Horror Tale 3: The Witch
description:
In this episode you will come face to face with Wanda the Witch, and also meet new friends. You will open many completely new locations, and learn more about the past of the terrible child kidnapper, which will lead you to new frightening discoveries. On the way to the goal, puzzles, moments of horror, unexpected turns and a lot of fun await you!

The story will develop rapidly and very unpredictably. This horror game is an exciting, fun, and scary adventure to the neighborhood of America of the '90s.

title: Paragon of Time
description: Crush the darkness that is corrupting time itself. Wield mighty artifacts, forge legendary weapons, and conquer the horrors that seek to break you, in this roguelite, dark-fantasy adventure.

title: Orbituous
description: Orbituous is a fast-paced, retro-style brick breaker with a dark twist. What begins as a casual arcade game slowly unravels into something… off. Break bricks, survive glitchy levels, and uncover secrets hidden beneath the pixels.

title: Andria
description: A Sci-fi First-Person-Shooter set on the Moons of Jupiter and Saturn. Scan the local alien creatures and robots to obtain technical data. Battle the guard robots and defeat the Master AI.

title: Misty's Super Golf Solitaire
description: Misty's Super Golf Solitaire is a Golf Solitaire variant with deck-building. Earn gold coins to buy unique cards to maintain your winning streak while you aim for the highest rank. Features classical music and turn-of-the-century-inspired backgrounds all in a nostalgic 16-bit style.

title: Hentai Lucia
description: Hentai Lucia is not just a puzzle game — it’s a journey into a world of seduction, where every scene reveals a new secret of the succubus. Unlock all of her secrets and become part of her unforgettable adventures!

title: A Simple Platformer
description: Your objective is to reach the end of the game while avoiding obstacles along the way some of the obstacles are spikes, thwomps (objects that kill you and move up and down), platforms that disappear on a timer, lasers, bullet spawners, and much much more. Good Luck :)

title: Univocity
description: Univocity is a short cyberpunk visual novel wrapped in neon aesthetics with a lush atmospheric soundtrack, featuring a deep and emotional conversation between two people about taking down a global tech monopoly.

title: Iron Onslaught
description: Iron Onslaught is a wave-based game where you survive an endless wave of bots and mechs, and the only way to survive is to kill to unlock new weapons before you're overpowered by them. So sit back, relax, and survive the ever-growing horde.

title: King of the Chat
description: Transform your Twitch chat into a marble battle! Viewers spend channel points or bits spawn in as marbles for a plinko-style challenge, earning points which can be spent attacking the throne. This stream overlay to automatically incentivizes viewer engagement, non-obtrusively, with zero effort!

title: Cryptigma
description: Cryptigma is a top-down innovative puzzle game where you can move your own respawn point. Most levels have a respawn point, which can be pushed to maneuver your way around obstacles. With only a few mechanics, the puzzles get shockingly complicated. Push, die, and solve this great game!

title: Archon: Initiator
description: Strategically place blocks, clear lines, create combos, and complete diverse missions in an audio-reactive neon world. Unlock powerful abilities or unwind with endless, zen-like puzzle gameplay.

title: Museums of History
description: Explore history like never before in Museums of History! Customize your avatar, solve puzzles, collect virtual passport stamps, and connect with players worldwide in this immersive multiplayer adventure.

title: Signal Creek
description: Explore the abandoned Signal Creek Shopping Mall in this dialogue-rich pixel art RPG. Playing as college student Nour, you must guide your companions through encounters with the past.

title: Fantasy Quest Realm Survival
description: Hunt monsters, collect crystals, stay alive in a mystical realm.

title: Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source
description: Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source is a hardcore survival roguelike auto-shooter game. Assemble a unique team, strategically utilize traps and mechanisms, and endure the endless waves of zombies to emerge victorious!

title: Pako 4
description: Action-packed crime "simulator" with lots of driving, running, gunning and doing crimes!

title: SubPixels
description: What happens when three tiny rectangles—Rub, Gub, and Bub—get lost from their screen? Chaos! Help them jump, stack, and puzzle their way back home in this fun, casual 2D platformer. Simple, colorful, and just the right amount of tricky!

title: Kintsugi: A Journey Through the Broken Pieces
description: KINTSUGI is a 3D puzzle game inspired by the ancient Japanese art of repairing ceramics, which transforms cracks into decorative features, highlighting their beauty with gold.

title: My Hidden Dreams
description: Immerse yourself in a world of cute and eerie dreams! Find, deconstruct, and assemble the thoughts and desires of the characters. Go through all the stages of personal development by helping the sleepers find answers.

title: Death Pit Explorer
description: Fly through a deadly pit to see what horrible secret lay at its deepest depth.

title: Dungemon
description: Raise and battle your very own Dungemon virtual pets! Battle your pets against wild Dungemon to make them even stronger! Train your creatures and increase their level enough to get them to evolve into stronger versions of themselves. Train and battle 90 different pets.

title: Barro F25
description: Barro F25 is pure speed! The fastest version ever created promises to push you to the limit with extraordinary performance and adrenaline at its peak. Get ready to dominate the tracks!

title: Shape Brawl
description: “Shape Brawl” is a 2D synthesis-based bullet hell shooting game.

title: The Room in a Glass Box
description: Escape a captivating diorama! Rotate, zoom, and solve puzzles to find the key. Explore a miniature world and unlock its secrets!

title: AnderKant 4
description: The 4th in the series. Discover more enhanced Visuals and great Music while you move through 7 different universes of your choosing in a fully 3D immersive first-person experience.

title: Blade vs. Undead
description: This is a top-down survival shooter game where players must fight for survival on a battlefield filled with skeleton soldiers.

title: Meow Time Machine: Newton
description: This is an immersive hidden object puzzle game that takes you through time to explore the extraordinary life of physics genius Isaac Newton. From the inspiration under the apple tree to the publication of 'Principia Mathematica', from Trinity College Cambridge to the Royal Society, every step is a journey into scientific mysteries.

title: Dino & Chill
description: Hatch and collect adorable dinosaurs that roam your screen while you work or play! Watch them gather gems, unlock perks, and customize your setup. Move and resize them freely, even across multiple monitors. But be careful—these dinos can get messy, so don't forget to clean up after them!

title: Doorz
description: Step into a world of mystery and riddles! Test your wits at every turn. Solve the riddles, unlock the doors, and uncover the truth behind this world as you journey toward the final showdown with the ultimate boss.

title: Can You Reach 60 Seconds
description: In this game you just have to wait 60 seconds to win, but every second, your chances of getting to the next one reduces. That's it! Can you reach 60 seconds?

title: Ars Vox Arcana
description: Cast spells with your voice in a fantasy world shaped by language and will. Originally designed for VR, but fully playable on PC without a headset. Your voice is your power—no matter how you play.

title: Little Tank
description: Shoot the Skeletons & Defend the Goddess statue. Enjoy the excitement when shooting the skeletons with a cannon ball. Fulfill your curiosity by exploring the map and crafting different items to help you win the game!

title: Crash Bandicoot: The Secret Place
description: Crash Bandicoot - The Secret Place is a fan made Crash Bandicoot game on Gamejolt made by KaloyGames. Crash must collect the crystals needed in order to defeat the Giant Golem in order to restore peace back into the world.

title: Battlers of Ekrasys
description: An idle auto-battler hero builder all about experimentation. Defeat waves of monsters and bosses to learn their spells! Craft jewels, enhance them with the smithmagic system, and fuse over 70 unique abilities to discover powerful synergies and evolve your build.

title: This Is Not A Love Letter
description:
Your name is Wilbur Soot.

You don't technically have an invite to this party, but technicalities have never kept you out of Las Nevadas. The air is cool, the night is young, and a hand penned letter is burning a hole in your pocket.

title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders - Baifushan
description:
Baifushan is a free update to the game, available now on Xbox and Steam. It is inspired by the beauty of Chinese mountainscapes and might be the most gorgeous mountain we ever made - it is definitely the biggest.

Baifushan offers four new trails with two slopes each, new challenges, new achievements, full multiplayer support for racing, team mode, quickmatches, private tours, and leaderboards.

title: Call of Duty: Spain at War
description:
Call Of Duty: Spain At War is a mod for Call of Duty: World At War, set in the war that devastated Spain in the 30s, the Spanish Civil War,offering a vision as closely as possible about what happened historically.
Call Of Duty: Spain At War aims to teach and entertain all those lovers of history and war games like Call of Duty, through a campaign mode, multiplayer and zombies mode.

title: Muffles' Life Sentence: Episode 2
description: EPISODE 2 of Muffles' journey. A darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are remade to match their crimes.

title: In a World After People
description: A robot awakens alone in a desolate world where humanity has vanished due to a plague. In this side-scrolling pixel art adventure, the robot, having lost its memory, retraces its past interactions with humans to rediscover the meaning of "love."

title: Gloamvault
description: "90s Black Metal Monster Collector!" In Gloamvault, you can charm any monster you encounter and add it to your party. Create a party with up to five minions and descend into the depths of the dungeon. Fuse any two monsters together to create stronger ones. Good luck surviving...

title: Abyss Ring
description: Survive, cook, and conquer the depths! In this survival roguelike, cook monsters to stave off hunger through 100 floors of dungeons. With over 200 equipment and randomly generated dungeon, every playthrough offers fresh challenges and endless possibilities.

title: Dyping Escape
description: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

title: Hololive Holo's Hanafuda
description: Holo's Hanafuda is banter-filled hanafuda battler featuring hololive talent!

title: Prize Denied
description: Prize Denied! Manage a claw machine arcade in this cozy management sim. Build challenging claw machines and play surprising cards to stop players from getting a prize! Earn money to unlock new arcades, collect cards, upgrade machines, and become the best arcade in the...UNIVERSE!

title: Cat Golf
description: Cat Golf is a fresh and exciting action-golf game where you can tee off in all sorts of unexpected places across a city! The star of the show? A round, adorable cat! The golf course is an Japanese town. Set off on a laid-back, carefree adventure as you and your cat zip freely through the city!

title: Beak Island Visitor Center
description: Congrats! You're now in charge of Beak Island's visitor center. This old gem's a bit rusty, and help's scarce, but don't let that stop you! Spruce up the island, cook up some treats, and bring back the buzz from 50 years ago. It's all in your hands now!

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character Set - Sandalphon
description:
Set Contents:
• Playable Character: Sandalphon
• Premium Avatar: Sandalphon
• Badge: Sandalphon
• Weapon Cutout: Apprentice
• Figure Studio poses 1–6 and expressions 1–7 for Sandalphon

title: Brave New Wonders
description: Automate, optimize, and build vast factories in a post-apocalyptic automation game for those who have evolved beyond conveyor belts. Command intelligent robots that obey your plain-text commands in any language, explore the ruins of a lost civilization, and rebuild humanity one machine at a time.

title: Dream Garden
description: An easygoing simulation game about creating tiny garden dioramas. Use a wide selection of plants, decorations and tools to build and nurture the garden retreat of your dreams.

title: Cosmolace
description: A narrative-driven puzzle game that combines "optical illusions" with "single-stroke puzzle" as its theme. Players rotate their perspective in a 3D space, using optical illusions to connect vertexes and segments, completing the patterns in each level with a single stroke.

title: The Litter: Trigo
description: A playful way to learn trigonometry, with quirky characters and interactive challenges.

title: Shrink Rooms
description: Run! The rooms are shrinking! A puzzle game Demo about escaping from shrinking rooms. Every step counts if you want to make it out alive! Complete box-pushing puzzles within a limited number of steps or be crushed into a puddle of meat by the pressing walls of the level!

title: The Greenening
description: The Greenening is a short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

title: Ritual Party
description: In Ritual Party you get to summon Cthulhu with your friends! Work together (or not) with 1-4 players to perform wild rituals, unlocking cosmic horrors from the Cthulhu mythos. Chaotic party game where summoning eldritch beings is only half the fun!

title: Bunny
description: "BUNNY" is a side-scrolling action game where Bunny and Smallbird embark on an adventure to find their friends. Control Bunny as you navigate through stages, overcoming obstacles and squeezing through walls. There's no game over, so everyone can play through to the end.

title: Cannoneer Girls
description:
"1·Shot·1·Reload" High school girls in pixel art battle in a chaotic 3-on-3 cannon brawl! Drive opponents to the brink and blast them away with a cannon shot!

Hougeki Shoujo is a 3-vs-3 competitive 2.5D shooting action game where high school girls battle it out with their trusty cannons! The game features a single-reload, single-shot system—you only have one chance to dodge an enemy shot to avoid immediate elimination! Win a round by wiping out the opposing team. The first team to win three rounds claims victory! Encircle your opponents and seize victory with a decisive shot! The game features simple, intuitive controls. You can tell when your shot is ready by the ammo icon that appears next to your character’s username. Use cute emotes and chat with your allies and opponents!

title: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
description: The citizens led by Saitama rise up in rebellion! The epic battle to defeat Tokyo begins now! Get hooked on the unique, wobbly limb controls! Dash through 3D-rendered "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" worlds in this innovative platformer like no other!

title: Rizuhuritan! Rhythmic Flip (Re)Turn
description: It is a journey that guides lost beings home "Rizufuritan!" is a Memory-based Flip-and-Rhythm Game where you memorize living things and press your favorite key to the Rhythm

title: Magical Girl Critical Deluxe
description: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

title: Crescent Tower
description: Aspire to reach the top of Crescent Tower that appears just once every 50 years! An authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawler RPG with a retro level of difficulty, where you repeatedly explore, level up, and traverse dungeons!

title: Mottainai Ghost
description: Don't allow food waste! A horror-flavored, exploration-based gluttonous adventure game where you aim to escape the apartment while running from the MOTTAINAI GHOST!

title: Doomed Otaku
description: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

title: Super Shinobi Den
description: A unique ninja action game that's easy to clear but hard to master—featuring huge jumps inspired by The Legend of Kage and a combo-based scoring system where you spend points to unleash powerful skills.

title: RrrrrAbbits
description: Protect... Grow... The herd is everything! As the leader rabbit, your mission is to rescue your captured friends and protect your herd! If you lose your herd, it's game over! Find and recruit allies with special abilities to strengthen your herd, and challenge the crows' dungeons!

title: Ramen Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of crafting the perfect bowl of ramen? In Ramen Simulator, you can unleash your creativity and build your own unique ramen style!

title: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
description: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.

title: Platina: Lab
description:
‘PLATiNA :: LAB’ is a rhythm game that features a classic top-down note drop play style.
Play a variety of tracks across different genres, connect with unique and charming DB(character) units, and discover the distinctive appeal that only PLATiNA :: LAB can offer.

title: Mochi-O
description: A doomsday land defense adventure in which you raise MOCHI-O, a weapon of annihilation that looks a lot like a hamster, to protect your country. Pet and raise MOCHI-O to defeat the oncoming enemies and fight through the tender post-apocalypse.

title: Do Not Play
description: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

title: GilGul
description: Why Do People Want to Die? Why Don't People Want to Die? This is a story about a group of girls in a world that exists in limbo between life and death. Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.

title: Hyke: Northern Light(s)
description: The young witch Hyke's adventure begins! A thrilling 2D top-down action pixel RPG. Relax and camp with your companions!

title: Magical Princess
description: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

title: Lilith's Game
description: Face the demon queen Lilith in high-stakes, asymmetrical chess matches. Capture all of her pieces, except one! Carefully sacrifice your own pieces, use special items, and outthink Lilith’s unpredictable moves to gain the upper hand.

title: Cybervoid
description: Cybervoid is a sci-fi point-and-click RPG adventure. Sent on a mysterious mission, will you follow orders or forge your own path? Manage your time and energy wisely exploring a city on the edge of salvation or ruin and in doing so, ultimately discover your connection to this city and its fate.

title: Stackmancy
description: Stackmancy is a fast-paced roguelite card game where you pop spell packs, stack powerful combos, and eliminate enemies on your journey to become the Grand Stackmancer.

title: DMZ: Nuclear Survival
description: DMZ: Nuclear Survival is a multiplayer open-world survival crafting game set in a post-apocalyptic world after nuclear war. Build a private military company, train survivors as soldiers, explore a vast procedurally generated map, uncover relics from ancient ruins, and fight for survival.

title: The Massive Iceberg Schoolhouse
description:
While you were on YouTube, you found a series by Sweguin called Massive YouTube Iceberg Explained where he explains every entry on the Massive YouTube Iceberg (obviously), and it apparently has 1000+ entries. Not only you absolutely loved the series, you wanted to look at more massive iceberg charts like the one in that series. Eventually, you heard that the iceberg's creator, Potted Plant, is making an internet iceberg with 5000+ entries. So just like any sensible person would, you developed a parasocial relationship with him and constantly DMed him on Discord to see the internet iceberg.

A few days later, Potted Plant told you that he just opened a schoolhouse in Thailand where there's not just one, but TEN iceberg charts you can get there, so you immediately booked a ticket to Thailand and travelled to his epic schoolhouse to collect all iceberg charts he made. However, there's a little catch! Potted Plant set it up so you have to answer questions about iceberg charts before retrieving them, and answering incorrectly isn't exactly the best idea in a Thai school. Not only that, he's also brought his whole gang (most of it somehow being entries from his YouTube iceberg) to stop you from collecting all of his icebergs so easily, so you must be careful!

You could either get all 10 of the iceberg charts and exit the school, or you could dive deeper into the iceberg schoolhouse and research some of its interesting anomalies...

title: Remains of Yith
description: Remains of Yith is a point and click adventure puzzle game inspired by The Shadow Out of Time by H.P Lovecraft, play as Sarah as she explores a mysterious island trying to recover a lost alien artifact

title: TemplarGFX's Aliens Colonial Marines Overhaul
description: This mod includes fixes to AI, Weapons, Graphics, balancing and more for the Main Campaign, Statis Interrupted and Bug Hunt in SP and COOP along with restoring content.

title: Kill All Enemies
description: Kill all enemies, Upgrade, Repeat! Defeat thousands of enemies in this incremental roguelite and become unstoppable as you progress through the game.

title: Jeune Styliste: Haute couture
description: The first game in the Jeune Styliste saga, developed by Carré Multimedia and edited by Ubisoft, released exclusively in French.

title: Jeune Styliste 2: Studio
description: After Young Stylist, the first haute couture design game, Young Stylist 2 lets you create trendy outfits, design the ones you'd love to have and the ones your favorite stars wear!

title: Jeune Styliste 3: Star
description: Young Stylist 3 Star on PC lets you create the look of the stars. Imagine their outfits for a concert, a fashion show, or an interview on the Croisette... Rediscover the world of the Young Stylist collection with Anna, the faithful assistant. Apply makeup with professional precision: blush, eyeliner, lipstick... Cast your cast and stage your fashion show. Choose the decor, music, and order of appearances to bask in the glory.

title: Jeune Styliste 4: World
description: Travel the world from Tokyo to London as the loyal assistant to the renowned Anna, and mix and match fashions to create the most beautiful collection! With the JS-Line, exchange your designs online with other players and receive new items regularly thanks to the Young Stylist Club. Pop Music, Manga, Marie-Antoinette... 6 new styles to mix and match to create the craziest creations!

title: Meganaut
description: A 3rd person narrative horror game with modernized retro 3D graphics, and unique floating mechanics. Travel past The Habitat walls into the deep megastructure in search of your missing friend Seija, and find out why he left.

title: Metal Gun III: Shout of the Arms
description: A unique doujin fighting game where players uses fire weapons to win. It's kinda a mix between a 2D fighting game and Metal Slug.

title: Stardom Warriors: LaSalle Ishii's Childs Quest
description: This is a recreation of the original Famicom game, LaSalle Ishii's Childs Quest, featuring both the Stardom Warriors localization and a new version with a translation of the original content.

title: Cosmic Fear
description: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. What lies hidden in the depths of the cosmos? Explore, solve puzzles and survive in this disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure.

title: Kollywood: The Game
description: Kollywood: The Game is a stop motion video, comedy game with quick-time event fight scenes inspired by Tamil Cinema.

title: Captured 2
description: You're trapped in an apartment with ever-changing rooms. Capture anomalies on camera, survive deadly entities and escape an endless nightmare.

title: Funshiki
description: Funshiki is a 3D action game where you control a rocket-powered box sliding over a frictionless surface, much like ice skating. The game is heavily based on inertia and momentum. You must carefully manage your thrust using rocket engines on the front and back of the box to move, stop, or turn. The objective on each stage is to collect all the gems while avoiding walls and obstacles.

title: Baku Funshiki
description: Baku Funshiki is a hard-mode sequel to the game Funshiki. It features 10 extremely challenging stages, far more difficult than the original. The core gameplay remains the same: controlling a rocket-powered box on a frictionless surface using inertia-based mechanics to collect items and avoid obstacles.

title: El gaucho Martín Fierro
description: Through various minigames, the player will discover the story of the legendary gaucho, narrated in verses taken directly from the original work (book). Each level offers a different mechanic, from rhythm challenges and skill-based tests to duels and puzzles, reflecting different moments of Fierro's journey.

title: BitLiberator
description: BitLiberator is a strategy/puzzle/action game where you eliminate corrupted Programs by either destroying them or reprogramming them. You can control friendly reprogrammed Programs and connect them into more powerful structures. You can also apply Upgrades to your Programs, allowing them to perform actions such as shooting enemies, shielding themselves from enemy fire, or slowing enemies down. However, be warned that, over time, corrupted Programs will detect you and start moving toward you.

title: Excommunicated
description: A typing game of investigation in a space base

title: Exo Wanderers
description: This is a sci-fi top-down tank shooting game that can be played solo or with two players. As human civilization is on the brink of extinction, you will take on the role of one or two "Exo Wanderers," seeking the truth of the Galactic and Earth civilizations on Gliese 667Ce.

title: Exsanguination
description: Exsanguination is a fast-paced, first-person melee combat game where you play as a former vampire hunter turned into a vampire. With your new vampiric powers, fight against your enemies to reclaim your humanity in a dark, brutal world.

title: Eye on You!
description: Control your gaze with the arrow keys and stop the cute prisoners from escaping! A surveillance action game that requires quick decision-making and full concentration!

title: Face The Abyss
description: The experiment has failed. The facility that was supposed to control the monster has stopped working, and now your only hope is to escape the facility before the monster hunts you down.

title: Fairealm
description: Immerse yourself in an engaging story that is rich in content and escape into Fairealm, a turn-based RPG game with 5+ hours of gameplay powered by RPG Maker MZ. Follow relatable characters as they use a variety of learned spells to defeat monsters and explore the Forbidden Lands!

title: Fairealm: Treasure Raids
description: Fairealm - Treasure Raids contains: - A Stand-Alone Mini Game the continues the story beyond the Forbidden Lands - A thank you note from Quest Moon Studios - A short graphic novel about how it all started (available as soon as it is completed, check DLC every so often)

title: Faith of Life: Survive Edition
description: Third-person combat shooter that mixes zombies, action, horror, and sci-fi elements. It features two distinct missions' modes and an exhilarating arena. Enjoy and have a fantastic time!

title: Fall From Eden
description: The world is divided in three realms. Eden is the realm that keeps the world together, when a unknown force threatens it's balance, it's time for an incursion between all realms to find the solution.

title: Falling Cube
description: Falling Cube plunges you into an adrenaline-pumping adventure where every second counts.

title: Falling Flower
description: "I have to defeat the Demon King and return home cursed."

title: Familiar Friends: What's Your Familiar?
description: A cute and cozy Visual Novel experience with plenty of choices to make! Come find the Familiar truly meant for you by feeding The Conjuring Cauldron with a multitude of choices, all to a relaxing Original Soundtrack!

title: Fantasy Memory: A Relaxing Match Game
description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Fantasy Memory: A Relaxing Match Game! This exciting and educational card-matching challenge is designed to sharpen your memory and boost cognitive skills.

title: No Fap Island
description: No Fap Island is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel. Set in a reality TV show surrounded by five gorgeous women can you evade the view of the cameras and find a way to get dirty with the ladies? Build relationships, go on hot dates, have sex and get ready for a vacation you'll never forget!

title: Farming
description: Farming is a Trading Card Game (TCG). Every 2 hours of online planting will yield a basic crop skin. There is a 30% chance to also yield a rare crop skin each time you yield. In this game you can enhance the level of your crop skins to improve your collection, and join us to make your farm unique!

title: Farming Isles
description: A relaxing farming simulator game that has the player focusing on resource management by maintaining growing crops, watering farmland, building additional structures for extending the stock.

title: Idle Farming Business
description: Build your farm empire

title: Fate of the Three Kingdoms
description: A collectible turn base strategy card game. Collect all the cards, rank up in multiplayer and/or complete the scenarios in solo play.

title: Fault 24
description: Fault 24 propels you into the heart of an abandoned spaceship, lost in the depths of the galaxy. Armed with only your courage and rudimentary tools, you must explore the bowels of this empty shell to unravel the mystery of its past. Each corridor crossed, each door opened brings you a little closer to the truth, but also to imminent danger.

title: Fayrehaven
description: Fayrehaven is a relaxing single-player trading and travelling game. Trade goods and cargo for upgrades. Explore Fayrehaven lake to find great deals for profit.

title: Fear of the Light
description: A survival horror game where light is scarier than darkness. Use your radar and other tools to stay out of the light, sneak around dangers, explore the quarantined ship, and find a way to escape. But be careful, monsters are hunting you and are aware of your every mistake!

title: Fellchaser
description: You've stolen Death's scythe in an attempt to cheat your fate. Now you must escape Purgatory by brewing combo-building potions and reaping hordes of creatures in this hack and slash Roguelike!

title: Fell in love with the Nobility girl As a member of the rebel organization
description: The Kingdom of Caeser is facing internal and external difficulties. As the captain of the rebel army, I met Cosgray, the daughter of the Duke who was loyal to the Kingdom of Caeser, at this time. In my interactions with her, she has become increasingly unforgettable to me.

title: Femboy Feet
description: Feet and Femboys? What more could a man ask for. Pursue your femboy fantasy solving unique puzzles to unlock the ultimate femboy.

title: Fighting Monsters In West Province
description: Fighting Monsters In West Province is a side scrolling action game that embarks on a thrilling journey in a fantasy world.Defeat monsters with skill and courage,unravel conspiracies with wisdom and experience.You are not fighting alone,your friends in the Local Area Network will fight alongside you.

title: Fightland
description: Mysterious cosmic forces have created the Fightland, and they’ve plucked warriors from across space and time to do battle there. Join with up to 100 other players in this massive team battle arena game where individual skill, squad tactics, and overall teamwork will determine the victor!

title: Figure it Out!
description: A puzzle game with an eye in it. And it's free. The game, not the eye.

title: Figure Skating Legends
description: Step into the dazzling world of ice and artistry with Figure Skating Legends, the ultimate figure skating experience! Whether you're a seasoned skating enthusiast or a curious newcomer, this game invites you to glide, spin, and jump your way to glory.

title: Final Hour
description: In a world on its deathbed, explore and connect with your neighbors for one last day.

title: Final Rounds
description: That's the final round, I swear this time, one last time for today... Final Rounds is a simple, yet highly addictive arcade game. Avoid the obstacles, enjoy the levels and beat your highscores!

title: Final Rounds: DLC
description: This is a DLC for Final Rounds, which unlocks all game content at the start

title: Find All Things
description: Welcome to the world of puzzles in the new exciting game Find All Things! Play a variety of mini-games in different themed locations, from Japan to a car repair shop. Look for hidden objects, find pairs, solve puzzles, enjoy match-3 games or train your memory, all in one game.

title: Find Charlie
description: Find 40 little Charlies in an interactive cartoon world. Some can be spotted by careful obersavation. For others, you need to interact with the world and solve a few puzzles.

title: Firework Defence
description: Use a variety of fireworks to fend off misfortune and protect your family!

title: First Steps in Child Developmental Support
description: Yuuka, a nursing student, is doing a summer practicum at a Child Development Support Center. Explore the facility in a role-playing format and experience child support activities. Learn about medical care, therapeutic interventions, and home healthcare over three days.

title: Fit-Right-In
description: Shape-shift your way through crazy wall cutouts in this fast-paced game show! Will you take the top spot in the most prestigious game show in the world and be among the greats?

title: Fix-mas
description: 『Fix-mas』 is a top-view action game centered on Just Avoidance. Make a screw over the enemy's head with magic bullets and accurate evasion, rush it in and throw it in! Make a screw over the enemy's head with a magic bullet, rush it in and throw it in!

title: Flag or Rage
description: Flag or Rage is a physics-based platformer game for up to 8 players! Choose and place obstacles and platforms, cooperate with your teammates to reach the top and capture the flag, or cunningly hinder your opponents and survive alone.

title: Floating Star
description: Play as a lone space traveler, floating in the galaxy while exploring the boundaries of human civilization.

title: Fluffquake Fury
description: A light-hearted, fun, simple RPG where you play as bedroom hero Pippa Pillowfeather and try and beat lights out by using her Pillow to defeat any monsters in the bedroom! Use new pillow attack abilities as she progresses to different bedroom scenes.

title: Focus Simulator
description: Practice Pulling focus On 11 Total different Lenses and a Multitude of scenarios!

title: Foot Lovers
description: FOOT LOVERS - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Forest Asylum
description: A short Psychological Horror Experience for one night that takes you through the dark corridors of a mental asylum. For best experience a dark room and headphones recommended.

title: Bear Escape Mission
description: A simple, casual platformer with 40 short levels and infinite lives.

title: Clean Start
description: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

title: Remote Realms
description:
Remote Realms is a retro-inspired free-to-play MMORPG with no pay-to-win microtransactions. Its addictive gameplay will entice you to jump into very long but satisfying grinds.

The game offers 26 skills to train, 20 quests and 9 tasks to complete, and lots of difficult bosses to slay.
Whether you are looking to compete in a fierce fight of the top spot, exploring everything in the world or fighting numerous monsters, the game has got you covered.

title: Rapid Impact
description: Rapid Impact is an online PvP-PvE shooter in a post-apocalyptic world. Fight players or AI in various modes. The game evolves with community feedback, shaping its future through player voting! Wishlist Rapid Impact now and be among the first to experience intense PvP-PvE battles!

title: Spell Wizard
description: Unleash powerful magic with your keyboard in this fast-paced Typing game with Roguelite elements. Battle relentless waves of enemies by typing the words tethered to them to cast spells. Collect gems to master new abilities and grow stronger each run.

title: Pigeon Blood
description: Hidden in a forest lies an extravagant residence. It is owned by our protagonist, known only as Chris. Chris is the latest in a family line of sex-slave trainers. His latest acquisition, a girl named Rita, is to be completely trained within six months. Our hero is also a bit of an enigma, for he has actually lost most of his memories. However, as the training of Rita continues, he begins to slowly piece together the fragmented events of his life. Chris will occasionally get help from his two assistants; conveniently each of them embodying either sadism or masochism.

title: Ex World Online
description:
Ex world Online is a Free to play anime inspired small scale MMORPG developed by Z house Studios. The features and mechanics in Ex World are heavily inspired by social and combat mechanics from a plethora of favorite anime we enjoy, this will give players the feeling of a fast-paced hybrid combat game that will give players a true mastery over their respective class choice. The approach we are taking with Ex world is an old school class and character progression type while maintaining a healthy balance between old school & modern gameplay mechanics.

Ex World will feature three races at the start of the game. Humans, Vampires, and Werewolves. It’s important to note that while there are selectable races, Ex world is not faction based. Each race has multiple common classes shared across the spectrum, while maintaining their own class identity.

title: Niut
description: Niut is kidnapped and sent to an unknown planet (Anthara), where she will have to survive alongside other people who share the same destiny, fight against powerful enemies of other morphologies and delve into the mysteries hidden in this new stellar wasteland.

title: Eldritch Evolution
description: Eldritch Evolution is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where eldritch power comes at a cost. Wield unique spells, unleash devastating curses and perform forbidden rituals to transform your abilities and survive the horrors. Every run is a descent into madness—evolve, adapt, and embrace the unknown.

title: Project Lambro: Part One
description:
"You’ve returned to your parents’ house after a long time, just to attend one of those school reunions you’ve always hated.

Sleeping in your old bedroom again feels strange, but it brings back a lot of good memories.

Your parents left for the weekend, even though a bad storm was forecast…

It’s the middle of the night, the storm has arrived, and a deafening noise suddenly wakes you up."

"Project Lambro – Prima parte" is the first part of the game. It was created to participate in the Spaghetti Invasion Game Jam 2025

title: Ultra Gravity
description: Game where you can test your reflexes, moving at high speeds and avoiding obstacles.

title: Neon Knights
description: Neon Knights is an action-packed, neon-drenched brawler that’s all about local & online multiplayer madness.

title: Star Wars Zero Company
description: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company, a single-player turn-based tactics game.

title: A Dream About Parking Lots
description: Look for your car in a series of mazes and parking lots while you talk to your therapist about feeling lost. An interactive short story about trying to make sense out of the unreal. Based on real dreams!

title: Thomas: The Shank Engine
description: A horror game mimicking a VHS-styled movie based on Thomas the Tank Engine, intent on haunting the player.

title: Golden Soul
description: Who should rule the human's fate: The human itself or an abstract god?

title: The Night Museum
description: The Night Museum needs a night clerk. The job is simple: take the money, give the tickets, and keep the exhibits under control. Just follow the rules, and you’ll make it through the night... probably.

title: Five Nights Before Freddy's
description: You are hired to work the night shift, 12AM to 6AM, for five days before the grand reopening, to observe the animatronics since they can roam around at night, but you begin to see there's more to their roaming, they're acting mysterious...

title: Five Nights at Freddys: Final Hours
description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food as far as the eye can see! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it was much cheaper to hire you as a security guard than to find a repairman.

title: Bonnie Simulator
description: This is a game where you are playing as Bonnie from Five Nights at Freddy's. It is your quest to get to the office and get the night guard before the clock reaches 6 AM.

title: Lost in the Secret!
description: This an adventure based live action interactive game，you need to save passengers from a plane crash. Beautiful nurses, graceful flight attendants, cool rich women, cool bloggers, and mysterious women in red all need your help. Whether to save yourself or rescue everyone, it's up to you to decide!

title: Daikoukai Jidai Gaiden
description:
Daikoukai Jidai Gaiden is a Strategy game, developed and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 1997.

Uncharted Waters is a popular Japanese video game series produced by Koei as part of its rekoeition games. In East Asia, the series has a large cult following, but has not received much recognition outside East Asia. The series has been compared to Sid Meier's Pirates! in gameplay and theme. It is a simulation and CRPG series dealing with sailing and trading.

Daikoukai Jidai Gaiden is a side story released in 1997 on PlayStation and Sega Saturn after New Horizons, the game uses the same engine and focuses on the story of two characters instead, further expounding upon the loose plot that ties the series together.

title: Watch Party
description: Enjoy a single-player horror game, about escaping your favorite streamer. Check your phone to know his location as you hide in closets, and behind furniture, grabbing whatever you need to escape your home.

title: Brews & Blood: Origin
description: On the night of the Red Moon, you take over your uncle's liquor shop in a remote Indian village as a favor. What starts as a routine shift soon spirals into a night of terror. Will you survive until dawn?

title: Backrooms Multi-Verses
description: Survival horror with realistic graphics based on Unreal Engine 5. Ten highly detailed levels: liminal world, puzzles and creatures. New levels and content regularly. Experience unbearable horror and find a way to escape from...

title: K.I.D.N.A.P
description: K.I.D.N.A.P is a psychological horror puzzle game. You play as an ordinary man who has been kidnapped and trapped in a rundown, old-fashioned room. In this eerie environment, you must find a way to escape by solving puzzles—or doing whatever it takes. Good luck.

title: Spider Land
description: There's a spider haunting these hills.

title: Oppressed
description: Our protagonist Luke finds himself in a hallway with a gun on the floor, not knowing how he got there. He has no idea how and why he ended up here. The writing on the walls tells him to move through the corridors and find anomalies.

title: Dead Format
description: Dead Format is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".

title: Jester: A Foolish Ritual
description: A co-op survival horror game. Play as one of four knights, resurrected in an abandoned castle. Search for hidden runes, unlock the way forward and finish the ritual before the Jester hunts you down.

title: Evil Lurks Below
description: Paranormal detective Harry Walters investigates the mysterious case of the missing Gilman family. Following rumors of supernatural events, he visits their abandoned home for clues. He uncovers disturbing memories and a hidden hatch leading to a mysterious area beneath the house.

title: Eyes of the Sky
description: A stylish Hack-and-Slash! Combine sword techniques and powerful spells as you switch between forms, each with a unique set of moves. Traverse the inner world of Toshiro, the master mage, as he struggles to regain his lost memories before the forces of the Abyss claim his world

title: Face to Face
description: A satisfying action puzzle game that merges the physics of Suika Game with a SUPER COOL set-matching mechanic.

title: Stagees: Just Play!
description: Stagees is an interactive music platform where the user experience will be a “short cut” to music playing and gives an instant feel of being able to play the sounds for any song in the world, simply by using only a few buttons. Try out the included songs, import own songs, or check out the Store.

title: Stackables
description: This is a game about stacking and combining shapes to get the highest score you can without over flowing and breaking the container. This game has single and multiplayer where you can go against your friends and see who can out preform the other.

title: Squid's Manslaughter
description: You will wander the earth as the most pathetic and sad organism in existence searching for meaning. At the end of the day though, there isn't any, you're just an empty husk with nothing to lose, might as well gamble your life away...

title: Squaser 4
description: SQUASER 4 is a minimalist puzzle game where you control a white square and erase the darkness on each level. Clear your path using logic and memory!

title: Squaser 2
description: SQUASER 2 is a minimalist puzzle game where you control a white square and erase the darkness on each level. Clear your path using logic and memory!

title: Squaser
description: SQUASER is a minimalist puzzle game where you control a white square and erase the darkness on each level. Clear your path using logic and memory!

title: Square Jump
description: Have you been looking for a simple game where you are a cube and want to jump on different things? Square Jump is perfect!

title: Square Fishing Builder
description: Build the fishing village of your dreams! From classic farming RPG games comes a mix with strategy and RTS! Choose the map, build, and fish!

title: Spring Adventure
description: ``Spring Adventure'' is a game where you work together to progress through the stages. It is an adventure game where you advance through the stages by avoiding or defeating various traps and monsters.

title: Spook Game
description: Spook Game is a 2D action endless game where the challenge is to survive increasing waves of enemies while advancing as far as possible. With pixel art visuals and a dark atmosphere, players face creatures like ghosts and zombies in an environment inspired by classic horror.

title: Reverse 1999: Journey to Mor Pankh
description:
Version 1.3 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Kaalaa Baunaa, Shamane, and Kanjira
• New Garments for Pickles, Tennant, Matilda, and Leilani
• New main event: Journey to Mor Pankh
• …and more!

title: SplitPool
description: A pool game with a twist: each time you hit a ball and don't pocket it, it spawns another one—raising the stakes and making every shot count. Use your skills and wit to prevent the table from overflowing.

title: Spirits of the Unloved
description: You, Youtuber James Pink, go into a haunted orphanage in order to get footage for your upcoming video. You are faced with paranormal activity in the orphanage while recording your footage.

title: Spider-Tank vs. Aliens
description: Evolve your mechatronics, get new powers and annihilate all the alien races!!!

title: Spell of Infinity
description: Play for Free !! Enter the world of swords and magic now. Team up with your friends in the fantasy world of your dreams, strategically select your heroes, and conquer your enemies.

title: Spellbound Stumble
description: Spellbound Stumble is a 2v2 arena shooter with an active ragdolls. It uses a host and join multiplayer system to find games.

title: SpellBit
description: Prepare to immerse yourself in a dynamic and spellbinding world of magical mayhem. As a powerful mage, you'll engage in intense battles against other skilled sorcerers, wielding an arsenal of enchantments and elemental forces.

title: Speedrun Maker
description: its like trackmania without cars

title: SpeedRacer
description: Control a continuously accelerating spaceship, dodging and blasting obstacles to the beat of an adrenaline-pumping soundtrack.

title: Speedball
description: A brand new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! Venture into the grim future of 2138 where mega-corporations use Speedball to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.

title: Reverse 1999: The Prisoner In The Cave
description:
Version 1.4 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: 37, and 6
• New Garments for Lilya, Diggers, and Sweetheart
• New main story chapter: The Prisoner in the Cave
• New Anecdotes for Charlie and Oliver

title: Spectral Realm
