description: Race through a plethora of levels, customize your characters, and unlock new abilities.

title: The Haunting of Ptolemy
description: The Haunting of Ptolemy is a first-person shooter game. The game features a variety of weapons, which will be needed for protection against some of the indigenous life forms. Collect the spore samples, transport them back, outmaneuver the obstacles and traps, and above all, Stay Alive!

title: Qiyb2
description: Qiyb2 is a mathematics -themed 2D score-attack auto-platformer with many different random-generated cubes, hand-crafted backgrounds and experimental soundtracks.

title: Snakecremental
description: Snake, but with a skill tree

title: The Photo of God
description: A short narrative-driven atmospheric horror game, where you play as an old photographer, who decided to take the photo of God one day. Take your camera and you are ready to go. Birds will lead you.

title: Profundus
description:
You're a dog. You're stuck on a weird green-porcelain island. There are statues of familiar dogs. You're alone. So... you fish.

Catch stuff, score points, try to beat your high score! Simple, weird, and somewhat cozy.

title: A Dog Called Buddy
description: A short PSX tower defense style game about protecting a dog. Survive 6 hours while the rescue department is coming. Creatures from the fog are going to try to devour your 'buddy'.

title: Snow Cone
description:
Snow Cone is a penguin-themed puzzle game where you arrange snowballs into elegant Snow Cones to match customers' orders in dozens of challenging puzzles. Meet interesting characters and expose the truth behind the city's shady penguin underbelly.

Features handcrafted puzzles, pixel-art graphics, and a jazz-inspired soundtrack.

title: Shutterbuds
description: shutterbuds is a first-person multiplayer photography game! Explore Lone Tree National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash!

title: Fallout 76: Ghoul Within
description: Unleash your inner ghoul. Today's Ghoul Within update allows Wastelanders to leave their humanity behind and play as a Ghoul.

title: God's League
description: God's League is a next generation Action RPG from a solo indie developer named Michael Deann Fudot. It features dynamic combat, diverse weapons, armor, heroes, and magic. Infused with Bible verses, it inspires players to grow spiritually and walk in the path of Jesus.

title: Ninja Ming: Wu
description: A mini 2D puzzle platformer with double teleport mechanic. Brainstorming is as important as hands-on experience. Thinking clearly before taking action can make it easier; If you are confident in your operation, you can engage in simple thinking.

title: NinjaThea 2
description: Help NinjaThea exact revenge on the nasty critters and reclaim her diamonds and fruits!

title: No Afraid Of Battle
description: Fight with cool combo ! Strike the enemy and enjoy it ! Equip up the spoils that your harvest ! 2D Action Game by beating monster . Easy to play, and with depth .

title: Nock & Load
description: Become the best band of bowmen in the land by defeating all those who would stand against you! Nock & Load is a small, casual archery game with PvP and roguelike elements. Recruit archers into your troop and collect upgrades to outmatch your foes.

title: Nocturnal Nemesis
description: Experience the terror in Nocturnal Nemesis, a first-person survival horror game. Navigate a dark, eerie winery, fix generators, and outsmart relentless AI-driven threats. Can you survive the night and uncover the mystery?

title: NokNok
description: NokNok is a unique cross-platform open world idle game with elements of self-governance. As a player, you're tasked with earning coins and treasure chests through idle mechanics, which in turn allow you to unlock and upgrade a variety of rare hammers.

title: Nook Fall: West Town
description: A charming yet fantastical town, where vitality and decay constantly collide. We hope that through interactions with characters and objects, and the sensory experience created by visuals and sound, you can connect with the emotions and charm of this little world of West Town.

title: NoSpellHero
description: A useless hero who only takes on D-rank quests suddenly becomes the world's only hero? Defeat monsters using the equipment left behind by other heroes!

title: No Throwing
description: There is only one level of the 3D fixed view integral mini-game.Maneuver the robot to hit falling items and protect the chickens.

title: NugQuest
description: Smoke. Eat. Survive. Play through 4 levels of action packed survival. Search for food and money to maintain your high, and hide yourself from the enemies trying to stop you. Can you beat your high score and unlock the next level?

title: Numbers Destiny
description: Welcome to this game, where you'll experience the deep strategy hidden behind simple operations in this number puzzle game. This is an easy-to-start but hard-to-master puzzle game suitable for players of all ages.

title: Number Tower
description: “Number Tower” is a casual puzzle game where you clear levels by choosing the best route between towers using basic arithmetic functions like addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. It features 120 levels, two modes to play with and aim for 20 achievements.

title: NumX
description: NumX is a party-game with several mini-games, in which you play as a simple cube.

title: Luna: Obscura
description: A first-person psychological horror game of hiding, solving, and surviving inside a haunted moon base

title: Ocean Otter Climb
description: Ocean Otter Climb is a 2D platformer game about climbing to great heights. Let's climb With CUTE SEA OTTER!

title: Ocean Playground
description: This is a collection of multiple casual mini-games. A variety of mini-games allow players to experience different fun. All casual mini games are completely free to play.

title: Ocero 3D
description: A free, Sega Saturn-inspired 3D fighting game. Soar through the sky and master your powerful techniques!

title: Oct 14
description: It's what happened that day.

title: Odyssey: Realm of Echoes
description: A game that blends exploration and adventure , offering two modes. In the dynamic RPG mode, players confront powerful bosses and equip weapons and armor to build their strength. In the solo platformer mode, players navigate treacherous environments filled with obstacles to reclaim lost powers.

title: Off Trail
description: Off Trail is a procedurally generated infinite downhill skiing game. Discover the beauty, life, and treachery, of the mountain.

title: OG Memory: Synthwave Vampires
description: OG Memory: Synthwave Vampires is an memory game with scary Vampires in an stunning synthwave style. You have to find the same correct pairs to completle the game in as few rounds as possible. Find all of the pairs to get a new try and beat your record.

title: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Vampires
description: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Vampires is an puzzel game with scary Vampires in an stunning synthwave style. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Oh Boy Cheese Remastered
description: Prepare for more cheesey action as you grab the cheese again hop on the broom one last time and remember get those presents when the game is finished dont forget to jump onto the scoreboard now you and a friend can team-up for an even higher score also go 4 player vs or take your skills online

title: Olympia: Festival of the Gods
description: Olympia: Festival of the Gods is a digital board game where players collect tokens in order to perform rituals to honor the Gods of Ancient Greece!

title: OneDayOne
description: OneDayOne - visual novel where you will dive into the routine life of Sergey, from which only a miracle and...your choices can help him escape

title: One More Question
description: A game utilizing the concept of “Situation Puzzles”, One More Question gives a new perspective on familiar quizzes, presents a backdrop and story to immerse yourself in, and give a workshop editor of your own to share your own puzzles with others. Enjoy!

title: One Paradox
description: A first-person narrative adventure set in a dystopian future. Advance through the futuristic OF-1 factory, solve puzzles, evade other androids, and uncover its hidden secrets.

title: Only The Lost Shall See
description: Wander though nature. Overcome dangers. Get to the end of your pilgrimage... But don't dig any deeper.

title: Only Trump: Up To Presidents!
description: The elections are just around the corner! - will you be able to win them, overcome all the difficulties and reach the final? ONLY UP: TRUMP FOR PRESIDENT - a game in which you will feel like Donald, going through many difficult obstacles, because the basis of the game mechanics is the OnlyUp mode!

title: Ooga Booga Battle
description: Raise your Ooga Booga Baby for greatness in Ooga Booga Battle, a half virtual pet, half horde defense arcade experience! Train to evolve into a fierce cryptid and take down as many Ooga Booga Baddies as you can! Can you battle with the Ooga Booga Best of 'em?!

title: OPA: Super Janken
description: A reimagining of the classic Rock-Paper-Scissors to make it more competitive and engaging. Collect the cards and boost your score by facing increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Operation Blackout
description: Operation Blackout is an atmospheric first-person shooter where you venture into an abandoned industrial facility to eliminate unknown monsters. Use your skills, scavenge for weapons and supplies, and uncover the secrets lurking in the shadows of this dark place.

title: Operation: Strike & Secure
description: Operation: Strike & Secure is a tactical and realistic FPS where every shot matters, designed for intense solo or team-based online combat.

title: Orion's Belt Expedition
description: Land on planets to get resources! Complete tasks to upgrade your ship! You are the commander, take good care of your crew! Always check the status so that the expedition goes well!

title: Otherworldly Air Gunship
description: This is a fun shooting game that includes tower defense elements. You will control an air gunship equipped with three main types of weapons and several powerful special weapons. And leap your army to defeat thousands of monsters from other worlds.

title: Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift
description: Is an immersive adventure that challenges you to explore unknown dimensions, solve intricate puzzles, and make choices that impact the unfolding mystery. Dive into the unknown, uncover hidden secrets, and prepare for an experience that could change everything you thought you knew.

title: Oublivious
description: Oublivious is a fast-paced combat platformer where you play as a daring thief battling through a deadly dungeon. Master precise platforming, overcome medieval traps, and defeat challenging enemies to uncover hidden treasure and achieve fame and fortune.

title: Our Ascent
description: Our Ascent is an incremental roguelite RPG with many layers of metaprogression.

title: Ourkade
description: Ourkade is bringing back your favorite childhood mini-games. Play quick, retro-style games that are easy to learn but challenging to master. Unlock achievements, earn tickets, trade items on the Steam store, and compete for high scores. Play your way!

title: Outl1ned
description: Fast-paced 1D arcade shooter. The Y and Z axis are overrated, it's time to play a game that pushes X to the limit. OUTL1NED.

title: Liminal Spaces: Outside The Backrooms
description: Have you ever wondered what Liminal Spaces are outside the Backrooms? Explore them in this surrealist short game based on lucid dreaming and liminal spaces in the nature.

title: Wendigo's Outside
description: Survive Wendigo and any other challenges that await you later in the adventure!

title: Over Heroes
description: A third-person MOBA shooter game with heroes of various distinct skills, there's always one that suits you. In battle, you can choose weapons like guns, wands, bows, swords, and spears. Combine them with your teammates' magic to charge into the enemy and achieve ultimate victory.

title: Tomb of the Overlord
description: Delve into the depths of the Tomb of the Overlord, a co-op action RPG where you battle relentless undead, master powerful classes, and forge your own path through multiclass progression.

title: Over Road
description: An engaging grab action game that takes place on a road floating in the air

title: Ludaro
description:
Ludaro is a Roguelike Deck-building dice game with a unique twist on Ludo!

Plan your moves, manipulate dice rolls, and unleash powerful Spirit Cards to beat the score. Upgrade tiles, collect quirky pets and stack wild combos as you battle in epic boss fights with game-changing modifiers.

title: Roulette Hero
description: Roulette Hero is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder where you assemble animal companions to defeat towering mechanical beasts. Line up the perfect squad on your roulette wheel, spin to activate your animals' abilities, trigger game-changing synergies, and turn the tide of battle!

title: Elleria: Book 1
description: Elleria is an adult visual novel, with focus on story telling and choices. Elleria contains mature content, such as sex scenes, usage of alcohol and violence in fantasy world.

title: Five Nights at Frickbear's 3
description:
Five Nights at Frickbear's 3 is a FNaF fangame with a big focus on player choice and replayability, featuring a uniquely goofy art style, a metric buttload of unique animatronic enemies, 3D free-roam minigames, and multiple story routes!

Can YOU survive Five Nights at Frickbear's? ...3?

title: Serenitrove
description: A pixel art digging game where the goal is to dig deeper and uncover more as you progress. Enjoy a relaxed, timer-free experience with no enemies, just pure exploration. Customize your setup, take your time, and excavate as much treasure as you can.

title: Might & Magic Fates: The Trading Card Game
description: The Sea of Fates emerged from the destruction caused by apocalyptic events across the Might & Magic worlds, a chaotic multiverse where fragments of order fight to survive. This realm draws heroes and creatures from all eras into its swirling conflict. Among them, Sandro, the necromancer, uses the power of chaos and order to summon a void of nothingness, threatening to consume all existence. As players clash in battles for survival and dominance, they unknowingly play into Sandro’s dark designs, shaping the destiny of the multiverse.

title: Beaver Rampage
description: BEAVER RAMPAGE is a crazy game about a killer beaver! Bite humans, cut trees, build bridges, destroy stuff, shoot guns, dodge traps, and wear funny hats. Low poly style, low system requirements, save system, and frequent updates with new levels!

title: Captain Edward Continues
description: Want to continue playing as a time traveling pirate? Now is your chance with Captain Edward Continues. 100s of cutscenes, jokes, and other oddities to make you and your friends laugh. Want to just shoot robots, goblins, and gang members? You can do that, too!

title: Demon of the Time
description: Demon Of The Time is a fast-paced FPS arcade shooter packed with intense, cinematic battles across vast, meticulously crafted locations inspired by ancient Japan.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Eternal Edition
description:
The Binding of Isaac: Eternal Edition (also dubbed Eternal Update or V1.666) is an official free DLC-like expansion to The Binding of Isaac, which adds a new Hard Mode, as well as fixing some long existing bugs.

The DLC was developed by Florian Himsl (the original programmer of the game) and released for free on Steam on May 05, 2015, for anyone who owns Wrath of the Lamb DLC.

title: R/A\W
description: Anthology of anti-war stories by award-winning authors from Russia

title: Blood Bowl 2: Norse
description:
The NORSE race comes with its own official players (Lineman, Berserker, Runner, Thrower, Ulfwerener, Yhetee) along with a couple of star players: Wilhelm Chaney and Icepelt Hammerblow!

Norsemen are homicidal maniacs who love battle and beer! This rolling roadblock may not be the fastest team on the pitch, but with most players benefiting from Block it’s certainly one of the toughest.

The Yhetee is the Norse’s very own walking mountain. It's a special kind of Troll from the northern lands, adapted to the cold, harsh environment in order to survive. Norse team coaches include Yhetees in their Blood Bowl teams thanks to their deadly combination of claws, fierceness, and natural talent for destruction.

title: Blood Bowl 2: Nurgle
description:
The teams of Nurgle come with their Rotters, Pestigors, Nurgle Warriors and Beasts. They are joined by the Nurgle legendary star-player - Lord Borak the Despoiler.

Nurgle teams are a form of Chaos team, whose players worship the god Nurgle - the Chaos god of corruption and disease. He rewards his players by granting them a rather unpleasant disease known as “Nurgle’s Rot”. If anyone gets close enough to get a decent sniff, they’ll contract one of Nurgle’s nasty diseases and usually die before anyone can suggest a new personal hygiene regime.

As with most Chaos teams, the Nurgle team is at its best when it can get stuck in and directly take on opposing players. What it has in strength and toughness, the Nurgle team lacks in agility. Nurgle Warriors have a lousy Agility value and Move rate, and do not make good ball bearers. With such a terrible average Move rate, these worshippers of the Chaos god Nurgle could find themselves being beaten not just by the opposing side, but also the clock!

title: Blood Bowl 2: Chaos Dwarfs
description:
Chaos Dwarfs are the twisted descendants of Dwarf explorers who have been terribly affected by the forces of Chaos, turning them into evil, self-centered creatures. In one way they haven’t changed at all, they still love playing Blood Bowl! They are joined by the legendary star-player Zzharg Madeye.

The Chaos Dwarfs are defence-oriented team, benefiting from the great velocity of their bull centaur retrievers and from a very powerful front line that can endure (and apply) a lot of pressure. Also, one of their strongest characteristics is that powerful players, like bull centaurs, unlock their powerful skills very quickly.

The main weakness of the Chaos Dwarfs stands in their poor ball-handling skills. Indeed, due to their tiny size and low agility, they have to rely on hobgoblins in order to push the game forward. Hobgoblins are quite agile, but are also very prone to getting crushed by any opponent.

title: Varlet
description: To be a "leader" that guides others forward, or to be an uncompromising "ruler"...VARLET is a school life RPG where, through encounters with troubled boys and girls who are also searching for themselves, you begin to uncover a version of yourself you never knew existed.

title: Project Nihilum: Zero
description: Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel. Discover the twisted story from different points of views and make your own choices. Discover 1 or 3 abilities: Mind Glimpse, Shape Shift and Hybrid. Use your ability wisely to see the past, influence the present and shape the future.

title: Project Bengal
description: Welcome to Project Bengal, an open-world action-adventure set in the vibrant, bustling streets of Bangladesh. Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world where you can free-roam, engage in intense action, and live out your own criminal empire story—all in Bangla language.

title: Prince Rystiya's Starship
description: The rebels claimed that they fought for freedom and democracy, yet they built a totalitarian regime instead. As a heroic imperial fighter pilot, you will eliminate waves of rebel scum and hunt down their leader.

title: Prince Rystiya's Starfleet
description: Conquer the entire galaxy or fight quick custom battles in this free space RTS!

title: Poultry Party
description: Poultry Party is a 2D arcade-like action game that gets harder as you go. Dodge, jump over, and extinguish hazards to avoid becoming dinner. Need help? Add up to 17 additional players (yes really) to assist you. Survive as long as you can, or beat the game as fast as you can. The choice is yours!

title: Potion in Motion
description: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

title: Potato Vs. Potato
description: Potato Vs Potato is a fun and addictive game where you click on potatoes to grow your potato empire! Join us and participate in exciting events, and collaborate with fellow potato enthusiasts. Together, we'll cultivate the ultimate potato paradise and grow into something truly awesome!

title: Popo & Rob
description: Popo & Rob is an action-packed shooter game that combines dynamic, casual-friendly shooting with a unique twist on movement. Engage in exciting battles where gravity is no limit. Choose your side, Popo or Rob, and immerse yourself in a world that’s bright, bold, and brimming with fun.

title: Poop Rocket
description: Poop Rocket is a casual sci-fi 2D shooter game. Bomb your way through debris and aliens before the poop power meter runs out. Avoid the debris and aliens, or you'll take damage and die. The game is controlled with your keyboard. Use the arrows to navigate and the space bar to drop bombs.

title: Poofie Plays God
description: Poofie Plays God is an Indie Open world Puzzle game where you'll have to lower the curse binding you in the forest and escape before he or the others kill you.

title: PolyTap
description: Tap to the rhythm based on the shapes that emerge!

title: Poker Clicker
description: Earn chips by revealing randomly generated poker hands and unlock gems for powerful bonuses. And don't worry if you're not getting any goals or feeling like you're missing a strategy. It's all about the endless clicking, and it's the perfect way to relax and unwind.

title: Plentiful
description: Stack stones to shape the world. A relaxing game about harnessing nature.

title: Please Say Hi
description: Simple, without unnecessary complications, with a good story and interesting ending.

title: Plattis
description: Be a hero robot guy in this 2d platformer. finish levels and avoid dangerous enemies

title: Plantoons
description: Powerful plants fight off invading weeds in a wacky 2D tower-defense game with Roguelite elements!Build your defenses, upgrade your abilities, complete challenges... and survive the onslaught!

title: Planternauts
description: Welcome to Planternauts – an immersive adventure in planetary terraforming where you play as a brave explorer tasked with greening barren landscapes. Explore, discover, and transform an alien world into a lush paradise by initiating a grand project to create a new ecosystem.

title: Pixel Horizons
description: Stranded on a beautiful island, craft tools, battle beasts, and uncover mythical weapons. Fight to survive, conquer ancient ruins, and master the wild in a high-stakes adventure. Will you prevail? - Created by a UC Santa Cruz Student

title: Pirate Survivors
description: Pirate Survivors is a fast-paced Roguelite where you battle endless waves of sea monsters, unlock powerful upgrades, and take on deadly Sea Legends. Choose your ship, conquer countless enemies, and face escalating challenges in this high-stakes Bullet Heaven adventure!

title: Pirates Adventure Solitaire
description: Search for legendary treasure! Solitaire in a Pirate setting!

title: Pioneers of the Coast
description: In this top-down, turn-based resource strategy game, you and fellow pioneers set out to start your own towns in a newly discovered region. Be the first to dominate the land and lay claim to the entire area.

title: Pig & Chikin
description: This is the tale of Pig & Chikin. In a world where pigs have wings, Pig loses her wings in an accident. Her dear friend, Chikin, takes her on a journey to learn to fly again. On the way, they meet magical places and creatures who offer insights into companionship, community, and acceptance.

title: Piece Yourself Up
description: Slash and shoot enemies with spoons and use their parts to piece your broken body up! Survive in this 2D pixel-art top-down dungeon crawler game based on chronic mental and physical conditions.

title: Picnic Syndrome
description: Nutopia is now booting... Picnic syndrome is a Meta puzzle game with light horror elements featuring file manipulation. Exploring "Nutopia" with Teddy the bear and hanging out with Vincent the wolf pup!

title: O.W.L.: One Wave Length
description: OWL is top down, rogue like bullet-hell that you can play with up to 1 friend. Everything is in beat, including your and the enemies attacks. With each new Instrument, new attack patterns unfold for you which will take you to your final obstacle; The Meowestro, the source of dissonance.

title: Aircraft Wars
description: This is a simple casual shooting game. With dynamic background music, players use the left and right keys to control the fighter plane to move, and use the space bar to shoot bullets to shoot down enemy planes. Play with friends to see who can get a higher score!

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wonderland Whimsy
description: The 16th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings the new Alice in Wonderland Realm, the new characters Alice and Cheshire Cat, a "uncrafting" system, Star Wars premium items, improvements in Photo Mode and the Garden of Whimsy Star Path.

title: Philomel
description: Join Donna, a young wife trying to help her fiance earn enough funds for their wedding. There will be a wide variety of tasks, obstacles, and distractions along the way, but nothing can stand in the way of pure love! Not even a lecherous priest or demons!

title: Periodicity: Hats and Scars
description: Survive against hordes of monsters. Equip different weapons with unique abilities. Forage for materials to rebuild a destroyed town. Upgrade your gear for maximum damage.

title: Pepez: The game
description: PEPEZ: Meme Warfare - Dive into the ultimate meme shooter! Battle iconic memes and crypto giants. Ally with legends like John Wick for epic rewards. Are you ready to rule the meme-verse?

title: Penelope Syndrome
description: You are not a hero. You are just an everyday average mechanic. You can fight, but without having the resources to repair damaged systems, you will die trapped with them.

title: Peepers Paradise
description: Jump into the world of Peepers Paradise! A hentai game made by peepers for peepers! Peepers Paradise is a place where the models crave attention and sometimes more. Come find out what all that attention will get you.

title: PC Jumps
description: Jump across ramps and dodge obstacles to conquer increasing difficult Levels.

title: PaymoneyWubby: The Game
description: With his streaming livelihood taken from under him overnight, the dethroned PaymoneyWubby must venture through various parts of the world to reclaim his fame and fortune alongside his friends and fans!

title: Pawns of War
description: Dark parallel world in which humanity has destroyed itself. And only small colonies have survived the last centuries holding on to power at the expense of the totalitarian regime of government. You were thrown here after your death, is this how you were given a second chance?

title: Path Ball
description: In "PATH BALL" control the ball to reach the dots and solve puzzles. Collect fragments of paintings to complete the levels. Develops logic, attention and the ability to predict. Perfect for an evening break with relaxing music.

title: Misuzu no Kuni
description:
Made as a promotion for Kirin no Kuni. Gold prize in the 10th Freem! Game Contest.

One day, Misuzu ceased to be human. According to legal jurisdiction, she had become a Tengu.

She had two options in front of her: Live the rest of her life under government surveillance and have all her basics freedoms stripped away from her, or venture onwards to the realm of the Tengu.

This is a story of hardships, setbacks, farewells and chances encounters. This is Misuzu's story.

title: Dead as Disco
description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

title: Parsec
description: In Parsec you pilot a spaceship through a field of asteroids trying to destroy as many as possible before they destroy you. You have three different weapons that can be picked up around the world. Health can also be picked up from random spawns and sometimes dropped by asteroids.

title: Parkour Chief: Chapter Secret Agent
description: In the future, you must retrieve a stolen hyper-advanced CPU from the CyberQuark Corporation before they use it to create destructive AI robots. In Parkour Chief: Secret Agent, you'll use your parkour and stealth skills to infiltrate CyberQuark's headquarters and recover the CPU.

title: Pantomime
description: Pantomime is an immersive collection of interactive story-driven games designed to make learning English an epic adventure. Every choice you make deepens your language skills and unravels new paths in these captivating, dynamic worlds.

title: Pamina vs. Slimes
description: Pamina VS Slimes is a fast-paced top-down arcade game where you defend your home from endless waves of slimes. Choose from 4 headpattable characters, master elemental strategies, and unleash powerful burst skills across 4 game modes. Get ready for non-stop action!

title: PalSync
description: In PalSync, control two characters who must move together at the same time. Face challenging levels where perfect synchronization is key to solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles. Test your coordination skills in this unique single-player experience!

title: Paint Puzzle Quest
description: Embark on a vibrant and colorful journey with Paint Puzzle Quest, a strategic puzzle-solving game that will test your creativity and problem-solving skills. Explore 100 exciting levels, each presenting a new challenge to keep you engaged and entertained.

title: Packit List
description: "Packit List" is a short, 3D organizing puzzle game that takes about an hour to complete. You will follow the wonderful adventures of Hana, a high school girl who travels across multiple worlds to organize various themed objects in a limited space

title: One Night: Young Bride for One Night
description: Finally, my reunion with my first love from ten years ago… And he didn't even notice it was me! In that case… I'll just have to make him fall for the new me then!

title: Hex Blast
description: Hex Blast is a horde survival x roguelike deckbuilder where you strategize on a hex grid, chaining explosive card combos to wipe out cyber hordes. Build your deck, collect overclocked chips, and discover the most broken builds to annihilate cyber threats—before they overwhelm you.

title: Makis Adventure: Level Editor
description: Build your own Dungeons, share them with the Community and play Dungeons made by the community. This is the official Level Editor for the 2D Action-Platformer Makis Adventure!

title: Imagine Island
description:
Imagine Island is a safe, magical online world where kids can play, create, and explore as their own custom avatars.

Designed with safety and creativity in mind, Imagine Island offers fun adventures, silly surprises, and endless ways to express yourself – all in a kid-friendly space built just for them.

title: Educational Virtual Reality Campus
description: Step into EVRECA! Explore IoT with three engaging projects, visit a virtual museum showcasing student artwork, learn recycling through an interactive game, and master English prepositions with fun gameplay. EVRECA transforms education beyond traditional boundaries.

title: Dead by Skill Check
description: A skill check trainer for Dead by Daylight - to hone your skills or just warm up for the day.

title: PirateFi
description: This game was removed by Valve on February 10th 2025 for containing malware. Users who ran the game in the time the malware was live received an email warning them accordingly.

title: Midtris
description: Midtris is mind bending puzzle game where your goal is to place blocks around the center piece and clear layers of perfect squares.

title: Abyss Vaulter
description: You've fallen down a sinkhole. Oh no! Luckily for you a gun has fallen on your head and balloons seem to be friendly. Ascend the abyss and escape these depths.

title: Fatigue
description:
A game about a depressive episode, created in an attempt to get rid of said depressive episode.

It’s been years since—and the trick seems to have worked—but I was reminded to re-release it.

title: Four Seasons Around the World: Autumn in France
Chicken Rush Deluxe
description: Hordes of savage meanies are invading, looking for the tastiest chickens around! Paula the hen needs to keep her fellow birds safe, and she needs your help. Guide Paula as she keeps these meanies at bay with her magic rifle that will turn her targets into cacti and stones. You'll need careful and swift reactions to keep these chickens away from becoming dinner in Chicken Rush Deluxe!

title: Catherine Ragnor and the Cursed Island
Build-A-Lot: Mysteries 2
description: Elizabeth once again needs help dealing with her eccentric family and you're the person for the job. Discover the hidden clues to unlock the mysteries of the Graves family as you build, buy and flip houses in each eerie neighborhood.

title: Melvor Idle 2
description: Embark on a brand new adventure building upon its predecessor. Melvor Idle 2 expands the world with deeper mechanics and greater challenges. Master new Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.

title: Lumberjacked
description: You wake up in a strange cabin deep in a mysterious forest, axe in hand, with only one way forward—through. Chop trees, sell logs, purchase and upgrade gear, and uncover the secrets hidden deep in the forest.

title: Demon Turf: Queen's Edition
description:
By royal decree, Demon Turf has been upgraded to the Queen's Edition!

What does this mean we hear you ask? It means we've packaged our previously standalone game Demon Turf: Neon Splash with Demon Turf's DLC Demon Turf: Tower and the Level Editor into the ultimate package of demon-y goodness.

title: Land of Ghosts
description: A literary horror adventure made in RPG Maker MV, where you explore a land of endless rain and continue a lonely journey through fleeting encounters with ghosts. Rain-soaked landscapes and quiet conversations shape a desolate, melancholic road ahead

title: Deadly Reunion
description: A reunion party — a place filled with old memories shared among friends. But what if, on that very night, all of your friends were murdered right before your eyes? What would you do? Run away? Find the killer? Or die with them?

title: The Lavarish Facility
description: A roguelite game where you must complete 50 chambers to experiment with The Facility's lava, but something lurks within.

title: The Deepwatch
description: As the head of security, you will decide the fate of those who try to enter the underwater colony. Among the hundreds of arrivals, you may encounter dangerous criminals, spies, and the infected. You will decide who lives here, who is banished, and who is eliminated.

title: Uwaiteru
description: A chill platformer where you play as Bubble Cat. Help her jump and slide along bubbles to reach a bubble star and achieve her bubble dreams!

title: Honey Guardian
description:
Short score-attack shmup in the "caravan" style.

Jenny has two minutes to save her hive from invading insects. Power up her sting shot with honey crystals and shoot invaders coming from all directions! No ads, no pay-to-play, no pay-to-win.

Original game made for Gunner Parade Jam 2022.
Ported to Android for Android Port Jam 2023.

title: Insanity Within
description:
Step into the shattered mind of a man haunted by his past in this chilling psychological horror puzzle game. Return to the eerie, riddled manor where you once lived with your wife and daughter, a place steeped in tragedy and shadowed by accusations. Imprisoned for a murder you can’t recall committing, you’re drawn back to uncover the truth, battling the relentless grip of schizophrenia that twists your reality with every step.

Navigate a series of mind-bending puzzles that test not just your wits, but your sanity. As your mental health unravels, the world around you distorts and nightmares seep into reality. Scavenge for meds to hold the madness at bay, but time is your enemy, and every moment pushes you closer to the edge.

With each puzzle you conquer, uncover heartfelt letters from your daughter, addressed to you, piecing together the heartbreaking story of your family’s collapse. Search the manor’s forgotten corners for hidden artifacts that reveal its sinister secrets and the fractured memories you’ve buried deep.

As you descend deeper into the manor’s depths, brace yourself for a devastating revelation. This is a journey of guilt, grief, and discovery where every answer comes at a cost.

title: Hollow Knight Randomizer
description: Welcome to Randomizer 4, the newest version of the Hollow Knight item and transition randomizer released for the Hollow Knight 1.5 update.

title: Call of Duty: World at War - Spain at War
description:
SPAIN AT WAR is a mod for Call of Duty: World At War, set in the war that devastated Spain in the 30s, the Spanish Civil War.

A different view of our history. Far from the polemics of good and evil, red or blue, SPAIN AT WAR aims to teach and entertain all those lovers of history and war games like Call of Duty, through a campaign mode and a multiplayer mode.

title: Hollow Knight Gun Mod
description:
A Hollow Knight mod that gives the Knight the ability to wield a modern day assault rifle. Why did I make this? I wish I knew too.

While this mod is not to be taken seriously, It still aims to make a semi-serious fun ranged weapon mod to capitalize on Hollow Knight's movement system.

title: Runa Illustra
description: A puzzle game about spellcasting, where you can cast spells by drawing magic circles.

title: Femboy Futa House
description: Congratulations, you've been accepted to the College of Magical Arts! Immerse yourself in a rich student life full of magic, passion, and adventure. Meet the eccentric residents of dorm 9 ¾ and get to know them as closely as you can...

title: Frostpunk: 1886
description: The original Frostpunk experience is being reimagined and expanded with new events, mechanics, and laws within a new Purpose Path. Return to your role as the ruler of Earth's last city, manage its citizens, weigh up your choices and ensure your society's survival.

title: Dead or Alive 6: Nyotengu
description: Download this to use Nyotengu in DEAD OR ALIVE 6 and DEAD OR ALIVE 6: Core Fighters.

title: Raiders of Blackveil
description: Join the rebellion against the evil cooperation Blackveil in this action-packed roguelite for 1-3 players. Select your MOBA-like champion, collect RPG-style loot and infiltrate Blackveil’s massive factory. Wreak havoc, and smuggle out loot to get INSANELY powerful!

title: Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard
description: Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking Beard offers action-adventure players of all ages a thrilling, humor-filled journey by providing dynamic 3D platforming, fluid combats, clever puzzles, and a real-world treasure hunt experience in the action-adventure genre.

title: Beastkeepers
description: Beastkeepers is your creature taming adventure at the bottom of the screen. Breed and train powerful creatures, battle enemies, and earn coins. Use them to unlock new creatures, upgrades, and decorations. Grow stronger and progress endlessly!

title: Wandering Sword: Secrets of the Eastern Sea
description: Set off on a new martial arts adventure in pursuit of a rare treasure! Encounter a mysterious girl with a hidden past, explore a secret island, and master forgotten skills. Or, escape the world's conflicts and create your own peaceful sanctuary.

title: Farewell, Bunny Boy
description: A short story about a cute bunny town far away from the rest of the world around them, and a cute bunny boy wanting to experience more. He leaves behind his calm life and loved ones for one of mystery and adventure.

title: Odd Dorable
description: An open-world exploration game made from my 4-year-old daughter's drawings. Step into a vibrant, hand-drawn world and help the princess find all her magical candies.

title: Homekeeping
description: Rutile finally scores her dream job... being a maid! But with an odd mistress to work for, will her work be as smooth as she imagined?

title: Corpse Collector
description: You are Java, one of the few survivors of a zombie outbreak. You go around collecting corpses... but what for...? As you collect the corpses, you'll go down memory lane...

title: Dotonon
description: A surreal dreamlike exploration game, heavily inspired by Yume Nikki.

title: Demon Demon
description: Silene has been searching for a long time for a certain love from her youth, after certain events she has found him again, but... Can they be together this time?

title: Lami: A Cup of Code & Coffee
description: Inheriting Grandpa’s Old Café… and Meeting a Cute Robot Girl?! Use all your skills to develop unique gadgets and run the café alongside the adorable Lami. Face exciting challenges and gradually uncover Lami’s story!

title: Into a Hearth Yonder
description: Forge genuine bonds with artificial allies and real friends in Viteria. Craft, explore, and befriend both the diverse cast of Settlers and the native Automata in order to unravel secrets and help the island thrive.

title: Oppai Oppai Orbs
description:
Puzzle game featuring a girl whom expands the size of her breasts in correlation with the two biggest orbs merging. The more orbs merge, the more exposed her chest becomes.

Make two of the same color orbs touch to merge, the game ends when any orb escapes the play area or the maximum bust size is reached. The final orbs are dark purple, if they merge they will pop out of existence.

title: Sugar Sling Showdown
description: Sugar Sling Showdown is a candy-slinging 1-6 players open-world adventure game where you brawl and compete with each other in Crackarena, while protecting and building a sweet society together in ToffeeTown. Your tongue is your ultimate weapon in this chaotic sugary mayhem.

title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
description: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance expands the Blue Protocol universe with a vibrant MMORPG experience. Create your own hero, team up for strategic raids, or simply relax and have fun with friends fishing, crafting, and endless exploration. Adventure awaits!

title: Aurora Polaris
description: Aurora Polaris is a vertical shoot 'em up set in a post-pandemic future where a mysterious old engineer brings together four unlikely pilots to stop a technocratic regime known as NOX. Blending arcade action, anime-inspired visuals, and heartfelt narrative, players engage in intense boss fights, upgrade their ships, and explore handcrafted stages across a frozen Earth. Featuring local co-op, emotional cutscenes, and a unique sci-fi take on holiday mythology.

title: Final Fall
description:
Final Fall is a psychological horror game about schizophrenia, trauma, and the monsters we carry inside. You play as Ophelia, a woman with no memory after a failed suicide attempt—lost in a crumbling asylum filled with hallucinations, riddles, and voices that won’t stop whispering.

Explore a world shaped by Ophelia’s fractured mind. As her sanity slips, the hospital twists around her—walls bend, whispers grow louder, and reality becomes impossible to trust. Solve brutal puzzles, survive disturbing hallucinations, and confront terrifying creatures born from her guilt.

Suicide isn’t just a backstory, it’s a mechanic. Misusing items or failing in key moments may push Ophelia to end her life. Do it three times… and your save file is permanently deleted.

title: Neocron Evolution
description: Play with and against other players online in the post apocalyptic world of the 28th century. You become a citizen of one of the last mega cities on Earth (Neocron) and it is up to you whether you want to experience exciting adventures or just lead a normal life in this virtual world.

title: Mars Taxi
description: As a taxi driver, you must pick up customers from Mars and accompany them to work. Do you have the skills necessary to carry out this mission?

title: Hurm's Odyssey
description: play as hurm, and journey acccross the galaxy to avenge your pal

title: Limbus Company: Season 6 - Zàng Huā Yín
description:
Season 6: Zàng Huā Yín, is the sixth Season of Limbus Company.

It consists of the game's eighth Story Chapter (Canto VIII: The Surrendered Witnessing) centered on Hong Lu from the literary source Dream of the Red Chamber, one side story event, and the sixth Mirror Dungeon, as well as the release of Identities based on story content and E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass. Additionally, the season contained the game's first limited-time event collaboration with the game Arknights, adding E.G.O based upon characters from the game.

title: Mastermind
description: As the survivors in the game show. You will have to prepare yourself with every opportunity possible to arm and supply yourself with weapons and gear. Fight your way through the show with or without Preparation which you will have to make do with what you have.

title: Killer Karnival
description: Killer Karnival is a first-person survival horror stealth game ​where players are trapped in an abandoned carnival ​and hunted by killer clowns, each with unique senses. The player must escape by solving puzzles while remaining hidden to avoid becoming the carnival's next victim.

title: Niconico-san
description: "Niconico-san" is a first-person, fast-paced horror game set in a Japanese residential area. Players must escape from the smiling man of urban legend, "Niconico-san," and find their way out of a terrifying otherworld.

title: To Find Her
description: 《寻踪》is an immersive adventure puzzle game with simple controls, perfect for beginners. ,crack codes, solve literary puzzles, and evade capture. With over 10 gameplay elements and a micro-horror atmosphere, the game offers a thrilling experience as you uncover the truth behind a girl's disappearance.

title: Pond Abyss
description: Pond Abyss is a first-person psychological horror game with a length of 25-30 minutes. The action takes place on a secluded forest pond, where the protagonist is tasked with looking after it while his uncle is away. However, the once peaceful atmosphere soon becomes unsettling when eerie and inexplicable events begin to unfold.

title: At Death's Door
description: At Death's Door is a psychological horror game focused on eerie exploration and puzzle-solving. As a ghost hunter in an abandoned psychiatric hospital, use specialized tools to capture paranormal evidence and save your TV show, all while navigating atmospheric, non-linear environments.

title: Happy Flappy
description: A relaxing and happy experience flying through colourful regions, avoiding obstacles and collecting exotic food!

title: Hounimal
description: Hounimal is a roguelite command battle RPG where you journey with Hounimal, a reliable companion and your home. Place colorful and powerful furniture to build the best Hounimal!

title: Moonlit Reaper
description: Where lost souls drift and silence screams, you walk alone beneath the moonlight toward shadows of pure malice. Reap those beyond redemption. Collect weapons and skills. Grow strength from each fall. In this roguelite action, you are the Moonlit Reaper — not a hero, but a promise kept in moonlight.

title: All About Chopsticks
description:
This is a game where you can naturally learn about chopsticks while challenging physics-based puzzles inspired by chopstick handling.

There is no known correlation between performing well in the game and improving actual chopstick skills.

This game is inspired by the game below:
Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy

title: Human Fast Food
description: A cooking simulator where you run an underground fast food for monsters and serve them with human meat. Improve your kitchen appliances, unlock new recipes, manage your stock and keep the monsters well fed.

title: Geyserlands
description: Geyserlands is a deck-building game of modern otherworldly mystery. Gain new cards and upgrade your deck as you explore the mystery of Geyserlands. Unlock secret powers and gain special advantages. How will your story end in Geyserlands?

title: Tuna Hake's Underwater
description: You are a fish who does tricks

title: Cosmobreeder Yiffai
description: Travel to a forgotten world and study alien creatures in this authentic retro metroidvania!

title: Glimmer Fighters
description: Glimmer Fighters is a shining new 2.5D Fighter on the horizon. Fight in action-packed 1v1 matches. With easy controls, any beginner may try out this exciting new installment amongst fighting games.

title: Fernandez Big Mystery
description: A fantasy game with touches of environmental humor. The story is about a wench who has to solve a great mystery, which greatly intrigues the town where she lives and for which she has to immerse herself in a great adventure.

title: Taking London
description: A love letter to old-school browser-based RTS MMOs - with charming nostalgic pixel graphics, a dash of political satire, and tonnes of strategic tension. Build your empire, face off against other players, and take what's yours in true British imperial style: by dominating the map.

title: Wheel Up the Hill
description: Roll a wheel uphill in this chill physics-based challenge. Soothing music meets soul-crushing difficulty. Easy controls, hard to master. Get to the top, if you can.

title: Hidden Cats Ellara
description: This hidden object game provides a relaxing experience as you search for 100 hidden cats tucked away in a carefully crafted hand-drawn setting.

title: Shards Reunited: Kintsugi
description: If you love puzzles and crave a straightforward, relaxing experience, Shards Reunited: Kintsugi is for you. There's no fluff, just pure puzzle-solving joy with beautiful Japanese porcelain to keep your eyes delighted and your mind at ease.

title: Smell Like a Puddle
description: — Each of us fell into a puddle. And everyone knows that you can find yourself after that... in a strange place from which there is no escape. Didn't it happen?.. Well, it's nothing — it's going to happen soon! You will have to explore your new home... and become a part of it. ^-^

title: When the Crow Sings
description: WHEN THE CROW SINGS is an adventure mystery game with a focus on exploration, characters, and world building, featuring a cast of diverse survivors trying to keep the status quo as their compound life grows more complicated and dangerous.

title: Gaucho: Subway Escape
description: The shelter is not safe anymore. You must venture into the Buenos Aires subway, defeat colossal Demon Bosses in a frenetic parry-based combat, explore branching stations, improve your equipment, level up, and claw your way to the surface to save your kitten, Gaucho.

title: Adventures & Quests: The Black Crystal
description: The king's advisor sends you on an important mission. A sinister magician seeks the power of the black crystal and plans to unleash its dark powers. Start an exciting adventure with this fantastic hidden object game!

title: Lightbulb
description: Lightbulb is a clicker game where you click the buttons to turn the light on or off, while all the other players are clicking too. A game where every choice shapes the world. Join the battle between light and darkness and witness the impact of your actions in real time!

title: Space Memory: Parrots
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable parrots in space

title: Eggcellent Life
description: A Placement And Development Game That Only Requires Mouse Operation And Is Played At The Bottom Of The Screen. It Has A Soft Color Screen And Is Suitable For Easy Play While Working, Harvesting Resources And Raising Chickens.

title: Pushmania
description: Two brothers stuck in the world of computer games. They have to fix it to get out. An isometric homage to digital games culture and the art of playing together. Challenge your logic, cooperation and coordination.

title: Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines - Tales & Strives
description: The "Tales & Strives" puzzle set contains 10 new puzzles representing 2 new themes with 5 puzzles in each, respectively - FREE demo puzzles included!

title: Atlas Brave
description: Dip, duck, dive, and dodge your way through hordes of enemies in this 4 player co-op Action RPG. Play online or offline multiplayer as you explore unique dungeons and try to not die in an embarrassing way again.

title: Resident Evil Remake Trilogy
description:
This great value pack contains three Resident Evil remake titles and additional content.

- RESIDENT EVIL 2 Deluxe Edition PS4 & PS5
- RESIDENT EVIL 3 PS4 & PS5
- RESIDENT EVIL 3 - Classic Costume Pack PS4 & PS5
- Resident Evil Resistance PS4
- Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition PS4 & PS5
- Resident Evil 4 - The Mercenaries PS4 & PS5

title: Hispalis: Proyecto NoDo
description:
Discover the free video game created by two Pokémon -loving fans from Seville that's taking Andalusia by storm.

Immerse yourself in the history of Hispalis , a post-apocalyptic Seville devastated by a massive pandemic, where Pokémon now reign supreme.

title: Tokyo Valkyries
description: Tokyo Valkyries is a roguelite deckbuilder where you build your deck, devise strategies, and progress through the map while defeating the enemies that stand in your way. One day, another world known as the “Other World” emerges in Tokyo, encroaching upon reality. Only a chosen group of girls can stand against this strange phenomenon. Will they be able to protect Tokyo from the encroachment of the Other World?

title: Nidana
description: She continues to dream. A first-person dream simulator where you explore a corner of a dream.

title: Starcraft Mass Recall
description: StarCraft: Mass Recall (SCMR) is a project that recreates the classic StarCraft and Brood War gameplay as well as the entire single-player campaigns within the StarCraft II engine. StarCraft: Mass Recall contains 68 maps, 59 from the original StarCraft/Brood War game, 3 that were hidden or deleted on various StarCraft supports, and 6 from the 1998 demo campaign.

title: Dooms 2: Seas of Blood
description:
This sequel is a selection of various scenarios linked to the dark world of Dooms, set before and after the first game.

Jack, sentenced to death manages to find his way out through psychological treatment.
Bob, after the explosion finds himself covered in bandages in a madhouse.
June, emotionally broken searches for his lost brother and meaning in her life.
Brian, a man trying to get to heaven through the pain of inserting a nail through his penis.
Graig, trying to take revenge on his wife's lover.

An overhaul of the game made in RM2K3 was released in 2007.

title: Cuffed
description: Awaken in a ruined underground lab with your hands permanently bound. In Cuffed, a combat-free survival horror, your shackles are your only tool. Solve intricate systemic puzzles, override facility systems, and outsmart the terrifying specimens hunting you to escape.

title: Infinity Nikki: Bubble Season
description: The Sea of Stars stretches endlessly, where past, present, and future converge. The stars hold the truth—resonate with them, and receive their blessing.

title: Koegasuru
description: Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku! When you solve the 4 riddles, a music video will be created of you solving the riddles! It is an escape room game set in the music video "KOEGASURU" by TEMPLIME!

title: Friendship Test
description: RPG Maker game about a Program built to be a perfect friend, who goes on a journey travelling a mysterious laboratory, where they'll meet different programs in need of help (and friendship). FriendProgram was built to be a perfect friend, but is that what they want to be? Is it wrong to not want to?

title: Inda Karane: Turnabout Tsundere
description:
A fangame make by Shizuka Studio, A 100 Girlfriends fangame inspired by Ace Attorney's iconic courtroom battles! It features an original story mainly focused on Karane as she tries to fight for the truth against all odds.
Experience Inda Karane's (pretend) courtroom battles with Eiai Nano, as they try to prove the defendant guilty or not so guilty!

title: Junkfood 4: Slotterween
description: Junkfood 4 is a 98-map community project hosted on the Pacifist Paradise Discord server. A Halloween-themed entry in the Junkfood series, where the premise is to make "Junk Food" slaughter where not a lot of time is spent deliberating about layout/detailing/fight design and other things that can bog a mapper down. It's just good BFG fun.

title: Catjinni Survivors
description: Catjinni is a single-player survivors-like auto-shooter. Battle endless monster hordes, upgrade abilities, and unlock powerful customizations. Face the sinister Jinn Ifrit and break free from the darkness. Survive. Customize. Conquer!

title: Monument Valley III: The Garden of Life
description:
The story continues.

Welcome to the seasons of Monument Valley 3. In the first season, help the Nomad create and care for the community garden.

title: Genshin Impact: Paralogism
description:
Version 5.6 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Escoffier and Ifa
• New main story quest: "Interlude Chapter: Act IV - Paralogism"
• New story quest for Escoffier
• New main event: Whirling Waltz
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: FMTC
description: FMTC is a multiplayer online shooter (TPS+FPS), 2Tap gameplay category. Choose the right location to land, choose the right skills for you, search for weapons, ammo, armor, vehicles and other equipment. One shot helmet, one shot head, two shots can kill the enemy, every moment, it is life and death.

title: Aijin
description: "'Aijin' is a Chinese dreamcore psychological and survival horror game with multiple endings. you play as a student who has returned from the 'Lover Internet Addiction Treatment School.' After enduring severe psychological trauma, one day you discover the truth about 'Aijin' and your own identity...

title: Find Clowns
description: The game is about finding 20 clowns who have wandered into a castle! There are a total of 100 characters in this game! Experience not only the search for clowns, but also what kind of characters live in the game world.

title: The Ghost of Alcantra
description: The Ghost of Alcantra is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one focusing on a blossoming romantic relationship, and another focused on unraveling a murder mystery.

title: Age of Empires IV: Knights of Cross and Rose
description: Command two well-known armies inspired by history in this epic return to Age of Empires IV!

title: Amanda the Adventurer 3
description: In the thrilling conclusion of the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy, follow Riley as they uncover the ultimate secrets behind Amanda, Hameln, and mysteries that have plagued Kensdale for decades.

title: The Beast and the Princess
description: A tower defense game where you combo ultimate moves to take down enemies! Have fun unleashing those moves while learning more about the twin princesses' story. Why did the twins get trapped in a game? What's the goal of the game master? And do you have what it takes to see it all to the end?

title: Malys
description: Expose, endure and expel evil from innocents on your hunt through a corrupted city. As Noah, former priest turned demon-hunter, you'll perform exorcisms, forge precarious alliances and strengthen your deck of arcane tricks in this unholy roguelite deckbuilder.

title: Questing
description: An oddball, subversive fantasy adventure game inspired by 16-bit classics like Chrono Trigger and A Link to the Past

title: Redrum: The Shining 2
description: A highly detailed 3-D recreation of the Overlook Hotel. You play the part of Duke Nukem, U.S. Marines Special Operative, sent in to take care of the "Caretaker." Yes, that's right. The sequel to The Shining is a video game.

title: Bionics: We Will Evolve
description: Take the role of Jonas Schmidt, a private investigator trapped in a deranged professor's house. Uncover the grim secrets of human experiments and grotesque machinery, all while solving puzzles and avoiding monstrous creations. Can you escape before you become the next test subject?

title: Bolf: A Golfoxing Game
description:
Two polar opposite sports meet at last - it's Bolf!

Box your golf ball and try to hit it as close to the hole as possible - only one stroke per hole. Watch for wind, water and bunkers - careful not to get knocked out!

title: Vietnam War
description: Open world single-player FPS. Command your squad in battle across jungles, hills and villages of Vietnam. Fight as U.S or Vietcong. Vast arsenal of weapons and 50+ vehicles

title: Eclipse of the Lost
description: A first-person horror story following Ryan's costly hiking shortcut. Solve puzzles, avoid monsters, get directions home, and survive.

title: Red Pistol
description: A roguelike bullet-hell with an immersive story, where a gunslinger faces hordes of zombies created by a vampire in a dark Wild West. Explore procedurally generated maps, hunt wanted criminals, build strategic playstyles with the skill card system, & take on challenging bosses in intense shootouts.

title: Bionicle: The Legend of Mata Nui Rebuilt
description: Bionicle: The Legend of Mata Nui is a canceled action-adventure video game developed by Saffire. In 2018, two developmental builds of the game were leaked online. YouTube community The Beaverhouse went on to found Litestone Studios, an independent video game development studio, with the goal of completing the game with support for modern computers. Version 1.0 of the updated game, Bionicle: The Legend of Mata Nui Rebuilt, was released on August 10, 2019.

title: Dark Soul.Ace 2
description: A RPG Maker Game. Mortis Ghost said of it " it’s maybe the best game I ever worked on".

title: Poco
description:
Poco is a 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure game where you play as Poco, a two-inch tall clown who is banished from a giant walking circus, and left to fend for themselves in the undergrowth of the Below World, where they befriend and enlist the help of the local homunculus population to build a rocket.

Explore the beautiful, cluttered Below World... Where everything broken, lost, or unwanted from the Worlds Above comes to decay.

title: Oh Tennis
description: In a universe where tennis is powered by screaming, you must yell louder than the rest if you want to be crowned the ultimate noisemaker or tennis player. So go and scream at your friends in PvP mode, or yell at an AI-driven robot in PvA. There's no way to enjoy tennis if you don't shout a little.

title: The Garden of the Gods
description:
In the village of Hitotose, where the heroin lives, there is a cultural tradition in which every year one of the young girls who turned twenty years old is chosen to dedicate herself to the four seasons Gods of the Earth.
They called this young girl "The Chosen Maiden".
Several years before, the heroin's big sister left the village because she was Chosen.
What is she doing now?
What are exactly the Gods of the Earth?
Why there is no Chosen Maiden who comes back to the village...?
I have attended this year's ceremony with skepticism and a paper doll fell in front of me...?!
Will that be a happy end or everything will end in tears...?
Your fate changes depending on your choices! Capture the hearts of these handsome Gods and get the happy endings!

The Spring God Arata The Youngest x Helpful
The loyal and cheerful type who likes humans a lot
His kindness will certainly make you melt!
The Summer God Ren Pretentious x Clumsy
The tsundere type who dislikes a lot humans
His sometimes sentimental side will keep you enthusiastic about him!
The Autumn God Kaede Mean x Unfortunate
A mean and elusive boy
You will spend days attacked by his sadistic words!
The Winter God Shu Cold x Natural
A cold and taciturn boy
You're fascinated by the gap between some sides of his personality and his appearance!

title: Try Them All!
description: A mysterious box is locked with a 4 to 8-digit code.Your only goal is to open it—with your own hands. No hints. No puzzles.But who needs them? If you try every number up to 9999... eventually, it will open.

title: The Spirit Engine DX
description: The Spirit Engine DX is a complete rewrite of the cult classic indie title from 2003 by Mark Pay. Instead of using a traditional turn-based system, an auto battler with real-time pausing is opted to allow players to switch tactics at their own pace without constant menu prompts.

title: Forgetmenots
description: Forgetmenots is a short story-driven puzzle game. Set on a theatre stage you control a knit doll trying to recreate lost memories. The game was made by Forgetful Studios a group of 10 students from Sweden.

title: Restart Heart
description: After a seriously messy break-up, you're on the market again. Except, you really don't want to open up to anyone. You just want to move on and live your life. But life has other plans, and so do your new 'friends.' Will you open up your heart again and accept someone new into it? Will you keep your new friends as just that, friends? Things start to get a little dicey when you realize someone is stalking you

title: Everything is Copper
description: Everything is Copper Mod (1.21.1, 1.20.1) adds a lot of things made of copper. The developer added copper ore to the game from Minecraft version 1.17, but it has not been used much. Copper in the current game is still lagging compared to other ores and is not as popular. The Copper Mod adds a lot of things made of copper, such as tools, weapons, armor, and more. This mod adds new items such as copper armor, swords, and axes that you can use instead of iron or stone in some cases. Copper tools are much better than stone tools and can be used to mine some materials faster, but they are not as strong as iron tools. Copper blocks can be used as an alternative to wood for building structures, but it is not as expected. Copper can also be used to craft many new items, including buckets, doors, fences, and more.

title: The Sims: 4 Sleek Bathroom Kit
description: Give your Sims a serene, modern bathroom featuring minimalist design and refined details with The Sims 4 Sleek Bathroom kit*. This collection brings a soothing vibe with a sophisticated aesthetic. The combination of clean lines and natural materials strikes a harmonious balance between warmth and elegance. Soft pastel tones blend effortlessly with brushed metal accents, while touches of greenery breathe life into the space, transforming any bathroom into a polished sanctuary. Created by Syboulette.

title: The Sims 4: Sweet Allure Kit
description: Add soft colors and clothing adorned with ribbons and bows to your Sims’ wardrobe with The Sims 4 Sweet Allure Kit*. With fashion featuring light colors and clothing adorned with ruffles and frills, the clothing and accessories in this kit give off an elegant vibe with their everyday looks. Express a more delicate side to a Sims’ fashion sense, effortlessly giving your Sim a casual coquette fashion feel. Created by Aharris00britney.

title: Better Days
description: This is a new type of PVE combat game that combines elements such as shooting, skill-based battles, exploration, search-and-destroy missions, PVE combat, survival in a free-roaming environment, vehicle control, and character customization.

title: Tidal Towns
description: Several pieces of driftwood have been gathered to form a village that floats on the waves. Features. New Structure: Ocean Village

title: Waystones
description: All the strategic depth of deckbuilding classics taken to the extreme! Manage combat on a tactical map, pursuing divine boons and avoiding the deadly spread of corruption in Waystones, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder!

title: JustHammers
description: Add hammers to the game that are able to mine in a 3x3, 3x3x3, 5x5x3 and finally a 5x5x5! They're pretty awesome.

title: Towns and Towers
description: Towns & Towers is a mod that aims to expand upon the 1.14 update created by Mojang with new villages, pillager outposts, and even brand-new ships. The structures themselves are a bit more detailed than their vanilla counterparts, but they still fit seamlessly into the world. Not only that but many are inspired by real-life buildings or architectural styles, giving them a fresh new feel. There are over 50 structures added by Towns and Towers so far (as of update 1.9), so have fun exploring! And remember, it’s not the destination that’s important, but the journey to get there.

title: Ribbits
description: RIBBITS is voice-action cooperative platformer! Players control frogs that adjust their jump strength using the volume of their voices, and work together by connecting their tongues like ropes to overcome obstacles. Shout, cooperate, and team up with your friends to reach your goal!

title: Shopping Clutter 12: Halloween at the Walkers
In the Pines
description:
A short horror game about buying a run-down house, and the residents that still reside.

You play as an unnamed protagonist trying to make a bit of cash flipping a house, when things make an unexpected turn.

title: Elfin National Park
description: Welcome to Elfin National Park! Once a wild and untamed land of creatures, we have now opened a portion to the public! Come on down and see the ever-changing sights of our forest. We have places for the whole family. Just please remember for the safety of you and your family to stay within the designated zones.

title: XI O'Clock
description:
Welcome to XI O'Clock, a thrilling game where you must explore hallways to find hidden anomalies. Your goal is to reach XI o'clock (11) by correctly identifying these strange occurrences.

Every time you spot an anomaly and pull the lever, you move one hour closer to your goal. But be careful—if you miss an anomaly, the clock resets, and you have to start over!

Can you keep your cool and make the right choices? Test your skills in a game where every second matters.

title: Aviãozinho do tráfico 1: despacito 5 quem ler é arrombado 2
Aviãozinho do tráfico 2: 3D resenha de pasta base de cocaína com Sorrizo Ronaldo
Kami Kamera
description:
On the last day of summer, the doors between the human and ghost worlds open, allowing 1000 ghosts to enter the mortal realm...

Some ghosts want to have fun, others wish to explore, and others are out for revenge...

Usually, demons known as SHASHINKAMI appear in the human world to send ghosts back by taking their pictures with a strange device known as the KAMI KAMERA.

This year, however, one SHASHINKAMI has decided that he wants to take a break from ghost hunting, and now one young girl must complete his task in his stead... OR DIE.

title: Ooohh, Big Stretch!!!
description:
Ooohh, Big Stretch!!! is a block-pushing puzzle game with a few extra twists!

Start your morning stretch (and never stop) as you collect treats and toys, growing ever longer and spreading through more and more of the house.

Watch out for messes! If you don’t clean up, you’ll spread them everywhere!

Sticky-tricky puzzles stand between you and everything you need for your trip to the park.

Stretch your way to walkies!

title: Aooni: The Horror of Blueberry Onsen
description: Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure! A completely new version of the legendary horror game "Ao Oni"!

title: Aliya's Awakening: Dooge 2042
description: Aliya's Awakening: DOGE 2042 is a narrative-driven interactive cyberpunk adventure game with secrets, survival, and justice. Experience a deep, and personal story of Aliya, and with her point of view, explore the dystopian cyberpunk world through fun and immersive gameplay.

title: Cucina Stellata
description:
Gastronomy meets horror in an unsettling narrative experience set in 19th-century Romagna, Italy.

Step into the shoes of a solitary writer and gourmet, inspired by the historical figure of Pellegrino Artusi, as a midnight snack spirals into the unexpected.

Cucina Stellata ✦ Starred Cuisine isn't your typical horror game: no frantic chases or cheap jump scares, but rather a thick atmosphere of tension, disturbing themes, and chilling twists that will linger in your mind long after the credits roll.

title: Ghost Witch: Soulstice Sprint
description: In this one-off holiday themed time trial, platform around as Esme the Ghost Witch and help the citizens of Terror Mountain reclaim their offerings in time for the Soulstice celebration!

title: Perrengue de escritor
description: Short typing game released in for Game JAAJ 4 for the "Your Enemy are your weapons" section".

title: Don't Feed It
description:
A derelict house. The door is chained shut—there’s a gap in the floor. Something is calling to you from below. Your heart feels like it's about to explode with each passing day. You try to breathe, but it feels like you're running out of oxygen. The air smells of rot. You don't remember how long you've been here, only that you have one very specific purpose: Feed it.

You have 10 days to complete your task, not counting the nights, of course. They told you to feed it during the day, not during the night. Nights are too terrifying.
Days are short here. You exist only to feed it...

title: The Moon Has Faded Away
description: After moving to a small apartment in a new city with his sister and mother for work-related reasons, Alex and his family's everyday life continues until an unprecedented event occurs: the disappearance of the moon.

title: Sonic.Exe 2: The Game
description: A video game adaptation of the sequel to the original Sonic.EXE story.

title: Beyond the Grove
description: Summon nature’s army in this charming RTS-inspired autobattler. With your troop of mushroom warriors and over 50 unique elemental Golems by your side, command your fun-guy forces to push back the corruption beyond your grove. Strategize, adapt, and overcome!

title: Mistful Crimson Morning
description: A mod about Squidward killing himself... FOR REAL THIS TIME!!!

title: Pokémon Awakening
description:
In the secluded Waerfall Village, ancient Idols guard divine secrets—and the enigmatic grimoire D. Moon, shared between you and your brother since infancy, has begun to awaken. Guided by Sage Addae and joined by your Pokémon team and Pixi, a spirited guardian fairy, you’ll explore Angard’s forgotten ruins and untamed wilds to unravel the grimoire’s ties to a looming Holy War. But as chaos threatens to shatter the world, a pivotal choice emerges: uphold order as the goddess’s champion, or embrace chaos to forge a new destiny.

Tailor your journey with a Class System that unlocks battle strategies, clash with towering Local Legends, and bond with allies through a relationship system that alters the story’s course. With time-based events, overworld encounters, and two stark endings, every decision weaves your legacy. Will Angard find peace—or burn in divine reckoning? The final page of D. Moon awaits your hand…

title: The Pink Valley
description: The Pink Valley is a Doom action-horror mod, a personal project by Vamvilodon that's been in development for around 3 years, where you take control as a disturbed man taking revenge on his small Chilean town.

title: Azhar Erriad: Hamzaoui Is Missing
description: Welcome to Azhar Erriad School, You are a new student at Azhar Erriad School, where nothing is quite as it seems. Your arrival coincides with the mysterious disappearance of Hamzaoui. Explore the school, meet its quirky students, and unravel the secrets hidden in the school.

title: Deeper and Darker
description:
Deeper and Darker adds an entire new dimension — the Otherside — with much content to explore. Here's a list with some of the features!

Biomes: explore the deeplands, echoing forest, overcast columns, and blooming caverns.
Structure: find an ancient temple, the home of the warden! Just be cautious when breaking the ancient vases to avoid awakening an ancient lurker.
Blocks: over a hundred new blocks to build, including gloomslate, sculk stone, and a new wood type!
Items: a brand-new warden set of armor and tools, an upgrade to elytra and the awesome sculk transmitter!
Mobs: 8 new mobs, including a miniboss!
To enter the Otherside, kill the warden and use its heart. Play the mod to find more content and explore hidden mysteries!

title: Ace Attorney: Prisoners of Fate
description:
Ace Attorney: Prisoners of Fate is a fangame based on the Ace Attorney series.

It serves as an interquel between the forth and fifth mainline entries in the series — Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies. Six cases are currently planned for the game.

title: The Bumblezone
description:
The Bumblezone is a bee dimension filled with many brand new bee-related blocks! There's even quite a few structures to explore and a unique bee armor you can obtain! If you are lucky, you may find a special Throne-Locating Honey Compasses from certain structures that leads you to a Bee Queen! The dimension itself looks like it is the inside of a bee nest and you will find giant walls in rows with canals of water between them. Maybe you'll even find a pollen covered section of the dimension or a canyon full of massive honey-based crystals! Check the Bumblezone advancements tab for how to enter dimension and what to do!

Also, you will find bees are extremely protective of their honey in this dimension. If you mine vanilla's Honey Block, destroy or take honey from Honeycomb Brood Block, or you hit a bee, all bees around you will get many buffs and will become VERY angry at you because you now have the Wrath of the Hive effect! But by feeding bees or the Honeycomb Brood Blocks with the honey foods that you have, you might be able to calm them down. By feeding bees or that brood block, you get Protection of the Hive that makes bees defend you against anyone attacking you! (You can nerf the bees in the config if you find them too strong or buff them if you want to die!)

title: Submeris
description: Submeris is an underwater mining adventure set beneath a mysterious island. Dig, upgrade your gear, survive dangerous depths, and uncover the legendary treasure hidden far below the ocean floor!

title: Stealpop's Basics
description: Stealpop's Basics is a game inspired from Baldi's Basics and was originally made in February 2021 and is ongoing many updates.

title: Born in Chaos
description:
