Born in Chaos is a mod that adds many new aggressive mobs with their own characteristics, it also adds a new boss, weapons and armor, decorative blocks, as well as new structures. Mod aims to diversify and complicate your survival by adding a variety of opponents that require a specific approach and tactics. With Born in Chaos, you will once again have a sense of fear of going out at night and exploring the dark caves, because now there will be dangers everywhere.
All mobs and structures spawn in all other biomes from other mods.

title: L_Ender 's Cataclysm
description:
Cataclysm is a mod that adds difficult dungeons, challenging boss-fights and powerful items.

This mod's bosses are inspired by Minecraft Dungeons,

being much more unique, complex and powerful compared to Vanilla's.

Defeat them in battle to prove yourself and earn powerful gear!

title: The Dawn Era
description:
The Dawn Era is a modification for Minecraft that brings many changes to your world.
The main one is the fauna of prehistoric times, which became extinct long ago, as it might seem at first glance. Explore the remains of past civilizations, hunt and tame, explore and discover with The Dawn Era!
Can you survive?

title: Listen Up! We Tried to Make "Those Games" Even More Extreme! Some Things Have to Be Learned the Hard Way!
description: THOSE GAMES are back, and harder than ever! Play upgraded, more difficult versions of familiar minigames to your heart's content! Are you up to the challenge? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!

title: Call of Yucatán
description: Call of Yucatan is a mod that adds 2 dungeons appearing in the jungles. These dungeons reference Maya and Aztec mythology and culture. Puzzles, traps, monsters, and gods like Kukulkan await you. The mod features numerous construction blocks, ruthless mystical fauna, and resources that will allow you to craft advanced equipment useful in your survival

title: Micromega
description: MICROMEGA blends hand-drawn artistry with intricate puzzles in a surreal 2D physics-based adventure. Guide a fragile Sphere through the unique world of visual artist Mani, interacting with its creatures to unlock paths and overcome challenges. A mesmerizing journey of beauty and fun!

title: Simple Hats
description:
Simple Hats is a JSON-configurable cosmetic hat mod that allows users to define their own hats with various additional options such as variants, dye-ability, particle effects, and seasonality.

There are almost 300 custom hats included in the mod by default that users can add/remove/change as they like.

title: OrbGuard
description: Defend Earth against waves of deadly cosmic threats determined to destroy your civilization! In this Rogue-Lite Auto Shooter, you’ll place Celestial bodies and upgrade them to unleash chaos on your enemies. How long will you survive?

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Vaults of the Artificers
description: From fiery crystal mines and kobold-infested islands to fantastic extra-planar vaults, House Cannith needs you for missions of acquisition and conquest. This is a premium collection of dungeons with 12 timed challenges. They support all character levels and play more like very long minigames that reward teamwork.

title: Joe Rules: Reloaded
description: Joe Rules: Reloaded is a top-down shooter game where you solve puzzles, kill enemies and progress through progressively difficult levels!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Temple of Elemental Evil
description: An enormous premium dungeon narrated by Wil Wheaton. Adapted from the classic Dungeons & Dragons pen-and-paper module.

title: MuteX+
description: MuteX+ is a challenging hack-and-slash inspired by the flash game Amorphous+. It focuses on tackling enemies that can merge mid-fight while mastering a fluid moveset with an unconventional control scheme.

title: Operation Enduring Pretzel
description: Operation Enduring Pretzel is a Czech indie FPS game where you infiltrate a government building taken over by terrorists. You progress through different floors (Garden, Ground Floor, 1st Floor, Basement), collecting keys, documents, weapons (like COLT, submachine gun, and MINIGUN), and battling enemies.

title: Path of Clicks
description:
This is a clicker game with RPG elements, where you gather resources that can be sold or used to create new ones, unlock upgrades, and strengthen your character.
Travel through unique maps, battle monsters, and use their loot to craft new items. There are weapons to enhance, levels to gain, and skills to learn.

title: What Walks on Four Legs
description: Play as Charles, an old journalist chasing down rumours of a strange phenomenon known as Portals that change anything that passes through them. An other-wordly mysterious light emits from the Lighthouse nearby. He had to see this for himself.

title: Idle Boss Rush
description: Slay giant bosses and turn the hollow wasteland into the almighty kingdom! Endlessly rewarding incremental game where you collect fountains of rare loot, unleash crazy combos and watch the monsters fall under your knees. Boss Rush that keeps on going when you're gone!

title: Crownbound: Fantasy Kingdom Sim
description: You’re the ruler, but your heroes have minds of their own. Recruit heroes, set rewards, build a thriving kingdom and hope your warriors don’t run off chasing squirrels instead of fighting monsters.

title: Trust
description: Explore a small open world in first-person, solving environmental puzzles across five distinct biomes. Observe, experiment, and uncover secrets at your own pace in this calm, discovery-focused indie experience.

title: Demon Bluff
description: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

title: Lone Soul
description: Lone Soul is a fast-paced hack-and-slash action game with fluid, combo-based combat and roguelite progression. Fight your way through a mythical tower, and discovering game-changing synergies between acquired gear and new spells in a uniquely designed world where fantasy meets space.

title: Set a Watch: Digital Edition
description: Assemble your party to survive in this dice-management game! Master steel and magic: roll dice and next use them to attack directly or for powerful abilities. Scout, light a fire, use ancient runes or equip perks to prepare before battle. Use tactics to fight monsters and Unhallowed. Set a watch!

title: Beatfinder
description: Dash, jump, and strike to the beat! Take on a city overrun by cultists in this fast-paced side-scrolling rhythm runner.

title: Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge
description: Blacksmith: Ignite the Forge is a mix of a simulator, strategy, and auto-battler. Become a master smith, craft various weapons, and enhance them with magical runes. Equip a team of adventurers with your hand-made tools, send them on missions, gather loot to upgrade your forge, and save the land!

title: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?
description: A strategic board game-style RPG where dice rolls guide your journey! Build your deck, explore changing maps, and face events shaped by your choices and luck. Play solo or online with friends—every adventure is a new experience!

title: Thrice Cursed
description: A roguelike game with Souls-style combat. Fight with a customised character through quests in a random order with randomised loot. Your character's build will be influenced by what you can find or buy. Every run feels a little different.

title: Pipeline Crawl
description: Trapped inside a narrow pipeline, your only choices are to move forward or backward. Deadly obstacles stand in your way, and a single mistake means starting over. Can you escape?

title: Abyssal Trench
description: Abyssal Trench is a first-person underwater horror game where you play as a lone explorer waking from cryo-sleep after a failed mission. With your pod out of fuel and your crew gone, a mysterious AI voice guides you to collect data from three abandoned drilling sites deep beneath the ocean.

title: Sword Tale: Lost Excalibur
description: Sword Tale: Lost Excalibur is an Action-Adventure game. It can be played using both a mouse and keyboard. Players embark on a journey to help a mysterious girl escape from a group of knights intent on harming her.

title: SignaNota
description: As the fallen god, 'Signa,' leave a myth of light on this land. We introduce you 'SignaNota'. A roguelike slingshot adventure game that you can simply enjoy.

title: BlazeRush: Star Track
description: The update featuresA campaign that includes 30 missions New type of vehicles — spaceships New types of weapons: laser, mines and chain lightning Special space-themed race track for multiplayer New powerful enemy — a massive spaceship

title: Emu Otori Clicker
description: A silly little clicker game based on the Project Sekai character Emu Otori.

title: Jump the Track
description: You're Sam, a young dreamer struggling in the gig economy. However, tonight may change everything. In this absurd comedy, fight your inner battles, rally your forces, and get ready to overthrow the system!

title: Seasonala Cemetery
description: A meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery as it changes with the seasons.

title: Skilander
description:
Grab your Ski's and race downhill while avoid melting ice caps and perilous pits in Skilander!

Proudly utilizing Ken Silverman's Build engine to provide what's possibly the first ever tactical FPS (First Person Skiing) game ever!

Skilander is a game designed with the fun of speedrunning in mind and comes with an easy Quick reset, encouraging competitive play and improving your times through the built-in high score system.

You play as Connor MacGleisberg, taking on the challenge of mastering 3 difficult Skiing slopes.

But you are not alone! The legendary ski shop maintainer Seppo from the city of Jaemsae is there to provide you valuable assitance! Remember – when in doubt, the right way is always the downhill.

Reach speeds you could have never imagined before and control the awesome power of "Snowquelching"!

title: Eternal Palace Sakura
description: "Eternal Palace Sakura" is a rogue-lite 3D action game where you power up your character and take on thrilling dungeon challenges packed with flashy combat. Step into the shoes of Retla, a brown-skinned, cat-eared dual-wielder, and explore the ever-shifting dream labyrinth!

title: Rewind to Fear: The Mansion
description: In "Rewind to Fear - The Mansion", you play as a brave woman returning to her late grandmother's home, discovering a trove of mysterious VHS tapes. When you press play on the vintage VHS player, you're transported into the memories of the person behind the camera. As you step into the shoes of an individual from the past, you'll unravel long-held family secrets, solve intriguing puzzles, and make choices that shape your history. Can you face the fear, confront the unknown, and connect the recorded memories to your own existence?

title: Tokei
description: Bun-Bot has claimed the world as his domain, it is the task of our hero Tokei to destroy and reclaim what has been taken away. Jump on every platform that lights up and that on time or else Bun-Bot might throw something on our hero Tokei. Luckily he has the power to fight back by obsorbing the power of the platforms in his fur and once he is fully charged up it is time to shoot back!

title: Something is Weird
description: You rent a cheap but big house while you're on vacation. But something is weird. Really, really weird...

title: Where's my Bara Deck?
description: Your Bara cards have vanished! Someone hid your deck around the house, and only you can find it. Explore 3D environments, search every corner, and unlock sensual art as you complete your collection. Ready for this spicy, surprise-filled hunt?

title: Keep of the Knights
description: Keep of the Knights is a battle simulator game where you can battle hordes of barbarians and other monsters. Upgrade your armor and weapons, hire allies, and, of course defend your keep!!!

title: Mycopunk
description: A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

title: Heroes Against Time
description: A roguelite where you gather allies and build the perfect team in a dangerous enchanted forest. Navigate events, fight enemies and dig through ruins while trying to avoid the creeping magical fog… Will your team endure… or be lost to the mist?

title: The Empty House: A Dementia Interactive Experience
description: A surreal interactive experience exploring dementia through FMV storytelling. Navigate a fading mind, make choices that shape reality, and uncover multiple endings in this emotional and psychological descent into memory loss.

title: Shimagami
description: Shimagami is an open-world RPG with anime-style visuals and deep lore. Battle fierce monsters in action combat, solve puzzles, and conquer challenges to uncover the mysteries of Shimagami. A diverse cast of demi-human heroines awaits—find your perfect companion and shape your adventure!

title: Dead Hourz
description: "Dead Hourz" is a thrilling survival adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world. In a land ravaged by zombies, bandits, and scarcity, you must protect your family by gathering resources and making tough choices.

title: Elemasta
description:
An open world RPG with beautiful pixel art.
Cities of various cultures, climates, and ruins are all seamlessly connected.
There are over 350 characters that can be your friends! Collect 3000 types of weapons and armor, defeat powerful enemies with your friends, and save the world!

title: Goddess Krypton Gold System
description: This is a "special" development adventure game performed by real people. Players play the role of "codenames" in the end times. It is up to the players to decide whether they can finally get the beauty or continue to fall into depravity through their own choices.

title: Dungeon Overdose
description: “Dungeon Overdose” is a roguelike command battle RPG combining dungeon exploration with overindulgence. Players manage “lives” while navigating a 100-floor procedurally generated dungeon, using random companions, events, and cards.

title: Good Morning Is Good Night
description:
Take a casual walk through space and time to cheer up a friend.

Good Morning is Good Night is a relaxing adventure game meant to put you at ease. Feel yourself unwind as you explore a sleepy little town and perform acts of kindness that transcend time.

title: Clawed
description: Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

title: Rebuild 2
description: The sequel to the first Rebuild game. Reclaim a city from the zombie hordes while managing supplies, housing and morale. Featuring new buildings, plotlines, characters, customizable survivors with skills and equipment, new & improved art and all new hidden endings to discover.

title: Dream Slayers
description:
Enter the twisted realms of Dream Slayers, a thrilling extraction RPG where reality and nightmare collide. In this dark fantasy world, players become elite warriors known as Dream Slayers, tasked with venturing into surreal dreamscapes to hunt fearsome creatures, reclaim lost relics, and escape before the dream consumes them.

Armed with a diverse arsenal of medieval-themed weapons—swords, axes, bows, and arcane tools—you must strategize every encounter. Each run offers new dangers and unexpected rewards as you navigate treacherous environments, solve cryptic puzzles, and face off against powerful bosses that embody the deepest fears of humanity.

Team up with friends or venture solo, balancing risk versus reward in high-stakes extractions. Will you grab the treasure and escape in time, or be trapped in an endless nightmare?

title: Catena
description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

title: Tengu no Kassha: Shoot and Embodiment!
description:
"Tengu no Kassha ~ Shoot and Embodiment" is a derivative work from Team Shanghai Alice, based on the setting and characters of the Touhou Project.
It is a heartwarming tengu roguelike where you interact with the characters through photography.

title: 2x0ng
description: Pronounced "TOO-zong", 2x0ng is a fun puzzle game, the sequel to Xong. Match colors to unlock new areas of each procedurally generated level while defeating enemies with your bouncing Squareball.

title: Mythscroll
description: Mythscroll is a fantasy RPG where every choice, encounter, and stat check shapes your journey. Explore the world, equip powerful weapons, master spells, and survive dynamic text-driven adventures, with D&D-inspired character building, turn-based combat, and branching outcomes.

title: Soul Chain
description: Use your soul as a grappling hook in this tight, non-linear, physics-based platformer. Swing through hundreds of hand-crafted challenges, explore a vast world inspired by classic metroidvanias, and find your place within the seasons of the Afterlife.

title: Infinity Blade PC
description: A PC Port of the classic iOS game Infinity Blade originally developed by ChAIR Entertainment.

title: Hyrax In The Rocks
description: LOOK, USE, TALK, and TAKE your way through this old-school text-based mystery of a broken kingdom. Only you can pry at the castle cracks and discover what lies at the core of a heart-breaking disappearance.

title: Backseat Drivers
description: Test your friendship in Backseat Drivers, the ultimate co-op driving disaster. One drives, one shouts directions, and your car belongs in the junkyard. Bump, crash, and scream your way through town as your clunker yeets into every possible obstacle. Yelling is inevitable. Apologies are optional.

title: The Anomaly Experiment
description: A Psychological Horror where you’re offered freedom by joining a trial for a new drug. The experiment is simple: enter the room, observe, and identify what has changed. Complete all tasks, and your sentence is commuted.

title: Astround
description: Rotate, aim and shoot in zero gravity space. "∀stround" is a zero-gravity shooting action game in which the screen rotates according to the character's direction. Survive against attacking creatures on a space station where gravity suddenly disappears.

title: Nindo: Guardian of the Starlit Shadow
description: "NINDO: Guardian of the Starlit Shadow" is a ninja rogue-like deck-building game set in a beautiful Japanese-inspired world. Face powerful enemies, make strategic choices, and grow stronger to craft a unique battle style.

title: Touhou Infinite Nocturne
description: "Touhou Infinite Nocturne" is a Roguelike role-playing game. In this game, you will take on the role of a team traversing the main stage of the Touhou worldview, Gensokyo, seeking help from friends, battling enemies, encountering various random events, and ultimately determining the fate of Gensokyo.

title: Eutolant Saga
description:
Eutolant Saga is a classic-style tactical simulation RPG developed and published by Oistar Games, released in early access on September 7, 2025 for PC.

The game is set in the fantasy world of Eutolant, where players follow a war chronicle story that spans multiple continents. Players command a party of units across varied maps and engage in turn-based strategy battles that emphasize tactical positioning and unit skills.

Key gameplay systems include a traditional weapon and magic rock-paper-scissors style affinity, movement skills that influence battlefield strategy, and a wound system in which defeated allies become injured and withdraw, causing temporary setbacks without permanent loss. Difficulty options allow players to tailor the challenge to their preferences.

The game also features a large cast of characters, encouraging diverse unit growth and personalized strategies as players progress through the narrative.

Although it is in Early Access, the game is playable through to the ending. Future updates are planned to include enhancements to the New Game Plus features and the album functionality.

title: Crablike
description:
Crablike is a traditional dungeon-crawler roguelike, following in the footsteps of the original Rogue, where you play as a crab. The whole game takes place underwater, as you travel across the ocean to find the source of a mysterious corruption that is turning all sea life against each other. Do you have the cunning, strategy, and tenacity to survive in the hostile depths?

Of course you do. You're a crab. The pinnacle of evolution.

title: 4004Ripper
description:
I gave this girl most of my life. No one else would have done something similar for her. I can't believe how differently things turned out from what I thought they could be.

I gave a part of my soul to this girl in the shape of a wired arm connected to her mind. Nonetheless, it seems like she started developing independence from me, and it's okay. I'm okay with that.

Even my mind is fuzzy when it comes to thinking about where this girl came from. One day, everything around me disappeared—every person I've met, every day, week, or even years of hard work. I'm unlucky enough to have transferred my soul to hers.

I don't know if this is what I wanted, but I'll make sure to help this girl leave this place. Through her empty eyes... I can see myself—a girl I stopped being long before I realized my life was a mess.

I named her Cry-e-Sys.

title: Super Real Mahjong Love 2~7! Special Edition
description: The special edition of Super Real Mahjong Love 2~7! bundles a retail copy of the game with a special outer box, a set of reprint instruction cards, and a miniature art book.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Attack on Stormreach
description: A premium set of 4 quest dungeons. Droaam, the kingdom of monsters, is attacking Stormreach. These adventures bring players over, under and around Stormreach, eventually leading to an ancient giant's ruin where monstrous deeds are underway.

title: Nip for Speed 2: Searching for Pussy
description: On still waters with a dog at the wheel, a catnip trace ahead. Mist, moonlight, and the unknown—what could be out there?

title: Morwen Estate
description:
The case was cold. The house was colder.

Detective Ryan McMillan’s investigation into a string of missing persons cases brings him to the isolated Morwen Estate. But when a sudden blow leaves him unconscious, he awakens in a dark, damp basement—surrounded by cryptic clues and the restless spirits of the lost.

To escape, McMillan must explore the eerie estate, uncovering the tragic stories of those who vanished. Every room hides secrets. Every item left behind is a key to the truth. But as the past resurfaces, something far darker watches, waiting for its next victim.

The truth is buried, but escaping may cost you everything...

title: The Outlast Trials: Project Relapse
description:
Project Relapse is the third season within The Outlast Trials, introduced on April 22nd, 2025.

This update includes:

New Trial: Liquidate the Union
2 New MK-Challenges: Spread the Disease & Cook the Informant
New Deluxe Catalog: Project Relapse
New Enemy: The Jaeger
New Limited-Time Event: Jaeger Onboarding
Introducing a New Game Mode: Trial Maker
Introducing the Relapse Initiative
Player Progression Adjustments
Save Game support in Escalation Therapy
Nudity Filter Toggle
Join Trials “In Progress”
Other additions, improvements and fixes

title: Doki Doki Salvation Remake!
description:
This is a remake of the mod Doki Doki Salvation that came out in 2018.

What if things could be different? What if you could save her? This question plagued the minds of most people after finishing the first act of DDLC. The story begins shortly after MC confesses his love for Sayori on the day before the festival. something wakes him up in the middle of the night however, and prompts him to check on Sayori, stopping her before she takes her own life. Salvation Remake is a mod that lets you see what a second chance could've looked like. A chance that, in some cases, we don't get to have. The mod, while being Sayori focused, also gives the others, especially Monika, a chance to show their own stories as they all struggle to cope with the near loss of a beloved friend. The mod puts a much heavier emphasis on friendship and trust rather than romance, and offers a much more grounded experience than the original does. Would you be her salvation once more?

title: One Last Star Trip
description: A visual novel about chasing love in university.

title: The Fae King Is My Roommate
description: ​Slice-of-Life Dark Fantasy Romance VN

title: Survival Hold Your Self
description: Survive alone in an open world. Explore biomes, build a base, craft items, and fight wild animals and bandits for your survival. Collect resources and earn your way to becoming a survival hero.

title: Rekindled Trails
description: Gather and Sell faraway goods to rebuild ruined towns and bring back light to a dark world in this cozy adventure game. With the help of your fire companion, fish, pull and mine natural resources in Aurteris to unite the people of this strange yet fantastic world!

title: Where They Wait
description: "Never enter the forest on Beltane Eve," they said

title: Circus of Clowns
description: For AF2024

title: Nanika Game Online
description: Choose from a variety of “Nanika,” each with unique skills, and build your very own original deck to challenge other players. Merge identical Nanika to evolve them, master the perfect timing for skill activation, and aim for victory!

title: Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse 2020
description: Dracula's Curse 2020 is a remake of the NES classic Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse. Its creators make a couple of key updates and enhancements: improved character control, newly drawn graphics, and a rearranged soundtrack. Familiar Dracula's Curse enemies appear, of course, but the cast also includes directly ripped and modified versions of characters that have appeared in other classic series games (Super Castlevania IV, Symphony of the Night, and the like).

title: Deedlee Doo! Carkour!
description:
A game where you do parkour with a car using explosions.
Everything in the game is made out of clay in real life.
The sound effects and music are all mouth sounds.
If you screw up a jump, children laugh and make fun of you. (Just like real life!)
Can you reach the top of the Meowtain?

title: Let's Meet Tomorrow
description: After countless nights spent talking online, you’re finally meeting Silas, the friend who made you laugh, listened to your secrets, and quietly stole your heart. He's visiting your country for a few days, and you’re determined to make every moment count. Maybe even confess how you really feel.

title: Project Motor Racing
description: All the passion, beauty & intensity of pro motorsport merging the most iconic cars & circuits with a new benchmark in handling performance.

title: Brave x Junction
description:
Do you leave it to chance or trickery?
A brand-new experience, a blackjack RPG!

title: Vampire Cat
description: Vampire Cat is an Idle Game,Roguelike 2D, where you capture, upgrade and control vampire cats in looping tactical battles. Choose your attack, spin, eliminate enemies, capture them and build a supernatural army. Every decision counts.

title: Detective Club: Missing in the Fog - Collector's Edition
description: Join Thomas and George, two young detectives, as they solve mysteries and find hidden objects in the foggy streets of Victorian London.

title: Horripilant
description: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon.

title: Mining Company
description: Online co-op horror for 1-4 players. Mine nearby asteroids for gems to pay for your new company's spaceship. Time your orbits, day-trade the minerals market, and avoid deadly monsters at night. Create your own public or private server and see how many days your crew can stay in business!

title: Photography
description: This mod has been created to meet very specific needs. It adds a camera to easily take photos from the client renderer to enable the use of shaders while maintaining compatibility with vanilla clients. To clarify the mod is required on both server and client sides. Vanilla clients will still be able to join and see the photos, but will not be able to see or use the added features (which will be displayed as vanilla items), and the items and photos will remain in the world after the mod is removed.

title: Kyoto Anomaly
description: Kyoto Anomaly is an anomaly detection game, inspired by games like The Exit 8, Platform 8 and Shinkansen 0. The player finds themselves trapped in the endless maze of Kyoto's backstreets, trying to reach the temple of Hōkan-ji before the main tourist rush. Inspect the street for anomalies, choose the right path, and reach your destination… or be trapped forever.

title: Gravel: Colorado River
description: The hot sizzling Arizona desert is the perfect place for a new Off-road Masters episode. Gravel Channel returns to the U.S.A. with new tracks and spectacular Wild Rush races organized around a dam on the Colorado River.

title: Archa
description:
As Archa, fight enemies with your scythe Anubis, use your cards, and collect items and shards to raise your score and get the Interdimensional Pumpkins or Carrots in this upcoming Bullet-Hell Platformer!

Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

title: Plaything
description: You wake up in a deranged captor's dungeon, treated as a prized plaything. He subjects you to deadly games testing your worthiness—failure means death, success could add you permanently to his collection. Your only chance is to escape, but beware: getting caught trying means certain doom.

title: Pharabis
description: Hidden in the cursed pyramid, a powerful mask awaits. It controls the elements, but only Pharaohs can use it. Many have tried to find it, but none have returned. Will you be the one to uncover its secret?

title: Van V. Vamp
description: You are Van Helsing. The army of Vamps have kidnapped your wife -- because they're in love with *you*. Kill them all.

title: Dragimon Dungeons
description: Prepare to challenge your friends in this mix of Dice, Monsters, and Strategy! Best your opponent by building your own mix of Monsters and Dice. Then, expand your path to fight your Rival's monsters using abilities to boost your own Monsters! The first to knock out their opponent's Gem Master wins!

title: Ecoco de Fight!
description: Ecoco de Fight! is a 2D platformer doujin game featuring the mascot for the Japanese company Tohoku Electric Power's air conditioner product "Eco-Ice" called "Ecoco" and various characters from Di Gi Charat.

title: Pulse Phobia
description: You control Kevin, aged 18, who woke up in a house, but the more strange is that he already knows this place, why ? Why is he here ? Try to discover the truth by collect the clues and find the final answer. But be careful, the fear is waiting for you. Be careful.

title: The Rake: Back To Asylum
description: The Rake: Back To Asylum is a short indie horror game situated in an abandoned asylum, with the goal of retrieving a cellphone and escape.

title: Gear Up Einstein!
description: Einstein becomes your soldier in this tactical multiplayer roguelite where strategy meets history. Lead a squad of legendary figures, craft insane item synergies, and fight through twisted historical timelines. Gear up your team, coordinate with your friends, and save the world in a new way every time!

title: Everwind
description: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

title: Maline
description: The zany and heartfelt story of Maline, a kind devil girl from Hell who discovers the true power of Kindness one day by giving a generic demon a compliment... and the chance to truly make everyone friends! Is this a dream come true, or just another demonic swindle?

title: Flamefall
description: In this pausable real time tactics horror game, you play as a team of four Ember Wardens who venture into the dark woods, searching for the Altar of Flame that you need to reignite. Exploring the darkness, fighting off creepy ambushing enemies and looting is all done with a unique combination of automatic and manual abilities that are gained through items found throughout the game.

title: The Long Tale
description: The Long Tale is a brutal black-and-white pixel platformer where every step can be your last. No tutorials, no mercy — just deadly traps, instant restarts, and pure challenge. Jump, die, rage, repeat — and uncover the long tale behind the ruins, the dragon, and the missing princess.

title: Jong Kyu Pon
description: "Baseball" × "Mahjong" × "Pachinko" × "Training"! A game where just playing mahjong can lead to winning at baseball? Become the manager of a high school baseball team in another world, manage and train your team, play mahjong and pachinko, and lead them to victory!

title: Fit and Fry
description: Cooking here is a delicious puzzle. Each level is a new dish to prepare, and your challenge is to fit all the ingredients perfectly into the pan. But be careful: space is limited, and only the best chefs will be able to complete each recipe without wasting anything.

title: Penguin Flight: Beyond The Clouds
description: In Penguin Flight: Beyond the Clouds, join the determined penguin on his quest to defy gravity! This 2D pixel art platformer offers challenging levels, creative obstacles, and high-flying action.

title: Mystic Pathways
description: Embark on a magical journey with Mystic Pathways, a puzzle game that challenges your logic and creativity. Manipulate enchanted trails on a beautifully designed hexagonal board to guide mystical fairies in collecting magical crystals and activating sacred altars.

title: Brawlhalla X Year of Shadow Launch
description: Celebrating the Year of Shadow the Hedgehog is back and he isn't done cleaning up Sonic's mess in Brawlhalla! This crossover mod see's a full rework of our original Shadow/Cross!

title: Fluffy Autumn
description: You are Coco, a little lost kitten wandering aimlessly through Westpace Park until you meet Rocky. Your mission is to help Rocky find a bone that is lost somewhere in the park.

title: Trails
description:
TRAILS is a cozy puzzle game in which players guide sandships across a crumbling desert to reach isolated outposts.

Players draw lines on a grid in order to plot the movement of ships that cannot selfintersect or visit a tile twice. When done drawing they can start the simulation and see the outcome their routs produced. If the ships reach their goal without collision and while satisfying all victory conditions they win and advance to the next level. Over the course of the game more and more interacting mechanics get added to the game, requiring players to supply outposts with vital cargo, unlock new passages, juggle items, avoid hostile drones and support allied ships.

title: Orbs Orbs Orbs
description: Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D precision clicker game. Clear the board with a white ring, master six orb types, and navigate the dynamic physics in a playful blend of relaxation and strategy.

title: The Ember Guardian
description: Explore a post-apocaliptic world in a beautiful pixel art style. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and setup your defenses during the day. At night, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

title: Royal Randomizer
description: This is a Randomizer mod for Persona 5 Royal. It randomizes the enemies in (almost) every encounter in the game with any enemy.

title: Demining
description: Demining is a 1-4 player semi open-world horror experience where every step could be your last. Work together or by yourself as you disarm deadly mines, delve into bountiful ruins, and fight to see another day.

title: Bennett Foddy's Speed Chess
description:
Bennett Foddy’s Speed Chess is the fastest game of chess in the world. Designed for sixteen players to play simultaneously, it lets players move their piece instantly, without waiting for their turn. They can change which piece they control at will. The game proceeds at the speed of thought.

This game was commissioned for NYU GameCenter‘s essential No Quarter event, and it is built for public festivals. It doesn’t have a UI and it definitely has bugs, and it might even fail to work on your computer. To enjoy it to the fullest, you’ll need 16 USB controllers and 16 friends, although you can play it with as few as 2.

title: League of Legends: 2025 Season Two - Spirit Blossom Beyond
description: Atakhan reveals to LeBlanc that the Darkin weapon she is seeking is somewhere in Ionia, where the Spirit Blossom Festival is currently taking place. At the same time Xin Zhao, the Seneschal of Demacia and a former pit Reckoner of Noxus, has decided to return to his birthplace of Ionia and discover more about its culture and his connection with the land of the spirits.

title: Packin'
description: Pacman with conservation of mass.

title: Boxing School II
description: BOXING SCHOOL 2! Take control of a boxing gym in the 80s. You’ll hire the boxers, teach them to fight and climb the ranks. This is the improved and refined sequel to the management game Boxing School.

title: Passage IV: Race to the Grave
description: Get further to the right than your twin, and enjoy the benefits of a well-placed death!

title: The Last Corpse Forge: Survivor
description: This top-down endless survivor lets you play as re-animated corpses. Progress through this challenging and dark bullet-hell while upgrading your corpses and unlocking powerful torches to help power you through the relentless enemies and bosses.

title: Formula Legends
description: From the golden age to the modern era, race through time in Formula Legends. Master reimagined circuits, command legendary cars, and chase glory across decades of motorsport history. A love letter to Formula racing, where speed, skill, and strategy define the champion.

title: Joker w Coat Physics
description:
Play as Joker from Persona 5
This mod includes Coat Physics

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - The Shovel DLC
description: A free DLC collaboration between Owlcat and Fatshark, bringing the Sapper Shovel from Warhammer 40,000: Darktide into Rogue Trader - a brutal weapon from Atoma Prime, now repurposed for the cold void of the Koronus Expanse.

title: Fleetbreakers
description: Fleetbreakers is a modern blend of classic strategy and fast-paced combat. Build your fleet, upgrade your units, and manage your squadron as you battle through a unique roguelike campaign in the quest to liberate space from the evil Voltari.

title: Dragon Roomates
description: A romantic slice of life visual novel about polyamorous relationships ... and dragons!

title: Castle Combat
description: RTS, but the soldiers will act automatically: Each soldier has different characteristics/attribute values/action methods. Choose the appropriate soldiers and buildings according to the battlefield situation, and destroy the opponent's castle only through your strategy rather than operation!

title: The Rake: Hostel
description: The Rake: Hostel is a short indie horror game situated in an abandoned hostel, with the goal of retrieving a cellphone and escape.

title: Sem Saída
description:
The story takes place in Nova Esperança, fictional city of São Paulo (Brazil).
You are in control of a regular adult man called Marcos Leme, a simple helper in mail delivery, he is divorced and have a son to take care.
One night at 11PM (already passed his service hours), Marcos is still wandering the city with his arrogant working "partner", with only a mysterious letter addressed to a building that you've never heard about, arriving there, your partner leaves you all alone to make the delivery.
The plot takes place there, in that big building that you had no idea it existed, what is this place? It's really morbid, I don't feel good here, a great discomfort takes over my soul... I want to go home...

title: Stealth Crossword
description: Stealth! Crossword! Action!

title: The Last Guild
description: An RPG full of combat and regions to explore, focused on collecting resources to create magical items and defeat monsters. You are the last defender of this kingdom, hire adventurers to help you on your journey.

title: Frog Heist
description:
Commit the greatest heist in frog history...

Steal famous artwork as a cute frog to build your own art gallery!

title: In Falsus
description: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.

title: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
description: The incredible Mr. Rabbit invites you all to a mysterious magic show! Celebrate 10 years of Rusty Lake with a new free-to-play point-and-click adventure that promises to delight and… shock you with its sleight of hand!

title: Neon Overdrive
description:
Neon Overdrive is an MBF21 project featuring 15 meticulously crafted maps by a talented team of eight mappers.
Explore various challenges, ranging from "classic" to "slaughter" styles, all infused with Vapor/Synthwave and Cyberpunk aesthetics.

The year is 198X. After chasing the fading sunset for what seems like a lifetime, you find yourself at the gates of Neon City:
A place for those who subconsciously yearn for the comfort of something long gone, where nostalgia and aesthetics collide into an array of pulsating lights.
Tired but hopeful, you enter these half-forgotten halls.

title: Blitz: Race Against Time
description: A 32 map megawad created by the Russian Doom community, featuring maps of various themes and gameplay styles, all centered around a single concept: The exit permanently closes after 30 seconds.

title: Robot Hospice
description: "Robot Hospice" is a 2D pixel art adventure game where beloved robots spend their final days in a hospice. As a new staff member, you will gently yet painfully bid farewell to these cherished machines that once lived alongside humans.

title: A Mansão
description: A Mansão is a psychological survival horror game made by Will in RPG Maker XP, inspired by Silent Hill and the developer's own nightmares. You play as an unnamed protagonist invited to a suspicious party at a nearby mansion. From the start, unsettling events—shadowy figures, eerie noises, and sudden deaths—hint at something sinister. Trapped inside, you must explore, evade danger, and uncover the terrifying truth without combat, relying on tension and atmosphere to deliver a chilling experience.

title: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
description: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

title: The Age of Bhaarat
description: The Age of Bhaarat is a dark fantasy action RPG that brings ancient India to life. Become a powerful Forest Warden, master mystical weapons and arcane powers, and defend your homeland against a devastating invasion by vicious demons, the Rakshasas.

title: Akinakes
description: Akinakes is a fast-paced shoot 'em up game where you pilot a powerful ship through vibrant levels, collect upgrades to enhance your firepower, and take on epic boss battles.

title: Icy Gifts
description: A thrilling and engaging chain reaction game that will keep you hooked till the end!

title: Banter
description: Banter is a social experience in virtual reality; you can meet new people and visit various worlds. Banter has various events you can join daily!

title: TubeDudeMan
description: A platformgame with 4 worlds, 64 levels, in which you control a guy that has to get to the next tube. Controls: Arrow keys + spacebar.

title: Fragmented Fear
description: You take on the role of Miyako, a schoolgirl who awakens in an abandoned school cloaked in an eerie red mist. With no memory of how she got there, she is hunted by a ghostly girl with hollow eyes and cryptic motives. Paired with a haunting soundtrack and a tense, oppressive atmosphere, the game draws you into a nightmare where every corridor conceals dark secrets and every shadow could be your end. Survive, piece together the school’s mysteries, and confront the terror within the mist.

title: Attack on Inirea
description:
Attack on Inirea is an arcade-style shooter for PC, Mac, Linux and Steam OS.

The player is tasked with defending the peaceful village of Inirea from hordes of monsters, gaining points and powerups as you progress through the maps.

title: Snekburd
description:
Snekburd is a Pico-8 demake of Snakebird, by Noumenon Games, with new puzzles and mechanics! Navigate the snakebirds to eat all the fruit and head through the portal to complete the levels on each island. The first island's levels should serve as a quick tutorial to new players or a refresher for returning ones.

The full game has about 70 levels in it, ranging from a little tricky to absurdly hard, and is available for free (donations enabled with Noumenon Games' permission).

title: Defenders of Etheria
description: Defenders of Etheria is a cooperative, RPG-inspired bullet-heaven where you'll lead crusades to reclaim territory against the Old One's Army. Recruit new heroes and pet companions, forge mighty gear, and hone your hero's abilities to preserve the sanctity of the kingdom!

title: Reverse 1999: Showdown in Chinatown
description:
Version 2.5 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Liang Yue, Noire, and Loggerhead
• New Garments for Windsong, Jiu Niangzi, Tuesday, Sotheby, Druvis III, The Fool
• New main event: Showdown in Chinatown
• New Anecdote for An-an Lee
• …and more!

title: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
description: Join Selene in a charming platforming and puzzle adventure, where her ability to absorb and emit light from various flowers is key to activating mechanisms, overcoming obstacles, and navigating through environments that adjust depending on how you wield the light.

title: The Shadow Syndicate
description: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.

title: Play Friends: Party Games
description: Play together, wherever you are! A party game for 2-8 players, using your phones as controllers. Play action, strategy, and board games with friends and family—locally or remotely! Wishlist now!

title: Deadly Quiet
description: Deadly Quiet is a 4-player co-op asymmetrical horror game set in the eerie Hoia Baciu forest. Featuring a bodycam perspective, your fate depends on your actions and the cooperation of your entire team. But remember to STAY QUIET.

title: Seamongrel
description: Welcome to Sea Ecosystem Adventure (SEA) park. Explore the park, and have a gander at the breathtaking exhibits the aquarium holds! Watch sharks swim about in the tunnel tank, be mesmerized by the glowing jellyfish, and admire the iconic SEA Park dolphin statue! The park is for you to (die) have your own adventure!

title: A Comfy Place
description:
Explore diferent ambients in this calm island
What would be on top of that cliff?
What is that black ball? Will i be able to go through it?
What would be at the bottom of that lake?

title: Metal Savior
description:
Metal Savior is a cancelled futuristic First-Person Shooter developed from 2010 to 2012 by Mangled Eye Studios, exclusively for the PC.

The player would have taken the role of XAC-987, a security drone that has been activated to protect a weapons facility from being overrun and destroyed by Nanotech Machines.

title: Shadow Fang
description: Alex and Bob went to the forest to pick mushrooms and ended up staying overnight for a few days. As time passed, they began to feel an increasing sense of unease, as if the forest was watching them and something was not quite right. Their discomfort grew each day, as though they were intruding upon something dark and threatening.

title: The Heart of Influencer
description: You are entrusted with training five "troubled" influencers from Mountain & Sea Media, and gain the “Heart Probe” ability which allows you to uncover girls’ inner thoughts. Use your wisdom and ability to help them meet their training KPIs, while discovering their real selves beneath their facades.

title: The Horrors of the Soviet Apartment
description: A short horror game that takes place in an abandoned, musty Soviet apartment, which has a terrible atmosphere. You have to pick up all the valuables in a short period of time and quickly leave so as not to run into him... face to face. Who is it?

title: Epsilon Protocol
description: Epsilon Protocol is a sci-fi turn-based tactics game with a rich story and refreshing visual style. Set in a reality where the Epsilon controls everything after they discovered light-speed travel. Take control of a team of rebels pushing against Epsilon's forces.

title: Initial Unity
description: Initial Unity is a free fan-made game inspired by the anime/manga series Initial D.

title: Infinity Blade II PC
description: A PC Port of the second installment in Infinity Blade series originally developed by ChAIR Entertainment and Epic Games.

title: Frog Pond
description: Frog Pond is a relaxed, bite-sized desktop idler where you can decorate a pond and collect different kinds of frogs.

title: Lonely House
description: Lonely House is a cozy little game about home decorating. It's just you, pleasant music, and a solitary building at a crossroads. Decorate it to your liking and forget about your troubles.

title: Cryphora
description: A remote mountain cabin, a raging snowstorm, and the line between reality and madness begins to blur. Make difficult choices, explore surreal worlds, and confront what waits in the dark.

title: Playtown 3
description: Thirteen years later, Playtown reopens, but it's no longer just a playground. Uncover the dark rise of the enigmatic E.Y.E. Order, battle terrifying mutated mascots, and stop Hexcor before his plan destroys everything. The truth lies beneath. Survive the nightmare. End the Order.

title: ARCA-102
description: Face logic challenges in this Escape Room game, where every second counts! Join Mirra, your mercenary partner, to uncover the mysteries of an abandoned colonizer ship on an unknown planet.

title: Paperents
description:
After moving into their new home, 10-year-old Liam begins to sense an unsettling presence lurking in the dark corners of his room.

Strange noises echo through the house, and his parents grow increasingly bizarre and terrifying.

Paralyzed and confined to his bed, Liam finds himself trapped in a room filled with unspeakable horrors, slowly sinking into endless desperation.

title: Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia
description: This is a 3D action game in which you take weapons from your enemies to strengthen yourself. The game offers a variety of combat styles, including shooting, fighting, guarding, and invincibility, depending on the situation. In addition, the use of aerial dash enables three-dimensional combat.

title: Hayo and the Emporium
description: Deckbuilding roguelike. In Hayo and the Emporium, display the items your customers desire and earn as much gold as possible. Strategically manage your emporium to avoid bankruptcy!

title: I Write Games Not Tragedies
description: An emo-inspired narrative rhythm game exploring growing pains, addiction, romance and music. Scream with Ash as he makes the transition from baby bat to elder emo, guide him through his growing pains, and help him navigate his dirtbag life through music.

title: Luna Hop
description: Luna Hop is a 3D narrative adventure game set in modern Seoul. As Luna, you’ll explore a colorless city, overcome gentle obstacles, solve simple puzzles, and collect scattered moon fragments. A journey born from small courage slowly brings light and color back to the faded world.

title: Shell Bless the Faithless
description: Shell Bless the Faithless is a 3rd Person Roguelite Shooter supporting 1~4 players where you take on the role of a Norse warrior. In a chaotic world where runes, magic, and shotguns coexist, evolve with the blessings of the gods, crush heretical foes and their leaders, and rebuild a macho world!

title: Hell-o-university
description: Take over as a professor of hell, and guide devil graduate students. Hello University, it's starting now!

title: Dodo Duckie
description: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises

title: Deus Mantle
description: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

title: Ball Scooping Friends
description: Experience the thrill of a Japanese festival with a unique twist! This online co-op game combines the fun of "Ball Scooping" (like goldfish scooping, but with balls!) and "Shooting Gallery" games.

title: The Bunker Notes
description: "The Bunker Notes" is a visual novel about a concrete trap where the past whispers through the cracks of rusted doors. In this world, survival is everything; meeting another person might be your last mistake.

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

title: GOC-Streetz
description: "Own the Streetz" No teams, no rules—just pure chaos! Gods of Cricket: Streetz is a free-for-all multiplayer cricket game where every player fights for glory. Smash sixes over rooftops, dominate gritty lanes, and outsmart rivals. Think you’ve got what it takes? Rule the streets and become a legend.

title: Plush Party
description: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

title: Run Before He Knows
description:
You're seven years old, and your parents are away for the night. Since you can't stay home alone, they ask a family friend - someone you've never met - to watch over you. It was supposed to be a quiet evening, nothing more. But as the night goes on, something starts to feel wrong.

Can you find a way to call for help before it’s too late?

title: A Wicked Game
description:
In A Wicked Game, the rules are unclear or incomplete. There may or may not be feedback. Patterns will be hard to find. A Wicked Game demands the player know things which are never taught, demands that they contort themselves to a constantly-changing control scheme, and success requires mastery combined with luck. The characters you meet are deliberately inhospitable. They are impatient, rude, and inconsistent. They will help you and harm you, but it will be unclear which is happening. Trust is hard to find here.

Good luck.

title: TypoJam
description: Introducing TypoJam! A rhythm game where you need to type to the song's rhythm!

title: Hexceed: Caeruleum
description: This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Caeruleum Puzzle your way through 190 new levels - levels include all previously introduced mechanics!

title: Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army - Digital Deluxe Edition
Airport Manager Simulator 2026
description: Take full control of a busy international airport. Manage passengers, baggage, aircraft servicing, and flight schedules while operating real ground equipment. Balance efficiency, safety, and satisfaction in a fast-paced aviation experience.

title: Beyond Memories: Tales From the Heart
description: Become a whimsical Grim Reaper, flying through enchanted realms to free mystical souls. Experience 11 epic stories in this peaceful, magical adventure.

title: Cats Visiting Historical Times
description: A cat & owner are lost in time! Journey through ancient Egypt, Viking ships & pirate coves to find hidden cats—some helpful, some sneaky. Collect clues, unlock history, & race the clock in this charming adventure!

title: The General Saga
description:
Create your own Millennium!
JRPG-style survival action

title: CybeRage
description: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!

title: CybeRage: Red Line
description: Inspect the infested harbor and find the giant sea monster!

title: CybeRage: Orange Line
description: Enter the famous Mockey Land and help your partner!

title: CybeRage: Green Line
description: Explore the abandoned Zoo and encounter its exotic creatures!

title: Cyberslayer: No Time to Regret
description: CYBERSLAYER is a high-intensity first-person action slasher that thrusts you into the pulse-pounding rhythm of a cyberpunk future.

title: Dungeon Slide
description: "DUNGEON SLIDE" is a puzzle game where you move the protagonist in four directions to collect gems and escape the dungeon.

title: Earth Saver
description: It's up to you to blast away the approaching meteorite and become the savior of the Earth!

title: Madden NFL 26
description: Dominate the league in EA SPORTS Madden NFL 26.

title: Madden NFL 26: Deluxe Edition
description:
Includes Season 1 Elite Player Item and additional content:
3 Day Early Access
4600 MUT points
Early Access Solo Challenges
MUT Cover Athlete Elite Player Item
Franchise Coach Ability Points
Super Star Legendary XP Boost
Player Card Exclusive Item

title: I Am Busy Digging a Hole
description: A relaxing digging simulator where you explore colorful underground worlds. Dig deeper, find valuable ores, upgrade your equipment, and collect rare dragons. The deeper you go, the more treasures and mysteries you'll discover.

title: Jack Barau
description: A parade of endangered baby petrels, a soft-hearted pirate… Help JACK BARAU save them before it's too late!

title: Nico Saves The State
description: SAVE and LOAD your state to get all the Crystals!

title: Nanostorm
description: Upgrade. Evolve. Dominate. Nanostorm is an incremental 2D arcade Shoot'em'up game where you get stronger with every death. Invest nano essence in new abilities and powerful perks.

title: Poker Solitaire
description: A fresh fusion of Poker and Puzzle! Arrange cards and complete poker hands!

title: Reel it! Fishing
description: Swing your rod, reel in your catch, and fish up a big one! Enjoy a refreshing fishing trip surrounded by nature!

title: School Photo Transformer
description: Koichi, who has gained the ability to transform, creates a special graduation album as part of the photography club...!

title: Shadow Labyrinth: Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition Includes:
• Shadow Labyrinth
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma - Super Digital Deluxe Edition
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma - Digital Deluxe Edition
SiMarket Cloth Store Simulator
description: Build Miami’s hottest clothing store! Stock, sell & customise your shop, hire staff, and expand to fashion empire status. Will you dominate the beachside strip?

title: Skating Rink Story
description: Make your wildest ice dreams come true with this skating rink management game.

title: Spy Guy Greece
description: A hidden object game full of hidden objects. Search, click, and advance through the levels. Fall in love with the atmosphere of Ancient Greece and search for hidden objects related to mythology.

title: Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar - Trunk of Transformation
description: Mix up your style with a customization collection that's sure to get townsfolk talking!

title: Waiting for Reply
description: Saturday morning. Tokyo Station. Ritsuka is waiting for Sakurako. However, even after the agreed meeting time, Sakurako didn’t show up. Ritsuka sent her a message before heading inside the train. When she reached the seat they had reserved, someone else was sitting there.

title: Arcanard
description: Enter the mystical world of Arcanard, a roguelike deck-building card game set in a universe shaped by nine powerful elements—Strike, Fire, Water, Ice, Earth, Wind, Electro, Holy, Dark, and Chrono. Assemble your deck, master elemental synergies, and face unpredictable challenges!

title: Spin To Win
description: You are trapped in a concrete box with nothing in it but a colorful wheel and a hole in the ceiling. What happens if you spin the wheel? Will you win or lose? Do you want to find out?

title: Ithya: Magic Studies
description: Ithya: Magic Study is a cozy background app combined with productivity tools. Customize your room and relax with lofi or fantasy playlists in beautiful, hand-drawn environments. Perfect for a focused or creative session in a magical world.

title: Escape from Tung Tung Sahur
description:
You wake up trapped in a creepy, abandoned village — no lights, no friends, just you... and a whole lot of trouble.
You’ve got one job: save the poor, caged Brainrot animals that the terrifying Tung Tung Sahur has locked up... and get them out safely.
Sounds easy? Oh, sweet summer child.
Tung Tung is always hunting. He knows you're here. He can smell your fear.
And he’s not alone.
- Bombardino Crocodilo patrols the village skies, randomly bombing the map. When you hear him coming, you'd better find cover fast — or you’ll end up extra crispy.
- Bombombini Gusini, Bombardino’s relentless brother, is circling above you at all times. If he spots you, he’ll immediately snitch to Tung Tung, who will come sprinting after you like he just clocked out for lunch.

Each time you play, new Brainrot animals need rescuing. New paths, new panic, new escape strategies. Will you sneak, run, or... cry a little in a corner?

title: Looping Doors: Diner
description: You're in a loop in a diner and you have to get out of it. All you have to do is find out if it's an anomaly and get out the right door. Good luck.

title: Looping Doors: Subway
description: You are stuck in a loop in a subway station. And there are two buttons in front of you. You need to press the right button 20 times to get out of this loop. Memorize where the items are in the subway station in level 0. You need to find out if there are any anomalies in the next levels. If there are, press the red button, if not, press the green button. One mistake will send you back to level 0. Good luck...

title: Misery
description: Misery is a 1–5 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 3
description: Relive the era of… hold up, what’s that in the sky? Fortnite OG is crashing into Chapter 1 Season 3, complete with the return of Lucky Landing and a meteor that’s on a seriously worrying collision course! Also from the OG days, the 50v50 LTM returns as OG 50v50.

title: Date The Dude
description: You're blessed with the power to travel through dimensions to look for your perfect boyfriend. He's smelly, he's a ginger, and he's addicted to "health pipes". You only have one chance to win him over (or multiple if you just replay the game) so make it count!

title: Football Heroes League
description: Football Heroes League is a high-octane multiplayer soccer game where superhuman abilities meet precise controls.

title: Lhea & the Word Spirit
description:
Master battle timelines and guide lost souls in this turn-based strategy adventure with peaceful vibes and meditative tactics. Easy to learn, surprisingly deep.

May the stars align in your favor!

title: Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered
description:
A call for help within a mysterious messaging app. Someone lost and wandering through a forest in a faraway place. And their destiny in your hands.

Beek: How I Became a Familiar Spirit and Everything After That is a text-based narrative experience from the creators of Nekojishi. Featuring dozens of branching paths, multiple endings, and CG's to unlock!

Help Beek seek a way home, and face the darkness of this world with strength and courage.

title: The Eyes
description: Follow Hisoka Kageyama, a desperate man who accepts the grim job of night watchman in an abandoned prison. As he navigates its dark corridors, surreal visions and eerie presences lurk around every corner. Can you discover the secrets hidden within these walls?

title: Why Jump
description: Why Jump? Because the only way is up. Why Jump is a vertical platformer where one wrong move can cost you — but don't worry, there are checkpoints to catch your breath. Sometimes. Test your patience, sharpen your skills, and see how high you can climb.

title: Through the Fog
description: You will take on the role of a detective and dive into a dark world from a first-person perspective. What will you have to do? Explore locations in search of clues. Make assumptions and write them down in your diary. Solve puzzles.Run away and hide from your demons.

title: Back: Fade
description:
Once again you take on the role of the protagonist, ​Ren Xing, who, after escaping the first "Otherworld," is thrust into a new and bizarre journey. In Back: Fade, players will uncover the rules governing this Otherworld. This time, you are not alone—other characters will join you, offering mutual support. However, your shared goal remains the same: survive this twisted realm and find a way to escape. Every choice you make in critical moments will shape the story, and different decisions will lead to vastly different endings.

After waking up in a hospital, ​Ren Xing believed his ordeal was over—only to be dragged into a new "Otherworld." To his shock, unlike the first Otherworld, this time, he is not alone.

title: MemoRemovers
description: With a sharp eye, and keen memory you will navigate 5 distinct levels that change around you. Report what happened and where with the handy reporting panel before the changes have a chance to pile up. Can you last until the timer runs out?

title: CyberControl: Another Life
description: An interactive cyberpunk drama where you live the life of a border officer in a brutal future ruled by tyranny, manipulation, and survival. Check documents, approve or deny entry, build relationships, and face nonlinear stories.

title: Obscured Stories: The Resentment
description: The Resentment is a psychological horror game that follows Lisa Parker through a traumatic event.

title: Norvezskaya Semga
description:
The Norvezskaya Semga Mod is the most extensive modification for Disciples 2 to date. Its author does not stop supporting his brainchild, and updates are released periodically.

Comprehensive and engaging. The modification contains so many new features that an unprepared player's eyes may run away at the first launch. But don't be alarmed. Despite all the scale and apparent complexity, the content of the mod is quickly mastered and remembered.

Everything new is a well-forgotten old. It is this phrase that most aptly characterizes the modification. Changes do not cause rejection, and innovations significantly expand the usual aspects of the game. Even completing original campaigns with the mod won't be a chore. You'll get a whole new experience, and you'll love it.

In addition to the legendary Battle for Vizgard, the author creates new maps that are strikingly different from everything that you could pass before. It is on them that you can test your strategic abilities. AI, which in the original almost did not pose a threat, will be able to give you a decent rebuff. Now PvE is not about clearing the map of neutrals in an attempt to collect trophies and upgrade troops, it's a real fierce battle with a computer opponent.

The Norwegian Salmon mod is also notable for providing advanced mapping tools. And many skilled authors have already switched from the original version to a modification in order to implement ideas that were impossible to implement before.

title: Pools: Chapter 0
description: The waters of POOLS just got deeper. Chapter 0 - a brand-new free level, is now available!

title: Unsolved
description: Welcome to UNSOLVED - the ultimate FREE hidden object adventure experience viewed through detective eyes in the extraordinary world of mystery games, puzzling investigations, and tons of hidden clues waiting to be found.

title: Word Vomit
description: Your home is getting moldier day by day. Air is uncomfortable to breath. Your room is only place where you feel somewhat safe from his neverending wrath. This can't keep going.

title: Soupcosis
description: A short horror game about drinking soup

title: Little Mage
description: Little Mage is an action-packed 2D Metroidvania where you play as an Æther Mage in a beautifully hand-drawn, high fantasy world. Explore the shattered city of Hornedrose, unleash elemental magic, battle fearsome bosses, and uncover the secrets of a world on the brink of destruction.

title: Feast of the Beast
description:
In a ravaged future, humanity has discovered an alien pathogen on Mars capable of generating TOX-Z—a toxin that, when combined with certain minerals, produces a source of energy more powerful than nuclear power. However, this discovery unleashes a catastrophe: the ambition to control this energy drives governments to allow the spread of the pathogen, turning people into destruction-thirsty zombies.

Now, the world has plunged into chaos. As a player, you must survive in a hostile environment, facing relentless hordes and uncovering the dark secrets behind the spread of TOX-Z. Your fight will not only be for survival, but for control of the most powerful and dangerous energy source ever known.

title: Fungus and Delicacies
description: Going into the woods to scavenge for supplies, you soon find yourself lost in a world that is not quite your own...

title: Scalpel, Please!
description: Assist in the curious surgery of a mythological creature. Provide information via voice commands, hand over tools, and manage various modules of the operating room without forgetting the patient's vital signs.

title: The Abyss Desire
description: A first-person exploration game set in the deep, dark ocean. Use your flashlight carefully, avoid hidden dangers, and find the items you need to complete your quest.

title: Shards of Dread
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Get chased by monsters. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

title: Doorms
description: You're trapped in a strange communal apartment with no escape. The only way forward is by elevator, but it has only two buttons. Each correct choice brings you closer, but every mistake sends you back to the start.

title: Most Quietly
description: The game, that supposed to be an ordinary, but developer accidentally made a fatal error, that completely brokes the game, and transforms it into a horror-game. Now, your goal is to somehow, fix the fatal error.

title: Sleeper S9
description: Traverse the sleeper coaches of an apparent empty Indian train—or so it seems. If you see an anomaly, face it and move forward. If not, it may be a trick of the mind—return to the previous coach. But beware, some anomalies will do everything to stop you. Face them or be lost forever.

title: Diceball
description: Roll the dice and dominate in Diceball, a turn-based sports strategy game where luck meets skill. Guide your team through 10 consecutive wins to claim the championship. Unlock 8 unique teams, collect powerful upgrades at the Concession Stand, and build your team on your way to victory.

title: Hachishaku
description: Search the village of Naninani Mura to find answers about your past and evade the hauntingly beautiful 8 foot tall HachiShaku-sama!

title: Shichiya Shrine
description: "Defeat the Monsters with the Cursed Sword and Sacred Talismans! The terror of the Japanese supernatural world awaits in this action-packed horror!"

title: Banshee
description: The game is about escaping from a house where “Banshee”, a frightening looking fairy, wanders around, exploring the surroundings and using the items found to escape.

title: Primordial Fate
description: A narrative driven, 2D, point and click horror/adventure game (using a two-click LOOK/INTERACT system), where you control multiple characters at various points of the game. With multiple endings and deaths, this fast paced story plays like an 80s horror movie!

title: The Maze X: The First Chapter
description: You return back to the once innocent and carefree escape room on Earth, filled with characters who brought joy to the living children dwelling the mazes walls! Now, it's a blood bath... You must press on! Complete the puzzles, activate the generators and free not just you, but the mazes soul itself.

title: The Haunted Nora Apartment
description: The Haunted Nora Apartment is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of the Nora Apartment which was built during the early 2000s.

title: SoundlessNightmare
description: Keep quiet and avoid making loud noises. Please refrain from making any sound for 10 minutes to enter a sweet dreamland. Of course, you can choose not to have a microphone!

title: Backrooms: We Escape Forever
description: We Escape Forever is a co-op survival horror game for 1–6 players. Solve puzzles and escape dream worlds. Explore eerie environments, avoid terrifying entities, and survive together. Built with Unreal Engine 5, the game adds new levels and content regularly, offering fresh challenges.

title: Starverse: Requiem Aeternam Eden
description: You remember Earth as a peaceful place but something happened. You go down to investigate and things don't add up. People are starting to question the nature of reality. Is it all a collective dream?

title: Salvage Protocol
description: A short horror about exploring abandoned space stations and collecting junk in order to pay off your S.R.P.O debt.

title: Five Nights with CJ
description:
A friend's house records Production

You, Alec a young, accomplished, handsome and charismatic individual are contractually obligated to finish The Fencesitters's debut album, "Picture Day" before CJ's arrival in 5 nights, but things go horrifically wrong when night falls...

Can you survive FIVE NIGHTS, AND finish the hotly anticipated album by The Fencesitters, "Picture Day"

A Five Nights At Freddy's Fangame to promote The Fencesitters newest single "Flight Song" on digital streaming platforms everywhere

title: Fortnite: Chapter 6 - Mini Season 1: Galactic Battle
description:
A galactic reckoning is coming…

Imperial Star Destroyers exit hyperspace in formation around the Death Star, which looms with its superlaser array fixed on the BR map. Heroes from across eras are ready to strike back against the assault led by Emperor Palpatine from the shadows, and the Island’s fate hangs in the balance. Draw your lightsaber and ready your blaster in Fortnite: GALACTIC BATTLE!

title: What Lies Frozen
description: A Psychological Horror game. Featuring puzzles, immersive environment, a tense atmosphere, and a unique hand-drawn art style.

title: Bokeh Adventure
description: Solve creative challenges with your camera in this puzzle platformer game. Explore a colorful world and join Randy on his journey to become the photographer he has always wanted to be!

title: Backrooms: Extractions
description: Backrooms: Extractions is a 1-6 player co-op horror game set in 2062. As a MEG operative, enter the Backrooms to locate and extract lost agents while evading lurking entities. Use advanced tools, solve tense puzzles, and survive eerie environments. Stay alert: every sound could be your last!

title: Husker
description: Traverse deeper and deeper down surreal rabbit holes of a hollow universe in this RPGMaker-based exploration game.

title: Bootleg in Wonderland: Pastel Paradise
description:
Bootleg rookie magician Yuuto Ichika finds herself lost in a strange, yet familiar world, only to be found by the young magician Alice.

What adventures await them in Wonderland?

Journey with Yuuto and Alice through a bullet hell adventure in Bootleg in Wonderland ~ Pastel Paradise!

This game was made in two weeks for the Touhou FnC Jam - Moriya Cleaning Game Jam!

title: Sword Art Online Eron
description:
SAOE – The True Sword Art Online Experience

SAOE is an MMORPG inspired by the Sword Art Online anime universe, where the goal is clear: complete the 100 floors of a gigantic tower, each filled with unique challenges, monsters and adventures.

In SAOE, you don’t live the story of the anime characters — here, you are the protagonist of your own journey. Starting at level 1, your path will be shaped by the choices you make: which skills you will master, which attributes you will strengthen, and which strategy you will use to overcome the dangers that await on each new floor.

With continuous evolution, challenging combats and the freedom to create your own fighting style, SAOE offers an intense and personalized experience. Get ready to test your limits, make allies and prove your worth on a journey where each victory brings you closer to the top... and each mistake can cost you dearly.

The challenge is on. How far can you go?

title: LaserAge
description: LaserAge is a retro game similar to Galaxian and Galaga clones. This shooter features power-ups and is highly detailed, combining nostalgia with 24-bit colour. Four levels have 100 waves of ships. Destroy 15 enemies with 13 power-ups. Your ship can be controlled with the mouse, which comes in handy when you're trying to dodge enemy fire. The Gold version features a new interface and a massive list of bug fixes.

title: Dwarrf: A Pinball Roguelike
description: Play as a Dwarven 'Pirate' and set sail on your modified minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball, Pachinko, and Bubble Shooter whilst collecting game altering balls & relics that ensure no two runs are alike.
