The update is comprised of four new sinister Supervisor Cogs, revamped Cog facilities, Version 2.0 Cog Disguises, and new cosmetics.

Various observational analyses were conducted by the Cogs throughout February 2024 to monitor and evaluate the performance of the new Supervisor Cogs. Toontown community members were able to playtest the Under New Management update and provide feedback before public launch.

title: Trust Exercise
description:
Inpro is starting the first day of his new job at Common Umbrella. A very odd company with a unique and strange history (and a very mysterious celebrity running it).

Unfortunately, after he signs the paperwork, everything immediately goes wrong.

Now he's stuck in an office room with 3 other people, playing a life-threatening exercise by said celebrity where they must discuss amongst each other. Traverse through various conversations and topics as each character tries to put any form of pieces together before it's too late.

Can he trust these people? Or will it all descend into dysfunctional chaos and even betray them at the very last minute?

Regardless, you have 1 hour.

Good luck.

title: Swipe Stream
description: The game revolves around a mysterious book, De Vermis Mysteriis. What is this book? Why do people want it so badly? How are your dreams connected to it? Is it real, or just a fantasy? So, many questions - can you find out the answers?

title: Dark Origins
description: In the dark and fractured world of Dark Origins, your adventure begins with a mysterious magical box. In Dark Origins, only the most skilled and resourceful will rise to the top. Will you dominate the chaos and become the ultimate ruler of this fractured land?

title: Unchained: Tale of Enra
description: A tactical RPG where trust is your greatest weapon. Build bonds with allies to unlock abilities, negotiate with enemies to recruit them, and shape your journey through choices that blend strategy, diplomacy, and emotional storytelling.

title: Out of the Shadows
description: Out of the Shadows is a cooperative game (up to 4 players) that blends exploration, tension, and coordination. Infiltrate abandoned locations, solve complex puzzles, and survive the unsettling presence of those who still linger there...

title: Earthscaper
description: Discover and shape the real world in this new multiplayer sandbox game! Reimagine famous landmarks, explore cities, create your own minigames, build and challenge the community of fellow builders and explorers. Let's reshape the world together!

title: The Drunken Beard
description: In The Drunken Beard, you take the reins of a lively tavern where every pint tells a story. Brew craft beers, manage orders between thirsty dwarves and impatient adventurers, expand the inn and turn it into a legendary haven. Between secret recipes, rustic furnishings, and demanding customers, only the finest innkeeper will win over hearts and livers. Glory awaits… one beer at a time!

title: Die Trying
description: Plunge into a world ravaged by the dead in this hilarious co-op shooter. Blending silly antics with the extraction shooter genre. Escape with a plethora of loot, or Die Trying!

title: The Cooking Club
description:
The Cooking Club is a Slice-Of-Life // Dating Sim visual novel that is produced in the Ren'Py engine!

Ready to start cooking?

High school can be a drag—especially when you’re stuck in classes you can’t stand. Looking for an easy escape, our protagonist.. YOU! (Yes - You!) stumbles upon the only club with an open spot: The Cooking Club.

What starts as a simple excuse to ditch class quickly turns into something far more delicious. Between chopping, stirring, and whisking up new dishes, unexpected sparks begin to fly. Will you master the recipe for love, or will things boil over? With a cast of charming clubmates, secret ingredients of romance, and just a pinch of chaos, The Cooking Club is serving up a story that’s equal parts heart-warming and hilarious. So grab your apron—because in this kitchen, love is always on the menu!

But remember.. each decision you make comes with a choice and a path - you can't have every girl to yourself!

title: Mole's Quest
description:
In Mole's Quest, the player controls a mole who must navigate moving platforms (similar to elevators) to collect objects and return to the starting point. The game is challenging, with obstacles such as bizarre creatures and platforms that can cause instant failure if jumps are mistimed. Each session is limited to 5 minutes, increasing the game’s difficulty and urgency.

The game features simple, colorful graphics typical of early 1990s PC games. Controls are basic, using the arrow keys to move the mole and jump between platforms.

Mole's Quest was included in the Fast Action Paq compilation released in 1993. This compilation was published by Mallard Software Inc. and developed by The Dreamers Guild. It featured a collection of four retro-style games, including Mole's Quest, BOT, Flak Attack, and Bubble Trouble.

In 2002, the compilation was re-released under the name Retro-Action Paq by Wyrmkeep Entertainment Co., which also handled the development of the re-release. However, the original 1993 release was published by Mallard Software Inc.

title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona - The Jewel in the Skull
description: Embark on a mysterious adventure where the shadows of the past intertwine with the threats of the present. You will venture into the labyrinth ship of the mad genius Mardek in search of a legendary artifact – “The Jewel in the Skull”. Using this artifact, you can enter the Ghost World and uncover the truth about Demagrass, the brother of Queen Aurora, whose fate is enshrouded in mystery and intrigue.

title: Dark Mine
description: Trapped underground after a collapse, you are the sole survivor of a deadly attack. Armed only with a night vision camera, navigate the darkness, avoid the creature, and find a way out in this retro-style survival horror game.

title: Hit Idol
description: Hit Idol is a cozy drag&drop indie puzzle game by Toraka about managing a high school idol band club, featuring twelve character-based story arcs and cute pixel art. Train in various musical mini games to reach Star-Filled Sky Festival and bring justice to Teacher's old enemies!

title: Blue Hill Wendigo
description: Arm yourself with weapons, traps, and supplies in this survival horror FPS. Battle ruthless bandits and a relentless wendigo as you uncover the truth and fight to survive in this open world horror game.

title: Card Streamer Simulator
description: You will play as a live broadcasting room to open card packs anchor, according to customer orders to open card packs live. The profit and loss gain of the live broadcast all depends on your choice and luck, in addition, you can also participate in it yourself to collect the full set of card books.

title: Balls Gone Wild
description: There are also portals that instantly teleport objects to different locations.

title: Moving Forward with Cat
description: Earth turns. Cats turn. And you will turn too. Welcome to the world of inertia, a law of physics. A game of gravity and inertia with unique controls for the hardcore game lovers.

title: Legacy: Reawakening
description: Point-and-click adventure game filled with unique puzzles and atmospheric exploration. Journey deep underground into a mysterious forgotten place and uncover the secrets hidden within.

title: Rod & Ripple
description: A fun fishing game where you catch fish, sell them, meet the weekly quota, upgrade your equipment, and fill out the AquaDex! The further out you adventure, the stranger and more difficult fish you may encounter, but be wary of sharks at night and in deeper waters...

title: Lets Nuke Mars
description: Follow orders. Press buttons. Nuke Mars. A darkly funny SPACEFORCE sim where obedience is optional.

title: DuoQ
description: Squad up with Tala, a mysterious (and flirty!) player you meet in the lobby of a fictional FPS game. Use your real-life voice to talk with Tala over comms, solve puzzles, and outwit enemies. By the end, you’ll answer the most important question: Is she into you?

title: The Deadseat
description: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.

title: Running Out
description: In this fast-paced platformer, every run is a race against time. Push your limits, speed through levels, and go further with upgrades that keep you in the game. Sharpen your skills, optimize your runs, and reach the finish before it's too late. Fast, intense, and addictive, can you beat the clock?

title: Don't Drop the Soap
description: A rage-fueled 2D platformer with dark humor. Play as a bar of soap escaping deadly traps, ghost guards, bullets, and prison floors. Fast, precise, and unforgiving. Packed with achievements. Cheap, weird, and brutally fun. Perfect for fans of indie, meme, and speedrun games.

title: Synthetic Captive
description: Synthetic Captive is a first-person stealth escape game designed to reveal that the most terrifying monsters originate from the human mind. In this dungeon, escape is nearly impossible. You play as the protagonist, exploring the dungeon prison, struggling to survive and escape.

title: Beauty’s Target
description: This is an immersive romance game where you play as the protagonist, exploring diverse settings and meeting unique characters. By chatting, dating, and exchanging gifts, you can build relationships, unlock engaging storylines, and create your own romantic journey. *****Implicit hints in the game

title: Urgent Message
description: "Urgent Message" is a post-apocalyptic survival game that combines text-based exploration with turn-based combat. In this world full of dangers, you will drive a car, navigate through desolate cities, and race against time to reach your destination, seeking a glimmer of hope for survival.

title: House Builder 2
description: In House Builder 2 you build your dream constructions with friends or alone in a vibrant, low-poly open world! Buy materials for work, load it up, and drive to your next job in the ultimate co-op construction adventure!

title: The End of Gameplay
description:
droqen's desperate attempt to explain, or explore, or understand the true meaning of "kill gameplay."

something as mundane as lights
neither of us saying "goodbye"
you following me following you
following me following you...

title: Anime Dream Match: Boys
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool anime boys.

title: Grease Monkey Grand Prix
description: Start your engines, then fix them! Grease Monkey Grand Prix is a retro-styled party racer with style, edge and most of all, blazing speed! In a world where companies are too cheap to hire mechanics, fixing your car as you try and reach the end of the track is up to you!

title: A Café Couple's Joyful Life of Resistance
description: Meet Lize and Auran, the proud owners of Cava's cafe! Their life seems perfect, but suddenly Auran becomes the victim of an incident involving an unicorn and gets infected with Unicorn disease. Find a cure for Auran and explore the town of Pachi in this lightweight and exciting visual novel!

title: Cursorcana
description: The World has flipped, everything's in chaos... but hey, you're a Fool — you're used to it. Strategically pick your Minor Arcana for each stage. Collect powerful Major Arcana as you go, each one rewriting your destiny. Your fate lies in the cards — choose wisely or stay a Fool forever!

title: Made For
description: MADE FOR is an episodic video game series where indie studio Raikori makes games for and about your favorite creators!

title: Walking on Ice
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Walking On Ice, a mobile game where quick thinking and strategic moves are your best allies. Test your brainpower as you guide your character across icy terrains to reach the level exit. Can you solve the puzzle and escape the frozen maze?

title: Up or Fall
description: Legend has it that at the top of the mountain, there is a star that can grant any wish. Those who have tried to climb to the summit have paid a heavy price. The path to the top is treacherous. This adventure will be full of hardships and challenges each misstep will lead to a long fall.

title: Cave Crusade
description: Classic roguelike deckbuilder designed for quick runs. Upgrade your cards, discover powerful artifacts, and master the Wheel of Fortune to maximize your rewards.

title: Only Up? Climb the Tower!
description: Challenge your limits in this 3D jumping action game! One mistake could be fatal! Climb a towering structure under maximum tension. Perform graceful jumps, master precise controls, and rely on your mental strength. Can you reach the top? Find out what awaits you up there!

title: HeXpunk
description: HexPunk is a co-op, third-person shooter with an emphasis on stylish and fast-paced combat.

title: Looxi
description: Find words, score points, beat the clock! Looxi challenges your word-hunting skills across 120 unique stages and endless quick play. With fast 2-minute rounds, it's perfect for short breaks or marathon sessions. Can you find the highest-scoring words before time runs out?

title: Drone Simulator: Smash Zombies
description: The world ended. You just didn’t get the memo.

title: Galdia
description: Craft, build, explore, survive! Your destiny awaits in this 8-bit sandbox adventure where farming, dungeon-delving, and battling fearsome bosses will test your skills and unleash your creativity.

title: Westfall
description: Westfall is a cooperative/collaborative horror game where you collect precious stones from cursed towns of the wild west.

title: Ascendant Realms
description: Ascendant Realms is a unique turn-based strategy game that bridges the gap between the rapid, accessible gameplay of Polytopia and the expansive, strategic depth of the Civilization series. Build thriving realms, chart unknown lands, and leave your mark on an ever changing world.

title: Babka
description: Babka is a retro indie game with a horror atmosphere that takes you to your hometown, where your neighbors summoned demons from the underworld to your grandmother's house. Rebuild her home and banish all the demons. Your decisions may change your path to becoming a better grandson.

title: The Last Train: Baquedano
description: In this short first-person psychological horror game, falling asleep on the subway brings you to the final station abandoned and eerie. Explore and try to survive the entity chasing you in the darkness. Who is it? Its face seems familiar...

title: Potion Problems
description: Potion Problems is a multiplayer party game, combining social deduction and magic. Navigate Pigeonpoint's College for Potion Making as a troublemaker or an apprentice. Collect ingredients, make potions, avoid being turned into a frog, and vote out troublemakers to complete your degree!

title: Tiny Dino
description: TINY DINO is an idle nurturing game where little dinosaurs accompany you at the bottom of your screen while you work or study. They produce gems for you to earn profits, and you can plant trees and build structures to create a free and lively world for them, growing together with you.

title: Brainrot: Animal Quizzes
description: Brainrot: Animal Quiz is an exciting puzzle game in which you and your friends will have to guess the popular animals from the Italian meme.

title: ShootX
description: Enter the world of ShootX and experience exciting missions as a soldier fighting evil.

title: Monolith's Dreamers
description: A captivating 2D puzzle game where strategic thinking is essential. Explore the world of the Monoliths, outwit the traps guarding the ruins, and help the inhabitants. Solve puzzles that block your progress by collecting and redistributing energy.

title: Figure Shop Simulator
description: Run your own figure shop! Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers. Manage your storage, expand and design your store. Try to complete collection sets, follow market trends, and grow your business!

title: Orbyss
description: In this logic based puzzle game, switch between Orbs to solve puzzles and light up your world. Be in several places at once, freeze time, fly in drones, play with sound… and overcome the evil shadow interfering with your quest.

title: Vikings Dynasty
description: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty.

title: Prohibeast
description: Immerse yourself in a 1930s Chicago plagued by corruption and illegal meat trafficking. In this stealth-tactics game, control Eliot Ness and his team. Exploit the environment, deceive your enemies and strike the mafia from the shadows to dismantle Al Capone's criminal empire.

title: My Heaven's Dale
description: A cozy ranch simulator game where you can travel to the moon.

title: The Dark Arrival: Shadows of the Past
description: In The Dark Arrival, Jacob, desperate for meaning, is drawn to Hollow Creek by a mysterious letter from his late grandfather. As he explores the eerie town, ghostly apparitions intensify. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets & survive the supernatural forces that haunt the abandoned train station.

title: Noir Total: Deadly Party
description: Noir Total is a 2D local multiplayer PvP shooter set in darkened arenas. Sneak through total darkness using your controller's vibrations, track down your enemies, collect bonuses and set traps to stay one step ahead of your opponents in fast-paced, competitive matches for up to 4 players.

title: Snakes with Fists!
description: A Beat 'em Up with RPG elements where you can explore an open world, level up, and customize your combat!

title: Z After: A Point and Click Survival
description: Z After is a Narrative Zombie Survival Point and Click Adventure game with Hidden Object and Turn-based fighting mechanics.

title: Letter Lost
description: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

title: Brass Lament
description: Brass Lament is an interactive experience that explores memory, trauma, and the intertwined fates of ordinary people. You step into the fragmented recollections of an aging soldier, witnessing four lives entangled by war.

title: TurnBreak
description: Enter the ultimate roguelite elemental creature-card battler! Collect and evolve powerful teams to build your perfect battle deck. Outwit your opponents with turn-breaking action! Exploit elemental weaknesses to draw cards to become a member of the Turn Breaker League!

title: Creature Creation Station
description: Create characters, watch them play together, and easily share your creations with friends!

title: Watchword
description: Watchword is the anagram roguelike. Strategically spell real and made-up words while using magical rule-bending books to score massively satisfying combos. Build your deck of letter tiles and find synergies in this endlessly re-playable twist on classic word games.

title: Foreman Frenzy!
description: Arcade Styled 2D Platformer, RUN, CLIMB, DODGE, and BOUNCE your way through 9 challenging and tense rounds, fetch your crew's 5 fallen lunches before time runs out, and whatever you do, STEER CLEAR of the mutant food dudes lurking around every corner!

title: Red Leaves
description: Red's visit to her grandmother's house didn't go as planned. Instead of her grandmother, she was greeted by a menacing wolf who'd killed her grandmother long before she arrived. Red quickly met the same fate. But, to her surprise, she awoke at an earlier location in the forest unscathed. Some unseen force is rewinding time when she dies and bringing her back. This means she has infinite chances to get revenge on that wolf! But surely, something like this doesn't come without cost. And will that cost be worth it?

title: Breakout Epilepsia
description: A fast-paced Breakout-style arcade with a bold black-and-white aesthetic. Engage in space battles against stunning yet deadly alien foes who are determined to destroy you. Intense visuals, thrilling gameplay, and a challenge that will test your reflexes.

title: Radley Ravencroft's Spy Web Mystery
description: Follow a murder investigation in this point & click 1920s murder mystery. Solve room escape style lock puzzles to unlock Radley's interviews with the suspects. Use your newfound information to draw connections between characters, and fill out a timeline of events.

title: Space Memory: Butterflies
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable butterflies in space

title: Hydroplant Tycoon
description: Start with tiny sprouts and nurture them into thriving crops using advanced hydroponics! Design your own farming system, experiment with different plants, customize your setup, and meet market demands to grow your business. Discover the perfect harmony of nature and technology!

title: Hiroshi
description: A romantic and adventure visual novel where your decisions are very important.

title: SpeedCoins
description: SpeedCoins is a frenetic 2D platformer that combines action, exploration, and time control. Run, jump, and fight your way through worlds filled with danger, hidden messages, and strange creatures. Use time to your advantage... make sure you're faster than the coins if you want to survive!

title: Your Cattle
description: An interactive casual game. By utilizing mechanics such as charging, knocking back, stunning, and blink, players can hone their skills in a low-pressure environment.Accompanied by exquisite music and smooth interactions, relieve emotional stress.

title: Garden Masters
description: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Garden Masters is a free-to-play gardening game with a fast pace.

title: Battle for Rakir
description: Fly, fight, and level up!

title: Heroes' Call: A Casual Mmo Guild Sim
description: Lead your guild and its members to conquer the challenges of perilous dungeons, all through a sleek and vibrant interface.

title: Frest
description: Unravel a forgotten world. Discover your power. Decide its fate. When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she's transported to Nekojima—a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse.

title: Karol World Breaker
description: Karol World Breaker brings classic brick-breaking gameplay together with Survivors-like mechanics in a single game. Destroy wave of enemies with your balls. Collect coins to buy power-ups in the Store. Face wise enemies that will spawn debuffs that will make your adventure more difficult.

title: Backrooms Liminal Escape
description: BACKROOMS: LIMINAL ESCAPE is a VHS-style horror game where you explore eerie liminal spaces through a camcorder. BACKROOMS: LIMINAL ESCAPE is More than just a walking sim, it features intense levels that require you to hide, run, stay quite, and survive in a creepy, analog nightmare.

title: Stream Defense Protocol
description: Stream Defense Protocol is a turret defense game where your viewers become the attackers! Chatters join via stream chat or Steam to launch missiles, while you upgrade and fight for survival. Can you withstand the barrage?

title: Entity Strike
description: Entity Strike is a 2D top-down survival game where you face endless hordes of monsters. Choose your upgrades, build powerful loadouts, and survive as long as you can. Fast, intense, and addictive.

title: Outsanity
description: Trapped in a mysterious place, you must uncover the truth. “Outsanity” offers a blend of stealth, puzzle-solving, and exploration. Tread lightly and solve the sparse enigmas to escape, but beware the monsters hear everything. Can you outwit these lurking creatures?

title: Grubby Fingers
description: GRUBBY FINGERS is an experimental point-and-click game about scratching lottery tickets in a surreal gas station lost in the middle of nowhere. Enjoy atmospheric pre-rendered 360° visuals, generative dark jazz, and a touch of mystery while chasing your next big win.

title: Le Bureau Des Rêves
description: This puzzle game, designed by independents escape room creators, will put your brain to the test! Observation, deduction, logic and twists... all the ingredients of a good escape room are here, right from your cozy little nest :)

title: XFlight
description: A top-notch FPV simulator with excellent control feel and a wealth of engaging content.

title: Putin Jigsaw
description: Putin jigsaw is jigsaw puzzle game with Putin themed images

title: Grid Gladiators
description: A pixel-art roguelike deck-building battler on a 2D grid. Similar structure to Slay the Spire with some twists.

title: Yo, Matias: Sueños Peligrosos
description: A side-scroller platform game of Sendra's strip cartoon, Yo, Matías centered in dreams and nightmares.

title: Yo, Matias 2: Fantasmas y Calabazas
description: Second installment of the Yo, Matías videogame series. A Side-scroller halloween-themed platformer

title: Nonononogram
description: Never-ending nonogram game.

title: Unsent
description: Trapped in a loop within old apartment, the only way out is to confront deliberately forgotten memories. Under the chilling atmosphere, you must confront the manifestations of your trauma, and decide the fate of a fractured bond. Every clue matters; every choice leads to a different redemption.

title: Operation Night Strikers
description: Taito's 80's arcade hits hit back! Four milestones of the 80s arcade movement in one action-packed compilation!

title: Dad Left Me in the Car
description: Survival horror game about a girl trapped in a car

title: Sintesoft 2.0
description: Compilation of 20 interactive educational applications, including chess, jigsaw puzzle, concentration and truco.

title: Know How
description:
Know How is a classic puzzle game. The objective is to move a treasure chest off the game board an onto an exit square. Various stones block the way and have to be moved first, but they will only move lengthwise. Special obstacles like springs, magnets and magically linked stones further complicate the task.

The game contains 350 puzzles, a 'free play' and a story mode. The free play mode is simply a linear sequence of puzzles. In story mode, the main character Valerie is stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape and to discover the secret of the ancient civilization that once lived there. The player must navigate her across a map of the island and solve puzzles along the way.

title: Strikers Club
description: Strikers Club is a multiplayer football game where you take control of a player and compete in action-packed matches against others. Every move counts. Master dribbling, passing, and shooting while working with your team to outplay opponents.

title: Strawberry Note 3
description: A parenting simulation game developed by South Korean game developer Open Mind World. You raise your daughter from elementary school to high school.

title: BooBooBooster
description: Fly with Farts! Take 'em down with Farts! A Cracking Action Shooter!

title: MapleStory N
description: A next-generation PC MMORPG that preserves the beloved 2D side-scrolling gameplay of classic MapleStory while introducing Reward experience and new game mechanics.

title: Silver Palace
description: Silver Palace is an upcoming open‑world detective action‑adventure RPG developed by Silver Studio and published by Elementa worldwide. It is set in the sprawling Victorian‑style metropolis of Sylvanea, built upon the revolutionary element known as Silver Liquid that has fueled its industrial and social transformation. Players assume the role of a detective tasked with unraveling complex criminal conspiracies and uncovering hidden truths scattered throughout the city. The game seamlessly blends open‑world exploration with dynamic real‑time combat, featuring character switching, skill combos, and QTE‑style finishers. Traversal options include horseback riding, aerial wire‑grappling, and free‑running across richly detailed environments. Silver Palace is built on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high‑fidelity anime‑inspired visuals and cinematic battle sequences. It will be available on PC, major consoles, iOS, and Android devices with pre‑registration now open for global audiences. The title adopts a free‑to‑play model enhanced by gacha mechanics for character and gear progression. An 11‑minute gameplay showcase has been released, offering a deep dive into the game’s mechanics and world‑building. No firm release date has been announced, but further details and developer updates will be shared via the official website and social channels.

title: Dark Zodiac
description: Mystictronaut is traveling alone in search all lost constellations. His costume, boots, gun and grenade give him special abilities so he is up to the task. Hunting aliens and robots, searching for the path through this universe of planets and stars.

title: Emily's Bizarre Dreams
description: Emily's Bizarre Dreams is a precision platformer where you'll navigate challenging levels, uncover secrets, and perfect your skills to help Emily overcome her dreams and grant her wish upon a shooting star: to see her late cat, Mr. Tom, one last time.

title: Reverse 1999: Floor it! To the Golden City
description:
Version 2.0 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Mercuria, J, and Pioneer
• New Garments for Tooth Fairy, Getian, Kanjira, 6, Spathodea and Sputnik
• New main event: Floor it! To the Golden City
• New Anecdotes for Sotheby and La Source
• …and more!

title: Reverse 1999: The Haunted Highway
description:
Version 2.1 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Tuesday, Argus, and Barbara
• New Garments for Isolde, Ezra, Blonney and TTT
• New main event: The Haunted Highway
• New Anecdotes for Blonney and Diggers
• …and more!

title: Reverse 1999: Tristes Tropiques
description:
Version 2.2 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Anjo Nala, Lopera, Mr. Duncan, and White Rum
• New Garments for 37, Marcus, Vila, Shamane, Yenisei and Poltergeist
• New main story chapter: Tristes Tropiques
• New Anecdotes for 37 and Mesmer Jr.
• …and more!

title: Reverse 1999: Chronicles of Uluru: London Dawning
description:
Version 2.3 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Willow, Flutterpage, and Brimley
• New Garments for Lilya, Semmelweis, Tennant and John Titor
• New main event: Chronicles of Uluru: London Dawning
• New Anecdote for Mercuria
• New challenge mode: Reveries in the Rain
• …and more!

title: Reverse 1999: Last Evenings on Earth
description:
Version 2.4 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Barcarola, and Fatutu
• New Garments for 6, Fatutu, Kakania, Ms. NewBabel, Necrologist, Mercuria and Mondlicht
• New main event: Last Evenings on Earth
• New Anecdote for Regulus
• …and more!

title: Queen's Quest 2: Stories of Forgotten Past - Collector's Edition
description:
When the king asks a famous shapeshifter alchemist to look into the murder of his most trusted Agent and friend the last thing she expected was to discover an intricate network of criminals working from the shadows to bring chaos into the land. At first it seems that the murder was nothing more than a simple crime of hatred and impulse but as she plunges deeper into the investigation the alchemist learns the hard truth, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

Follow the indulging investigation of a shapeshifter, discover the conspiracy threatening to shake the very foundations of a kingdom and unveil the Stories of Forgotten Past: Queen Quest 2.

This Collector's Edition includes the following extras
- Bonus Chapter
- Game Guide
- Wallpapers
- Concept art
- Music
- Cutscenes
- Hidden objects
- Mini Games
- Characters

title: One Man's Trash
description: Ever heard of the guy who lost his hard drive full of PitCoins worth $1 million? You ARE that guy—now digging through a shady junkyard with a vacuum cleaner, hoping to find it. No timers. No pressure. Just you, the dirt—and whatever’s lurking in the dark.

title: Bionicle: Glatorian Arena
description: 3D Fighting web game based on the first part of the 2009 Bionicle story.

title: Heroes Unhinged
description: Unleash chaos in this fast-paced action RPG twin-stick shooter where you take control of one out of 20 badass superheroes, each with unique powers and playstyles. Tear through destructible stages and obliterate hordes of enemies! Gain an assortment of random powers to up the insanity!

title: Mycelium: The Silent Contract
description: Mycelium: The Silent Contract is a co-op/single player extraction horror set in a haunted liminal forest. Your contract is simple: get mycelium and extract. But in this forest, nothing is what it seems. So what did you sign, exactly?

title: Bionicle: Glatorian Arena 2
description: The sequel to the 3D Fighting game Glatorian Arena based on the second half of Bionicle's 2009 story and featuring new characters from it.

title: Rose Riddle: Fairy Tale Detective - Collector's Edition
description:
Help Rose Riddle solve the mystery of her missing parents and uncover the secrets of her past during a wild and wonderful road trip through a fairy tale realm!

Each level is a race against time to collect and manage resources, complete quests and unlock the next level. Players who prefer a relaxed adventure will enjoy the option to remove the time limits, while veteran gamers can try their hand at a mode designed to challenge their skills.

Regardless of the mode chosen, the player will enjoy the same eye-popping visuals, catchy original music and laughter-filled story, and have the opportunity to earn special achievements and unlock a wealth of Collector's Edition bonus content.

This Collector's Edition includes the following extras
- Bonus levels
- Game Guide
- Music
- Heroes
- Wallpapers

title: The Sinking City Remastered
description: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

title: Girl Purgatoriem
description: Clone combat dolls deployed in endless wasteland [features frotting]

title: Horny Warp: Hentai Fantasy
description: Horny Warp is an erotic game that blends visual novel and village-building elements. Embrace the role of the Savior with the help of six seductive girls. Play minigames, upgrade buildings, and build your relationships!

title: Beautiful Ugly
description:
Beautiful Ugly is an interactive art piece that critiques notions of the body, media consumption and the ephemerality of digital technologies.
Beautiful Ugly is an exquisite corpse comprised of 6 interactable vignettes that thread together to create a sensorial experience unique to videogames. Beautiful Ugly plays on videogame conventions and film techniques to critique design, player conventions, along with media consumption and the ephemerality of technology.

Beautiful Ugly is created by Owen Bell, Ansh Patel, Karina Popp, Reynaldo Vargas, and Tony Kao.

title: Dandelion Void
description: Explore the jungle choked corridors of a derelict ark, adrift between the stars. Construct shelters and loot powerful artifacts from the skeletal remains of your starfaring ancestors. But never let your guard down, because the jungle is alive and hostile…

title: Pac-Man Museum: Ms. Pac-Man DLC
description: Ms. PAC-MAN by Namco is one of the most popular video games in the arcade history! Who can forget the countless hours and quarters spent outrunning ghosts and chomping dots? Re-live the retro action with the queen of the arcades!

title: Sibling Souls
description: Year 2147: In a city where androids and vampires rule, you're caught in the crossfire. Searching for your lost twin, who will you trust—and what are you willing to sacrifice? Every choice shapes your fate—for better or worse—in this dark visual novel.

title: Palace Jam 1
description: Palace Jam 1 Mission Pack is a mod for Quake II Remaster and a tribute to the late Jennell Jaquays containing 6 brand new maps inspired by her works on E3U1 (Unit 9: Palace). Includes a hub and a boss map.

title: Neko no Sentouki
description: An Adventure Visual Novel where you can choose your protagonist – Play as Aiko or Hikaru as they try to uncover the secrets that lurk all around them in this character-driven story. Every choice you make will have an impact on the story.

title: Spooky Bodies
description: Spooky Bodies is a cozy puzzle game with a ghostly twist. Switch between ghost and human by using traps or possessing bodies. Each form offers unique abilities. Combine them cleverly and interact with the world to solve creative, brain-teasing puzzles.

title: Minecraft: Actions & Stuff
description: Actions & Stuff is an animation and texture overhaul for Minecraft that stays true to the vanilla style, but adds fresh visuals with smoother animations, enhanced textures, 3D items, 3D armour, new sounds, and even more stuff!

title: Out of This World
description: After the release of the first version for Amiga and Atari ST, some complaints about the short length of the game became known by the publisher, and the main developer created a new level to expand the game to the DOS and Macintosh ports.

title: Manivore
description: He doesn't just hunt to kill. Manivore is not just a murderer, he is an artist. For him, death is not an outcome but a process. Can you uncover the truth within this twisted game, or will you be the next prey?

title: Manos: The Hands of Choice
description: A weird, surreal visual novel retelling the cult B-movie Manos: The Hands of Fate. Face tarot cards, blackjack duels, and bad vacation decisions in this Ghibli-meets-grindhouse choose-your-own-disaster comedy. Featuring Torgo. Lots of Torgo.

title: Don't Sleep
description: Don't Sleep is a horror game set in a dark bedroom infested with monsters. Survive the night by navigating the shadows and outsmarting the lurking creatures. Can you endure the night and outlast the nightmare that unfolds within the shadows?

title: Gladiator Fights
description: Hold the Line. Command the Fight. Survive the Chaos.

title: Canyon of Outlaws
description: Step into the boots of a wild west sheriff and blast your way through a cursed frontier!

title: 1306 Chapter 1: Reactors & Robots
description: Join 1306, a little reactor maintenance robot, on a terrifying new adventure filled with robotic horrors! Get the rods. Fix the reactor. Prevent the meltdown! Most importantly, don't get disassembled.

title: Blight Night
description: The shadows whisper secrets you were never meant to hear. Step into Blight Night, a retro survival horror where the past won't stay buried. Relive the chilling VHS-era terror of the 1980s, where every sound makes you question if you're truly alone.

title: Z Mission Breakout
description: Fight your way through swarms of mutants and zombies in this intense top-down shooter. Complete rescue missions, survive deadly waves, and break out of the quarantine zone before it's too late. Are you ready to face the outbreak?

title: Pizza Tower: Fall Damage
description: Adds fall damage to Pizza Tower. Just kidding. You don't take damage. You die a horrible death.

title: Moe Moe: No Limit Off Beat Action Shooting
description: A doujin game created by the now defunct Japanese team Make Of Enjoy (M. O. E.). This game is a platform fighting game featuring characters from various Manga and Visual Novel franchises, as well as two original characters. This game focuses on projectile shooting combat, and features character-specific specials and supers.

title: The Great I Am
description:
Play out the life of I Am, a girl with a very strange speech impediment.

A linear visual novel with a duration of ~10 mins.

title: Fischer's Fishing Journey
description: Put Fischer on your desktop as your ultimate study and work buddy. He'll fish quietly in the corner, taking care of it all—you just drop in occasionally to collect your rewards, unlock new fish, upgrade your rod, while enjoying that calming, healing atmosphere.

title: Williams Pinball Classics
description: Williams Pinball Classics is a pinball video game that includes digital recreations of four classic Williams' tables: Creature from the Black Lagoon, Tales of the Arabian Nights, Black Rose and Lost World.

title: Beef Street
description:
There's beef in the streets! Squash it!

BEEF STREET is an early stage beat em up with a punishing score/difficulty multiplier system and dreams of becoming a roguelike.

Initial release made in 60 hours for TOJam2025!

title: Ascent of Eternity
description: Ascent of Eternity is an action-rpg rogue-like magical horde-slaying third person coop game. Fire, Ice, Electric, Light, Dark, Metal, and Life. The 7 elements call for mastery. Master the elements and ascend through eternity!

title: Sea Blindness
description: Sea Blindness is a 2D pixel-art narrative RPG Game. In the year 2064, players assume the role of Jimmy, a deep-sea researcher who becomes entangled in a mysterious incident only to discover he's trapped inside a video game.

title: 1998: The Toll Keeper Story
description: A narrative simulation game where you play as a mother-to-be working as a toll keeper in the fictional country of Janapa, a nation on the brink of chaos. Navigate daily challenges and make difficult moral choices to survive—all for the sake of your unborn child.

title: Liminal Leap
description: Liminal Leap is a pulse-pounding escape room experience set within the unsettling world of the Backrooms. Here, reality unravels, and familiar spaces morph into unrelenting, unsettling corridors. You awaken trapped within a labyrinthine facility – a twisted reflection of the everyday, now warped and hostile. Your Objective: Escape. Unravel the secrets of this insidious place and find your way back to reality. The Peril: The Lurkers: These guardians of the Backrooms manipulate the very fabric of reality. Walls shift, doors vanish, and the map you hold becomes unreliable. Stay alert! A single misstep could lead to a dead end, a trap, or worse. A Multitude of Deaths: The Backrooms are unforgiving. One wrong turn, a misstep in the dark, or a run-in with a Lurker could lead to a gruesome demise. The Challenge: Limited Saves: The first level is a harrowing gauntlet – your wits and reflexes alone will be your guide.

title: Super Penguin Ball & Chain
description: Super Penguin Ball & Chain is a 3D marble rolling game which recreates the feeling of the genre classics, with a comical twist. Your goal is simply to roll to the end of each stage, but you must do so while attached to a giant ball & chain. Play solo, attached to a giant iron ball, or play chained together with your friends.

title: DineInn
description:
You suddenly get a call that your father has gone missing and this Inn is all that he left behind for you. You must now work at DineInn and handle all operations from Cooking to maintaining the building. Restore the DineInn and uncover its secrets!

You arrive at an abandoned motel and you are now the manager, the Chef and the owner. Start cooking!

title: Dew
description: Dew is a 1-2 player Co-op Adventure with classic 2D Platformer mechanics set in a stunningly beautiful realistic micro-environment. Play as two tiny unlikely heroes, Myric and Dewey and stop the evil forces that is spreading a creeping mold that is infecting all living in their world.

title: Operation Blindside: Annihilation
description: Operation Blindside: Annihilation is a tactical, highly-realistic military-simulation shooter based upon the Operation Flashpoint mil-sim series. It is developed and published by RV Studios.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl - Enhanced Edition
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl, the first chapter of the Legends of the Zone Trilogy, which started it all. Welcome to the former exclusion territory near the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant… the most dangerous place on Earth. Play as The Marked One, face sinister mysteries, radiation-soaked anomalous threats and moral dilemmas, as your decisions determine your destiny in this immersive dark sci-fi saga.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky - Enhanced Edition
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky is the prequel chapter of the Legends of the Zone Trilogy. With the ability to directly influence the balance of power through Faction Wars, step into the boots of Scar — a seasoned mercenary, able to somehow survive deadly Emissions. Make your way to the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant through radiation, anomalies, enemies, mutants, and conflict-raging Zone.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat - Enhanced Edition
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat follows the story of special service agent Major Degtyarev as he investigates the fate of a lost expedition. Rich with colorful characters, memorable side stories, and the spirit of true freedom, this chapter delivers a powerful and unforgettable conclusion to the Legends of the Zone Trilogy.

title: Spellforce: Conquest of Eo - Children of Nor
description: Stars align, shadows rise. A new power appears from the corners of the world - the enigmatic Dark Elves. As an Astromancer, you'll master the arcane art of constellation crafting. However, a new Antagonist, Zahaar, the Snake, threatens your path.

title: #7-J5Z: The Driftwood Experiment
description: A simple and short cozy game where you play as an unusual robot, exploring an underwater cave system.

title: Elemental War Clash
description: Elemental War Clash combines classic tower defense with roguelite and RPG mechanics as well as different elements to combine and create more powerful towers. In its PvP mode you can also battle with other players trying to overrun them with your own hordes of monsters!

title: Besmirch
description: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.

title: LEGO City Undercover
description: New features of the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows and Xbox One versions includes that of split-screen cooperation support.

title: Kunoichi Trainer
description:
After continual viewing of Naruto for a several days, you end up near the main entrance of Konoha somehow. You are met by three familiar to you girls: Hinata, Ino and Sakura. Obviously, they confused you with someone else so you put a bold face on and decide to play along.

As it turns out later, you are the invited trainer for girls above mentioned… It is time to decide what your trainings are gonna be like… Though… Since it is a dream, maybe you can have some «fun» with them…

Can something so vivid be just a dream…?

title: Streamers Interactive Quiz Game
description: An interactive Quiz that works in your Twitch Chat. With minimal fuss or set up you can fill in the time with your chat on Twitch.

title: Super Swarmer Survivors
description: Blast waves of worms back into the void! Choose eldritch superpowers each level for unique new mechanics! Your 6 jelly tendrils hold overpowered mutations! Dash and surf around in this fast-paced kinetic top-down action roguelite in an arcane petri dish and control dark rifts and curses...

title: Under The Surface
description: Under The Surface is a fast-paced first-person maze game where players must navigate a dark, mysterious facility while evading a relentless presence. As you collect vital objectives scattered throughout the level, the environment reacts—becoming increasingly dangerous and unpredictable.

title: Jovian Drive
description: Gaze upon the moon-filled skies of the Jovian system and drive absurdly long distances across the Galilean moons of Jupiter! The routes themselves are easy, but the distances are not!

title: Animation Versus
description: Animation VERSUS is a new fighting game featuring your favorite stick figure characters from animator Alan Becker!

title: Back*space
description: You have found yourself in a space that reminds you of nothing, and everything. A space of rooms, that are both comfortingly familiar, yet strangely unknown. A space of quiet and loneliness. You have found the BACK*SPACE. You aren't sure if you are alone. You aren't sure if you want to leave.

title: Disposable Corps
description: Disposable Corps is a 5v5 multiplayer tactical shooter set in a stylized, alternate-history version of World War I. Players engage in team-based combat featuring trench-building, destructible environments, and objective-driven gameplay. The game emphasizes coordination and battlefield control, with a focus on close-quarters encounters and shifting frontlines. Its art direction blends historical inspiration with exaggerated, low-poly visuals and a darkly satirical tone.

title: Side Effects
description: Side Effects is a horror game that attempts to re-design Russian Roulette, replacing the gun and bullets with pills.

title: Koyomin's Revenge
description: The mysterious ****** was lured to his death(?) by "the witches." You follow Koyomin's struggle between revenge and individuality.

title: Night Swarm
description: Rise as a young vampire, earn your name, and gather powerful allies. In this survivor-like auto-shooter, battle relentless werewolf hordes, grow your strength, build your pack, and dominate the night.

title: Journey Of Rune
description: Journey of Rune is an anime turn-based CRPG game with adventures and friendships. Just create your own story whatever you like!

title: Flipper Frenzy
description: Flop, slide, and splash your way to victory in Flipper Frenzy—the seal-iest racing game ever! Customize your seal, gallumph on land, and zoom through water in wild tracks like frozen glaciers, tropical oases, and sky-high tubes. Play solo, online, or local co-op and seal the win!

title: Airplane Racing Championship
description: Buckle up and soar to new heights in Airplane Racing Championship - the ultimate high-speed aerial racing experience! Compete against elite pilots in stunning environments, from bustling cityscapes to treacherous mountain, Beach, Many More.

title: Advanced V.G.: Saturn Tribute
description: Compete for the title of the strongest fighter and claim the legendary prime real estate! A dazzling fighting game!

title: Our Exciting Summer Camp
description: It's time for an adventure in the great outdoors! Enjoy the wonders of nature at this exciting summer camp!

title: Nice Day for Fishing: Legendary DLC
description: Ah, hello Adventurer! We noticed your equipment could do with an upgrade. Fulfil your destiny with the Legendary DLC.

title: Neon Roller
description: The ultimate physics runner game set in a vibrant, neon-themed world! Navigate through dazzling landscapes filled with glowing obstacles, collect shimmering coins, and unlock a variety of exciting new themes and balls.

title: Steam-Heart's: Saturn Tribute
description: Save the virus-ravaged planet! A frenzy-filled shooting game!

title: Sniper Elite: Resistance - Target Führer: Lights, Camera, Achtung
description:
The Allies are swarming across Europe and gathering pace.
In a last-ditch effort to sway the favour of the French, Adolf Hitler, leader of the Third Reich, is en route to the Ville du Lac Film Studios to film a series of propaganda shorts.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - German Shorthaired Pointer
description: Meet the German Shorthaired Pointer! This skillful dog will point you in the direction of your desired targets and help you find their whereabouts quicker.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Salzwiesen Park
description: Explore the salt marsh habitat at Salzwiesen Park and hunt a wide range of waterfowl and small game. Plus, sharpen your shooting skills solo or compete against friends at the new Clay Shooting Range.

title: Gladiator Manager
description: Gladiator Manager is a sports management and tactical battle simulation game.

title: BrightGunner
description: BrightGunner is a innovative fast-paced first person shooter game.simplicity and refreshment, the three major design concepts are: diversified gameplay, mild Rogue mechanism, and no interface design style.

title: Kaz
description:
KAZ, your shot of dopamine wrapped in a minimalist roguelike. Execute lightning-fast moves with frame-perfect controls : easy to learn, hard to master. Immediate, Intense, Addictive. Every run makes you better, faster, hungrier, unlocking tons of unique items, skins and challenges.
4 keys, no excuses: Prove your skill and dominate the ranks.

title: Depth Complaint
description:
Depth Complaint (The Unfinished RPG) is a game created by Zero Dollar Gift Card AKA ZeDoGiCa/ZeDo, in RPGMaker VX Ace.

You play as ADAM, a slime, who throughout the game will meet and absorb other party members into himself.
Its visuals are comprised almost entirely out of rough sketches and found images, arranged in surreal collages, and its soundtrack is an eclectic mix of experimental music, hip-hop, jazz, and vaporwave, all laden with samples.

The game was made with the intention of being abandoned partly through its own development, and much of the dialogue reflects this. It explores themes of artist's block, creative struggle, and self-doubt.

The estimated playtime is 0.5-2 hours.

title: Mine Jam 1
description: Mine Jam 1 features 9 brand new mine themed maps that ran from Feb 4th to Mar 2nd 2025. Features its own intro, story intermissions, custom textures, hub, boss fight and a secret map if you can find it. So, what are you waiting for marine, Christmas? On the double!

title: Space Speedjam 1
description: Space Speedjam 1 features 5 new maps, a hub level and a intro made in just two days (Apr 4th-Apr 6th 2025), themed after the space maps of Quake 2 and other games.

title: Action Entities
description: A multiplayer game with anti-gravity mechanics and unique worlds in which you need to fight off monsters. Original graphics, glowing plants, the environment, and perfectly selected music make the gameplay rich and entertaining.

title: Filthium Zero
description: Filthium Zero is a single-player survivor-like action roguelite. Purge the Filthium-infested zones of Earth, take on hordes of mutants reanimated by the corruption, engage in vertical and ground combat, and watch the ragdolls fly.

title: MTB Mavrix
description: The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Seasons of the Worm Cult
description:
Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 launches on June 2 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles and is included as part of the 2025 Content Pass. In this new storyline and zone, you must uncover and investigate the Worm Cult’s new base of operations on the tropical island of Solstice.

In Part 1, as you explore Western Solstice, you will quickly discover that the Worm Cult is far from defenseless. They’ve erected a massive arcane barrier using soul magic—the Writhing Wall—that divides the island, and for now, Eastern Solstice (and its secrets) is sealed off by this arcane edifice.

Despite being a zone divided, you will find that Western Solstice is full of challenges and rewards, including new World Bosses, Delves, a Public Dungeon, and a brand-new Trial, the Ossein Cage. There are 16 Antiquities (including three new Mythic items), four new Trial item sets (including Perfected versions), and a host of other rewards, including even more item sets, and a ton of Collectibles, from crafting motifs to pets. You’ll also receive a 10% experience boost from adventuring in Solstice all year!

Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2 arrives in Q4 and gives you the opportunity to finally uncover just what these villains have been hiding behind the arcane barrier. Be warned, Eastern Solstice is far less welcoming than the previous territory, thanks to the Worm Cult’s malign influence.

Solstice’s second half introduces yet more challenges and rewards, with additional World Bosses, Delves, another Public Dungeon, and new rewards both exclusive to the new content and shared across the unified Solstice zone. You can expect three new overland item sets (giving Solstice six in total once Part 2 unlocks), three more Mythic items, and many more items and collectibles to earn.

title: Master Hanzi
description: One day, soldiers disappeared from a Chinese city, and now they are being searched for in an underground military base in the desert. However, after intensive research, it turned out that the results were anything but positive.

title: Rogue Scum
description: Sci-fi action-roguelike survivors bullet-hell with dialogs.

title: Harmonic Reflections
description:
A visual novel based on the "Kioku no Kenban" novel by Ono Wasabi.

High school senior Aruto, burdened by lost childhood memories and the silence of the piano in contrast to his talented younger brother, lives with a quiet unease. His unspoken feelings for a classmate linger. Then, an enigmatic girl appears, claiming memories of the future, and sets Aruto's fate on a dramatic new course. This poignant summer love story explores a tangled triangle of past, present, and future.

title: Coagulation Station: Fleshfall
description: A rustpunk sci-fi horror game with a touch of dark corporate humor. Operate a free-hanging elevator and explore the depths of a horrific alien world made of living tissue.

title: Monochrome Serenade
description: A new visual novel by Laplacian and Nagatsuki Tappei, the author of Re:Zero, to be released in 2027. It will be approximately 10 hours long.

title: Kugayama Shiori's Death Diary
description: A mystery visual novel where horror meets occult comedy. Follow Kugayama Shiori, a ghost who casually dies over and over as she searches for her cause of death and the regrets that bind her to this world. Her investigation will eventually lead to a single incident—and the truth behind her demise.

title: Meth Make Simulator
description: Simulator. Low-poly style.

title: Parabellum: Siege of Legends
description: An epic war and strategy game set in the medieval universe.

title: The 5th Door
description: You find yourself in a quiet room with four doors. There's always an anomaly. Choose wisely.

title: Hexitten
description: Hexitten is a sci-fi roguelike deck builder with tactical grid based battles. You will build an elite team of heroes to tackle the greatest threats to the galactic alliance. During your campaign, you will travel through the 6 hextants of the galaxy to collect new abilities, modify your ships, recruit additional team members, discover each hero's story and increase their synergy with other heroes, encounter special events, and fight for the future of the alliance.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Brushes with Death
description: Help a mysterious artist uncover his enigmatic past and unleash your creativity in shield painting. Henry encounters a quirky painter, who draws him into a web of intricate plans, pushing his skills to its limit in finding solutions.

title: Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army - Demons of the Aril Rift
description: Additional downloadable content that grants a special book upon completing a "Trial of a Hundred Demons."

title: One-liners
description: One-liners is a modern take on the classic dots and boxes game traditionally played with pen and paper. The goal is to create more complete boxes than your opponent by taking turns to draw horizontal or vertical lines between adjacent dots. However, there are new possibilities for strategizing and defeating your opponents, such as items that can be activated on the board.

title: Adventure Awaits in The Secret of the Golden Key
description: A family friendly adventure visual novel that makes reading fun! Accessibility is top of mind with voice-acted read-along narration with friendly fonts for readers with dyslexia. Experience hand drawn art and make important choices to determine how your story unfolds.

title: Castle of the Countess
description:
Felix the Cat is somehow back in Black and White. Wha' happened???

The Countess, played by Xena Princess Warrior, has trapped other past characters in the year 1922. Travel with Kitt to her fancy Castle and solve the puzzle of how to get back to 2022!

This classic-style platformer started as a puzzle adventure, then turned into a arcade action game. Enjoy 15 levels of unique arcade adventure! Lovingly crafted by 5 appreciators of old school game design.

title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Fortune Edition
Washout
description: Washout is a single-player first-person horror game where the player must escape a flooded maze inspired by the Bathroom Maze aesthetic while avoiding an irrational threat — a Washing Machine whose behavior defies logic and reason.

title: Online Records: Unknown Seller
description: A 22 year old student arranges to meet an online seller at their home to pick up an item. At first, everything seems normal, but as she steps through the door, an eerie feeling creeps in. What was supposed to be a simple purchase soon turns into an experience she will never forget.

title: Let Catch Me
description: Let Catch Me is a bodycam-perspective survival horror game. In the game, players must survive in a cramped, eerie, and terrifying forest are combined with the horror demons, where players must to take pictures to score and to gain chances of survival and escape from enemies

title: Triangle: Cursed Town
description: Triangle - Cursed Town is a 4-player online co-op atmospheric horror game. You and your friends are a team sent by the church. Together, you will enter the cursed village, try to collect as much evidence as possible, and complete the necessary ritual to lift the curse. The tools you find in the village will help you learn about the type of demon you're dealing with and uncover the mystery behind the curse.

title: Zoey: Nightclub Secrets
description: Zoey: Nightclub Secrets is an Hentai visual novel set in an alluring nightclub. Follow Zoey, the new dancer, as you indulge in forbidden encounters and explore desires that go beyond the rules. What happens behind closed doors stays hidden... if you can keep the secret.

title: The Mandarin II
description: A fangame faux bootleg loosley based on The Mandalorian, Developed for the Windows and several old computers.

title: Ares
description: Ares is an abandoned FPS project by Mancuso Raffaele that uses the Irrlicht Engine. It has odd gameplay and support for mods. It is currently only archived through a GitHub page.

title: Sake Acanthus
description:
The setting is Azami High School, an ordinary school you could find anywhere.
Naoya Izumura, the sole member of the literature club, is told one day by Kazane Nogawa, his childhood friend and the student council president, that unless the club shows some results soon, it will be disbanded.
In his search for a way to save the club, he meets Himeka Sakashiro, an art club member in a similar situation. Together, they decide to collaborate on creating a picture book.
Will their artistic efforts bloom like the flower of the acanthus ?

title: DreadOut 3
description: DreadOut 3 is a third-person horror adventure inspired by Asian - Indonesian urban legend. Follow Linda’s journey as a Keeper of the Dark into an interdimensional rabbit hole to find the source of unseen power threatening the balance of light and darkness.

title: Blasfemia
description: Blasfemia is a first-person horror game. You are trapped in a seemingly normal apartment but realize early on that you're not alone. Explore a handcrafted, detail rich environment in a tense and terrifying atmosphere and try to find a way out before an ominous entity gets to you.

title: Dominova
description: Collect and chain dominoes together: the longer the chain, the higher you score. Amplify your score-breaking engine through various upgrades, while also navigating through a volatile board full of hazards and loot in this oddly satisfying domino deckbuilder.

title: Legends Aligned: Minis in Conflict
description: Not all wars make noise. Some just mess up your box.

title: Ping Pong Up
description: Feel the tension of the big match breaking through the screen.

title: Ramen! Road to Mastery
description:
Noodles! Soup! Toppings!
Fill ramen orders as quickly as possible and follow the road to mastery!

title: Foto Boy: Flashstar
description: Join Kin, during his side job in this hilarious journey!

title: Cats Visiting Fairy Tales
description: Spot clever felines tucked into fairy tale scenes! Hunt for 100 cats in each magical zone, plus discover all special hidden treasures. A purrfect puzzle adventure!

title: Not Not 2: A Brain Challenge - Golden DLC
description:
With this DLC you'll NOT NOT unlock:
3 unique skins for your character
3 cool backgrounds for a change of scenery

title: Not Not 2: A Brain Challenge - Platinum DLC
description:
With this DLC you'll NOT NOT unlock:
3 unique skins for your characater
3 cool backgrounds for a change of scenery

title: Planet Party Time
description: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!

title: Jawbone Hollow
description: We may be a small team, but we sure as hell have passion and drive. This single-player horror experience in a long-abandoned gold mine will make you go insane, wandering endlessly until death finally finds you. Misery awaits all who enter Jawbone Hollow. Do you think you can survive?

title: Meaning of Flower
description: Welcome to the butcher shop with a unique atmosphere. This is a point-and-click puzzle where you play as a mysterious worker. Explore interactive scenes, search for hidden puzzles and secret levels, using attention to detail. Everything is not what it seems.

title: Starlight Squad
description: Lead an elite squad of heroines in this high-energy vertical shmup! Blast through enemy waves, dodge deadly patterns, and take down epic bosses as you fight to free the galaxy from the grip of the Merlian Empire.

title: Divine Legacy: Neo Amburia
description: Divine Legacy: Neo Amburia is a medieval-fantasy RPG where a young woman must save her childhood friend, who's been pulled toward a dark fate. With little more than determination, she'll battle powerful foes, form unexpected alliances, and uncover secrets that could reshape the world.

title: Drone Dash
description: Race, boost, and soar through physics-driven tracks in this fast-paced 2D drone racing game. Master precision flying, compete on global leaderboards, and push your skills to the limit!

title: Meme Survivors: Backrooms
description: Meme hordes are attacking! Choose one of four heroes and survive 30 minutes in the hellish Bullet Hell Backrooms!

title: Greatsword Point!
description: Swing your greatsword and hold your point! Only you can effortlessly and endlessly fend off armies of Oranges! There is no one else up to the task!

title: Zombie HQ
description:
Your city has been overrun. The zombie infestation is seriously getting in the way of your downtime. It’s time to take back what’s yours!

Scavenge what you can, find bigger and badder weapons, and take the fight to the undead!

The streets are no longer safe, but you can seek refuge on the rooftops. What you need is somewhere to catch a breath, somewhere safe to kick back and prepare for your next explosive zombie-killing mission ... what you need is a Zombie HQ!

title: Clockwork Palace: Mysteries of the Mughal Mechanicum
description: Dive into a Mughal Steampunk world where math puzzles, steam-powered contraptions, and hidden stories await! Solve challenges inspired by Eastern and South Asian cultures, tinker with intricate machines, and explore a palace frozen in time. A fun adventure for families and puzzle lovers!

title: Chaos Classroom
description: Chaos Classroom is an action-roguelite, bullet-heaven where the player selects a team to fight hordes of make-believe enemies in an imaginative dream version of the school, with the option of swapping between different students as they try to make it to the end of each week.

title: Rule the Kingdom
description: An epic RPG adventure awaits you in Rule the Kingdom! Outfit your character, train your loyal band of warriors and join the battle against trolls, skeletons and other baddies to save the empire from evil! Build homes for your workers, produce goods in your workshops, fortify your stronghold, and farm crops to feed your subjects in your quest to build a thriving kingdom!

title: Humble Zombie
description: HUMBLE ZOMBIE is a game in which you control an unstable Zombie, trying to get to the top to taste the freshest brain.

title: Colossal Kickoff
description: Colossal Kickoff is a 1-versus-3 arcade soccer game. One player plays as a giant monster with powerful abilities, while the other three players play as human warriors who must work together to defeat the boss on the pitch. Colossal Kickoff features five unique monsters based on creatures of mythology from around the world.

title: Ultimate Destruction Simulator
description: Slow down time, spawn tornadoes, change gravity, create your own maps, play maps created by others! All kinds of missiles, grenades and charges, different sized tornadoes, black holes, earth shatters. Different material types to build from with their own properties. All that and more in this Sim

title: Burgaholic
description: A platforming game about collecting burgers!

title: ZombMe
description: ZombMe is a 2D platformer based on old-school platformers with influences and callbacks to Mario, Sonic, Bonk, Bionic Commando, MetalStorm, and Mega Man. The hook with ZombMe, though, is that you're a zombie who is trying to stay DEAD--so the traditional gameplay mechanics of needing health is reversed: catching fire and jumping on spikes is good, and getting health packs is bad!

title: Sleepy Girl
description:
A mostly autobiographical retelling of my mornings.

This games comes with footnotes, have "footnotes.txt" open while playing.

Mild flashing lights warning.

title: Birb Game
description: A racing game where you play as a bird and race in single player or online multiplayer

title: Champions Tactics Reforged
description: Champions Tactics: Reforged is a free-to-play tactical PvP game set in the dark and mystical world of Grimoria. Assemble a team of unique and powerful champions and engage in intense, turn-based duels. Outsmart your opponents, forge your strategy, and rise through the ranks.

Take part in the Eastern emancipation process and meet historical figures from the time. You’ll undertake different missions that will lead you through the besieged streets of Montevideo, the encampments of the besieging forces, and the Éxodo Oriental. Challenges will become increasingly difficult!

title: Super Miaoyin
description: Super Miaoyin is a 3D hardcore platformer crafted by a solo developer. You will play as a cartoon-style Miaoyin, ascending the divine tree in a vibrant, fresh art style while embarking on a perilous journey.

title: Bestiary of the Mountains and Seas
description: you will be able to experience the charm of the "Classic of Mountains and Seas" firsthand, as a game named "Shan Hai Jing Demons' Compendium" has been born. It represents the various elements from the "Classic of Mountains and Seas" through synthesis and evolution

title: Below Nowhere
description: A man made of red flesh is hunting you. He is the Meat Man. Below Nowhere is a first-person survival horror game that will pull you into the depths of evil. While exploring strange memories that aren't yours, you will be pushed to your limits in this terrifying tale of humanity and second chances.

title: Some Assembly Required
description:
Some Assembly Required is a Farmer's Delight and Create add-on that allows players to create custom sandwiches.

To get started, create some bread slices using Farmer's Delight's cutting board, or make a burger bun. Then, place down a Sandwiching Station, place a bread slice or bun on top, and start adding ingredients. In addition to food, potions can also be added. Once your sandwich is finished, you can pick it up by breaking it. Sandwiches can be placed down anywhere in your world by shift-right-clicking.

A sandwich restores the same amount of hunger and saturation as it's ingredients. However, if it contains at least 2 unique ingredients (excluding bread and potions), it will additionally grant a Comfort buff if it's a sandwich, or a Nourishment buff if it's a burger. The length of this effect increases with the number of unique ingredients.

If doing things automatically is more your style, you can automate the production of sandwiches using Create's deployers. Furthermore, spouts can add fluids such as potions, honey or chocolate to your sandwiches. A full list of compatible fluids can be found in JEI.

title: Sect House
description: Indie Horror in which you play as a child whose once-happy life is shattered after your how your parents gave you to a cult by a pastor. Trapped in a nightmarish home, you must explore environments, solve eerie puzzles, and without falling into the hands of the pastor. Can you escape the house?

title: Biophobia
description: A woman is violated by a man. In a final act of rebellion to preserve her humanity, she takes control and opens her stomach. Unable to finish what she started she waits for you, and asks you not to look away.

title: Survive the Labyrinth
description: In Hollow Streets, navigate a dark maze filled with terrifying monsters and hidden mysteries. Solve challenging puzzles and choose your path carefully as you face unpredictable dangers. Every decision matters. Can you escape and survive?

title: ?? Movie Theater
description: This is a funny movie theater where you can watch any kind of movie. I saw a movie here. It is a story of a high school boy “Sota Sakurai” until ※※※※※※.

title: Carlos Haunted House
description: Carlos Haunted House is a 2D Top-Down survival horror game based on the story of a haunted house where you have been invited by your friend, the current owner, to experience the paranormal activities and to help him deal with them.

title: Phantom Reckoning
description: Phantom Reckoning En este juego psicológico de terror chino en miniatura, encarnarás a una enfermera de un hospital rural en los años 90, atrapada en una pesadilla que se repite sin fin.

title: One Night at the Steeze
description:
You remember being a kid. You remember eating your first slice of pizza at the local pizzeria. You remember how the cheese would slip off the crust and onto your new jeans. You remember that one cute employee who refilled your soda a little more than the others. You remember running out of tokens for the arcade and smacking the machines when they didn't work; and you remember how one of the animatronics winked at you and proceeded to flirtatious shake its hips at you the rest of the night.

Oh you don't?

Well, on one night at the Steeze Pizzeria, something like that happened.

title: The Old Mansion: Eternal Night
description: "The Old Mansion" is a horror game that begins when a journalist receives a tip about a mansion that has been abandoned for a long time. As the journalist investigates, they gradually reveal the hidden truths behind the occurrences.

title: Kindergarten of Hell
description: You are a detective investigating a case that has been forgotten for 5 years. The case involves finding out why everyone disappeared from a daycare.

title: Desecration
description: Who have you become? All that matters is that you keep your "brother" fed. In this narrative Horror Game drag your newest victim through the subterranean cavity where your brother now resides, but tread lightly as you explore. The flesh of victims' past claws out from the walls for retribution.

title: Into The Net
description: Into The Net is a Mega Man Battle Network/.hack fangame created in RPGMaker 2000 by divinelight, for the Itch.io "Game Off" Game Jam in 2021.

title: Click to Continue
description: A strange white room. One button. Endless clicking. Unlock bizarre upgrades, face unexpected challenges, and uncover a hidden truth in this surreal, humorous, short clicker game.

title: Krysolov
description: A post-apocalyptic atmospheric experience. Scavenge what you can and get out. But you are not alone. Be fast before the creature finds you a prey.

title: Light in the Woods
description: A horror escape room. Trapped by a demonic entity in an old house, solve puzzles in each room before the candles go out.

title: Can't You Run?
description: An endless torment

title: Endless Legend: Definitive Edition
description:
Endless Legend is the turn-based 4X fantasy strategy game from Amplitude Studios. Your home planet of Auriga is an inhospitable planet. As the leader of your people, it is your duty to protect and guide them... but you are not the only one trying to survive and thrive on this planet.

Will you be remembered as the explorer who unlocked the secrets of Auriga, the magnate who mastered the subtle arts of diplomacy and trade, or the warmonger whose legacy was written in blood? The choice is yours.

Endless Legend Definitive Edition, along with the base game, includes:

Endless Legend - Guardians
Who are these guardians? And more importantly, how will you harness their power?

Endless Legend - Shadows
The Forgotten are one of the major factions thought to be long gone. These masters of espionage, infiltration, and sabotage operate from the shadows.

Endless Legend - Echoes of Auriga
These seven new songs are here to further enhance your immersion in the world of Auriga.

Endless Legend - The Lost Tales
The minor factions are filled with characters whose stories remain to be told.

Endless Legend - Shifters
The Allayi faction has been on Auriga since before Endless. They are bound to Auriga, their bodies and minds reflecting the state of the planet, and they will do anything to defend it.

Endless Legend - Tempest
The oceans of Auriga still hold many mysteries, one of which is now revealed in the form of the Morgawr faction.

Endless Legend - Inferno
This faction thrives on volcanic terrain and will not rest until the rivers of Auriga are filled with lava.

Endless Legend - Symbiosis
The ancient Mykara faction joins the fray with one goal in mind: to restore balance to Auriga.

Endless Legend - Monstrous Tales
Dive in and discover ancient truths with these twenty new quests.

title: Tzimtzum
description: Tzimtzum is a surreal retro-styled horror game set in an office building. Explore each floor and try to exit via the elevator. Each floor becomes more unsettling and surreal. The lights may go out, but fortunately, you have a flashlight. Unfortunately, you are also not alone.

title: Bubble Surge
