description: This is a platform - jumping game. You'll be encased in bubbles and immersed in an underwater world, while the 'monster' is lurking in the cave, waiting for a chance to move. Hurry up! Cross numerous obstacles to explore the path and free yourself.

title: Open Net Battle
description: Open Net Battle is an open-source game/game engine based off of MegaMan Battle Network 6. Players can create and import Navis, BattleChips, Viruses, and more. Players can connect to real-world websites, battle each other, and more.

title: Dusky Cap
description: Dusky Cap is a 2D hack-and-slash game.

title: Kunkun Defender 2
description: KUNKUN Defender 2 is a hybrid TPS and tower defense game where players must fend off waves of zombies in virus-infected zones, holding their ground until a helicopter arrives for extraction.

title: Monster Battles
description: Gather your monster squad and fight in Monster Battles! Dive into this inventory management auto-battler. Collect, combine, and strategize with your monsters. The same-race monsters get powerful buffs, and monsters can fuse and evolve. Discover endless possibilities and build your ultimate squad!

title: Sorry Survivor
description: In "Sorry Survivor," the main character becomes irresistible and rejects girls who approach him, aiming for his dream heroine. It's a simple top-down, harem-denying, Vampire Survivors-like 2D action game.

title: You Are Not Alice
description: YOU ARE NOT ALICE is a social engineering sandbox game where you play the role of a hacker who has taken over Alice's work computer. Your goal is to spread through her company by talking to her coworkers and convincing them to run a virus file you can send them.

title: Five Owls
description: Five Owls is a visual novel telling the story of Veronica and her crazy adventure set in the 21st century in the beautiful city of Pińczów in Poland. The girl is a type of gaming loner who doesn't look for trouble- it finds her!

title: Sickly Days and Summer Traces
description:
All ages version of the visual novel "Doinaka Kyoudai".

A devoted brother and his fragile sister share a quiet, dreamlike summer. As her gentle companion, speak with her, care for her, and gather the fleeting, precious fragments of a love that blooms softly in the stillness of everyday life.

title: Rank: Warmaster Bunker Buster
description: Rank Warmaster: Bunker Buster meets tactical control with strategic execution, bringing RTS elements to this sci-fi, action tower defense. Acquire resources as you further secure your bunker strategically placing perimeters and defensive and offensive units.

title: Formless Star
description:
The Formless Star, a mysterious planet whose surface constantly changes...
You're Anemo, a field researcher for the Space Archives!
Your assignment is to travel to the Formless Star and gather data on the animals that live there.
Each time you step out of your spaceship, the land will change. A new world just for you!
Discover 60 different alien creatures, all with with unique behaviours and descriptions.

title: Akeno's Veil
description: Spot the anomalies. Escape the loop. Akeno’s Veil is a psychological horror game where spotting anomalies is your only escape—from the relentless demon determined to pull you back.

title: Informaticus
description: You are tasked to explore a tropical island with old temples and find the thief of two stolen artifacts. Solve computer science puzzles using an in-game knowledge-database and talk to archeologists.

title: Ero Condo: Remastered
description:
"Ero Condo" is an adult mobile gay for LGBTQ+ since 2021. It has uncensored sexual graphics with fun, diverse storylines. With more than 1000+ CGs and 100+ stories, you can enjoy its ride for a long time!

"Ero Condo" is designed for fans who appreciate beautiful hand-drawn artwork and the thrill of adult RPGs. Whether you’re managing the building or indulging in some intimate moments, this game offers a captivating experience that will keep you hooked.

title: Cheese is the Reason
description: Enter the depths of Rat City and fix Chev Hampton's clogged bathroom pipe! Made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 57

title: Kaiju No. 8: The Game
description:
Crush colossal Kaiju with a game-changing blow! Experience exhilarating attacks with intuitive controls! Explore the world of Kaiju No. 8, recreated with stunning visuals!

Based on the global hit anime, adapted from the Shonen Jump+ sensation, KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME brings you into the heart of the action! Witness epic battles between the Japan Anti-Kaiju Defense Force and cataclysmic Kaiju, all rendered in breathtaking graphics!

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 1 - Welcome to Uropia
description: While on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland, Okada Yu and the children find themselves lost in the deserted amusement park Uropia. To return to their original world, they must challenge the attractions scattered throughout the park...

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 2 - Promises and Crayons
description: To safely escape from the mysterious amusement park Uropia, Okada and the children take on Block Answer! As they answer quiz questions of various genres, they also uncover the past of the Hero Squad and children participating in the challenge...

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 3 - The Divided Children
description: As their friends get Game Overs one after the other, the children split into two teams!? Together with the Wolf Team, who are determined to collect medals on their own, they face Merry-Go-Circuit, where a new "trial" awaits them!

title: Pokemon Reloaded
description: “Pokemon Reloaded” is an Rpgxp Fangame made by F3R. Discover an amazing anime-style battle system similar to Pokemon, featuring movements and actions. Also, journey through the fresh ‘Star’ region, where you can encounter Pokemon from generations 1 to 9, face various villainous teams, pick from multiple main characters, and much more.

title: Ha-ha-ho-ho-horror
description: An indie horror game with a comedic twist about a girl with asthma, imaginary cartoons, and a voice in her head. She ends up in a strange yard and tries to escape. The antagonist? A clown. Scary? At times. Funny? A little.

title: Reverse 1999: Folie et Déraison
description:
Version 2.6 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Recoleta and Aleph
• New Garments for Willow, Lopera, Melania and Erick
• New main story chapter: Folie et Déraison
• New Anecdote for Bette
• …and more!

title: Aristocratic Potato
description: Aristocratic Potato is an Action, Parkour, 3D-platformer Game.featuring Evil Peelers chasing you with their UNIQUE ABILITIES, and The Final Boss.This game is EXTREMELY difficult, recommended after a bad day in work :3

title: Grimwar
description:
GRIMWAR is a fast-paced platform shooter with an emphasis on movement, playstyle customization, and low-poly graphics.
Using an arsenal of deadly spells strewn across twisting passages, you must escape the tower and defeat the GRIMWAR -- fighting your way through waves of enemies and wall-running across obstacles.

title: Smiling Terror
description:
Smiling Terror is a fixed-camera horror game in PSX style, inspired by the classics of the genre. It will be released in chapters – and Chapter 1 is already available in Early Access.

Once the project reaches a solid level of stability (based on your feedback and the number of players), our goal is to release new chapters to expand the story with fresh content, new dangers, and many surprises.

Will you be able to escape and survive The Smiler?

title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
description: Study the crime scene, connect clues, hack into systems, search databases, uncover the truth! Your trusty PDA opens up countless gameplay possibilities. You have everything you need to solve the case in your hands -- and brain!

title: Incredible Ink
description: Incredible Ink is an arcade puzzle game where you are tasked to guide the Magic Ball through obstacles in living paintings using the Magic Quill and the Incredible Ink.

title: Plants vs. Zombies Delturbia
description: Plants vs. Zombies Delturbia is a mod that overhauls PvZ 1, featuring a brand-new art style, new plants, new zombies, and entirely new worlds with unique gimmicks.

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 4 - Well Wishes
description: Despite losing more friends, Okada Yu, Lion, Lime, and Zoya challenge Heartpoundin' Ferris Wheel to earn more medals! They also join forces with the other children to take on Bye Bye Slots, but a cracks begin to form between them...

title: Super Stroke the Pants
description: Stroke your special pants! This game is super easy! All you have to do is click and hold! Your score will accumulate and achievements will be unlocked! You are free to keep your score at 100 or become the king of pants! You can enjoy it for the price of a cup of coffee!

title: Georgie-Yolkie 64: The Furry Tale
description: Let's tell an old tale anew, and go back to the good ol' days of gaming with a new classic, hack and slash adventure. Upgrade Georgie & Yolkie's abilities and travel across 17 lovely lands and save Princess Tabitha from the clutches of the evil King Rattie! Lots of addictive swordplay and fun here!

title: Ritus Exorcismus
description: Become the exorcist that the world needs! Use Holy Relics and the knowledge from your book to fight demonic possessions. Investigate unholy events and take part in church rituals in this medieval pixel horror game.

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 5 - That Which Connects Us
description: As they grow more distraught over the string of Game Overs, everyone's treasures have gone missing!? Okada and the children, in pursuit of Kanata and their treasures, arrive at the Sweeping Pool, where a mysterious shadow appears...

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 6 - The Red Mask
description: A few days after beating Sweeping Pool, the mysterious girl appears in front of Okada! While Okada chases after the girl, the children form the Brave Squad and challenge Hero Theater A!

title: Fallout Zero
description:
Fallout Zero is a quest mod , complete with its own world
and backstory set two months after the outbreak of the Great War. The mod
includes several new game features: a reactive people helmet, a drivable
metro car, craftable objects, an original basic needs system (hunger, thirst).
The player is teleported to Zero world with a level 1 Character /see walkthrough video to see how to start this mod/,
an empty inventory and the possibility to choose their character’s attributes. After completing the story,
the player is ‘returned’ to the original world of Fallout 3, retaining the
level and attributes their character had possessed before starting the mod.

title: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 7 - The Lost Path
description:
The children search for clues about the missing Okada and arrive at an attraction that suddenly appears in Uropia called "Okada Castle". There, they find themselves re-experiencing attractions they had previously beaten!

As the story reaches its climax, will the children and Okada be able to escape "together"...!?

title: Project Dukkha
description:
Project Dukkha is a narrative-driven 2.5D adventure game that invites players into a richly crafted, atmospheric world.

The game emphasizes storytelling through exploration, offering a unique blend of mystery, emotion, and discovery. Players will navigate visually stunning environments, uncover hidden details, and piece together a thought-provoking story without relying on traditional dialogue or exposition.

Every aspect of the world has been designed to draw the player into its immersive atmosphere, from the meticulously crafted visuals to the subtle environmental storytelling. Project Dukkha aims to create a memorable experience by blending seamless gameplay with a deep and meaningful narrative. As you explore its enigmatic landscapes, you’ll uncover secrets, face challenges, and ultimately experience a journey that lingers in your mind long after the credits roll.

Perfect for players seeking an emotional, story-rich experience, Project Dukkha delivers a compelling adventure that resonates on both a personal and imaginative level.

title: Crusader Kings III: Khans of the Steppe
description: The winds sweep across the Great Steppe as you look over your people, preparing to ride toward the horizon in search of greener pastures, lands to conquer, and new treasures to claim. In Khans of the Steppe, the second Core Expansion for Crusader Kings III, the nomadic life takes center stage, offering a rich tapestry of new challenges and opportunities. Become — or defeat — the Great Khan as you harness the unique powers of the nomads, navigate the ever-changing Steppe Seasons, and bend the world to your will.

title: Yo, Matias 3: Cazador de Golosinas
description: The third installment in the Yo, Matías stripe cartoon videogame series. A puzzle-solving platformer where Matias collects candies and fighting enemies.

title: Yo, Matias 4: Viajero del Tiempo
description: Fourth installment of the Yo, Matías comic stripe videogame series. A side scroller platformer travelling through different time periods.

title: 10S Forever
description: 10S FOREVER is a TENNIS HELL arcade game consisting of 8 stages, ruthless boss encounters, 4 difficulty modes, 2 player local co-op. concerned with a certain CHAMPION, whose absence weighs on all our hearts. as you walk this way, remember! things can always go backwards

title: Syvnta: Sovereignty
description: A decision-making card game where you play as a king ruling a nation in the 1940s. As war breaks out in neighboring countries, you must lead wisely; swiping left or right to make choices. Your goal: keep your people safe, maintain stability, and avoid being drawn into the conflict rule for a decade.

title: Hammerhead
description: A short narrative-driven game that explores themes of isolation and nostalgia as player unravels suppressed memories through solving cryptograms.

title: Yo, Matias 6: Contra los Ciber Robots
description: Sixth installment on the Yo, Matías comic strip videogame series. A side-scroller platform ambiented on the sci-fi cibernetic world.

title: Lag Simulator
description: It really was the game's fault you lost

title: Devil May Cry 3 Crimson
description: The mod, which is only compatible with the HD Collection version and can be downloaded from Nexus Mods and GitHub, allows players to enjoy the third entry in the series with plenty of new features and enhancements, including a new HUB based on the Devil May Cry 5 interface, updated lock-on and camera options that provide a much better view of the action, local co-op with plenty of options for an optimal experience, on-the-fly style switching, which is only available officially in the Nintendo Switch release of the HD remaster and more.

title: Shake
description:
“Shake” is an action game where players control a slice of salmon and aim to reach the goal.
The game features physics-based movement, where the character easily rolls, requiring players to carefully manage jumps, balance, and positioning.

Players can use a “freshness” gauge to stick to walls and floors, helping stabilize movement. Mastering both careful control and bold decision-making is key to reaching the goal.

title: Window of Perspectives
description: Play as a contractor for a mysterious organization in a new mystery point and click. You're tasked to review tapes and complete reports about strange situations. Find clues, connect dots, choose what you want to believe and influence the world.

title: Max Axe
description:
Tired of lame-axe games? Get ready for MAX AXE! Throw axes with your finger to slay foul beasts, collect REDONKULOUS treasure and score BILLIONS of points to outrank your friends!

Max Axe blends 100% pure arcade frenzy with humor, crazy combos, and absolutely bonkers high-speed action like nothing you've ever seen before. Take on the role of Max, a Viking barbarian berserker on a quest for total destruction, massive loot and of course, princesses!

title: Starstrike
description: Starstrike is an action packed space shooter with incredibly detailed spaceship destruction.

title: Tantei ha Tsuki wo Miru
description: On the night of the full moon, a young man becomes assistant to his childhood friend, a detective. They take on guild quests, solve mysteries, and chase the phantom thief “Obrutale,” a figure both feared and admired. A mystery RPG full of story, battles, and secrets.

title: Kambayashi-ke Satsujin Jiken
description: murder mystery genre.solve the game

title: Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to Reach the Sky
description: Tokino Sora zaps into another world mid-live! Join her Hololive friends in a thrilling Metroidvania-style action-adventure, blending 2D and 3D. Explore a mysterious realm, recover scattered items, and guide Sora’s epic tale to a dazzling finale!

title: Shatter Point
description: Shatter Point is a fast, fun, and exciting first person shooter. You grapple, run, jump and slide through 20 levels.

title: Stone 4 Souls
description: Stone 4 Souls is a medieval fantasy metroidvania with RPG elements. Explore a world full of secrets and dangers while wielding powerful swords and equipping stunning visual items. Unlock new abilities and level up your character with a skill tree.

title: Noox
description: Noox is a medieval fantasy ghost investigation game. Find the correct ghost type based on the clues left behind, assemble the correct runes on your trap, and capture the spirits and expand your powers.

title: Doctor Life Simulator
description: Step into the shoes of a dedicated medical professional in Doctor Life Simulator. Experience the challenges and triumphs of running your own medical practice, from diagnosing complex illnesses to performing life-saving surgeries.

title: One's Own Exile
description: One's Own Exile is a narrative exploration game in which you must abandon your identity in order to escape across the border without being noticed.

title: Goblin Traders
description: Goblin Traders is a simple mod that adds goblins which have unique trades. Similar to Wandering Traders, goblins are found randomly underground in caves or in the nether and provide exclusive and beneficial trades that allow you to take your adventure to the next level! Goblin Traders adds two new traders, the Golbin Trader which is found in the overworld and the Vein Goblin Trader which is found in The Nether; both with their own unique set of trades. These little goblins have a little attitude and don't like it when you hit them. If you're feeling generous you can feed them their favourite food for a fun animation.

title: Jaden's Nether Expansion
description:
Jaden's Nether Expansion is a vanilla friendly mod which aims to Expand the entire Nether Dimension adding various new content and as well as overhauling existing vanilla concepts, this project is evergrowing and is constantly being updated so prepare yourself for the biggest nether mod yet.

It started out as a humble texture pack but has turned into fully fleshed out mod for Forge 1.20.1+

title: Magla
description: An action roguelike where you battle in an arena, level up, and combine Fire, Ice, and Earth to unleash devastating magic. Choose upgrade cards, craft powerful builds, and dominate the battlefield.

title: Gutterball 2
description: Get bonkers with Gutterball 2! Bigger and better than the original, Gutterball 2 takes bowling to the next level. Unlock custom bowling balls and wacky alleys as you battle your way through challenging computer oponents and performance milestones. You'll be blown away by fantastic graphics, special effects and hilarious comic relief.

title: Fungus World
description: Play as Fugus, a curious little mushroom navigating a surreal and dangerous fungal realm. Jump, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the spores. With tight controls and creative level design, Fugus World challenges your reflexes and your mind.

title: Outpost Assault
description: In Outpost Assault, you are the commander of a remote outpost under siege. Build your defense towers.

title: Ender's Delight
description:
Ender's Delight is a Farmer's Delight addon that make you able to cook delicious dishes from the amazing resources you have found in the End, such as ender pearls or chorus fruits. Or, add Endermen or Shulkers meat to your recipes to create truly extraordinary meals. With this mod, you can push the boundaries of cooking in Minecraft and discover a new gastronomic dimension. Get ready to explore the unique flavors of the End, experiment with new recipes, and amaze your friends with your culinary skills

Discover new ingredients for your favorite dishes with the new drops from End creatures! Add some sparkle to your dishes with Ender Sight (unstable Endermen eyes that produce a blinding light). Or, add a unique texture with Shulker Mollusk (a slimy creature inside the tough shell of the Shulker). And if you want something crispy, try Mite Crust (crispy but pungent Endermite skin).

title: Rinth
description:
Rinth is an old school dungeon rpg with 90s style.

Enter the dungeons and face different monsters and bosses.

Collect weapons, buy/sell and craft them to get even better ones.

title: Steel Carnelian
description: Steel Carnelian is a 3D anime-influenced shoot-em-up where you play as Cass, a mercenary with a mech suit and a loyal crew at her side. Dodge bullets and wreck robots as your ragtag team takes on the most dangerous job of your lives!

title: Pizza Tower: Scoutdigo
description:
Pizza Tower: Scoutdigo Mod is a Pizza Tower Mod that aims to add new content akin to what a possible Pizza Tower DLC would feel like.

A fully playable campaign featuring The Vigilante!
Use an entire arsenal of weapons on a quest to complete a bounty on Pizzaface in a harder, more gimmicky playthrough.
Discover new friends and foes while ravaging the tower in order to deliver justice. Will you be there, or will you be square?

title: Classic Pizza Tower Editor
description:
This little "mod" can be used to create custom Pizza Tower levels and to play levels made by others as well.

Create extremly fun levels for you and others to enjoy

title: Pizza Tower: D&LC
description:
Pizza Tower: Delicious & Luxurious Crust is a Pizza Tower DLC / Expansion mod that aims to add new content into the game while keeping it fresh and probably unique, examples:

* Brand new floors to explore, two of them you will be able to explore after floor 1 and in post-game

* Old content from previous builds are coming back, redone from the ground up as post-game content

* New playable characters that comes with their own campaign, like Doise, Mr.Stick, Dougie, etc

* New bosses to tackle and dunk, you might encounter a mimic gentleman and some hell spawn along the way

* Pizzacoins from SAGE Demo are back, kill enemies and these coins might drop occasionally

* New clothings, you might have to find a green creature to access his shop within the new floor you unlock after you beat Floor 1

* A sandbox mode, you unlock this by beating one campaign with any character, there are no limitations here, you can wear everyone's clothes as the character of choice?, check!, revisit levels with brand new challenges?, check!, you can fight Doise as Peppino without Swap Mode?, check!

* And new achievements, from the campaigns and Sandbox, good luck getting them all!

title: Pizza Tower United
description:
Pizza Tower United is an online MOD for pizza tower, sitting on the full game with all it's glory and features!
With this mod you can:
-See your friend
-Play with your friends
-Taunt with strangers
-Meet people who aren't your friends
-Hate people who aren't your friends
-And much more social related features!

In a serious note, the mod introduces a smooth multiplayer experience that sits on the complete game as a mod, it features synchronized gameplay from the beginning until the end with shared destruction, enemy elimination and most importantly pizza time escape!
So grab your friends, install the mod and escape the pizza tower as a unit

title: Dungeons and Taverns
description:
This datapacks ported as mod adds vanilla like structures that are supposed to blend in with the rest of the game and feel like they belong there. Going from environmental additions like fire watch towers and taverns to dungeons like Badlands Miner Outpost and Illager hideout. But it also overhauls some of the vanilla structures by changing their loot and how they generate.
Please note that this is a datapack Ported as a Mod and therefore doesn't add new blocks, items or mobs.

title: Take Them Down
description: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. Not a roguelike, game features handcrafted levels.

title: 3Tower
description:
In 3Tower, you are the new night watchman at a graveyard like no other.

Your job? Survive the night.

But not just any night—and not just any graveyard. You're stationed at the Three Tower Cemetery, home to the so-called "problematic dead."
Three tower with ancient technology are the only thing keeping them contained.

When the towers work, all is calm.
When they don’t... things buried long ago begin to stir.

And some of them never belonged in this world to begin with.

title: Echo Rift
description: Echo Rift is a beat-based combat game where players dance on an arena grid in their fight against the audiocratic elite to bring back music to a silenced world.

title: Syberia: Remastered
description: More than 20 years after its original release, Syberia is reborn in a fully modernized version. Rediscover its iconic locations and unforgettable characters through a stunning visual overhaul, redesigned gameplay, and the same captivating storytelling that made it a classic.

title: White Room Protocol
description: A psychological first-person horror game where you enter a memory-erasing protocol and relive a trauma. Uncover dark secrets, and experience fear through immersive atmosphere.

title: Glass Cannon
description: Challenging and chill roguelike where you plan your shots carefully and creatively eliminate enemies using different weapon combinations. Buy weapon mods to create powerful synergies and clear all 24 rounds.

title: Villages & Dungeons
description: A hardcore roguelite card game where deck-building strategies are at the core of everything! With a vast array of cards, random dungeons, a wealth of encounter events, and diverse enemies, it awaits your exploration and challenge.

title: Risk: The Official Game
description: RISK: The Official Game offers players to play the classic board game on their i-device. The game features the same rules as the board game in three different modes:

title: The New Flesh
description: Explore the strange world within the screen in this ambient exploration experience featuring the music of Red Vox.

title: Bonebuilder
description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through Bonebuilder's unique crafting and talent systems!

title: Them
description: You just want to play a video game in an old game club, but time passes quickly, and strange noises draw you into a dark nightmare! A nightmare that begins with an old video game... Are you ready to experience a 2d platformer game within the heart of a first person psychological creepy game?

title: Winter Games
description: Get ready for the most fish slinging, gnome hurling, slip sliding Winter Games you've ever seen! From launching gnomes from a catapult to sliding down a treacherous ice-run, theses games are more fun than anything you'll ever see in the Winter Olympics.

title: Cast & Spell
description: Cast & Spell is an action-packed multiplayer game where wizards battle using elemental magic. Fight in PvP duels or team up with friends in co-op modes to defeat monsters. Master different elements and enjoy intense, strategic combat across various game modes.

title: EverSiege: Untold Ages
description: Liberate Bastion, humanity’s last refuge. Defend against evil hordes, reclaim lost powers, rebuild ancient ruins, and adapt your tactics to break the everSiege. A top-down action-strategy rogue-lite where choices shape every run, playable solo or up to 3 players in co-op.

title: Light Dude
description: The level hides when you move in this skill-driven tactical action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill.

title: Slaughter Void
description: Slaughter Void is a heavy metal dark fantasy slasher where hesitation is death. Chain kills, keep your momentum, shape your build, and slaughter your way into the Void.

title: Sunken Memories
description:
After a weird incident happened to you and your spaceship, you end up stranded on a submerged planet with nothing but your trusty sub.

What kind of mysteries are hidden on this planet, and what kind of dangers will you encounter?

Will you find your way back home? Find out by playing Sunken Memories.

title: Blungo's Dungeon Luncheon
description: Blungo's Dungeon Luncheon is a bite-sized, fast-paced, action-packed dungeon crawler about killing for money and getting food.

title: Hardstrike: The Fall
description: Hardstrike: The Fall is a first-person shooter that puts you on the front lines of a growing global crisis. Set in a world similar to our own, extremist violence is surging, and you're tasked with stopping it.

title: Suborbital Salvage
description: Fly through a dangerous, hazard-filled orbit where every run is a lesson that sharpens your flight skills. Featuring procedurally generated runs built from hand-crafted segments that demand precision piloting to outpace a persistent space predator.

title: Wirelight
description: A tiny turn-based tactical... soulslike! Explore a twisty, interconnected world, battle enemies using a unique spin on a 'posture' system, and employ different combinations of upgrades to your advantage.

title: P.A.C.K.: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit
description: Step into the wheels of a robot in this sci-fi cleaning adventure set after the apocalypse. Wash, vacuum, repair and clear debris from abandoned structures while learning about the ultimate fate of mankind, alone or with friends.

title: Taryn Barker: Demon Hunter
description: Taryn Barker: Demon Hunter is an action-adventure game where you step into the shoes of Taryn, a skilled warrior with a dark past. You’ll fight your way through hordes of demonic creatures, solve puzzles, and explore dark, atmospheric environments reminiscent of classic survival horror and sword fighting games. Armed with a katana, twin blades, and a crossbow, you’ll face increasingly tough enemies as you uncover the mysteries behind the demonic invasion.

title: Sunset Drive
description: Sunset Drive is a narrative road trip game about two people, one car, and the quiet moments that shape a day and a relationship. Talk, take meaningful detours, and uncover what’s been left unsaid. Some things are easy to miss, others stay with you.

title: Baionlenja
description: Baionlenja is a first-person metroidvania with an extreme movement focus. Explore the vast and interconnected research facility, where a mysterious fossil grants you unimaginable power and mobility. B-hop, rocket jump and air strafe to uncover the secrets of the Baionlenja corporation.

title: Car Park Capital
description: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

title: Richat Structure
description: Strategic excavation simulator. Dig deep into the mysterious Earth's bullseye, build underground bases and study anomalous finds. The deeper your miners advance, the more questions this geo-phenomenon raises. Will you be able to unearth the true nature of the Richat Structure?

title: Don't Look Behind
description: "Don't Look Behind" is a first-person psychological horror game , You will experience surprises you have never experienced before.

title: Red Blaster
description: Blast your way through increasing waves of enemies in this fast-paced top-down action-arcade shoot 'em-up while unlocking new levels, weapon upgrades and harder enemy types as you make progress in RED BLASTER!

title: Age of Dark
description: 《Age of Dark》is a turn-based strategy RPG. Players must: (1) Command their team, utilizing all available skills to battle powerful enemies; (2) Explore the map, gather resources and equipment to strengthen their squad. The initial release includes approximately 3 hours of main story content.

title: Pawsky
description: Welcome to a whimsical animal adventure in which your choices shape the story and the world reacts to your actions!

title: Seraphonin
description: A dark fantasy precision platformer set in a broken world ravaged by hunger and immortality.

title: Synthetic Dreams: Falling
description: Synthetic Dreams: Falling is a science-fiction visual novel about human feelings, friendship, love and memories.

title: Legendary Class Blind Date
description: 500 days before the college exam, 5 boys and 5 girls from rival schools meet at an amusement park for a fateful group date. Choose your character, go on 1:1 dates, make smart choices, and avoid rivals to win your first love. 52 possible endings. Can you find your happy one?

title: Conservation Concentration
description: Conservation Concentration The dynamic memory-matching card game featuring multiple boards, diverse regions, collectibles, and timed challenges. Perfect for players with a completionist mindset, it offers endless fun and strategic gameplay as you race to conquer every level!

title: Room Football: Sand Storm
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Drive and Unwind
description: Drive And Unwind — Your Gentle Companion for Work and Study Drive And Unwind is a light and soothing tool featuring 2D parallax backgrounds, vehicle and weather options, five music genres, and a Pomodoro timer — perfect for relaxing during work or study.

title: SimShock2025
description: SimShock2025 is a free, bilingual (EN/ES) hemodynamic shock simulator. Treat cardiogenic, hemorrhagic, and septic shock using real drugs and interventions. Written in PureBasic, available for Mac and Windows. Apple-signed and notarized.

title: Trade Tycoon Life Simulator
description: Manage your shop in the city with Trade Tycoon Life Simulator, negotiate to buy and sell materials. Participate in warehouse battles, upgrade your shop, and explore different activities. Build your strategy to reach the top of the trade world!

title: Rope Raider
description: Climb Your way up with only one button, one grapple and one man. In this precision-based rope-swinging platformer

title: Fishing Shop Simulator
description: A post apocalypse world where you catch fish to sell and collect in your shop! As you rebuild your shop - a town begins rebuilding around you and more types of customers begin showing up. Explore the ruins of the 'Old world' and find new fishing spots to get bigger and better catches!

title: Frostbound
description: FrostBound is a roguelike tower defense card game set in an endless, frozen winter. Take command as you build your garrison, explore the snowy wilderness, gather vital resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies.

title: Dress-Up With Helene
description:
Helene Marylin becomes your dress-up doll in this fun little Dress-up game!
Mix and match with over 120 different articles of clothing and accessories!

title: Pokemon Gamma Emerald
description: In Pokémon Gamma Emerald, on your way to your new home your trip takes an unexpected turn when a sudden storm appears and your boat crashes on a mysterious, uncharted island situated between the Hoenn and Sinnoh region. With no way to call for help or outside contact, you are forced to explore- but you are not alone.

title: Chamber X
description:
"CHAMBER X" is a gripping puzzle-based horror mystery game where every locked door holds a secret waiting to be uncovered.
As you navigate through eerie rooms and solve intricate puzzles, you'll uncover dark truths and hidden clues to escape an ever-tightening grip of danger.
Time is running out, and the only way to survive is to solve the riddles and escape before the walls close in.

title: WasteFlow
description: A super mega giga cool turtle told our turtle, named Crushy, that he's not cool so our turtle was sad and wanted to become cool and have flow. He met a little goldfish who told him that in an Australian current he could have starfish to build his flow. He went to the current, but this stream was completely polluted with a lot of waste (and even a shark made of waste) and the starfish needed to create her style were all among this waste. So, he had to cross this current to collect as many starfish as possible. With all these starfish, he will become the turtle with the most flow.

title: Dog Witch
description: Dog Witch is a roguelike deckbuilder where your spells are fueled by enchanted dice. Combine over 150 unique items to forge ever-evolving strategies, perfect synergy combos, summon minions, and tackle an endless range of bizarre foes.

title: The Walls of Jericho
description: The Walls of Jericho is a challenging move and match game inspired by an epic tale of faith and preservation. Your faithful followers won't stay around forever, unless you can solve the puzzle, activate powerful combos and bring down the walls!

title: Quiz & Learn: Geography
description: A family-friendly, relaxing multiple-choice quiz about geography that includes photo rounds with interesting facts

title: Robot Unlock
description: Robot Unlock is an open-ended puzzle game with 75+ levels. Design your own solutions and optimize them for speed, instructions or space and compare with other players. Create your own levels, challenge other players and solve community made ones.

title: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

title: Holder of Place
description: Holder of Place is a Roguelike Auto-Battler Card game. Recruit different follower cards, arrange them, watch them fight ever-stronger enemies. Along the way, unfold a dark science-fantasy tale of a ruined kingdom, meet strange characters, and visit exotic locations.

title: Ferra
description: Ferra is a high-octane FPS slasher set in 2055 Japan. Unleash the kitsune’s fury: swap between a lethal arsenal of firearms and primal beast power. Wall-run, shred PMC mercenaries, and turn your revenge into a stylized bloody dance amidst neon lights and living myths

title: Tetrenga
description: Stack wobbly tetrominoes! Spawn crazy heavy shapes! The most weight wins!

title: Knight's Tail: Tactics
description: Prototype Procedural Tactical RPG

title: Scrabble
description: Enjoy the classic word-spelling game with your friends either locally or online, and add computer opponents of varying difficulties to make things interesting. When you’re up to it, compete against players of your skill level around the world in a variety of exciting multiplayer modes. Rank up, win, and challenge others as well as yourself—it’s Scrabble like you’ve never seen before!

title: Portal Bagley: Aperture Remote Terminal
description:
Are you an Aperture Science employee?
Then you NEED this program!

Whether you just want to chat with your colleagues via our secure messaging, control testing rooms remotely, fill out our forms to earn rewards or even store your files* in Aperture Science's massive database!

title: Wordbound
description: Wordbound is a mixed reality puzzle game where the world is made of words. Take a journey to unscramble the world, solve daily challenges, and craft your own puzzles to share with friends!

title: Sticky Business: Book of Shadows
description: Add a little magic to your sticker shop with the Book of Shadows DLC! Craft enchanted stickers, explore witchy new stories, and charm your customers with mystical goodies in this cozy, spellbinding expansion. The coven is waiting!

title: Lakria Legends
description:
Aeons ago, before planets and worlds came to be in the fabric of time, Goddess Gaea the creator of Life and Rebirth, created six mystical elements which made the foundation of a world. Nature, Fire, Water, Earth, Light, and Shadow, these elements coalesced to form planets full of life and energy.

The world you live in is known as Lakria, a planet blooming with lush life and full of wonderful mysteries and legends. Many inhabitants of the world often give praise and thanks to Gaea for bestowing them such a life to live.

Until one day, the energy of the Lakria appears to be waning and the planet slowly begins to start dying. Everyone is in shock and is wondering what might be causing the planet's pain, they began to look up at the sky to Gaea for a miracle, hoping she will once again visit the planet and bless it with rebirth.

title: Dreamwalker: Dream A Little Dream Act I
description: It begins in the world of Yaweth, a peaceful world combined massive lands and small oceans. We look upon the two rivalling nations, Kindred and Courtwood, both north and south of another.

title: Beauty Salon Simulator VR
description: Step into the ultimate virtual beauty salon experience! Transform your clients with a variety of makeup, pedicure tools, extensions, accessories and outfits in this creative and relaxing simulation sandbox. Customize every detail of their look, snap stunning photos, and let your imagination shine!

title: Everlusting Life
description: Everlusting Life — classic auto-chess game set in a fantasy world. Assemble a squad of beautiful girls to aid you on your quest to save the magical realm. Triumph in battles with strategy and win hearts with undeniable charm!

title: Happy Treasure King
description: Dear players, monsters don't spawn automatically. Use ‘C’ to switch to overhead view and press start to spawn them. Use keypad 1, 2, 3 to select towers, W, A, S, D to move in both perspectives，a thrilling experience!!!

title: The Golden Retreat
description: You work in a hotel and your shift is over but instead of heading home, you find yourself in an endless loop. Your only chance to decrease a floor is to identify anomalies and choose the correct elevator to escape.

title: Dead Tapes: Fading Father
description: Fading father is a man consumed by addiction and memories

title: Afterglow: The Fifth Ending
description: A Memory Maze Spanning Life and Death: A Tender Web of Salvation and Deception Follow protagonist Ye Yuyao into the Tai Xu. Through fragmented memories and relentless inquiry, unravel the hidden truth behind an anonymous organ donor in this haunting interplay of light and shadow.

title: Lobotomy
description: James, a freelance journalist, breaks into the notorious "Lobotomy" asylum to expose decades of brutal experiments. Armed with a camera and flashlight, he must navigate the suffocating darkness. Record the truth, survive the shadows, and escape before the asylums dark history claims you next.

title: Night Grip
description: An arm wrestling game with mechanics based on precision and endurance. Manage your sanity, face escalating challenges, and uncover the limits of reality in a routine that never seems to end.

title: Get 0ut
description: A puzzle-solving horror game about a broken father with an unknown past who finds himself in a never-ending cycle, trying to find the answers to his old life, guided by an unknown hand.

title: Tormenta: O Desafio dos Deuses
description: Accept the challenge! Gatzvalith, the Lord of the Storm, has kidnapped the powerful mage Niala and intends to sacrifice her in an unholy ritual. His goal: to spread the Storm across Arton, engulfing the continent in the Crimson Tempest. It is already too late to stop the ritual. But two heroes lost in the history of the world may still arrive in time! The Challenge of the Gods is a computer game set in the universe of Storm. Play as Samson, a human barbarian/rogue, or Sellena, an elf mage/cleric, and explore great moments in the history of Arton, such as the battle of Fort Amarid, the fall of Lenórienn and the march of the Kishin of Master Arsenal!

title: The Cave Diver
description: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

title: Dwarf Campaign
description: A fully voice acted single-player custom campaign for Warcraft III that sends the dwarves of Khaz Modan on a quest to explore the unknown, in hopes of saving their ancestral homeland. The lengthy campaign has three missions where you can choose to play from four difficulty settings and also features custom monsters, scripted events, music and spells. As an added bonus, the stand-alone version of Chapter 3 supports a two-player mode.

title: Ultraleak
description: ULTRALEAK is an ULTRAKILL fan game made as an April Fools joke pretending to be a leaked version of ULTRAKILL. Despite it claiming to be a leaked build of ULTRAKILL, it is actually it's own entire separate game.

title: Sea of Remnants
description: Sea of Remnants is an original ocean adventure RPG developed by Joker Studio. Your journey begins as a puppetfolk sailor who has lost their memory. Alongside a mysterious girl, you’ll set sail on a chaotic and colorful voyage—one filled with treasure, conflict, dreams, and unexpected companions. As the seas stretch endlessly before you, an epic world of myth and history slowly unfolds. But beware, Captain: fall overboard, and your mind may be swallowed by the very thing this ocean was named for—forgetting.

title: Time Space Rebuild
description: In "Time Rebuild", human civilization stands on the brink of destruction. You will become a time-traveling hero, embarking on a journey to save the world while encountering and bonding with women of vastly different appearances and personalities.

title: Omanah
description: Myst-Like 3D free exploration game

title: Epic Zen Garden
description:
Tap to navigate this interactive oasis brimming unmatched detail on mobile.
Swipe the Sakura tree to make thousands of cherry blossoms swirl in the air, graze the koi pond to summon leagues of fish, and rake the sand with your finger to create subtle designs.

title: The Shift
description: The Shift is a first-person 3D psychological horror game where you play as a night shift cashier in an isolated gas station, performing routine tasks while uncovering disturbing, unexplained events.

title: Retro Adventurer
description: Retro Adventurer is an action-packed 2D platformer where you take on the role of Retro, a fearless explorer on a quest to conquer treacherous landscapes and reach the finish line. Wishlist now and get ready to embark on an epic adventure!

title: Booze Shop Simulator
description: Run your own liquor shop and build your business from the ground up. Stock your shelves with a variety of alcoholic drinks, cigarettes, and other daily essentials. Set your own prices, manage payments. Expand and customize your shop, unlock new items as your business grows.

title: Oil Refinery: The Simulation
description: Operate a fully functional oil refinery! Control distillation, manage pipelines, refine fuels, maintain machinery, and optimize production.

title: Zelda Again: Link Is Adventuresome
description: Zelda Again: Link Is Adventuresome is a fan made remaster of Zelda II: The Adventure of Link with the intent to add more content to the game. This remaster ports the classic NES sequel to the first The Legend of Zelda but includes several new minor gameplay tweaks and features such as tons of quality of life improvements, widescreen, new areas on the overworld to explore, new collectibles and upgrades, revamped dungeon and overworld layouts and a brand new post game quest and final boss featured only in the game's new game plus mode, the 2nd Quest.

title: The Soul Stone War 3
description: By the power of your Soul Stone and the strength of your own indomitable soul, uncover secrets held in blood and lead the charge that will change the world. A text-based fantasy novel, 260,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

title: X-Wing Revival
description:
X-Wing Revival is a fan project to create a multiplayer combat space flight sim in the style of the classic Star Wars X-Wing games, built from scratch in C++ to be compatible with modern PCs and internet play.

Basically: 90's style combat flight sim, mid 2000's graphics, built from the ground up to run on modern PCs.

title: How to Open a Locked Chest
description: Can you open the un-openable?

title: Weed Shop Simulator
description: Weed Shop Simulator launches in Early Access! Build your cannabis empire from seed to sale. Grow rare strains, craft legendary products, hire your team, and outsmart rivals in a chaotic world full of wild adventures and deep cannabis culture. Your empire awaits!

title: Brainrot Tung Tung Sahur
description: Made by memes. Powered by chaos. Your brain left the chat.

title: Final Zone
description: Memory of the God of War… In the future of the 2000's, war is no longer fought with missiles weapons or nuclear bombs. With the high technology of military satellite, enable to monitor any large scaled forces....

title: Deja View: A Spot the Difference Game
description: Dive into surreal worlds in Deja View, a relaxing yet challenging spot-the-difference puzzle game. Explore 16 hand-drawn, mind-bending illustrations, each split into two intricate halves. Earn hints, unlock achievements, and immerse yourself in an enchanting soundtrack along your journey.

title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother: Online Battle Royale
description: This game has everything you could wish for in an online game, Battle Pass? Yes! Live Service? Yes again! Dating dead grandmothers with your friends online? YES BABY!!!!

title: Rumbly
description: Rumbly is a fast-paced turn-based roguelike battle game that focuses on speed and accuracy!!

title: Starbright Agency
description:
In the neon-lit streets of Neo Seattle, being a hero isn’t just a calling — it’s a high-stakes industry. Unranked and overlooked, Star Scout Wishbright would do anything to get her big break until her agency proposes a bold plan: Fake a high-profile romance with one of the city’s top-ranked Scouts to skyrocket her to success.

Staged dates, exciting twists and turns. It’s all for show — until the spotlight reveals truths Wishbright could never expect.

Neo Seattle’s finest, not unlike the city itself, are full of secrets. Secrets hidden in their civilian lives — where the masks come off and identities are not just for show. Can Wishbright navigate the act and the actual without losing herself?

In the end, will she choose fame, love, or something gray in between? Set against a glittering City-Pop inspired backdrop this queer friendly visual novel puts you in control of Wishbright’s journey through love and heartbreak, fame and failure.

Will you rise to the top? Or will you realize that some dreams aren’t worth losing yourself over.

title: One Hour With Mr. Hopp
description: A spin-off of Mr. Hopp's Playhouse that was available exclusively to the Patreon supporters of Moonbit Studios.

title: Cell Sword
description:
It is the future. Video games are dead.

War has left the world polluted with microscopic autonomous robots. These drones enter the bloodstream and consume the organs and life-force of their host.

This deadly disease is known as RUST.

Instead of games, players are hired by the rich to remotely pilot fast nano ships to blast the Rust.

These guns-for-hire are called Cell Swords.

title: Mr. Hopp's Hunting Hour
description: Mr. Hopp, a creepy rabbit doll that has come to life, is trying to get inside the house! Check all doors, windows and vents to make sure he can't find any way in. Avoid the toys on the floor, the sound draws him in.

title: Pigmalion's Angel
description: In the game, you date an angel and need to increase your love bar with her and give her gifts and find some way to unlock the door at the end of the hallway.

title: Mukogawa
description: The Takeuchi family have been the ones at charge of preserving the mysterious house, Mukogawa, for decades. The eldest son of each generation is chosen to take care of the house. But due to an accident, Takato Takeuchi is unable to fulfill his duty, so Chiyo, Takato's younger sister, must take charge of the Mukogawa House.

title: Kid Kharagma
description: KID KHARAGMA is a turn-based adventure RPG set in a charmingly outlandish apocalypse! Lead a band of unwieldy young heroes, uncover strange powers, encounter cosmic entities, and befriend unforgettable characters.

title: Bogey's Report
description: well, sometimes things just don't come out as you'd like. i'm sorry ma. i'm sorry da. i'm sorry sam. i'm sorry bogey. sorry. sorry. sorry.

title: Operative Assailants
description: I forgot the ess

title: Helldivers 2: Heart of Democracy
description: Helldivers, the Illuminate have reached the Heart of Democracy. Our Mega Cities are under siege. Liberty now hangs in the balance. The Ministry of Defense has authorized arsenal upgrades and placed SEAF soldiers on active duty. Today, we fight for the future of Super Earth!

title: Lasagna Boy Classic
description: A puzzle horror game with a gameboy aesthetic.

title: Mystic Cleaver
description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive. The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action. Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

title: WarSpawn
description: WarSpawn is a multiplayer action PvP game inspired by old-school PvP classics such as Rakion Online and Infinity Online. Slash, stab, grab, blast, and launch your way to victory using various weapons with no timegates or pay-to-win, just dive right into the action and have fun!

title: Dumbass Survivors
description: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Dumbass Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against hundreds of monsters. Except you're stuck babysitting the guy who thinks he's the hero.

title: Morse vs. Horse
description: Deliver messages between ancient cities in morse code, in a battle against horses, cars, trains... and more! Start out by learning letters, then build up your skills until you can write full sentences, with numbers and punctuation. Officially self-approved best game in history.

title: MidnightNears
description: A turn-based role-playing game. You’ll have to fend off beasts, mutated fish, and even bandits, surviving in turn-based combat with a "distance" mechanic, and using precious resources to craft tools or barter for supplies.

title: Aggi's Tiny Friends
description: Join Aggi and dive into a world that lies just out of sight. Customize your own cell and see it thrive in a vibrant ecosystem. Discover a wide variety of organisms like you've never seen before. And learn real science in a playful and relaxed environment.

title: The Bleakest Keep
description: The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!

title: The Last Visit: 98th
description: "The Last Visit: 98th" is a psychological indie horror from the first person, in the genre of a walking simulator, in the setting of the post-Soviet winter space. The main focus is on the atmosphere of horror, which is emphasized by realistic 3D graphics.

title: Berenice: Videogame
description: Driven by love, he ventures through the palace's metaphorical labyrinths - where absurd architecture of endless halls, bridges and arches resonates with his beloved Berenice's haunting, distant song.

title: Witchy Wonderland
description: Witchy Wonderland is a thrilling horror-park simulator where you're not just building attractions—you're crafting nightmares.

title: Deep Sea Arena
description: Dive into Deep Sea Arena, an intense underwater arena shooter where deadly creatures emerge from the abyss. Battle relentless waves of deep-sea horrors, dodge ambushes, and fight to stay alive. How long can you survive the depths?

title: The Cursed Underground Parking Lot
description: After finishing work, the protagonist heads to the underground parking lot to retrieve their car. For some reason, their car is nowhere to be found, and as they search, strange events unfold one after another...

title: Terrors to Unveil: Intrusion
description: David Hopster, a 15-year-old high school student, has just been left home alone for the weekend while his parents head out of town. At first, everything seemed normal. He had no idea how quickly things would spiral.

title: Dream Eaters.exe
description: Trapped in a secret sleep experiment, you and your friends must survive terrifying nightmares, completing tasks to wake up before it's too late. Play solo or in co-op, but beware—the experiments are never the same, and something watches from the dark.

title: Electronic Shop Simulator
description:
Electronic Shop Simulator is a business simulation game where you establish and manage your own electronics store. Increase customer satisfaction, maximize your profits, and expand your store by offering phones, laptops, and accessories for sale. You have complete control over everything from stand placement to product pricing!

Packed with detailed systems like crypto investments, billboards, and evolving store management over time, this experience offers ideal gameplay for both strategy and simulation enthusiasts.

title: Word Scores
description: A casual strategy word game. Spell words, score points, and avoid filling up the board. Enjoy the satisfying and relaxing game play.

title: Hollowroot
description: Hollowroot, a fast-paced 2D action roguelike. Master tight platforming and combat in ever-changing, procedurally generated levels. Every run is a new challenge. Can you survive?

title: The Attack on Egg Harbor
description: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up roguelike built on a real-time strategy framework. Battle to obtain eggs, upgrade your base and gear, and ultimately repel all invaders to destroy the enemy base and win.

title: Smoke Break!
description: Smoke Break! is a lighthearted 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood — a living puff of smoke. By breaking machinery, dashing past bakers, and using smoke to grow, you can hunt down the ultimate, yet elusive, burnt pie!

title: Immortal Magus
description: Immortal Magus is a throwback to old 'artillery' games such as Scorched Earth or Pocket Tanks, but in a fantasy setting. In a simple mixture of turn-based and real-time strategy, defeat your enemy by hurling spells and summoning Units in destructible environments.

title: Space Bar
description: Space Bar is a short psychological horror experience where simply pressing one key slowly reveals that something inside the game is trying to communicate with you.

title: Light of Reversing Destiny
description: "Light of Reversing Destiny" is a live - action interactive movie game, skillfully blending role - playing and plot choices. Players follow the protagonist's perspective throughout, immerse in the ups - and - downs of the story, with interspersed mini - games bringing a new interactive feel.

title: Operation: Surface Takeover
description: A pixelated 2.5D RTS meets tower defense as you battle mutated ants in a short campaign. Build walls, place turrets, and hold the line to reclaim Earth's surface in this tactical fight for survival where placement of everything matters.

title: Atama Ikuto
description:
Ikuto has always been able to see things that others cannot, but over time the visions became worse. Glimpses into the horrors of this world made him unable to live a normal life, and so he left behind his family to follow the visions. The crows have led him to Akikawacho, but what awaits him inside?

In this short prequel to Atama set in 1883, you look through the eyes of those around you to explore the village of Akikawacho and avoid being spotted by the monsters that lurk there.

title: Revella
description: An emotional pixel art RPG where forgotten memories shape your fate. Explore mysteries, meet unique NPCs, and confront sanity-breaking foes.

title: The Paper Loop
description:
Welcome to the Spider Nature Research Laboratory. We are doing really crazy stuff with spiders here! Today is a very important day!

Play as a person, caught in a time loop, exactly 10 minutes before the incident. Find a way to break the loop. Every action can affect future events.

title: Abodtion
description:
The incedenst require you to move out.

Let's start unpacking stuff and cozy up our new abode!

title: Finding Alex
description: Zoe just came back home after a year of boarding school. However, his best friend is missing... Please help Zoe figure out what is happening through this puzzle game.

title: Barnicle
description: A very short RPG Maker game about a girl named Barni. She struggles to go to class, so you have to help her through her morning.

title: KoboldKare
description: KoboldKare is a multiplayer farming simulator, but instead of making produce you're making Kobolds! It's an FPS where there is bhopping, surfing, trimping, and also intimate activities.

title: Fuck Paper Scissors
description: Is it online? Yes. Does it have sex? Yes. Is it Rock Paper Scissors? YES! Collect all the abilities and girls to defeat your opponent in a sexual Player Versus Player!

title: Time Assassin
description: Become a nimble shadow ninja and experience the thrill of assassinating enemies at lightning speed!

title: Mind Within
description: A psychological adventure where memory and fear collide. Explore the mind's darkest corners, solve surreal puzzles, and uncover the truth within.

title: The Office Killer
description: The Office Killer is a 1-3 player online co-op survival horror game. As a spy, your main goal is to complete the file transfer process containing the office's secrets while monitoring live surveillance camera footage. Can you survive the entire night or will you get caught by the killer?

title: Synthwave Driver
description: A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.

title: Kaire
description: A third-person game where you press switches, open doors, and interact with objects to clear a single stage. Developed in Unreal Engine 5, it features a coastal environment with cliffs and vertical terrain. As you walk on the sand or shoreline, waves react and footprints appear.

title: Blob's Adventure
description:
Blob is a spherical space traveller. He has only got one eye, which is perhaps why he has crashed his space ship on Blobland - oh no! Blob must find a new rocket to escape... before the Alienblobs catch him!

Blob's Adventure is a tilting maze / labyrinth puzzle game. The game takes you through grassy, rocky, and icy terrains, using pick ups and physics to progress through each level. A "Mario-esque" combination of arcade platform mechanics and puzzle elements.

title: Dodge the Creeps
description: Dodge the Creeps is a fast-paced arcade survival game where your reflexes are your only defense. Control your character using the arrow keys to evade relentless waves of creeps emerging from all sides of the screen.

title: Berty the Giraffe
description: Step into the Shoes of Berty the Giraffe in this 2D Top-Down Dungeon Crawler

title: Battle
description: "B.A.T.T.L.E. is a high-action single-player FPS with realistic gunplay, intense combat, and stunning graphics. Master 64 unique weapons, customize them with 240 skins, and fight against enemies in immersive war zones."

title: Good Luck Crossing
description: A brutal, unforgiving parkour experience with no checkpoints, no second chances, and no hand-holding. Every jump matters. Every slip sends you back to the start. Not for the faint of heart it's rage-inducing, soul-crushing, and almost unfair

title: Strange Shores: Social Desktop Fishing
description: Strange Shores is a 1-4 player online fishing game you play from the corner of your desktop. Catch over 100 fish and unusual items, share catches, send emotes, and unlock new locations. Work, study, chat, watch... FISH!

title: Revolvermen
description: Revolvermen is a local PVP partygame where up to 4 players battle in the wild west. The goal is simple, get to high ground & shoot players below to climb the scoreboard. Aside from your standard revolver, you can also pick up different power-ups in the world to rain hellfire from above!

title: Fruit Wars
description: Fruit Wars is a chaotic multiplayer puzzle game where players throw fruits to create matches and score points! Outplay opponents by landing combos, blocking shots, or stealing points. Aim, throw and match to become the true Fruit Chef.

title: Space Bubbles Must Die!
description: Space Bubbles Must Die! is a tiny, highly-addictive bubble-shooter where you eliminate evil space bubbles to save the planet. Inspired by the classic titles like Peggle, Arkanoid and Space Invaders.

title: Seeking the Guardian
description: 「Seeking The Guardian」is a puzzle adventure game filled with puzzles and “impossible” puzzles. Within the stone cave engraved with legends of the Guardian, read the murals, solve the puzzles, and search for the exit.

title: Carnival Happy Day
description: ( Carnival Happy Day ) This is a casual and Joyous carnival game, There are 18 different game stages in the game! And there will be 5 different ways to play in each game stage! There are 90 ways to play in total.

title: SphereCore Survival
description: A top-down survival action game where you shoot, dodge, and upgrade to survive endless waves of deadly spheres.

title: Endless Robot Dash
description: "Endless Robot Dash" is a fresh and fast-paced endless runner game.

title: Elliot's Show Time
description: Help Elliot light up the stage in a rhythmic adventure featuring 10 original songs.

title: Wumball
description: Wumball is a challenging adventure game. You have no health and no weapons to defend yourself, so tread lightly. Can you make it to the end and save the king?

title: Digital Desktop Cats
description: A cute virtual cat (or two... or three) that lives on your desktop. Feed them, play with them, and enjoy their company while you use your computer.

title: Goddess Scroll: The Last Starlight
description: A short ARPG game of the Tower of Demons genre, You are playing the savior of the goddess world - the Valkyrie Akashii, You need to plan and manage the collected resources, strategically engage in battles, and use various keys, In addition, there are 7 imprisoned goddesses waiting for your rescue

title: Slaughtra
description: Slaughtra is a arcade styled top-down horde shooter where you face off against an ever growing onslaught of enemies seeking nothing but to end you. Fight your way through and maybe somehow you'll find your way out of this nightmare...

title: Decaying Memories
description: Spot the difference in the 3 given photos and survive for six minutes! Take too long to spot enough discrepancies and you lose to the fear meter!

title: Whispers of Wings Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Soar into "Whispers of Wings Jigsaw Puzzles"! Piece together stunning scenes of hawks, owls, and songbirds in vibrant habitats. Unlock bird facts and enjoy customizable puzzles. A delightful avian escape!

title: Wildrise
description: Join Floofi, the forest guardian, on a mission to restore nature's splendor. Match colorful flora and fauna in this charming puzzle adventure to transform barren lands into flourishing wilderness. Will you help Floofi bring the world back to life?

title: Holiday in Europe: Czech Adventure - Collector's Edition
description: Explore Prague and beyond with the Collins family! Solve hidden object challenges, brain teasers, and uncover secrets in stunning locations!

title: Seaquest Find the Difference
description: Dive into the underwater world and find all the differences!Embark on an amazing adventure in the depths of the ocean! In this exciting game, 80 levels await you with images of marine animals—from graceful dolphins to formidable sharks, colorful fish, and other sea creatures.

title: What Could Go Wrong?
description: A one-staff shoestring budget bio-lab management simulation game

title: Restorart: Horizon Bay Collector's Edition
description: Restore damaged masterpieces and uncover hidden stories in the enchanting seaside town of Horizon Bay!

title: Rogue Ninjas
description: In Rogue Ninjas, survival demands cunning and precision. Manage a squad of elite ninjas through twisting dungeons, strengthen your inventory with rare enhancers, and battle ruthless bosses in this dice-driven roguelike adventure.

title: The Piano That Staying Time
description: “Can you play the piano?” Summer vacation starts soon. However, she says that she has rented out the entire music room during the vacation, and instead of postponing the lesson, she proposes one condition.. A full-voices visual novel with a theme of memories with emotional music.

title: Aris
description: Strategically clear your way of enemies to gather points, salvage killed enemies for extra points, all while avoiding and engaging in combat with other different types of enemies. Added effects and game mechanics make for challenging gameplay in a fast paced environment.

title: The Falling Star
description: The Falling Star is a first-person exploration and narrative-driven walking simulator. Following the mother's last wish, the girl embarks on a journey in a dream to uncover the story of her missing aunt's past.

title: Therapy Simulator
description: Step into the chair of a therapist in Therapy Simulator! Guide your patients through emotional journeys with branching dialogue choices. Balance humor, humanity, and the chaos of therapy!

title: Highway to Heal
description: Highway to Heal is a top-down arcade driving adventure game set in an open world solarpunk city. You play as Jakub & Mishra, a paramedic duo, on duty to rescue locals while facing traffic and big weather events. The goal is to bring the patient safe and sound as fast as possible.

title: Steal The Pig
description: STEAL THE PIG — a cooperative platformer where you play as two thieves trying to steal a pig. Be careful, because this pig isn’t one who enjoys traveling! Try not to wake it up or let it escape! Get ready for tons of fun, unexpected situations, and a real test of teamwork.

title: Zoom: Paparazzi in Action
description: Zoom: Paparazzi in Action is a first-person photography game where players act as paparazzi capturing VIPs in compromising moments across 15 levels. Photos earn money, but bodyguards and rival photographers pose obstacles. Players can temporarily blind pursuers with the camera flash and must reach a set income to complete each mission. Levels are scripted, allowing players to memorize events, with optional humorous interactions throughout.

title: Yesterday's Crossroads
description: Yesterday's Crossroads is a choice-driven adult visual novel where every option leads to different outcomes. Meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own personal struggles, and shape their stories along with your own.

title: Vampirates
description:
Vampirates is a wave-based co-op brawler set in a tavern under siege, where the only way to survive is to feed zombies to a terrifying, flying Otter God.

Play as chaotic vampirates in a crumbling tavern overflowing with zombies, weapons, and very questionable decisions. Fling enemies or friends, into the fray using anything you can grab. Yes, literally anything. Rubber Chicken? Check. Barstool? Obviously. Kevin? Especially Kevin.

Slap your way through waves of undead while desperately trying to appease a bloodthirsty otter god who’s watching your every move. You’ll fight. You’ll feed. You’ll probably die. Horribly.

The tavern’s in “otter” chaos, the Otter God is starving, and your squad is screaming in proximity chat. This is fine.

title: Spin Royale
description: Spin Royale is a bottom-of-screen idle game where your slot machine spins and earns money automatically. Collect rare symbols, upgrade powerful items, and climb the global leaderboard in this endless progression experience!

title: Shuttlecock-H
description: Survive challenging bullet hell stages and enjoy the rewards of your cute companions!

title: Rumbral
description: Rumbral is a dark, puzzle platformer set in a seemingly forgotten world. Find your way in this desolated place while trying to recover your memories and find out who you really are.

title: Transport Fever 3
description: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

title: Critical Shift
description: Critical Shift is a hardcore turn-based tactical game with RPG elements and a profound dramatic story. An atmospheric sci-fi mystery imbued with the unknown and featuring the strangest objects awaits you! Every enemy here is a lethal threat, and resources are worth their weight in gold.

title: Shuten Order
description:
"168 remaining until the end of the world..."

Humanity is approaching its end. A sudden dismemberment murder of the leader of a religious nation that advocates an apocalyptic ideology... Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

title: Castle of Heart: Retold
description: Introducing Castle of Heart: Retold, a completely reworked version of the challenging action platformer that had been exclusive to the Nintendo Switch. The tweaks include rewritten dialog, reworked cutscenes, remixed music, graphics and animation changes, improved gameplay and UI, changed endings, and more.

title: Megadeka
description: At some point, the giant “Her” began living in this country. She crushes parts of the city beneath her feet and shakes the earth with her breathing. We must defend the city from Her. MEGADEKA is a simulation game where you defend your base from a giant woman.

title: Atomfall: Wicked Isle
description:
The Wicked Isle story expansion is set on Midsummer Island. To get there, players must speak to the boat-keeper in Wyndham Village, who provides the first Lead.

Located near the Windscale Atom Plant, Midsummer has higher infection levels and introduces new enemies like pirate bandits and infected druids. Players can find new weapons, including a Blunderbuss, bow, daggers, the Beekeeper’s Staff, unlock new skills and an upgraded metal detector.

Leads found on the island open new story paths and possible alternate endings to Atomfall.

title: Bombardiro Crocodilo: Italian Brainrot Simulator
description: Join Bombardiro Crocodilo, the iconic crocodile-bomber plane, and a roster of absurd meme characters like Bombombini Gusini, Tralalero Tralala, and Lirili Larila in a surreal battle for supremacy across the Croco Nation and beyond!

title: Zombie Outbreak 1942
description: Glowing eyes are seen in the distance, and you start to hear the sounds of the undead approaching your location. You quickly scramble to find your pistol and barricade the windows as quickly as you can, but it's too late. Zombies are approaching. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

title: Run Jump Climb Disarm
description: Run, jump, and climb your way through 20 uniquely themed levels and disarm all bombs before time runs out.

title: Parliament of Hell 1796
description: Parliament of Hell is a horror comedy adventure game set in 18th century England. Young gothic poet Matthew has been forced to serve in Government by his Father. He will get himself kicked out by any means necessary, even if he must call on the Devil himself…

title: Sunset Racer
description: Sunset Racer is an immersive racing game that transports players to the golden era of automobiles, where powerful cars with full tanks of gasoline raced into the sunset.

title: Daily Sudoku Together
description: A Discord activity offering daily sudoku puzzles, as well as a number of unlockable puzzles of various difficulty levels.

title: Higgs Boson: Puzzle Collection
description: Higgs Boson Collection is a trilogy of brain-bending puzzle games where every rotation counts and every second matters. Your mission? Guide mysterious spheres through a precise network of pathways — but there's a twist: you don’t move the spheres… you rotate the world around them.

title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
description:
Hoard’s LLC is a cozy, story-driven puzzle game where you play as Barry, a mild-mannered minotaur working deep in the depths of a corporate dungeon. When Barry starts to realize his coworkers are being exploited, he sets out to do something truly radical: help them.

Navigate a maze of departments—like Loot Logistics and Monster Resources—solving puzzles to reconnect isolated coworkers. Along the way, you'll uncover endearing stories, roll your eyes at cheesy corporate puns, and bring together a community that needs each other now more than ever.

title: Breadleg
description: Breadleg is an absurdist, comedy game about running round a scottish village as a piece of bread with legs. Encounter the people of the village and collect socks to help you escape without being eaten, whilst maybe getting involved in a bit of mischief along the way.

title: Broomstick Exorcist
description: Play as Vikka, a street sweeper who hunts demons at night while keeping the street clean. Devour the darkness in a night filled with demons in this unique 2D, hand-drawn, Manga-inspired beat 'em-up horror adventure.

title: All-front Assault
description: This is a game where players manipulate and command a commander from a customized perspective, controlling an entire team to combat alien creatures.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description: A turn-based dark magical girl dungeon crawler. Create a squad of magical warriors, explore twisted labyrinths, and exterminate the demonic Hate that threaten the city.

title: Chronoquartz
description: In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?

title: Despicable Boss
description: Rise from the depths of hell in Despicable Boss, a third-person action game filled with intense combat, strategic choices, and dark humor. Defeat powerful bosses, navigate treacherous contracts, and climb the infernal hierarchy. Will you outwit the chaos and seize control?
