description: Build, paint, and customize model kits in this immersive virtual workshop. Snap parts together, apply decals, paint with precision, and even kitbash for unique creations. Experience the satisfaction of model kit building without the mess.

title: Zombie Liminal Fishing
description: Eliminate zombies. Collect zombie meat for bait. Fish and harvest crabs. Sell your catch for money. Upgrade weapons, robots, transport devices, and fishing gear. Unlock new areas. Repeat.

title: Rosemary Village
description:
Play as Ferdinand, a young adventurer in search of a new journey. In Rosemary Village, even the simplest adventure can put a lot at stake, and in it, Ferdinand's will and power will be his main weapons.

Turn-based combat, varied environments, optional activities and interesting characters are just a few examples of what you can expect from the game, as well as mechanics that will make you replay Rosemary Village over and over again...

title: Ventomori
description: In this asymmetrical multiplayer co-op puzzle game, brave the treacherous unknown and endeavour on a deadly, desolate planet. Be the eyes from above or the scout on the ground and work together with a friend to uncover the mysteries and escape from the planet Xanahspati.

title: The Shadow Beneath
description: The Shadow Beneath is an action roguelike where you must fulfill an ancient prophecy and rise against the demonic forces that have taken over the world. You will battle relentless waves of enemies, master powerful abilities and reclaim what humanity lost since the Demon Lords reign began - freedom

title: PhantomRider
description: This is a role-playing game, the protagonist has four magic, the enemy has heroes, ordinary monsters, the enemy's heroes have powerful magic. Dropped weapons have a rank. Ordinary monsters will cause you trouble. The protagonist conquers an expedition to destroy the enemy's castle.

title: Next Business Trip
description: You will be spending a horror filled 3 nights at the hotel. Your room this time around, is a rather large one complete with a bed and bath.

title: Yoshi's Archipelago
description: Yoshi’s Archipelago is a community collab game made in SMBX. It was created under strict pretenses in an effort to make it one of the most solid Mario episodes imaginable. Whether we succeeded or not, well, that's up to you now, isn't it?

title: Struggler
description: This is a dark game that includes regular monster killing, treasure dropping, gem setting, strategy matching skills and talents, collecting special items, battle flags, destructible environments, and other elements. It can also be played in city strongholds to eliminate crime and police.

title: BlackVein
description: A Retro Survival-Horror Mining Game, mine for resources, survive horrors and descend deeper in to BlackVein mine.

title: Escape From Benjamin's Room
description: Crack challenging puzzles to escape the room and recover Benjamin's memories.

title: The Prisoner
description: Stuck in a prison you don't remember being sent to, you must find a way to escape. Using the guards and the other prisoners as tools to guarantee your escape requires strategizing your movement to successfully maneuver them to solve the puzzling challenges ahead.

title: Supernova: Galactic Wars
description: A shoot'em up with a strategic component. Place your ship on a galactic chessboard. Try to use all your arcade skills to win when 2 ships encounter.

title: Dig & Deal
description: Dig & Deal is a game where you dig underground to find valuable items and bargain with customers to sell what you find. Upgrade your tools, grow your shop, and make the best deals to build your fortune.

title: Starbug Troopers: The 4 Horseflies of the Apocalypse
description: Starbug Troopers is a cute and colorful action game blending turn-based strategy and shoot 'em up elements, set in the cute world of insects. Using your Starbugs, insect-like ships, face off against the four horseflies of the apocalypse who want to pollute your environment and destroy their armies

title: No Man's Sky: Beacon
description: Expand your planetary empire in No Man's Sky BEACON. Become Overseer of multiple planetary settlements, and discover the townships of the secretive robotic Autophage. Introducing improved settlement balance, more variety of management decisions, building upgrades, infestations, new base parts and more.

title: Monster Pub: Chapter 3
description: Monster Pub is an episodic narrative game about finding new friends in a new town, but, uh, also everyone is a monster, including you! Be a good friend, or a bad friend! Play cards and crush your opponent! Or maybe just try to have a nice time, I'm not your boss.

title: The Dark Legacy
description: The Dark Legacy is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore an abandoned surgeon's estate. Uncover hidden memories, solve narrative-driven puzzles, and face the chilling consequences of forbidden experiments. The game emphasizes atmospheric storytelling over jump scares.

title: Dustwind: Resistance
description: Dustwind: Resistance is a single-player tactical game. Lead your squad—including your dog—against a brutal raider army. Pause to plan tactics. Use brutal firepower, stealth, traps, turrets, or an armored car to outmaneuver enemies. Protect your home and freedom. No surrender!

title: Medieval StartUp
description: Medieval StartUp is a unique mix of tavern management, crafting, and exploration set in a rich medieval world. Manage your tavern, craft unique items, recruit staff, and explore a mysterious marsh full of hidden secrets and rare resources.

title: Hounded
description: You are Duke, a determined young Border Collie who is searching for their lost master, the leader of The Rebellion. Hounded by a cunning hunter, can you track the scent, unearth the power of The Tide and find your way home?

title: Criminally Yours
description:
You're the next generation of heroes—"Oracle," given to your mother and you for your ability to see glimpses into the future.

The only thing that stands in your way of keeping peace in the city is the supervillain "Chronos".

When you aren't protecting the city from Chronos, you're just an average everyday civilian working as a project manager with your long-time crush, Nikolaos.

Little do you know that Nikolaos knows your secret, but you don't know his—that he and Chronos are one and the same.

title: Rescue the Girl
description: Ex-cop's life shatters when kidnappers take his daughter, implant a bomb, and force him on lethal missions. With enigmatic allies, his choices rewrite destinies while unraveling a conspiratorial web.

title: Block King Demands Red Squares
description: Automate a network of towns producing the required shapes for the ever fickle Block King while keeping the citizens happy. Remember, if you fail, you will get fired.

title: Doom Spiral
description: DOOM SPIRAL is an intense first person shooter where your health is the integrity of your consciousness.

title: Prism Shift
description: A minimalist, grid-based puzzle game where you merge colored blocks using additive color mixing. Clear connected blocks and interact with special blocks to progress through each level.

title: Pirate's Gambit
description: Pirate's Gambit takes you on an unpredictable voyage, blending deck-building with Yacht Dice mechanics. Roll the dice in the dimly lit cabin, where fate shifts with every turn. Are you closing in on treasure or something far more sinister?

title: Bubbles in the Air
description: Bubbles in the Air is a grid-free real-time matching game. In a dog's dream, colorful soap bubbles float and collide… The task is simple! Shoot bubbles, merge matching ones, and let them burst—creating even more bubbles. Can you make it to the end of the dream?

title: Touhou Dream Duel
description: Battle your way through Gensokyo in this fan-work inspired by classic Touhou Project fighting games.

title: Guardian of the Rebellion
description: A classic war-chronicle fantasy SRPG set on the continent of Falnea, where beings known as “Guardians” wield power beyond mortals. Lead Arzes—the son of a Guardian—against the Ruzeroa Empire’s bid for unification and the shadowy forces stoking the war.

title: Rogue Rollers
description: A pinball roguelike where you battle through chaotic arenas and cursed dungeons, unlock powerful upgrades, and choose branching paths as you bounce, bash, and roll your way through an ever-changing world.

title: Sketch Magician
description: A sketch action game where you fight with your drawings. You are a Sketch Magician. From arrow-like attacks to shields that block enemy attacks, everything is created from your sketches. Fight in the world of the sketchbook!

title: Super Worms
description:
A kart racing game with segmented "worms" in different colors instead of karts.
Similar to older kart racing games, the game features a pseudo-3D view made up of flat sprites.
The game has a racing mode where you can race against AI opponents or against another player and a battle mode for two players.

title: Postal: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze
description: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze isn’t “just a DLC” - it’s a tropical serotonin collapse packed with juicy carnage, alleged jokes, overbaked new levels, even less appropriate enemies and unhinged guns. This is another mag of SPF-free mockery fired point-blank at modern life.

title: Gunstoppable
description: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

title: A Planet Full of Cats
description: A Planet Full of Cats is a hidden object adventure with metroidvania-style exploration — in true Devcats fashion. Explore diverse biomes, unlock new powers and uncover ancient secrets!

title: Dishventory
description:
You will take a job as a Dishwasher manager, figuring out the most effective way to wash dishes. Are you up for the challenge?

Wash dirty dishes that keep on piling on the board. Put dirty dishes on the Dishwasher board in the most efficient order and earn Golden Bubbles. The Store that appears every couple of rounds will allow you to purchase some awesome upgrades!

Survive 5 days and get a dishwasher with a new card to play with in your next run.

title: La Vuelta al Mundo con Vascolet
description: This third game made for Nestlé's Vascolet features Alejandro and his friends kart racing around the world. But beware! Evil Malmark and his lackeys are out there trying to ruin the races!

title: Pip Pepper Park Planner
description:
Pip Pepper Park Planner is a cozy, strategy game in which you play as Pip, a tiny bird with a giant job: to design parks for animals to enjoy. Explore different habitats, discover the needs of diverse animals and fully customize your parks. Can you build a park that all the animals will love?‎

Create your own customizable park choosing different structures for each park area. With hundreds possible combinations, you get to decide what happens next.

Interact with a variety of objects and animal species. Learn about their unique needs and interests through engaging and fun dialogue sequences.

Explore a playground of possibilities. Did anything change after building your park? Take your time to reflect on your design decisions. You can always try a new combination!

title: Felt That: Boxing
description: Felt That: Boxing is a comedic boxing game set in a world where the charm of furry puppets collides with the fury of boxing. Step into the shoes of Ezra "Fuzz-E" Wright, an unlikely hero with a big heart. His quest? Battle his way through the Tournament of a Million Punches to save an orphanage!

title: Lumines Arise
description: A mind-blowing, fiendishly addictive reinvention of the puzzle classic Lumines from the creators of Tetris Effect: Connected, where sound pulses through your body, mind, and every block you place, triggering dazzling visuals synched to the driving beat of an infectious, eclectic soundtrack.

title: Romeo is a Dead Man
description:
Latest ultra-violent sci-fi action title from Grasshopper Manufacture and Suda51.

Step into the blood-soaked boots of Romeo Stargazer, a man pulled back from the brink of death by a time paradox gone wrong. Now reborn as Agent Dead Man of the FBI Space-Time Division, and armed with the mysterious Dead Gear mask, Romeo must chase the universe’s most dangerous fugitives across alternate realities.

Blending high-octane gunplay, brutal sword combat, and over-the-top sci-fi insanity, Romeo Is a Dead Man is GhM’s bloodiest action game yet. Players can expect mind-bending twists, outrageous gimmicks, and a deeply cathartic combat system that turns enemies’ powers against them in universe-shattering battles.

As Romeo tears through the multiverse, he’s also on a desperate quest to find Juliet, his mysteriously vanished girlfriend. With a narrative that fuses love, loss, and metaphysical chaos, Romeo Is a Dead Man offers a stylish and unpredictable journey through the very fabric of time itself.

Can you survive the bleeding edge of space-time? Or will you become just another ghost in the paradox?

title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
description: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles
description: This dramatic tale of ambition, betrayal, and honor comes to life again with an updated and enriched script with fully voiced dialogue, alongside improved graphics that bring a new level of immersion and playability to the battlefield. Additionally, the enhanced version brings quality-of-life updates like new difficulties, a revamped UI, auto save, and more that make the game more accessible to newcomers.

title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection
description:
Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years. Experience the legendary origins of the franchise with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions for the Super NES and Sega Genesis. Dive deeper with rare and fan-favorite releases across the Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega 32X, Game Boy Advance, and more—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

Digital Eclipse's interactive documentary format explores how Mortal Kombat changed the way society perceived video games. By using digitized humans as player sprites in an over-the-top, martial-arts fighter, the game thrilled players, shocked critics, and laid the foundation for a franchise that has thrived for more than 30 years. Hear firsthand from the original dev team of Ed Boon, John Tobias, John Vogel, and Dan Forden, along with other exclusive interviews, rare concept art, vintage marketing materials, and archival video footage.

Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection also lets players explore Mortal Kombat lore, with a timeline of the original series' storyline and comprehensive character histories that offer stories, secrets, and glimpses behind the scenes at their creation.

title: Nioh 3
description: In the latest game in the dark samurai action RPG series "Nioh," you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open world.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
description:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

title: Planet of the Ants
description: Planet of the Ants is a fast-paced, action-packed real-time strategy game with evolution mechanics. Grow your colony of ants from scratch and conquer your enemies through evolving eras of civilization. Your reflexes, decision making and micromanagement skills will be put to the ultimate test.

title: My Time With Dee Dee volume 0
description: My Time With Dee Dee is a series of short visual novels staring the mascot of DigitallyDownloaded.net, Danica, or Dee Dee. This is a very short introduction, to give you a first look at Dee Dee, and how she came to meet you, the protagonist.

title: Prison Escape io
description: Dash through traps, tunnels, and glass bridges in fast-paced multiplayer! Team up or compete to escape first. Survive wild maps and become the ultimate escape master!

title: Necromancer Nonsense
description:
It's the blood moon! Time to take over the world... or it would be if every other half baked necromancer and vampire wasn't trying the same thing.

Capture buildings and locations full of bits and bobs you can use to build your army, and conquer all!

Made in 1 month for the "Games for Blind Gamers" game jam! So should be fully blind accessible.

title: Coming Home
description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

title: CoopRooms
description: CoopRooms is a co-op survival horror game for up to 5 players, set in the endless Backrooms. Take photos and videos to progress—and maybe survive. Just don’t scream... the Entities are listening.

title: Metal Slug 3
description: “METAL SLUG 3”, the masterpiece in SNK’s emblematic 2D run & gun action shooting game series, still continues to fascinate millions of fans worldwide to this day for its intricate dot-pixel graphics, and simple and intuitive game controls!

title: Project: Fractured Reality
description: A failed toxic weapon experiment left you alone in an abandoned village… or so you think. Craft, explore, uncover dark secrets, and help the last survivors—if they’re still human.

title: Hybrid Blood
description: Step into the role of a Vampire-Human Hybrid, imprisoned for longer than you can remember. Explore a Open-world RPG and expand your Vampiric Domain. Defeat the local Vampire Lord to claim his territory and begin your quest to dominate—or liberate—the lands.

title: Art Together
description: Art Together is a multiplayer drawing game where creativity meets chaos. Gather people online and experience the hilarious results of collaborative art creation!

title: Fallout 76: Gone Fission
description:
Grab your tackle box and your waders and head for the water, because the Gone Fission update reels in a huge new feature: Fishing!

This peaceful wasteland activity lets players catch fish in any water where they can swim. Now you can chill out with your friends at your favorite radioactive body of water in any region of Appalachia and catch more than 30 new fish. Players can even collect and cook a batch of nutritious new recipes with the fish they catch.

title: Legion Was Here
description: You are Legion, a secret agent who can change his appearance at will. Use your investigative and chameleon skills to infiltrate enemy ranks!

title: AFK Shift
description: Streamer has gone AFK. What could go wrong? Tune in to abandoned livestreams, watch for unexpected changes and sinister anomalies, and report them for remediation before they can permanently corrupt reality!

title: Grumblemoor
description: Explore a colorful haunted world, fight and befriend its bizarre inhabitants, unlock game changing upgrades, and unravel a story of epic proportions.

title: Quadrofriend
description: Ethan goes to a psychiatric hospital to visit an old friend. Upon arrival, he discovers that the staff has disappeared and his friend has gone mad. Now, Ethan must endure brutal trials to survive and escape this nightmare.

title: Vox Populi: Canada 2025
description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative Canadian elections! In "Vox Populi: Canada 2025", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

title: Waving Around
description: Jump, stomp and create dangerous waves to defeat up to 4 of your friends in this cute competitive arena. May the best stomper win!

title: The Stairwell
description: You've been hired to keep watch in a mysterious building with an infinite stairwell. Your task is simple: investigate each floor for strange phenomena. If you find an anomaly, be careful. Test your skills on the global leaderboard and in the weekly challenge event.

title: Silent Hill f: Deluxe Edition
description:
Silent Hill f is a survival horror game published by Konami as part of the Silent Hill series.
It is set in rural Japan during the 1960s, marking a departure from the franchise’s traditional Western settings. The story is written by Ryukishi07 and focuses on psychological horror, social pressure, and transformation.

The Deluxe Edition includes the full game along with a digital artbook, a digital soundtrack, and the Pink Rabbit costume. Pre-order bonuses for the Deluxe Edition consisted of the White Sailor School Uniform, the Omamori (Peony), an item pack, and 48-hour early access.

title: The Elementalist Typing
description: A tactical typing role-playing game to sharpen your typing skills! Featuring colorful hand-drawn pixel art and a unique mad-lib engine for endless typing variety! Upgrade your wizard and play tactically to defeat mighty foes and collect fabulous home decorations. Make typing practice fun!

title: Operius DX
description: Blast off into Operius DX, a high-speed arcade shooter where you navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle waves of enemies, and confront formidable bosses in an endless amount of procedurally-generated levels. How far can you get?

title: Deep Pixel Melancholy
description: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

title: There Will Be Light
description: There Will Be Light is a top-down puzzle adventure in a gloomy but cozy environment. To progress, you have to solve tricky logic puzzles, while defending yourself against enemies. Dive into this cozy but challenging puzzle adventure as you solve riddles and fight your way back to the light.

title: Doug The Digger
description: Doug The Digger is a casual, single-player mining and crafting game where you aim to escape a crash landing by crafting a rocket. The gameplay is simple but addictive—play at your own risk!

title: Empower Your Intent
description: Built for those who want to better themselves. A unique rhythm game designed to help reclaim your motivation and attention. Focus the timing and direction of your movements to burst projectiles into a mesmerizing eruption of flower petals.

title: Orbit Maze
description: Orbit Maze is a unique maze game set on various surfaces. Control gravity, navigate through platforms, and solve mind-bending puzzles!

title: Pro Cycling Manager 25
description: New graphics for an even more realistic simulation. Become a team manager and lead your riders to the top. Choosing sponsors, recruiting riders, managing the race, it's all up to you.

title: The Tavern In the Woods
description: "Tavern in the Woods" is a first person, single-player interactive fiction story that blends mystery, storytelling, and supernatural horror. Players explore and investigate an isolated environment as the narrative slowly unfolds, gradually uncovering the truth behind the eerie emptiness.

title: The Liquid Jet
description: A slimy, psychedelic adventure about a girl attending a forest warehouse rave party with her friends, where she'll go to experience a long, profound bad (?) trip.

title: Fantasy Kommander: Fascination of Evil
description: Command armies of knights, orcs, and dragons in epic battles! Conquer lands, collect items, and lead Marcus III to victory in this strategic turn-based RPG set in a world of fantasy warfare.

title: Black Dungeon: Draw A Card
description: Once a lowly servant of the Arcane Illustration Society, you triggered a portal while reading the forbidden Codex Obscura and were cast into the Devourer Dungeon. Branded by its core, you gained scrollbinding powers. Explore, collect lost cards, and seal the Demon Devourer: Taotie.

title: Pair Master
description: A challenging matching game that requires quick reflexes and memory skills. It includes both single-player and multiplayer modes, with various difficulty levels and objectives to choose from in competitive play.

title: Uni-Code
description: A 2D platformer where you play as a magical unicorn battling through a world of alpha characters, symbols, and emojis! See if you can survive through all 26 levels of absolute unicorn madness!

title: World Tree Inferno
description: 操控你的角色与团队，在芬布尔之冬的末日世界中进行探索，遇见各种各样的朋友和敌人，进行解谜与回合制战斗，为神明带去诸神黄昏！

title: Idle Dangers
description: In a world where dark forces threaten to consume all, a magical continent is under siege by monstrous invaders. As a hero in this dark fantasy realm, you must rise to the challenge. Strengthen your skills, and lead your team through endless battles to protect the world from destruction.

title: Molehill Empire 2
description: Lively gnomes, gardening and research - your garden plot is the place to be!

title: Wet City
description: Welcome to Wet City the city of sin and opportunity, where you rise as an adult film producer. Meet the hottest girls, uncover their secrets, and build your very own entertainment empire. Money, romance, dangerit's all waiting for you!

title: AlphaFurry
description: The story of Maggie, a 25-year-old girl who ventured into a dark forest, where not only dangerous werewolfs awaited her but also unexpected passions. The full moon is strong, and the werewolves are truly out of control. However, Maggie knew what awaited her, and she paid no heed to the warnings

title: Dark PGT
description: Dark PGT – A Souls-like game in an alternate universe of future USSR on Unreal Engine 5. You will play the role of alcoholic-schizophrenic experiencing psychological disorders and hallucinations. Travel to a village in 2030 to unravel all its secrets and solve all its problems.

title: Turbo Balls
description: Race through tricky tracks with up to 8 players online. Roll, jump, and bump past opponents to reach the finish line first! Choose your character, and customize your ball.

title: Moon Tropica
description: Engage in competitive combat, either alongside or against fellow players, as you strive to elevate your character's prowess and amass the most coveted and rare items available within the game world.

title: Necrofane
description: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

title: Monterey Jack
description: Run, run, run as fast as you can, you can’t escape the Cheese Man!

title: Find My Frogs
description: Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game full of frogs, mushrooms and moss. Help Uncle Froger take a commemorative photo, or just lounge in the pond and relax.

title: Coffee & Boobs
description: Coffee & Boobs is a 2D visual novel about a cozy coffee shop where the staff serves hot espresso in the morning. Help the hero achieve his dream: to become the best barista and brew the kind of coffee that will make any date a success!

title: Law School
description: A 3D adult visual novel where your choices shape relationships, rivalries, and a gripping story. Dive into drama, humor, mini-games, romance and a fully interactive social app in the journey of a young law student at Stocklinburg College.

title: Chronicles of the Celestial Way
description: Action RPG: Battle, level up, enhance gear & challenge foes, dungeons, and players. Based on Chinese myths, ancient tribes warred. Five tribes unite against the mighty Chiyou. Nuwa plans to create humans using Wuxing power, but Chiyou attacks. Your adventure starts now!

title: Nightmare Files: Stoned
description: In this short horror game, you take on the role of the ship’s mechanic, recruited for an expedition led by an ambitious archaeologist who claims to have found a map to a forgotten island.

title: Tiāndào: Gōngdé Chāojí Bāo
description: After purchasing, you can obtain the Heavenly Dao Merit Super Pack in the game. Please obtain it from your in-game email

title: Tiāndào: Gōngdé Dà Lǐ Bāo
description: After purchasing, you can receive the Heavenly Dao Merit Gift Pack in the game. Please obtain it from your in-game email

title: Fairground Online
description: Fairground Online - The ultimate simulator! Control rides, create light shows and accompany them with music. Experience realistic physics, detailed controls and the day-night cycle. Play online with friends worldwide and become part of the community!

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening - Set of 6 Scenarios
description: This set consists of 6 scenarios, with 3 historical scenarios including "Birth of Nobunaga," the scenario with the earliest possible starting point in the game, and 3 fictional scenarios including "Absence of Great Conflict," the scenario about how history would have played out if the Onin War had not occurred. In addition, the scenario "Battle of Nagashino," which was released as a bonus for the Asian version for the game,

title: Favela Defender
description: Favela Defender is a tower defense game where players protect their Brazilian urban settlement from waves of attackers. Players deploy defenses across various maps while developing strategic approaches to safeguard their territory, with performance rankings tracked through global leaderboards.

title: Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee
description: Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee is a surreal comedy-filled RPG about four primates attempting to stop humans from destroying the universe.

title: Flappy Bat 3
description: It's a Halloween night and Flappy Bat is trying to make his way home. Can you help the Flappy Bat navigate through numerous procedurally generated obstacles. Flap your way past enemies and obstacles and compete on the global leader board for the ultimate top score!

title: The Tower of Shadows
description: Tower of Shadows is a turn-based strategy game where every decision counts. Climb the levels one by one, face formidable opponents, and perfect your tactics to reach the top. Your ultimate challenge? The Master of Shadows himself.

title: Demonk
description:
Demonk is a cooperative horror experience for 1–4 players, where you take on the sacred role of Slavic monks — trained in the forgotten art of dealing with the dead.

Your mission: communicate with ancient spirits, uncover their stories, and choose whether to banish them... or negotiate for peace.

Set in a world deeply rooted in Slavic mythology, every encounter is a test of faith, logic, and trust between players.

Success brings reward — money, relics, and reputation. But failure? That may cost your soul.

Will you find harmony with the beyond… or will the darkness consume you?

title: Mexican Ninja
description: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

title: TurretGirls
description: Grody extraterrestrials are pouring through a space-time rift, and only one girl and her turret stand in their way! Lock, load, and blast them to oblivion—because if she doesn’t survive today, there’s no ‘omurice’ tomorrow! Earth depends on her!

title: Return to Ash
description: “The hospital was empty. Quiet, and brighter than usual... like waking up on a snow day. But I didn't feel cold. I didn't feel much of anything.”

title: Dancing Wings: The Aerobatic Simulator
description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

title: Deltarune Sakuya Battle
description: This is a demo of the a Deltarune and Touhou fan game. Kris finds himself a new enemy that can control time! The Scarlet Devil Mansion chief maid Sakuya Izayoi.

title: Who's at the Door?
description: You are trapped in a small house with psychosis, having lost your memory. Carefully observe your surroundings, distinguish between reality and hallucinations, and take the medication provided by visitors on time to overcome your illness.

title: Sisyphe's Backspace
description: A 5 minutes game about love and hesitation. Use Backspace to play. Hope you will never experience this hesitation.

title: Trine 4: Definitive Edition
description: Trine 4: Definitive Edition includes Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince and the Trine 4: Melody of Mystery DLC campaign.

title: Glyphs
description:
GLYPHS is a difficult puzzle-platformer about exploration and persistence.

Traverse the depths of the Tomb of Forbidden Knowledge; a sentient labyrinth containing traces of the past in the form of glyphs. Formidable bosses, platforming, and puzzles stand in the way of discovery - GLYPHS fulfills the extent that one willingly searches for true knowledge.

EPILEPSY WARNING - This game has occasional drastic color flashes/sudden color changes

title: Noble Legacy
description:
After returning from war you claim your inheritance: Greenwood—a neglected realm on the brink of collapse. As its new Lord, you must guide your kingdom to greatness, not from a distant throne, but by walking its cobbled streets and verdant fields. In this third-person kingdom builder, you must raise your realm from rubble with a builder’s touch—every hall, heath, and castle wall crafted to your design.

Attract skilled settlers to your realm and keep their spirits high by ensuring their homes are furnished and their needs well met. Rule wisely over your land’s resources and build a thriving economy through careful management of trade and labor. Prepare in the times of plenty as harsh weather, plague, and roaming bandits can stall your progress. From the ashes of ruin, reclaim your land, guide your people, and uncover your past as you forge a Noble Legacy worthy of song and steel.

title: Skull Hotel
description: A first-person horror game where you clean haunted hotel rooms while evading deadly entities. Inspect hiding spots carefully, listen for warning sounds, and spot subtle clues left by monsters. Your vigilance is your only weapon in this terrifying housekeeping shift.

title: Pure Pool Pro
description: Welcome to Pure Pool Pro; the ultimate pool simulation. Play solo or online, master every game type, and compete in high-stakes tournaments in immersive venues. Experience breathtaking 8K native visuals, lifelike physics, and pinpoint-precise controls.

title: Gunny Ascend
description: A Roguelite Block-Stacking Adventure — Stack, Adapt, Escape! Gunny Ascend is a high-speed puzzle game where every falling block is a chance to escape. Build clever loadouts, adapt to ever-changing hazards, and outsmart the Collectors in this chaotic, dimension-hopping adventure.

title: Greasemnk++
description: a short rpg by heaven's guard with characters by Mariken set in the 10,000 arses world.

title: Legitimate Space Corp Simulator LLC
description:
NOW HIRING: Station Manager! (Interim)
Run a totally legitimate space business, in Sector 7-G.
Farm totally legal alien crops, refuel legally acquired ships** of 100% reputable clientele, and sell technically edible snacks and other consumables.

Perks: justification of your species' continued existence, "gloves", oxygen insurance, and mild recognition.

No exp needed.
Apply today!

title: Cyberspace Defender
description:
Welcome to the CyberSpace Defender Program.

CyberSpace Defender has detected 24 data duplication bugs in the cyberspace. You have been tasked with removing the bugs, to stop the Cyberspace from collapsing under the ever increasing weight of meaningless bits and bytes.

title: The Compunaut & the Meaning of Life
description: The meaning of life already has been discovered but was lost a long time ago. You explore an ancient organic computer to restore this lost knowledge. But be aware... You are not welcome! Be ready to fight for your life!

title: Past Mistakes: Act I
description: See dazzling 4K images and 60FPS animations, and unravel an epic story in the visual novel Past Mistakes! Experience the story of Cyrus, a regular guy with a lot to answer for in his past, as he gets a rare second chance to heal and repair his past mistakes!

title: Engine Eternal
description: An online co-op horror for 1-4 players. Travel across the Old World on the Engine Eternal and explore randomly generated dungeons to locate fuel and upgrades for the last train to Paradise.

title: Tetra's Escape 2
description: Help the tetras find the exit.

title: Bratz Rhythm & Style
description: Conquer the world of fashion with your new BFFs, the Bratz Pack!

title: Bloom Paradise
description: A fixed-screen action game offering a 2-player coop mode.

title: Gnomes and Knights: Path of Success
description: On the Path of Success you will meet Despicable Dwarf, who tells you how to become successful and, perhaps, shares wisdom about methods of catching gnomes. A long motivational monologue of very controversial content awaits you. There is nothing else to do in the DLC. You can't catch gnomes either.

title: Inkventure
description: Join Gloop, a lovable slime single dad, on a colorful quest through another dimension! Solve color-based platforming puzzles and rescue his quirky kids in this adorable, all-new Megadrive game!

title: Make it! Sushi
description: Make delicious sushi and become a sushi chef! Work quickly and accurately to fill as many sushi orders as possible!

title: Split Fiction: Friend's Pass
description: Invite a friend for free with the Friend's Pass and experience a mind-blowing co-op adventure together as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction.

title: Time Jump
description:
A casual 3rd person action-adventure

Play as William Roger in this 3rd person comedy adventure. It's 1994. You're late for school! No sleep. No Breakfast. You "accidentally" activate your professors “Camera” and get sucked into the past.

Lost and alone in this strange place with your wits and no knowledge of where to go next, uncover the many mysteries of why you are here and at all costs, find your way back home before time runs out.

title: Shrine of Haunts
description: In the summer of 1990, you return to the secluded mountain village of Iwao as your grandfather falls critically ill. The village shrine is said to seal the yokai "Tsuchigumo." As the "Mushi Okuri Festival" nears, its ritual flames may awaken a thousand-year-old curse…

title: HR: Human Remains
description: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

title: Five Heads
description: Five prisoners each have a visible-to-others card on their forehead. Across three rounds, they logically deduce and rank their cards from lowest to highest. On the final round, each guesses their exact card, using every prior guess as a clue. A single mistake can doom them—can you solve it?

title: Mind Over Monarchy
description: Command your army in a turn-based strategy game where every move matters. Each round represents new challenges in randomly generated battles, but be careful because when your king dies your attempt is over!

title: Match App!
description: MATCH APP! is a visual novel game based on a Japanese dating app. Players take on the role of the protagonist and experience a story of new encounters through the dating app.

title: Beach Invasion 1915: Gallipoli
description: Beach Invasion 1915: Gallipoli is a first-person shooter set during the WWI Gallipoli campaign where players defend fortified coastlines against allied forces. Players use period-accurate weapons and defensive tactics, including mines and explosives, to repel waves of infantry, armored vehicles, aircraft, and naval vessels attempting to breach their position.

title: Vow
description: Vow is a mystical game about a cursed village frozen between sunset and night. Explore abandoned houses, read birch bark letters, and observe ancient rituals to uncover the mystery of the disappearance of its inhabitants — and your own fate.

title: Jail Dice: Roll to Break
description: As the last pilot aboard the dice-shaped combat machine [ Dice-Rover ], destroy threatening objects with exhilarating action. Power up your Dice-Rover enough to find and destroy the ultimate target, [ JAIL DICE ].

title: Children of Mare
description: Venture into the host's mind and extracts all its fears to feed Mare. Build, explore, mine and conquer ruins to please the goddess of nightmares.

title: Furry Company
description: This is an idle-style casual game that appears at the bottom of your screen. In the game, you'll hire adorable animals to work at the company you've founded. You be the boss and make sure they don't slack off. The earnings can be used to renovate or expand your cozy office.

title: Santa's Hitlist CEO Edition
description: Santa's Hitlist: CEO Edition is a single-player, top-down shooter rogue-lite game where you play as Santa, avenging average workers by taking down their CEOs. Armed with a vast arsenal of weapons, you'll face off against epic bosses from the business world in your quest for justice.

title: TreeTale
description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH RPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.

title: Bandeirantes: The Game.
description: Bandeirantes invites the player to experience the life of one of the bandeirantes who explored Brazil in the 17th century. Come to the first historicly correct game of it's kind. Survival Crafting placed in the Brazilian Rain Forest.

title: The Garden of Hermeneus
description: Step into the role of 'Me,' a linguist, and decipher the words of 'Him,' a beastman. With only 90 days, can 'Me' connect with 'Him' heart to heart within this limited time?

title: Sokobos 2
description: A puzzle game about pushing vases into a cart, but you can push the cart too!

title: Rusty Foodies
description: Rusty Foodies is a puzzle game where you must strategically place various food blocks according to specific rules to achieve the target score. As you progress through the stages, you'll face an increasing number of obstacles, making placement more challenging.

title: Spring's Finale: Tales of Love
description: This spring, your campus life is quietly changing. You start to ponder what the relationships between you all really mean. The throbbing of youth, the intimate bonds, and the hidden feelings are intertwined, waiting for your choices.

title: Lavender Field
description: An atmospheric visual novel with puzzle elements and a nonlinear storyline.

title: Swimmer Away
description: Brave storm-lashed seas as a Coast Guard swimmer. Plunge from choppers, swim through swells, search sinking ships, strategize rescues, and ultimately decide who lives and who dies in the dark, icy, unforgiving ocean.

title: Beach Bar Simulator
description: Run your own beach bar on the shores of Miami Beach! Serve drinks, manage customers, and grow your business. Play solo or co-op, customize your bar, and create the ultimate summer hotspot! ️

title: Blossom Breeze
description: Blossom Breeze, take a breath and calmly clear some petals.

title: Toy Smash Kaboom!
description: Toy Warfare, Physics Collisions, Auto Chess, Space Management, Item Crafting, Trap Setting, Countless Playstyles—Every Combo is a Brand-New Adventure!​

title: Chronominion Idler
description: Manage your party, develop skills, and shape the fate of a living world in this strategy-driven RPG.

title: The Creator
description: The Creator is a peaceful meditative game-simulator where you create unique designs for locations and territories. Enjoy the creative process without searching for resources or fear of making mistakes, as you design stunning interiors and exteriors in picturesque corners of the world.

title: Robots and Planets
description: It is time, the planets have been invaded and need saved from infinite destruction. The enemies must be stopped from causing any more chaos. Go through challenging space puzzles and seek to be the hero and save the planets within your solar system!

title: Tainted Pools
description: Tainted Pools is a first-person survival horror set in the eerie poolrooms of Backrooms Level 130. A stalking entity lurks in the shadows, drawn to every sound. Scavenge for resources and survive long enough to find your way out.

title: The Airflow Trials
description: In the simulated world, the drone tries to cope with tasks that sometimes defy gravity and at other times, common sense. Loads, buttons, levers, and amusing fails in a physics puzzle where every mistake is almost an experiment.

title: Anura
description: Join Don Rano in his adventure! A platformer in which you will have to use the bubbles of the stage, and the ones you create, in order to reach the most difficult platforms. Will you try to go as fast as possible? Or will you take it at your own pace? You decide!

title: Off-world Prospecting
description: Off-World Prospecting is a game about mining for valuable resources, recovering long lost artifacts and resources left by a mysteriously vanished colony. Upgrade your tools, get rich, and unravel the stories of an alien planet as you delve deeper.

title: Shadows of Midnight: They Watch Me Sleep
description: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

title: Haxrail
description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter in a decaying star system trapped in a time loop. Fight, adapt, and break the cycle... before it breaks you.

title: Hope & Elpis
description: Hope & Elpis is a deck-builder roguelike where you play as a magical girl with two souls. Transform into the ancient mage Elpis, wielding Orbs to battle enemies. Learn diverse spells, unleash the Orbs' power, and seal calamities in Eden.

title: Welcome, Sharehouse!
description: Living in a share house with three pretty girls

title: Bacterian
description: Ever wanted to reach deep within yourself? Now you can. Fight off filthy diseases and germs in Bacterian - new take on a classic Sokoban - style game.

title: Realm Watch
description: Realm Watch is a cooperative Top-Down Dark Fantasy defense game where you choose your hero, fortify your defenses, and battle to survive relentless enemy waves. The sky weeps glowing pus—are you ready to defend the realm?

title: Icoptic Journey
description: Grapple, bounce, and fly through vibrant challenging levels. Build momentum and use precision to reach the goal as quickly as possible.

title: AI-deal-Rays
description: "Spring into action, supersonic Sylpheed." Become the owner of the female android "AI-deal", and prepare for high-stakes drama and high-speed action, all rendered in real-time 3D.

title: Punch to Glory
description: Start your journey as a boxer from the ground up, fighting your way to glory. Develop your character, collect fight cards, and face the challenges life throws your way. Train hard, manage stress, and give everything you've got to turn your championship dreams into reality.

title: Chicken Brother Guardian
description: An exciting top-down dodge shooter.

title: Gnom
description: Build and defend a settlement with an increasing number of gnomes. Gnomes chop wood, build things, and fight. Some become giants. Some become nanognomes. There are 52 buildings and 900 tech tree perks. The gnomes have options.

title: Super One More Jump
description: Super One More Jump is a hand-crafted intense arcade platformer. Simple to learn one button controls. Hard to master levels.

title: Tamagorudo: Floor O
description: TAMAGORUDO - Floor 0 - is an atmospheric psychological horror game. You will find yourself stuck in a parallel floor of the Backrooms, trying to break out of the loop of a chicken-or-the-egg paradox. Will you find the answer to this endless question ?

title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
description: This is a romance simulation game. In this game, there are no naive, overly-sweet girls—you'll need genuine charm and flirting skills to win a girl's heart.

title: Brotank
description: "BROTANK" is a top-down action roguelike game that combines retro RPG elements. Players will adventure in a post-apocalyptic world, recruit companions, acquire powerful tanks and equipment, capture wanted criminals, and ultimately become legendary hunters!

title: Land of Anima: The Research of Artificer
description: Isometric tower defense game where you can change the map routes to create your own strategy. Collect resources, craft towers, and upgrade your equipment to unravel the mysteries of the Land of Anima.

title: Jolly Land Adventure
description: Love the golden age of 2D platformers? Jolly Land Adventure brings back the joy of smooth jumps, colorful worlds, and creative levels in a fresh and accessible way. Whether you're a longtime platformer fan or new to the genre, there’s plenty to enjoy!

title: Equate 8
description: Equate 8 is an innovative and addicting new math puzzle game by the creator of The Devil's Calculator. Rearrange numbers in a 3x3 grid to solve eight equations (3 across, 3 down, and 2 diagonal) in the fewest moves possible. Challenges involve a variety of operators and difficulty levels!

title: Life in the Janitor's Room with a JK Girl
description: I returned to the janitor's room and found that a JK had suddenly barged in... As I got used to her presence, our relationship grew closer.

title: My Desktop Sister
description: My Desktop Sister is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from My Desktop Sister.

title: Maximus Mouse's Manic Mayhem
description: Maximus Mouse is back! Experience Manic Mayhem across Story, Arcade & Trial modes. Or grab some friends for party mode!

title: The Existence Theory of the No.13 High School
description: This is a text-based adventure game about a Chinese high school, where you will experience the joys or pains, the richness or meaninglessness of high school life by rolling dice and making choices.

title: No Time for Pants
description: Compact, tactical, rogue-lite, 2d action with pixelized graphics with a dark, gritty tone. Gather all the resources you can and customize your loadout- you must evolve with every death to fight through the horrors that await you. This is No Time For Pants!

title: Rogue Shapes
description: Rogue Shapes is a fast-paced roguelike bullet hell where you battle waves of deadly shapes, level up, and choose powerful upgrades. Complete challenges to unlock new playable shapes, each with unique weapons. How long can you survive the chaos?

title: Lost Ground
description: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

title: Astral Dusk
description: Astral Dusk is a first-person, crafting horror survival game following a lone astronaut marooned on the edge of a deep, dark moon crater. Scavenge various resources, debris, and alien plant life to craft tools to venture further into the void, to fix your damaged rocket, and blast off into space.

title: Prototype Juan: A Tale of Two Mundos
description: Juan's been banished to the prototype version of his game! He's gone from a colorful 16-bit hero to a tiny 1-bit homie. Help him platform his way back in this narrative action-platformer—with Juan himself teaching you how to control him through this mini-metroidvania!

title: Roach Post
description: Restore an abandoned post office by order of the Royal Postal Academy! Welcome customers, send packages, hire cute little roach-workers and pass Inspectors’ checks in an incredibly addictive roguelite puzzle Roach Post!

title: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
description: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.

title: Rise of the Penguins 2: Penguin's Dark Ascent
description: Dive into 'Rise of the Penguins 2: Penguin's Dark Ascent' a thrilling 2D action-platformer where you battle bosses, throw snowballs, and challenge the Crimson Star cult in a world shrouded in Eternal Dusk.

title: Royal Vermin
description: Climb, throw, and survive in this chaotic 2-4 player physics-based party game! As your preferred critter caught in a sudden flood, you must fight in a massive trash pile to claim your crown as the true "Royal Vermin."

title: Hope Harrison
description: Hope Harrison takes a twist on the survival horror genre and remixes it with Hand Crafted RNG, Nightmarish Monsters and Permadeath. Can you find hope?

title: Mythic Isle
description: "Create your mini fantasy island in the corner of your Windows desktop! Tired from work or study? Just click casually and watch adorable pets farm, mine, and build automatically for you~ From a deserted isle to a thriving paradise - all thanks to these little creatures with superpowers!"

title: Nina’s Sugar Cage
description: Alone with your adorable girlfriend. A perfect home. A perfect routine. A perfect love. Sweet, happy, and flawless in every way. …Except for one thing: you can’t leave. A loop of love and madness— An exploration-based 3D psycho horror featuring a beautiful girl.

title: SnaPaul 2: Anomalies
description: After a prank gone horribly wrong, you're ensnared in a nightmarish loop crafted by your own mother. As you delve into her twisted past, the boundaries between reality and madness blur. Unravel the sinister secrets and confront the malevolent forces that bind you.

title: Regex Game
description: Regular Expressions (Regex) are a powerful text pattern-matching tool used for searching, replacing, and validating strings. The game wraps Regex into text-based puzzle, allowing players to gradually master regular expressions as they progress through levels.

title: Vanguard Galaxy
description: A relaxing game about space exploration that lives at the bottom of your screen. Trade, fight, mine and salvage your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Let the game idle while your autopilot handles business and builds your fortune.

title: Only Dance!
description: You are a little fairy born from a girl's tears. Let's dance to make her smile!

title: Military Logistics Simulator
description: Drive real military vehicles, deliver critical cargo, and master first-person logistics solo or with friends. Rescue survivors, provide infrastructure, and rebuild a war-torn region!

title: SourceWorld
description: SourceWorld is a Dungeon Crawler Half-Life 2 mod with Immersive Sim elements. Be an indebted explorer doing raids on procedurally-generated parallel dimensions. Your job is Multiverse Research, but the curiosity comes with putting everything in danger of something lurking in far universes.

title: Strangers of the Power: Trancevania
description: New addon character and a small dungeon with brand new gameplay functions

title: Hop n' Hook
description: Hop N Hook is a platforming-fishing game set across three distinct zones, built around movement, exploration, and collection. Swing with your rod, explore open-ended zones, and catch over 50 unique fish—some of which fight back in reactive boss encounters.

title: Room Football: Shipyard
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Room Football: Dark Place
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Yosei Wars
description: Defeat the Junk Food and Rescue the Tooth Fairies! Platforming game inspired by many arcade classics. 9 out of 10 dentists recommend wishlisting this game!

title: A Simple Job
description: A simple task: Don't press the red button. Sounds easy? Featuring an annoying voice, absurd endings, and too many achievements. Free. Pointless. Glorious.

title: Painted Echoes
description: Painted Echoes is a relaxing puzzle game where you absorb and shoot colors to repaint mismatched rooms.

title: Trolley Dash
description: Trolley Dash is a fast-paced, endless arcade game where you race to grab items, fill orders, and deliver them before time runs out! You must dodge rogue trolleys, navigate shifting shelves, and react fast to keep up with the chaos. Can you get to the top of the leaderboards? Good luck!

title: The Mountain and the Moron
description: The Mountain and The Moron is a 3D Rage Platformer about a Uncle who is down on his luck, and watches a podcast telling him to "Climb a mountain to become Enlightened".

title: Arcane Archer
description: Arcane Archer is a 3D platforming FPS speedrun game where you must use explosive arrows to blast yourself across gaps and up walls to reach the goal! Use the power of your explosive arrows to parkour your way through an assortment of stages, and shoot for the top of the leaderboard!

title: Riftseekers
description: Use your abilities to defeat enemies, avoid traps, collect gems, and score enough points to summon bosses. Defeat these bosses to open rifts to randomized biomes. Collect upgrades in-between stages to ensure survival. In this endless arcade-style roguelike, how many points can you get?

title: On Donuts and Holes
description: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

title: Reverie in the Moonlight
description: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

title: All Aboard! The Twilight Train
description: All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a first-person narrative-adventure set on an interdimensional train. Explore the train, talk to the passengers, drink carrot juice, and help fellow passengers make it to their destination off this weird train.

title: La Galerie des Toilettes
description: Explore a museum containing the word's greatest collection of toilet art.

title: Velocity Riders
description: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping 3D bike racing adventure! Zoom through stunning environments with ultra-realistic graphics and smooth controls.

title: Grim Trials
description: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

title: Four Directions
description: Four Directions is a turn-based strategy game that incorporates mechanical tasks and card skills based on the war chess game. Players will control 15 heroes, with different professions, use a variety of card skills, open mechanical devices on the chessboard map and confront the enemy head-on.

title: Guardian Grids 2
description: A super casual and relaxing tower defense game, fully upgraded from the previous generation! Light roguelike elements — click to choose your card each round!

title: Sable's Grimoire 2
description: Sable's Grimoire 2 is a visual novel featuring monster girls in a magic academy setting. This is a sequel to the original Sable's Grimoire game. It follows Sable's studies of magic and his budding friendships with his demi-human classmates and teachers.

title: Pixel Dash: Toast of Destiny
description: Haruka Ran is a high school girl who runs with a piece of bread in her mouth. She is searching for her fated encounter in a side-scrolling, furious JK anime action game! Let's go meet the man of your dreams with the anime-style story and slapstick sprinting action!

title: Dicey Words
description: The wordy roguelike. Dicey Words is a clever dice-based word builder where you roll letters, reroll like Yahtzee, and craft five-letter words for big points. Earn powerful badges that twist the rules, boost your score, and transform each run into a strategic puzzle.

title: Tiny Circuits
description: Solve bite-sized circuit board puzzles as a tiny robot! Connect components, become employee of the month in this logic puzzler with randomized layouts and handcrafted charm.

title: The Demon Queen's Dire Dilemma
description: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.

title: Lots of Cats on an Adventure
description: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure” is a game where you find hidden cats in comic strips, meow!

title: Lots of Cats on an Adventure: Alien Showdown
description: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure: Alien Showdown” is an expansion pack that contains the latter part of the story from the base game, meow!

title: Paper Pusher
description: A short atmospheric psychological horror game. Locked in a corporate contract, you must decide who lives and who dies based only on details that can be written down about them. How will you justify your choices?

title: Branch Collector
description: Challenge the cold in this cozy, rogue-like survival game. Collect branches to keep your fire lit, choose shop items and upgrades to increase your chances of survival with dozens of ways to modify your game play. Remember, the cold always wins.

title: Dhadoom!
description: High-speed parkour obstacle racing with wild courses, fierce rivals, and nonstop action!

title: Topiopolis
description: Topiopolis is a medieval world-building game based on accumulating and arranging tiles in the right places. You unlock new tiles when you place them next to others.

title: Alien Evolution
description: Alien Evolution is a Minecraft mod that overhauls hostile mobs with evolutionary variants and new behaviors, introducing mutated creatures, tiered life stages, and evolving biomes that alter combat and exploration.

title: Astral Lodge
description: A short 2D point-and-click room escape game in the spirit of flash games of the early internet. Explore a surreal, dreamlike room, using objects and clues to interact with the environment and escape.

title: 100 Barcelona Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Lisbon Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: Alice in Disguise
description: Help Alice rescue her friends to save Wonderland! Alice in Disguise is a stealth puzzle game where you disguise yourself as chess pieces and move like them to solve sneaky challenges. Use potions, magic mirrors, and quick thinking to stay hidden — all wrapped in a charming and colorful art style.

title: Software CEO
description: Build your own software empire from scratch. Manage projects, recruit staff, design components, and grow from a garage startup to a tech giant. Create SaaS platforms, sell software, or fulfill contracts. Balance quality, deadlines, and innovation in this relaxing yet deep business simulation game.

title: Goblin Vyke: The Thief Tycoon
description: At night, you're a thief, sneaking into dungeons to steal goods. By day, you're a cunning merchant, haggle to sell at high prices. Master the art of stealth, steal the Demon Lord's hidden treasures. Recruit employees, expand your business. Grow from a penniless goblin to a black market tycoon!

title: Bad NPCs
description: A Minecraft mod that enhances NPC behavior by making villagers and other humanoid mobs hostile and unpredictable. Expect aggressive dialogue, opportunistic attacks, and new AI patterns that turn settlements into dangerous, reactive environments, forcing players to adapt defenses, tactics, and interactions.

title: Naja Medjai
description: Naja Medjai is a family-friendly Souls-lite 3D platformer set in a mythical Ancient Egypt. Play as Rosetta, a Medjai warrior blessed by Apophis and Anubis, as she battles corrupted gods to save humanity.

title: Star-Coat
description: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

title: Sniffin for Bones
description: Sniffin for Bones is a cozy game about finding little hidden bones and solving some relaxing puzzles. Unwind with a game that doesn't force you to have fast reaction times, complex inputs or be a puzzle wizard.

title: Terra Pit
description: Dig, explore, and survive in procedurally generated mines. Collect ore, avoid traps, upgrade your gear, and go deeper for greater rewards — or lose everything.

title: Mine Safety
description: A fast-paced, highscore-driven game where you operate a mining platform with speed, precision, and zero workplace accidents.

title: Wake Explorer
description: Explore, map, and survive a vast alien ocean. Upgrade your fleet, follow cryptic orders, and uncover secrets in this atmospheric corporate exploration game.

title: Enemy Expansion
description: Is a mod that aims to make combat encounters in Minecraft more varied and interesting with the introduction of several new mobs. The mod is in continual development, consistently being updated by Nekomaster with all manner of creature to freshen up your combat experience.

title: Legendary Armory
description:
Legendary Armory is a mod all about integrating the Legend of Zelda series as seamlessly as possible into the base game experience. With a wide variety of items carefully integrated into the Minecraft experience. All with a focus on looking and feeling like they belong in the game. Inspired by Zelda Sword Skills of old, this mod aims to include the function of every Zelda item into the vanilla style of Minecraft. It's features are made to be fully functional, intuitive to the Vanilla experience, and most importantly fun to use.

Most of the items are not craftable, only a handful of things are able to be crafted. Instead you are meant to explore and obtain the items from structures already present in the game. There are multiple ways to achieve items, such as fishing, archeology, Villager trades, Piglin bartering, unique interactions with mobs, and structures! Most items have at least two ways of obtaining them so try your best. Most items are upgradable so, you will want to begin collecting Master Upgrade Templates! Upgrade Templates can be found from structures, archeology, and even fishing as they're vital to the mod's progression.

If you find yourself stuck, you will want to check in the advancements in game. There are over 40 designed to act as hints or push you towards achieving certain goals.

I've handcrafted everything in this mod myself to be something that ultimately I would want to play. From the over 318 hand made textures, ~30,000 lines of code, and all kinds of mental labor that's to say all of this goes together to create the ULTIMATE Zelda mod!

title: Legendary Creatures
description: It adds new creatures to the world. Those creatures are supposed to be aggressive and make the game more challenging.

title: Legendary Monsters
description: Legendary Monsters is a mod that adds 9 new challenging mobs to the game. for each mob there is a reward, for example unique weapon (for each weapon from this mod there is an unique ability) this mod also add some new structures to the game. There are also Friendly Creatures which you can ride or tame or even recolour by holding shift and right clicking with valuable items!

title: Occultism
description:
A ritual magic system centered around summonable spirits allows you to automate various tasks, store vast amounts of items, let demons mine in void dimensions, create powerful enchanted tools and jewelry, get support from familiars, and much much more.

Begin your journey by crafting the Dictionary of Spirits, and following that in-game guide, discover the secrets of the spirit world,
find otherworld groves hidden in plain sight by gaining the "Third Eye", and finally summon your first spirit.

title: Do You Even Forklift?
description: Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japan car culture! Use your forklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

title: Maltese's Fluffy Onsen
description: Run a bathhouse visited by animals! Maltese's Fluffy Onsen is a relaxing simulation game that you can enjoy while doing other tasks, as it sits at the bottom of your screen. Place baths with different temperatures and rest areas to help a variety of animal friends unwind.

title: Cursed Digilens
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Use a digital camera to take photos of ghosts. Get chased by monsters. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

title: Tower of Pestilence
description: In this survival/roguelite with a fanciful and monstrous art style, explore a dungeon where vampiric creatures and pestilence demons coexist. Play as adventurers with simple and accessible controls, improve your gear, and survive the hordes lurking in the tower !

title: Idle Cave Miner 2
description: Idle Cave Miner 2 is an idle incremental game about mining resources, crafting items, and improving your team of miners. Discover unique worlds, battle monsters, and strengthen your team on your quest to explore the mines, and find out what secrets lay at the bottom.

title: Sushi vs. Burger Race
description: It's time for a gourmet race battle like no other! Who will claim the top spot: Sushi or Burger?

title: Stip
description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

title: Song of Morus: Limbo Express
description: Third-Person On-Rail Shoot 'em up, where a young Taoist priestess and a deity of Death escort a spiritual train through the underworld. Nonlinear space, physics-defying action, and relentless speed await.

title: Entry Denied
description: A 2D point-and-click investigation game where you play as an undercover agent checking guest documents and appearances to uncover a criminal conspiracy.

title: Context Catacombs
description: Shift between first-person and text mode at will, allowing you to manipulate the 3D world with text commands and dungeon-delve into the text world using first-person movement!

title: Ready, Set, Block!
description: "Ready, Set, Block!" is a fast-paced PvP board game where players race to reach the opposite side first. Place blocks to slow opponents, use character abilities and items to outwit rivals, and plan your moves carefully in this turn-based, tactical race. Play locally, online, or vs AI.

title: Crystal Keeper
description: Mine crystals and defend your wall in this idle defense game. Balance resource gathering with combat as you upgrade your way through endless enemy waves.

title: Cryptid Keeper
description: Become the Cryptid Keeper. Track, catch, and collect cryptids, monsters, and aliens. Manage your own Cryptid Zoo, care for your creatures, and attract visitors while exploring the wild to discover new and mysterious Cryptid species to add to your Index.

title: They Call It Gravity
description: They Call It Gravity is a fast-paced single-player air combat game where you pilot a highly agile drone through handcrafted arenas in push-forward tactical action — dodge air defenses, expand your zone of control and destroy enemy swarms.

title: Can't Stop Rory
description: By day, grow and decorate your cozy post-apocalyptic farm to meet government quotas, unlock new decorations and scale your farm. But beware, when night falls, the Unfed will try to take away everything that you've built. Lay traps, build turrets and deploy mechs to defend the last sustainable haven.

title: CryptidCam
description: Head out into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

title: Succubus Roulette
description: Play Succubus Roulette with a deck of 8 cards. Two enter. One comes out. Bet your ass to roll the dice. Good luck.

title: The Gentle Golem
description: The Gentle Golem is a relaxing open world exploration game inspired by Zelda and PowerWash Simulator! Clean up the corruption that's encroaching on your home! Grow plants to help you traverse, or just grow pretty ones! Explore the Cloudlands at your own pace. Can you uncover its mysteries?

title: Powerfall
description: Powerfall, a 3D dystopian platformer set in the year 2500. Your task? Return the power (literally speaking) to the people by parkouring your way to the top of the skyscraper that withholds it all.

title: Ultra Core Dive
description: SHOOT AND DODGE your way through the underground arenas in this Dark Chaotic Arcade Twinstick Shooter! Don't get consumed by the noise!

title: Idle Reincarnator
description: An incremental RPG where you reincarnate through lifetimes, mastering professions, unlocking skills, and exploring mystical realms.

title: Blessed
description: Blessed is a fast‑paced, 2D top‑down co-op arena shooter where you and your friends team up as "blessed" heroes to battle endless waves across elemental realms, and more in intense action.

title: Frontline Command
description: Frontline Command is a tactical auto-battler where you control a squad of soldiers through intense missions in a modern military setting. Use strategy and combat skills to outsmart tough opponents as you navigate challenging battlefield scenarios.

title: Underfishing
description: You just arrived in hell. Nothing left to to do but contemplate the life you lived, and fish. Fish out ancient treasures, upgrade your fishing abilities, and face your biggest regrets in this narrative fishing game! Will you manage to fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life?

title: Abyssborne
description: Abyssborne is a dark fantasy roguelite that thrusts you into a shadowed, ever-changing dungeon, teeming with enemies, upgrades, and untold power.

title: Across the Obelisk: The Sunken Temple
description: Lost beneath Aquarfall, an ancient temple has been uncovered. But its final guardian is never the same. The deeper you go, the more the past reveals itself — secrets of amphibious races, forbidden rituals, and dangerous relics await.

title: Fofumia
description: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

title: Shape Blast
description: Shape Blast is a short, arcade roguelike where you bounce a ball between two paddles and blast waves of shapes. Unlock tons of upgrades and customize your build. Keep the flow and find new strategies every game.

title: Inverta
description: Defy gravity in Inverta, a 2.5D puzzle-platformer set in a ruined world. Flip between surfaces, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover apocalyptic secrets. A unique challenge awaits!

title: PuppetShow: Lost Town
description: After discovering a new system of caves, the entire town is excited to explore, until Suzy is kidnapped by a mechanical beast! Emerging from the darkness and startling the townfolk, the creature causes a cave-in behind him, leaving no trail to follow. Track the creature down and explore the mysterious caves in PuppetShow: Lost Town.

title: Untamed Ehizia
description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with multiple experimental game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

title: Idle Tree Keeper
description: Idle Tree Keeper is a relaxing idle/incremental game where you care for a mystical tree. Generate resources, unlock upgrades, evolve, and progress even while offline. Free to play with optional in-game purchases.

title: Beastopia
description: A strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics, where players compete for financial dominance in the Animal Kingdom through clever investments and bidding.

title: Vegetables of Mass Destruction
description: An action hack 'n' slash roguelite where you play as a feisty raccoon tasked with saving the farm animals from evil robots by his master, Sensei Cow. Use the destructive power of vegetables and team up with your trusty chicken and pig pals to rescue farm animals and destroy the robot invaders!

title: Apothecary of City X
description: Run a warm, cosy apothecary in a cold, dark city. Grim-cosy management sim with card combat and loveable weirdos.

title: Corebound
description: Corebound combines automation and deckbuilding into a unique strategic experience. Battle mysterious constructs as you build production lines to generate the cards you need. Optimize your decks and factories, expand and fight your way to the mountain’s core.

title: Broom and Boom
description: Blast goblins with gunpowder and magic as you ride your assortment of broom and broom-like apparatuses in this twin stick arcade shooter. Customize your witch and cackle for Victory!

title: Lunatix
description: Enter the twisted dreamworld of Lunatix in this first-person psychological horror experience. As a test subject you'll navigate a distorted and ever-changing landscape, where reality blurs with nightmare. Solve interactive puzzles to unravel the mysteries of your subconscious and the forces at play.

title: Beetleball
description: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game to ever exist.

title: Cats & Pandas
description: Hidden Cats & Pandas is a hidden object game. The player's task is to find all the cats and pandas that are hidden in different parts of the map.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas Stories Los Santos
description:
Total conversion mod for GTA San Andreas that tries to recreate a "San Andreas Stories" faithful to what Rockstar could have done after the launch of LCS and VCS (based on these) and also taking into account the limitations of the PSP.
