description: Blockremental is an incremental game mixing management, exploration, and strategy. Control a drilling platform, dig through a mysterious island, face powerful golems, and challenge a legendary dragon in a calm and captivating adventure.

title: Perished Truth
description: Inspired by classic "Resident Evil" and "Saw", prepare for an adrenaline-fueled survival horror following the story of Shinji Ueda, a struggling father who finds himself the subject of a twisted series of life-or-death trials. Fend off ravenous zombies, solve puzzles, and escape the trials...alive.

title: Don’tGetCaught
description: An overlooking angle battle game, operate characters to avoid constant enemy attacks, collect gold coins and experience, choose different combinations from a variety of random weapons, and defeat the final enemy

title: Backyard Baseball '01
description:
Backyard Baseball 2001 is the second Backyard Baseball game, and the fourth overall game, in the Backyard Sports franchise. Build your roster from iconic Backyard athletes and legendary MLB players. Strike out opponents, hit homers, and earn hilarious Power-ups. Play ball!

This version replaces three players (Barry Bonds, Frank Thomas and Ken Griffey Jr.) with generic characters with similar stats, as well as changes the Cleveland Indians to the Cleveland Guardians, removes "Oakland" from the Athletics' name, and removes the digital scans of the professionals' trading cards and online play.

title: Kamata
description: Join Nia in a cozy adventure to save the future of her island! Clean up the tropical paradise of Zimzemba by recycling, composting, and uncovering hidden secrets. Upgrade your gear, make friends, and solve the mystery behind the island's pollution.

title: Palia: The Elderwood
description: Welcome to the Elderwood! Step into an ancient overgrown forest teeming with magic in the Elderwood Expansion — Palia’s biggest update to date! Explore the new Adventure Zone and discover powerful artifacts and relics, complete exciting new quests, meet mischievous (but cute!) critters, find loads of new collectibles, decor, and so much more!

title: Galactic Coffee Shop
description: Grow your coffee enterprise from a single stand to an empire stretching across the stars! Go from grinding beans to hiring employees to buying buildings to consuming planets! Bring the gift of coffee to the stars!

title: The Organized Capy God
description: Help Capy God organize all his creations. Sort, stack and group items in this relaxing and chill game!

title: Toon Siege
description: Call the banners. Prepare your army. The siege has begun. Toon Siege is a minimalist action strategy game about building an army and attacking castles. Guide your battering ram and soldiers through the maze of obstacles and fortifications to reach the enemy castle and become its new King

title: Soul of the Dungeon
description: Survive against hordes of ninjas, upgrade your character with coins dropped from enemies, get unique skills with cards from chests, and face powerful bosses in this fast-paced, top-down shooter with rogue-lite mechanics.

title: Viral Reload EX
description: Viral Reload EX is a sci-fi shoot-em-up with a unique dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom before he destroys the moon?

title: Duskmarch
description: Create a hero, explore, fight, and unravel stories in Duskmarch RPG!

title: Golgalian
description: Pilot the tank Golgalian in an endless micro shoot 'em up inspired by arcades old and new. Blast mechs, dodge bullets, and compete on the global leaderboard!

title: Wanderburg
description: Drive your Castle on Wheels into battle in this minimalist medieval roguelike of roaming fortresses! Devour entire villages, build your modular arsenal of siege weapons and arcane machinery as you grow with every stronghold you crush.

title: Dreamship Sugarcube
description: This is a gamejam work developed by a team of four people within ten days. It is a third-person 3D space adventure game. Its core gameplay involves simulating jumping and flying under the gravitational force of planets.

title: Playomoji
description: Playomoji is a chaotic and fun 2D platformer you can play with up to 16 friends. Jump, slide, and take the weirdest paths to move forward, or sabotage your rivals and knock them off course!

title: Future Cowboy
description: A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge.

title: Popit Game
description: Play Popit Game — a massively multiplayer roguelike card game. Сlimb a tower of Blocks. Use game-breaking Popits to defeat other players. Chain strategic combos to boost your score and sabotage your rivals on the live leaderboard.

title: Action Game Course
description: This action-packed game is the result of the Action Game Course by UNF Games—a complete beginner-to-pro game development training using Unreal Engine 5. This project showcases exactly what you'll build step by step in the course.

title: DSS 2: War Industry
description: In this real-time grand strategy game, command armies, build cities, and manage a dynamic economy. Establish automated supply routes within your territory to streamline production. Fortify your defenses and brace for intense battles.

title: Moonlight Traveler
description: This is an action game focused on combat, where a girl returns from the abyss to explore her own secrets and redemption, trapped in a cycle of battles.

title: Dracamar
description: Join Caliu, Foc, and Espurna on a journey full of adventures in the magical island world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and fight to free the Okis. Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the bridges and reconnect the islands. Get ready to fight the evil King Crad and save the world with your friends!

title: Dino Quake
description: Join Mina and Kiwi to stop an alien invasion from outer space! Dino Quake is a platformer arcade game where you hit the ground to create quakes, stun enemies, then kick them to trigger epic avalanches. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op!

title: Break Shot Hero
description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

title: Love x Crotch x Gym
description: With a well-toned physique, opportunities for romantic encounters will come knocking on their own. Just imagine, if one day you could spend two months in an all-female fitness center, serving as the exclusive one-on-one personal trainer for these VIP members. How wonderful would that be?

title: Vampire's Best Friend
description: Vampire hunters are after a mischievous vampire girl, and it's up to her pet bat to save the day. Flap through peril in this open-ended precision “batformer” with a unique control scheme that re-contextualizes precision platformer trappings and flips them upside-down!

title: Acornia of the Stars
description: You must sprint, jump and homing attack your way through the different worlds that you encounter along the way, are you up for the task of saving Acorn kind?

title: Worker: 7549
description: 7549 was one of the worker class servants. That was until this mine turned from a peaceful workplace into a headquarters of rebellion. This place is now filled with the remnants of the relentless war between humanity and robots. Illuminate your path through the darkness and dust.

title: Mighty 1990
description: A hilarious retro game mixing text-based adventures with point-and-click mechanics! Solve puzzles, roll the dice, and shape your story with multiple endings in a pixel-perfect 16-color world. Relive the charm of classic games with a modern twist!

title: Drill Beat
description: Drill Beat is a puzzle-rhythm game where you control an animated bit that moves to the beat. Navigate through its puzzling landscape, and collect golden cogs to progress. Explore deeper into this mysterious mechanical world and uncover what lies at the bottom.

title: Master of Balance
description: Are sudden promotions and superpowers a blessing or a curse? After an accident, your fate has been changed. Faced with eccentric bosses, difficult colleagues and relatives, the only way to keep the balance of life is to make careful choices so as to reclaim the initiative of your destiny.

title: Beyond the Red Door
description: A first-person walking simulator horror (60 mins). As a desperate father, explore a nightmare hospital to retrieve the red skull—the only key to breaking the barrier trapping your daughter's soul. But the building remembers you... and your dead wife walks here.

title: Shirohebi and the Tower of Mercy
description: In this roguelite RPG, Nemesis climbs the Tower of Mercy and discovers its secrets. He can meet and team up with other characters, and learn their reasons for climbing the tower. However, he needs to be cautious as he continues, since an entity is taking his strength away.

title: Complex 629
description: Narrative psychological horror in vivid colour. Explore a surreal Icelandic apartment block built by the Devil. Shovel through snow with your bare hands and Converse with other residents while navigating between non-euclidean apartments and gathering money to escape the violence of Grandfather

title: Shrooms! Tower Defence
description: You can’t spell ‘Fungus’ without ‘Fun’! Shrooms TD is a quirky 3D tower defence game with procedurally generated islands, endless replayability, and a cast of mushroom defenders you command to fight off invading lumberjacks.

title: Lap of the Gods
description: When the sun shines on the Lap of the Gods, it is blood red. And when it rains, the sky sobs. Explore a strange world populated by even stranger beings in this story-driven adventure as Marion attempts to undo a mistake on a universal level, before everything she has ever known becomes Undone.

title: The Triminals
description: The Triminals is a fantasy roguelike blending squad tactics & deckbuilding. Lead 3 heroes through randomized adventures, collecting cards and making strategic choices in turn-based combat to unravel mysteries of time & space.

title: The Broken Clock
description: A Japanese fantasy role-playing game in the pure style of the SNES classics. Join Ray, Eliza, Lera and Nets in an exciting adventure where human ingenuity and obsession cause all kinds of problems that they will have to fight to save their world.

title: Roam0120
description: A point and click horror game linked to Feldup's AT Connect ARG

title: U4iA: Season 1
description: What could be better than restart your new life at an exotic Caribbean island nicknamed Euphoria?

title: Rust and Patina
description: A story about transience and acknowledging needs

title: Orbital Mechanic
description: Master spaceflight and progress through realistic orbital mechanics challenges of increasing complexity. Plot maneuvers to coordinate transfer orbits, gravity assists, and high-stakes rendezvous.

title: Mau Squared
description: Mau² is a deck builder Roguelite based on classic games such as Mau-Mau and Uno. Get as many points as possible to guarantee your victory even if you don't clear your hand, and upgrade your deck to make sure you always stay on top.

title: Plague Genesis
description: In Plague Genesis, Peter wakes up in a secret laboratory after a failed experiment. Surrounded by monsters and soldiers, he fights to survive while a deadly infection transforms him into the perfect biological weapon... or into the nightmare no one anticipated.

title: Dying with Thyself
description:
In the abnormal land known only as DFW Texas, strange and exciting things occur on an almost daily basis...

Unless you live there and are used to it.

Mark Goodrich, a junior in high school, tries to find excitement in his life yet continuously fails to do so. Instead, he has to deal with the everyday bores of being resurrected from the dead, preventing a nuclear launch at school, fighting alongside robot maids from the Soviet Union, and going up against one of the most dangerous weapons ever created: a cardboard box.

Join him and his group of friends as they go through their boring high school life while looking for excitement.

title: Mysteries of FangClaw
description: An immersive horror-adventure game. Betrayed by a trusted friend, Baxter finds himself trapped in an abandoned gold mine. Set traps, gather creature samples, and make life-or-death decisions to survive. Can you face the horrors lurking in the darkness of the night?

title: Pigkaboo
description: Survive by getting dirty! You’ve been captured by a pig-like creature. Escape this nightmare alone or with up to 4 friends in co-op mode. Leave trails, distract the monster, solve puzzles, and find your way to freedom. But beware—the pig will find you, and when it does, there’s no mercy!

title: Strife Lords
description: In this epic turn-based multiplayer board game adventure with Strife Lords! Play in 2, 4, 6, or 8 player modes, commanding footmen, spearmen, and a powerful king. Capture farm and mine tiles for gold, control major sites, and outmaneuver your rivals. Strategize to become the ultimate Strife Lord.

title: Game of Fitna Vol. 1
description: Game of Fitna Vol. 1: A thrilling death game visual novel set in 2030. Play as Zayn, a high school student thrown into sinister survival games known as "TEST." Fight for your life, uncover shocking truths, and face intense moral dilemmas in this mature, thought-provoking experience.

title: Konjie
description: A fast-paced 3D third-person combat game featuring dynamic weapon combos, wave-based challenges, and character customization. Adapt, fight, and conquer!

title: Undead Fortress
description: Undead fortress is a simple and pure first-person shooter game that tests players' shooting reflexes and upgrade combinations.Players take on the role of a survivor in a post-apocalyptic world, constantly fighting against the pursuit of bio-armies and zombie waves.

title: Sery: Into the World of Myths
description: Dive into the mythical dream world of Sery for an epic adventure. In this precision 2D platformer, Sery must restore balance between the real world and the dream world, battling malevolent figures that invade her dreams.

title: One & Done
description: Explore dungeons and fight monsters using four unique weapons in One & Done. Switch weapons strategically, face powerful enemies, and conquer labyrinth-like dungeons with dynamic strategies for victory!

title: Asterix & Obelix: Searching for the Black Gold
description: An adventure game only released in Germany but comes in German, French and English. It is essentially a digital version of the comic book “Asterix and the Black Gold” with voice acting, several minigames and an encyclopedia about Asterix and various things mentioned in the comic.

title: Sense Cook
description: Have you ever cooked like this? Try to rule the kitchen with three characters who can't see, hear or speak! Sense Cook is a chaotic and fun cooking game for co-op play with friends. With teamwork, manage the chaos and prepare delicious meals!

title: Niskala: Sacred Knowledge of Leyak
description: "Niskala: Sacred Knowledge of Leyak", inspired by Balinese culture, local wisdom, Balinese folklore, as well as diversity in Bali and of course with the help of sources to dig up information about "leak/leyak".

title: Auto Dungeon
description: Conquer the Astral Plane, Summoner! In this roguelite autobattler, build a powerful army in a vast, procedurally generated world. Collect cards, defeat foes and rival summoners, and equip, enchant, and mutate your creatures. Defeat the five champions and recover your stolen rings!

title: The Uncultured
description: The Uncultured is an art museum management game where you turn visitors into artists. Manage your museum, introduce people to art, nurture their talent, and display their creations. Can you transform the uncultured into creators and build the museum of your dreams?

title: Bally Fears: The Paradox
description: In Bally Fears: The Paradox, you play as Reyes, a young child. Your mother recently passed away, but Reyes does not know yet. As a result, your father keeps you in his office. The game starts when you receive a call from your father, warning you about something...

title: Ultimate Golf Battle
description: Multiplayer Golf Game with up to 12 players. Different modes, play turn-based or simultaneously. Choose from over 50 holes you want to play or play randomly selected holes. Choose a new item before each hole to help you get to the finish faster or to hinder the others.

title: Phantom House
description: Phantom House is a third-person survival horror game that plunges you into an abandoned house once home to dark rituals. Explore eerie halls, face unspeakable horrors, and rely on your wits and weapon to survive the unknown.

title: Starfall: Inferno of Worlds
description: Are you ready to embrace the challenge? In "Starfall: Inferno of Worlds" you will experience an adventure like never before, crafting your own legendary tale!

title: Super Golden Odyssey: 3d Platformer World
description: Super Golden Odyssey takes you on a thrilling 3D adventure through vibrant fantasy worlds! Discover hidden secrets, conquer moving platforms and explore twisting tubes. Experience breathtaking landscapes filled with surprises and endless fun!

title: Soulbound Roguelike
description: As heir to the fallen Divine Beast Sect, restore your clan by exploring procedurally generated Jianghu realms, forging pacts with mythical beasts, and combining Martial Skills × Blessings × Enchantments to craft your ultimate combat style—experience intense, satisfying roguelite action!

title: Cardrunners
description: Cardrunners is a fast-paced roguelike card deck-building game set in a gritty cyberpunk world. Build your deck, equip powerful trinkets, and engage in tactical grid-based combat to outwit your enemies.

title: Disappeared
description: Disappeared is a horror game, whose central aspect is exploration and stealth progression. You are Axel, camping with your wife, Deb, in a forest. She suddenly disappears. You need to make sense of what happened and find a way to save her, while being attacked and chased by powerful beings.

title: Lord of Metal
description:
Lord of Metal is a single player story-driven management simulator game about organizing Rock music festivals bringing a dystopian world back to life. Gather your crew, book bands, sign sponsors, claim festival grounds and bring some Rock to the masses!

In Lord of Metal, you're a disciple of the almighty Metal God, tasked with reviving the world's passion for hard rock and metal. To achieve your goal, you need to host festivals going from small roadside gigs to mega events for thousands of fans.

Get ‘under the hood’ of heavy music industry: gather your crew, book bands, land sponsors, build & manage fests and make decisions that matter. Travel the vibrant world of the game and enjoy the stories and mechanics based on real music industry experience brought to you by pros.

title: UltraGirl Alters
description: In this SRPG game, you work for the internet giant INFI-X and become the manager of the virtual combat idol group Alters. you will command five giant girls in rubber suits to fight monsters on the new tokusatsu stage,Uncover the company's secrets…accompany the girls to grow into true idol legends.

title: A Song in Elyel Nalore
description: "A Song in Elyel Nalore" is a 2D Metroidvania adventure set in a world of swords and magic. Accept a dangerous guild mission that leads you into a deadly journey. Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and face tough challenges in this dark fantasy action RPG.

title: Dichotomy Illusion: The Coser Disassembly Incident
description: "Dichotomy Illusion" is a Shin Honkaku mystery visual novel that combines real-world entertainment elements with physical locations, utilizing ACGN (Anime, Comics, Games, Novels) subculture knowledge to solve criminal cases and uncover the truth.

title: Tactical Ghost
description: Tactical Ghost is a thrilling, realistic tactical game where you eliminate threats with precision and flair. Master your abilities for high scores and epic combos. Can you devastate your enemies with the biggest combos possible?

title: Tricks, Treats and Mirrors: An EoG Side Story
description: "Trick-or-Treat" doesn't always get you a treat.

title: Anomalous Railroad Crossing
description: "Anomalous Railroad Crossing" is an escape game where you search for strange happenings, set at Japan's most famous railroad crossing. - You suddenly realize that you're standing on a road leading to a railroad crossing with an ocean view. Escape from a world invaded by strange happenings!

title: Greedy Darts
description: Darts roguelike game. Greedy Darts is a deckbuilder where you clear various darts games using enhanced darts and modified rules.

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description: Join Maria on an unforgettable journey through the world of Sintonia to rescue her beloved pups. Forge unlikely alliances, face epic bosses, and outsmart every challenge in a universe brimming with magic and adventure.

title: Idle Critter Adventure
description: Pick your first Critter and head off on an adventure, even if that's away from your PC! Choose an area in the Dorma region and leave Alfa to battle trainers and capture new Critters. Unlock areas filled with new Critters and defeat Clubs on the way to becoming a Critter Champion!

title: Burial of Shortcake
description: "The Burial of Shortcake" is an unpredictable story. It is a new visual novel with characters which are created/designed by voice actor Nozomi Sasaki, whose "expressiveness" shines throughout her career as a performer.

title: Hell and Back
description: Climb up the layers of hell, bring chaos by disturbing each one. Work together with a once-fallen demon to reach your salvation.

title: Neoclassical: Chromaticist
description: Playing Classical Music and Classical gameplay in a new way. An alternative aesthetic and classical Feeling. A great chance to reach the first step of classical music. Rotate the falling blocks, and master the color and music. By the way, it could save your neck somehow!

title: Two Sides: Voyage to the Mainland
description: Two Sides: Voyage to the Mainland is a management game where you play as a divine being who guides his people using his incredible powers. Will they be cute, overly benevolent people, or a people who live from day to day with no respect for anything?

title: Judah Knight: Knights & Demons - Chapter 1
description: Judah Knight: Knights & Demons is a visceral single-player action-adventure slasher that plunges you into a dark, demon-infested world. Wield your blade and unleash brutal combos against relentless enemies in a fight for survival.

title: Clicker Kingdom
description: In Clicker Kingdom, manage and expand your kingdom by collecting resources with every click. Unlock upgrades, build structures, and recruit allies to automate tasks and enhance your realm. Aim to create the most powerful kingdom in this fun and engaging incremental adventure!

title: MultiPlanetary
description: In the sci fi world of MultiPlanetary you Jump, Shoot, and Explore your way through a solar system controlled entirely by a corporation! Thwart the robot uprising in this adventure inspired by the PS2 era Ratchet And Clank games!

title: Sleep Herd
description: Explore, collect, fight, and light your way through a dark and dreamy wonderland in this 2-4 player resource management campaign!

title: Rag Doll
description: Fighting based on physics. Rag Doll is a 2D game with cartoon graphics, where you control the character's head, and the body moves according to the laws of physics! Play Story Mode, fight in multiplayer or local battle 1 vs 1!

title: Grorb: Grow the Orb
description: Expand. Gather. Evolve. Shape a simple sphere into a boundless force by harvesting energy and unlocking powerful upgrades. Discover hidden synergies, optimize your growth, and push beyond every limit. How far will you go?

title: Smuggler City Simulator
description: Build, expand, and customize your own office. In unique worlds blending Cyberpunk and Middle Eastern themes, sell your products, smuggle them through customs, and boost your profits. Use your wit and creativity to become the best in this exciting world!

title: My Last 20
description: Your goal on this mission is to survive for 20 seconds on the space anomaly zone avoiding asteroids, cows [MOOOOW] and all kind of stuff and extract as many Space Tokens as possible and adquire unique and crazy astronauts (spoiler, there is a wiener).

title: Spark Quest
description: Get ready for a race against the clock where you'll control a team of bulbs with unique abilities! In each level, you'll help these fragile bulbs overcome obstacles, rescue their companions, and finally light up in their sockets before time runs out.

title: The Forest of Black Eden
description: Stranded on an island crawling with terrifying creatures, you must survive, build, and uncover its dark secrets. Escape or be one of them with lost dream.

title: Outlawyer
description: An upcoming visual novel set in Purgatory during World War 1. Take the role of Ned Kelly, former Australian outlaw turned lawyer, and the fallen angel Azazel, his partner and apprentice, as you help save souls from eternal damnation, while uncovering a mystery of biblical proportions!

title: Fishing Alone
description: Fishing Alone is a game where you play as an automata service robot, endlessly fishing in a tranquil, post-apocalyptic world, uncovering fragments of the lost human past.

title: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator
description: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator is a fun real-time strategy game with ragdoll physics. Protect your tower and destroy the enemy's.

title: NecroMerc
description: Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy.

title: Guns and Spookies
description: Fast-paced, wave based arena shooter roguelike with hand-drawn 2D art. Unlock new weapons, items and characters with unique abilities to move through five distinct stages full of enemies and bosses.

title: Basketball Simulator
description: Basketball Simulator delivers a true-to-life basketball shooting experience with intuitive controls. Step onto the court, sink impossible shots, and feel the crowd roar as you chase greatness. Will you become the ultimate three-point legend in your city?

title: Futuralia
description: Futuralia is a simple mining simulator with the old "flash games" look. It features a red smiling male vessel, which the player can use to collect ores, experience and get stronger with him. The game also has a "rebirth" system, which is often seen in grindy games.

title: Pixel Fortress: Tower Defense
description: Pixel Fortress is a retro-inspired tower defense game packed with fast-paced real-time strategy. Build your defenses, command powerful abilities, and unleash devastating energy blasts to hold off relentless enemy waves. Can you master the battlefield?

title: Blademancer
description: Blademancer is a brutal and bloody JRPG where every choice shapes the fate of the realm. Explore a vast world, descend into treacherous dungeons, and endure relentless battles. Will you become the savior the world needs, or the scourge that brings its downfall?

title: Heat Retreat
description: Your home town is forced to evacuate: assemble your party, choose a vehicle and grab supplies before hitting the road in search of refuge. Manage your resources and barter, scavenge, hunt or steal along the way to survive in a rapidly warming world filled with hard choices, danger and dysentery.

title: Gangster Boss Simulator
description: Conquer the city in Gangster Boss Simulator! Build your criminal empire by producing drugs, crafting weapons, and trading illegal goods. Rise from a small-time gangster to a feared gang boss in this thrilling open-world experience. Seize power, dominate territories, and rule the streets!

title: Silent Express
description: In this 4-player online co-op horror game, you embark on an adventure by summoning a mysterious train. You must find and defuse bombs in an 8-carriage train. However, beware, there's a blind conductor and dangerous creatures chasing you. Race against time, find the bombs, and survive!

title: Keebee
description: A first-person shooter where you have 45 seconds to massacre fleeing ragdolls. Pile up bodies, earn points, and dominate the global leaderboard. The more brutal you are, the higher you score. Happy massacre!!

title: Soul Cards
description: Soul Cards is a retro single-player deckbuilder roguelite. Customize your deck, recruit powerful characters, modify your cards, and defeat the devil and his minions to get your soul back!

title: Pokertown: Cheater's Paradise
description: Step into Pokertown, a seedy underworld run by gangs and mobs filled with loan sharks, laundered money, and Texas Hold'em Poker. Learn to cheat your opponents by marking cards, stacking the deck, and other underhanded techniques. Just don't get caught...

title: Dark Labyrinth
description: You have stumbled into a world shrouded in darkness, where your body has transformed into that of a strange creature. Using your ability to dispel the darkness, you must explore and learn within this mysterious realm, uncovering the truth of this world while seeking a way to return to your own.

title: High on Life 2
description: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

title: Golf Pro Simulator
description: Golf Pro Simulator lets you step onto the green, line up your shot, and feel the thrill of a perfect swing. Enjoy a relaxing day under the sun, challenge friends in local multiplayer, and master different clubs to climb the leaderboard. Time to hit the fairway!

title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
description: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

title: Fatal Grounds
description: Fatal Grounds is a tough 2D precision platformer with a minimalistic dark artstyle.

title: Bullet Coven
description: This is a side-scrolling Rouge shooting adventure game. You'll become one of the Bullet Witches and explore the abyss in search of a variety of abilities and power-ups to defeat the monsters of the abyss. The game contains hundreds of gun and bullet abilities and magic。

title: Fire Hop
description: A platform shooter game with following fireballs, various enemies, parkour & more!

title: Fishing Pro Simulator
description: From quiet waters to rare trophies.

title: Super Meat Boy 3D
description: Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux – IN 3D!

title: Academy: Become a Hero
description: Time-based challenges, precise jumps, and special abilities in an immersive academy to become the next hero.

title: Drone Warfare: Global Ops
description: At the forefront of aerial combat and at the heart of modern warfare, Drone Warfare: Global Ops places you in the cockpit of a TB2 unmanned aerial vehicle. This game offers a realistic and thrilling combat experience that only a drone pilot can truly experience.

title: Astroplanet
description: You have damaged the ship and ended up on a mysterious planet where the air is unsuitable for breathing. You have to save yourself by creating an atmosphere suitable for life. Build a base, master resource management, terraform the planet, and grow food so you don't starve to death.

title: Dragon March
description: Dragon March is a modern and challenging spin on the classic game of Snake. Guide Cereal, The Metal Dragon, through levels full of obstacles while rescuing other Metal Dragons along your path. As your line increases, so does the danger. Bumping into almost anything causes a game over. Reach the exit and you win the level!

title: Beast of Reincarnation
description: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

title: Gold for Retirement
description: You are a knight, albeit not young anymore. You still prefer your vocation: saving pretty and not really princesses, fighting mighty and tiny monsters. Nevertheless, you love gold much more! So it's time for you to hit the road and earn enough gold for retirement.

title: Xenna: The Invasion
description: Face endless hordes of zombies and monsters in this intense shooter, where you can play in first-person, third-person, or top-down view. Unlock new weapons, recruit powerful allies, explore new maps, and take on increasingly challenging enemies.

title: Clowntown
description: An off-beat co-op party campaign for 2-8 clowns. Collaborate or sabotage your way through hand-crafted action puzzles and evolving minigames that will have you laughing, screaming, and honking with your friends.

title: Phoenix's Faye
description: A girl who has practiced martial arts since childhood finds herself, for some unknown reason, trapped in a fantastical world. She must continuously fight to find her way back home! This is a high-difficulty action game featuring intense combat, immersive scene atmospheres, highly oppressive NPCs.

title: Phantom Incident
description: Low poly horror. A paranormal streamer investigates an obscure urban legend referred to as the "Phantom Incident". In documenting the journey, the more he uncovers, the less it makes sense.

title: Bullet Ballet
description: Bullet Ballet is a Wild West action FPS game that follows John Maxwell Goldman, a man searching for answers and his missing father. Set in the unforgiving frontier, this comic book-inspired journey places the fate of a father and son in the hands of the Wild West.

title: Grounded 2
description: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

title: Through His Eyes
description: Through His Eyes is a psychological horror game where a father, trapped in a haunting time loop, must uncover the truth and escape from his house to find his daughter but a dark presence won’t let him go. Unlock doors, solve puzzles and break the cycle.

title: Mystic Merchant
description: Quirky store management game where you run a shop for adventurers. Start small and turn your humble store into a bustling marketplace. Adapt to a dynamic economy, setting prices, hire staff, acquire market permits and expand your shop.

title: FluffyInn
description: This is a special inn located at the bottom of your computer desktop, where everyone—from staff to customers—is fluffy! Unlock and purchase different facilities to improve customer satisfaction, earn more coins, then become the ultimate manager!

title: Undead Presidents
description: Undead Presidents is a chaotic, round-based zombie survival shooter with a satirical twist. Play as infamous world leaders in solo or 8-player co-op, battling undead hordes while uncovering dark conspiracies. Arm yourself with insane weaponry and rewrite history—one zombie at a time.

title: Hexa World 3D
description: HEXA WORLD 3D is a cozy 3D puzzle game with procedural levels. Earn XP, unlock skins and maps, use powerful boosters, and master three unique game modes.

title: Doodle Knight
description: 2D Drawing Puzzle Platformer

title: Snowmelt Manor
description: Snowmelt Manor is a puzzle game where you push boxes to solve challenges. Explore an abandoned manor deep in the forest and gradually uncover its mysteries.

title: Wild Shot: Animal Savior
description: The fate of the captured animals is in your hands. Plan your attacks, outsmart the poachers, and prove that one skilled shooter can make a difference in the fight for wildlife. Are you ready to take the shot?

title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Heavenly Spear
description: Unleash 12 new gods in a mythic Japanese campaign and multiplayer. Command powerful samurai, shadowy ninjas and creatures from Japanese mythology in this epic expansion.

title: Journey Through the Undead
description: Blast through hordes of relentless zombies in an action-packed journey across a stunning, mutated world. Arm yourself with guns, melee weapons, and grenades as you fight for survival through eerie ruins and deadly swamps.

title: Mudang: Two Hearts
description: MUDANG: Two Hearts is a narrative-driven, third-person action adventure that blends tactical stealth, visceral combat, and cinematic storytelling set on a politically volatile Korean peninsula.

title: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf
description: Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui. Whether you're a returning hero or a new adventurer, step into a world where a new, ancient mystery emerges from Novo's hidden depths. But as they scour these depths, a new threat will put their unbreakable bond to the ultimate test, guiding Lana to confront her destiny amidst encroaching shadows.

title: Aniimo
description: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

title: Destiny Isle
description: "Destiny Isle" is a visual novel that combines survival horror, multiplayer combat, and puzzle-solving elements. Set in a mysterious isolated academy, players take on the role of newcomer Xu Fan, uncovering the academy's chilling secrets while navigating between darkness and hope.

title: The Map Is the Thing
description: The Map Is the Thing is a casual, mind-bending puzzle game. Explore a dungeon where you solve puzzles by folding your map to open new paths. Find keys to defeat barriers and find the fabled GaMuffin.

title: At Fate's End
description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

title: Ogrüuk
description: Ogrüuk is a 3D platformer stealth game where ogres have captured all your dogs! You must save them before their cooking pot is at the right temperature! Sneak between monsters and keep away from their lights or you'll also be their dinner!

title: Queen's Cards
description: Roguelike deck-building strategy game. Combine decks compatible with your chosen playstyle, deliver satisfying damage, and cast powerful spells to defend your territory in this card-themed strategy game.

title: Persona 4 Revival
description: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

title: Yumi's Adventure
description: This is an action-adventure game where a magical girl embarks on a journey through a fantasy world. Take control of the protagonist and dash through eight diverse stages. At the end of each stage, a powerful boss awaits the player.

title: IzanamiYako
description: Aim to escape while avoiding the spirits that lurk in the darkness and destroying the torii gate. Can you escape or will the darkness consume you?

title: Sea of Thieves: Smuggler's Tide - Season 17
description: Order of Bone and Blade Skeletons have been hard at work in the Skeleton Forts, installing traps and hoarding weaponry – and now they’re under assault by the Dark Brethren’s Phantom fleet! Carve your way through this mêlée, unlock the Weapons Cache by defeating a Master of Arms whose skull serves as the key, then slay your way through the remaining threats to stake your claim to the Vault…

title: Periapsis: Eclipse
description: Conquer the Settled Galaxy in Periapsis: Eclipse, a unique roguelite where gravity, heat and the physics of space are the keys to conquest. Master orbital mechanics, real-world inspired weapons and nuclear rockets to outmaneuver dozens of hostile ships and claim victory for the Exiled Empire.

title: Invincible Vs.
description: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is a first-person shooter set in 2035, co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software. The game features three main modes: a cooperative campaign playable with up to four players or solo, multiplayer with 6v6 and 20v20 modes, and the round-based Zombies mode. Multiplayer features a perk system split into combat specialties, weapon prestige progression, and scorestreak rewards.

title: Echoes Below
description: Echoes Below is a tactical first-person shooter set in an unforgiving open-world survival environment. Build and fortify your base, craft essential gear, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Explore a hostile archipelago, hunt for resources and engage in intense firefights.

title: Eternal Night Metro
description: A first-person, high-atmosphere horror game that includes elements of horror without jump scares. The main plot follows the protagonist, who, while working late and on the way home, accidentally enters a threshold space. Players must either find an escape according to the rules or stay here forever.

title: Lost Child
description: Are You Lost? Wander endless corridors where shifting environments, sinister voices, and echoes of real events create a chilling atmosphere. Andrey doesn’t remember who he was, but the walls know the truth. It’s time to remember everything.

title: Silo
description: A first-person exploration and platforming game with high-speed third-person arcade action. Navigate the depths of the SILO, survive intense descents through hostile skies, and uncover the secrets buried within its vast, mechanical walls.

title: Love Mart
description: Where retail management meets heartfelt romance in a vibrant anime world! Build and customize your shop, overcome exciting business challenges, and forge deep bonds with three unique, compelling characters. Every decision drives your success in both business and love! ✨

title: 32, Dandelion Drift
description: Discover the secrets held within the old House on 32, Dandelion Drift. In this classic Visual Novel you'll find joy, hope, but also remorse and terror.

title: The Window 8
description: Welcome to The Window 8, a psychological horror experience that watches as much as it is played. This isn’t just a game—it’s a doorway. Follow my voice. Trust my guidance. I will lead you to see our god.

title: Isekai Mining Defense
description: NAD blends tower defense with roguelike, crafting, and sandbox elements, offering a rich gameplay experience with a main story, unlockable content, multiple endings, and more!

title: Crownbreakers
description: Insatiable, hyper-charged capitalism has the magical city in a chokehold. Crash into the tyrants' districts and build your deck as you push forward. Use your heroes and your cards to fight back against criminal syndicates and demonic billionaires in this turn-based card-game brawler.

title: Awaysis
description: The ultimate dungeon brawler. A revolutionary, physics-fueled throwdown where you’ll jump, slide, and collide on your adventure to restore peace to the Awaysis - an ancient floating relic under attack by forces of great darkness!

title: Psycholytic
description: Reality and illusion are a thought apart. Switch worlds, solve puzzles, and reshape your perception in the first-person puzzle game Psycholytic.

title: The Gatekeeper of Scarlet's Mansion
description: In this Touhou doujin STG, you don't attack enemies by shooting bullets. Instead, use punches, fairy maids, and Spell Cards to fulfill gatekeeper's duty. On top of that, learn how to build combos, win a lot of blue points, and experience the exhilarating feeling when they fill the entire screen!

title: GameOn!
description: Run your own video-game studio in this engaging simulation! Design hit games, manage your team, and compete with rival studios for the global ranking. Balance your finances and research new upgrades. Follow market trends to build your legacy as the ultimate game development master! Let's GameOn!

title: Medieval Archer Simulator
description: Medieval Archer Simulator is a most true-to-life test of skill, wherein ye taketh up bow and arrow as an archer. Train across the king's lands, hone thy aim, and prove thy worth to stand as guardian of the realm. Dost thou have the skill to prevail?

title: In Silico
description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

title: Hololive Gorogoro Mountain
description: Push your favorite to the top! A simple and fun 3D action game—just keep pushing!

title: Hotpot Defense
description: “Organize and arrange the unique Tabémons at will and defend the hotpot from the onrushing enemies!” This is a tower defense food battle to save the world by defending the dark hotpot.

title: Sky Reclaimers
description: Sky Reclaimers is a real time strategy game where you command a fleet of aerial craft and wage war across the skies! Build zeppelins, gunships, and laser machines to battle fearsome dragons and rival enemy commanders. Harvest resources, build and micro manage your airships!

title: Idolz
description: The most badass online multiplayer fighting game, where you can kick your friend's or your favorite idol's ass. It's not just about throwing punches, but also insults and trash talk. The war is on!

title: The Visitor Effect
description: What if your world was a lie? Outsmart inventive puzzles to escape the glitching simulation that holds you captive. Question reality and uncover a dark conspiracy while evading rogue security systems in this innovative puzzle-adventure.

title: Mister Gato Idle: The Meowsiah
description: Mister Gato Idle is an idle and incremental game where you can play minigames for rewards. There are no red dots, no ads, no P2W, no daily tasks, no MTX! Find unique items that change your gameplay, choose what randomly generated skills you use. Play the minigames Banjo Hero and Grand Theft Meowto!

title: Bashing Brutal
description: Bashing Brutal is a fully Physics-Based combat game, focusing on melee fighting. Experience the Brutal life of a Gladiator, Bash your opponent's heads in with Maces, Boxing Gloves, Baseball Bats.

title: Job Battle Simulator: Accurate Physics Showdown
description: Jobs gone wild! Farmers drop cows, chefs toss flaming pans, office workers hide on the toilet while flinging TP. Clowns fly. Coders hack health ... This is not a battle—it’s a full-blown job meltdown! Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created

title: Steady, Steady, Steady!
description: Steady, Steady, Steady! is a chaotic delivery game for 1 or 2 players in couch co-op. Work together with a tiny team of robots and try to balance your cargo through wild weather, puzzling obstacles and chaotic challenges. Will you reach the goal with your delivery still intact? Welcome to the team!

title: Losted Mind
description: Losted Mind is a linear shooter with horror elements. The game takes place in our time. The main character is a man experiencing mental problems, at some point, as it seems to him, beginning to lose touch with reality.

title: Detective Firefly
description: In Detective Firefly, your job is to solve cases by meticulously filling in the report with the locations and actions of all suspects at the time of the murder. Interrogate all witnesses, search for evidence, and form hypotheses to uncover the identity of the criminal and bring them to justice.

title: Touch Fish
description: Touch Fish is a casual fish-raising wallpaper game with a built-in console featuring lots of mini-games, truly a must-have for home, travel, and slacking off at work.

title: Star Loot
description: A co-op sci-fi looting game where you and your animal crew raid derelict space wrecks, dodge traps, collect valuable junk, and survive with limited oxygen and questionable teamwork.

title: Gun Paradise
description: A tense 20-minute battle, using firearms and skills to eliminate enemies. Upgrade and select MODs to enhance yourself, complete various battlefield missions to learn skills, and obtain weapon materials. Maintain rapid growth in abilities to survive in the game.

title: Helianthus
description: Horror, tension, and vulnerability. Fatal: Unleashed Darkness immerses you in a survival horror experience set in 1974 Texas. Trapped inside a motel scarred by biological trauma, you must explore carefully, survive the unknown, and find a way out before it is too late.

title: Beat the Markets
description: Beat The Markets is a turn-based digital board game based on investing in the stock market. Play with 2 - 6 players in this competitive financially based game inspired by 80s style board games and family game night. Players will buy investments and sell them to gain capital and sabotage their opponents with cards. Play is based on dice rolling and cards. The winner of the game is the player with the most cash on hand when the markets close at the end of the month.

title: Far Far West
description: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 4-player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

title: Meown
description: A 2d multiplayer sandbox MMO where players create, build, and trade in a vibrant online world.

title: Ambrosia Sky
description: You are Dalia, a deep-space disaster specialist dispatched to the rings of Saturn. You’ll lay victims to rest, clean up alien fungus, and research its strange origins. Adapt to survive, cleanse the contamination, and escape the crisis.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition
description: The Fate of The Forgotten Realms is in Your Hands. Return to the city of Neverwinter in Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition.

title: Arcane Eats
description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

title: Citizen Pain
description: Citizen Pain is a first-person dark fantasy action game. Play as Catherina, warrior princess of the Moges Empire, who gains the supernatural force known as Pain and leads the fight against the Undead King. Classic single-player combat meets modern visuals in this skill-based indie experience.

title: A Story of Questions
description: You are trapped, unable to walk, only a desk in front of you. The voice you hear is that of a woman on a speaker. Solve puzzles, interact with your surroundings, and make weighty decisions as you uncover a strange and disturbing story in this supernatural single-player horror mystery.

title: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
description: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

title: Scourge of Scavengers
description: Fly high!

title: The Orange of Tomorrow
description: The Orange of Tomorrow is a turn-based RPG where you must aim your attacks. Use the power of fate and the elements to discover the meaning of love, oranges and what tomorrow holds.

title: Star Fiction
description: Star Fiction is an indie RPG about the unusually weird journey of four creatures and their struggles to save the world. It blends classic RPG mechanics with a touch of real-world oddity to create a fresh and unique experience.

title: Sea of Souls
description: Discover the secrets of the cycle of reincarnation in Sea of Souls! A Turn-Based RPG with various Metroidvania elements to help you explore the world.

title: Streetsad
description: Monsters appear all over the world, and meanwhile, Joe and his friends join the pilgrimage to the Quenching, a globally televised event where something terrible is about to happen. Scramble all your stats, find all the missions, learn all the skills.

title: SkyRig
description: Build floating automated rigs in a volatile gas giant. Extract elements, synthesize compounds, and descend through atmospheric layers in this sci-fi systems-builder focused on chemistry, engineering, and survival.

title: Isekai: I'm an FPS Hero Who Was Summoned to Another World
description: I'm a die-hard FPS gamer. By mistake, I became the hero of an Isekai story. An incompetent Goddess summoned me to her world to defeat the Demon Lord. I'm in my element—guns, upgrades, action, and hordes of monsters to slay. There's even some magic… and Goddesses…

title: Cardcaster
description: Cardcaster is a small roguelike dungeon crawler. Dive into monster-filled depths, wielding ability cards as your weapon. Slash through enemies and bosses as you descend, building your deck and unleashing powerful combinations. Craft a new path to victory with each run by mastering card synergies.

title: Eurgava: Pathforgers
description: The Naga Cult has started a new march! Join the fight against them! In this simple 2D isometric combat game where the focus lies in the boss fights, everyone expects you to show the Naga Cult why the Pilgrims named you their champion!

title: Barotrauma: Home & Harbor
description: Home & Harbor is the upcoming expansion for Barotrauma. Introducing outpost ownership, building and management and a mysterious new faction: The Descendants, which will shake up the world of Europa's merry sailors.

title: Presidential Rise
description: Presidential Rise is a strategy management game where you lead a growing nation. Plan policies, manage the economy, respond to public needs, and face political dilemmas. Your leadership shapes the nation's success or its downfall.

title: Book Shooter
description: 《Book Shooter》 is a rougelike game that combines many different gameplays. There are a lot of magic, magic books, and enemies in the game. Come and fight!

title: Farever
description: Forge your legend in a forgotten realm! Farever is an online co-op action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world. Alone or with allies, explore wild landscapes and epic dungeons, build your own playstyle, craft powerful equipment and carve your path through dynamic combat and playful platforming.

title: Refuse & Reuse
description: Malicious forms of pollution invade the world in this 2D top-down RPG co-op Adventure. The heroes of this story? Leaders of their habitats, Goran the Deer, Ornelia the Orca, Pya the Scorpion, Arnold the Rafflesia, and their weaponry crafted from trash materials. Fighting trash WITH trash!

title: Stickman Puzzle
description: Stickman Puzzle throws you into a wobbly world of physics chaos, where every victory feels like outsmarting the universe and every failure is just an excuse to try something even dumber. Wiggle, fling, and fumble your way in this doodle-drawn adventure!

title: Mandrake
description: You are the last of the Mandrakes, a sorcerous line of gardeners. At long last, you’ve returned to your family's abandoned home. Make friends, tend your gardens, and put down roots. Fish, gather and delve in the wilds. Make a place for yourself, and uncover the mysteries your family left behind.

title: Roulette Pro Simulator
description: Roulette Pro Simulator drops you into the thrill of the spin—heart racing, palms sweating, and pure excitement as the ball bounces toward your fate. Will luck be on your side, or will you be shaking your fist at the wheel? There's only one way to find out!

title: Railborn
description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

title: Icarus: Great Hunts
description: The Great Hunts Campaigns introduce a new way to adventure in Icarus. Proceed down branching paths of decisions on your way to hunt down new Bosses. Your choices can affect the world around you, unlock unique, useful tools, or degrade the boss’s abilities.

title: Blackjack
description: Blackjack is a card game where players attempt to reach a hand value of 21 without exceeding it. Players are dealt two cards and can choose to draw additional cards or stand. If a hand exceeds 21, the player busts and loses the round. After all players stand, the dealer plays their hand, and the closest to 21 without busting wins. The game supports multiplayer with up to 8 players on a server.

title: Bird Coloring
description: Bird Coloring invites you into a peaceful world where creativity flows and stress fades away. Relax as you bring beautiful birds to life with your own unique touch, letting colors blend and imagination soar. It's your moment of calm in a busy world!

title: Neon Striker
description: Configure the weaponry on your ship to blast away enemies as you navigate through swarms of bullets and space battles. Each ship has unique customization options and playstyles.

title: Stars of Icarus
description: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

title: TerraTech Legion
description: Build the ultimate battle vehicle and rage against the machines in a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Master a deep, block-based vehicle-building system to survive an army of robotic foes driven by a crazed AI, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

title: RustNaut
description: A bullet hell game where you battle against relentless robots, covered in rust. Escape the chaos and make it home.

title: The Outer Worlds 2: Premium Edition
description:
The Outer Worlds 2 Premium Edition includes:
- The Outer Worlds 2 base game
- Up to 5 days early access
- DLC Pass for 2 future story expansions*
- Moon Man’s Corporate Appreciation Premium Prize Pack
- Access to The Outer Worlds 2 Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack

title: MythicZon
description: "MythicZon: a captivating 3D game merging survival, zombie combat & resource management. Navigate a world overrun by zombies, survive their onslaughts, upgrade weapons & fortify your base. Ready to face the horror? "

title: I Have No Change
description: “I Have No Change” is a first-person narrative game that immerses players in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholia, and the reflections of residents from Russia’s regions.

title: Gallery Theft
description: Gallery Theft throws you into a tense, heart-pounding heist where every step could be your last. Sneak through a maze full of security, and outsmart vigilant guards. Will you remain unseen?

title: Terrors to Unveil: Day Off
description: Jack Williams, a 26 year old hard-working man, is finally taking a day off after a long week at work. He decides to spend his day off at his quiet cottage for a weekend of relaxation. Little did he know what would happen during his stay there.

title: Jeff the Skinner
description: You have to escape Jeff`s house.. You have five days. Jeff the skinner is a scary horror game where you must escape from a sinister Jeff. Test your wits, stealth, and survival skills in an intense, immersive experience. Navigate through a terrifying environment, feeling the suspense at every step.

title: Bajka
description: Enter the realm of animal dreams! Experience adventures in places where humans exist only in legends. What path will you take, my friend?

title: Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad
description: Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad is a turn-based game where you can dodge skills through movement, blending elements of roguelike and squad building. While the combat is fully automatic, you need to move or attack at the right time, optimise your deck, and enhance your squad's strength!

title: Cards and Fables
description: Cards and Fables is a deck-builder with a strong roguelite component: strengthen your deck, create synergies, and face powerful enemies.

title: City of Dolorosa
description: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

title: Ashgard: Infinity Mask
description: Infinity Mask is a third-person platformer set in a rich Norse mythology-inspired world. Engage in intense combat, navigate dynamic environments, and solve challenging puzzles. Experience a deep narrative and innovative gameplay, offering a seamless and immersive adventure.

title: Echoes of Nara
description: Step into Sognaris where Nara must make his way through the nightmares of its inhabitants. Explore a variety of 2D and 3D worlds with unique mechanics and different visual styles overcoming the fears that may arise.

title: Make Your Move
description: Make your Move is a roguelike game where you control the map like a rubik's cube. Create combinations to improve your stats, discover new cubes, get equipment, and battle for resources to protect your world from the void.

title: Walk The Frog
description: Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home. Make new quirky friends, help each other out and overcome many obstacles. It’s a cozy and heartwarming point&click adventure with a unique and easy drag&drop puzzle style.

title: Nirih
description: Fly across worlds in pursuit of tainted souls that will corrupt the realms they inhabit. Boost your speed by following their trails and battling their creations, while dodging obstacles in your hunt.

title: Clayers
description: Roguelike game with a unique art style and experimental shooting mechanics

title: Thumps & Blows
description: Chaos and fun are guaranteed in this fighting game, where a quirky cast of stickmen battle each other using ridiculous techniques in fast-paced fights with easy-to-learn yet unexpectedly deep mechanics.

title: Deriva
description: Pilot a submarine through a world swallowed by the ocean and explore what remains of civilization. Catch unique creatures, trade across floating cities, and upgrade your vessel in a narrative adventure with exploration, resource management, and meaningful encounters.

title: Forza Horizon 6
description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

title: Highreach
description: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

title: Dark Fairy Tale
description: 《Dark Fairy Tale》 is a role-playing game blending light Rogue elements, deconstructing classic fairy tales into a shattered world of dark fantasy. Build powerful characters through weapons, talents, and runes. Gradually uncover the truth and save this world corrupted by evil thoughts!

title: Berserk or Die
description: This is an action game in which players attempt to survive by defeating a number of enemies which appear from the left and right sides of the screen. Use a unique keyboard-banging control scheme for maximum dopamine! Go Berserk, or Die!

title: My Little Cafe Nightmare
description: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

title: Hogtie
description: Dive into Hogtie, the ultimate Sokoban puzzle adventure where you wrangle mischievous pigs with your trusty lasso and guide them back to their pens! Explore different biomes, navigate tiles with unique effects, and enjoy character customization to make the gameplay experience truly yours.

title: Blippo+
description: Never bland and non-demand. You simply can’t find television like this anywhere else. Change the way you channel with Blippo+. Coming soon.

title: Flashloop
description: Due to engine failure, the ship crashes onto an uninhabited planet. During his research, the captain finds out that the area is inhabited by angry creatures, and the ship was shot down by someone. These mysteries of the dreadful planet will lead the researcher to terrible discoveries

title: Bus Bound
description: Step into the driver’s seat in Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21. Explore the vibrant city of Emberville in officially licensed buses, and help transform it into a pedestrian-friendly paradise—one stop at a time.

title: Solus Machina
description: A lone robot, deemed worthless by its creators, seeks freedom and adventure in a hostile world

title: Cosmic Run
description: Cosmic Run is a single player space roguelite game. Take on hordes of galactial enemies, build your ship strategically to overcome the hurdles, improve your stats to stand longer and flee the Zogark family from the galaxy. Fight, Build, Survive, Escape!

title: Hello Space
description: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

title: Deck of Memories
description: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

title: Astral Ooze
description: Astral Ooze is a sci-fi realtime strategy game. Your astral ooze generates over time for every controlled star. Expand your astral ooze and conquer the stars!

title: Thumblemania
description: Thumb up and fight! Thumblemania is an action-packed wrestling game where you smack down your opponents to become the “Strongest Thumb of the Univeeeeerse”!

title: Tow Game
description: Your beloved old car has broken down and needs to be towed! Hooked and hauled - time for the garage! But will you get there in one piece? The tow truck is in a hurry!
